companyDescription: Combining industry-leading research and experience to give you flexible coverage options and support the health of your employees.
descriptionHtml:
Site: Mass General Brigham Health Plan Holding Company, Inc.

Mass General Brigham relies on a wide range of professionals, including doctors, nurses, business people, tech experts, researchers, and systems analysts to advance our mission. As a not-for-profit, we support patient care, research, teaching, and community service, striving to provide exceptional care. We believe that high-performing teams drive groundbreaking medical discoveries and invite all applicants to join us and experience what it means to be part of Mass General Brigham.

Job Summary

Mass General Brigham Health Plan is an exciting place to be within the healthcare industry. As a member of Mass General Brigham, we are at the forefront of transformation with one of the world’s leading integrated healthcare systems. Together, we are providing our members with innovative solutions centered on their health needs to expand access to seamless and affordable care and coverage.

Our work centers on creating an exceptional member experience – a commitment that starts with our employees. Working with some of the most accomplished professionals in healthcare today, our employees have opportunities to learn and contribute expertise within a welcoming and supportive environment that embraces their unique and varied backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

We are pleased to offer competitive salaries and a benefits package with flexible work options, career growth opportunities, and much more.

Responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting complex data sets to provide actionable insights and support data-driven decision-making. This role will support ad hoc, network accuracy, and clinical reporting at MGB Health Plan using SQL and PowerBI.

Essential Functions

  • Collect, clean, and transform large and complex data sets from various sources for analysis.
  • Partner with aligned senior leaders to determine and plan for data analytics/reporting needs of a business unit or functional area(s).
  • Mentor and train other data analysts.
  • Identify trends, correlations, and anomalies in data and provide explanations or recommendations based on findings.
  • Create clear, concise, and visually compelling data visualizations, dashboards, and reports.
  • Present complex data and analytical findings in a meaningful and understandable manner to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Performs comprehensive quality assurance, ensuring that data and reports meet end-user specifications and are accurate and reliable.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree Analysis required; experience can be considered in lieu of a degree

Experience

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in data analysis required
  • SQL and PowerBI proficiency highly preferred
  • Healthcare experience preferred

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Strong knowledge of relational databases, SQL, data visualization, and Business Intelligence tools, such as Tableau.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to communicate complex workflows and data to a variety of audiences.
  • Project management skills and/or experience are a plus.
  • Knowledge and application of statistical analyses, including variance analysis, and statistical significance preferred.
  • Healthcare knowledge, particularly as it pertains to electronic medical record data, is preferred but not required.

Additional Job Details (if Applicable)

Working Conditions

  • This is a full-time schedule with a Monday through Friday schedule
  • This position is eligible for remote work from approved U.S. locations, subject to organizational requirements
  • Remote employees must maintain a stable internet connection and a secure, private, quiet workspace appropriate for handling confidential and protected health information
  • Remote workspace requirements, including privacy and security standards, may be verified in accordance with organizational policy

At Mass General Brigham, we believe in recognizing and rewarding the unique value each team member brings to our organization. Our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and any offer extended will take into account your skills, relevant experience if applicable, education, certifications and other essential factors. The base pay information provided offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications; however, it does not encompass all elements contributing to your total compensation package. In addition to competitive base pay, we offer comprehensive benefits, career advancement opportunities, differentials, premiums and bonuses as applicable and recognition programs designed to celebrate your contributions and support your professional growth. We invite you to apply, and our Talent Acquisition team will provide an overview of your potential compensation and benefits package.

EEO Statement

8925 Mass General Brigham Health Plan Holding Company, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religious creed, national origin, sex, age, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, military service, genetic information, and/or other status protected under law. We will ensure that all individuals with a disability are provided a reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To ensure reasonable accommodation for individuals protected by Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act of 1973, the Vietnam Veteran’s Readjustment Act of 1974, and Title I of the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, applicants who require accommodation in the job application process may contact Human Resources at (857)-282-7642.

Mass General Brigham Competency Framework

At Mass General Brigham, our competency framework defines what effective leadership “looks like” by specifying which behaviors are most critical for successful performance at each job level. The framework is comprised of ten competencies (half People-Focused, half Performance-Focused) and are defined by observable and measurable skills and behaviors that contribute to workplace effectiveness and career success. These competencies are used to evaluate performance, make hiring decisions, identify development needs, mobilize employees across our system, and establish a strong talent pipeline.

descriptionHtml:
Tokio Marine HCC (TMHCC) brings 50 years of service to the specialty insurance industry, today offering over 100 products to commercial customers in 180 countries around the world. Organic growth and over 60 successful acquisitions have grown our 2022 Gross Written Premium (GWP) to $5 Billion. Our workforce has grown to 4,300 worldwide … big, but not so big that you cannot make a difference. Our Good Company values, including integrity, empowerment, and commitment to customer service, and a culture of innovation, communication, and collaboration make TMHCC a great place to work.

For over 50 years, HCC Life Insurance Company, operating as Tokio Marine HCC – A&H Group, has been at the forefront of medical stop loss insurance. In addition to traditional stop loss, we offer captive and Taft-Hartley stop loss solutions, Organ & Tissue Transplant insurance and MedPlus insurance. Tokio Marine HCC – A&H Group is rated A++ (Superior) by A.M. Best Company and benefits from the financial stability of its parent company, Tokio Marine HCC.

  • This role is located onsite in Kennesaw, GA*

Position Summary

Performs data analysis and report development, working with internal teams. Understands the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and develops an understanding of current products and technology in order to design and implement solutions to meet business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Select appropriate business analysis approach.
  • Data analysis, validation, and report development.
  • Document data model and reporting model as needed.
  • Evaluate project complexity, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies.
  • Identify and communicate risks and issues that may require changes to plans or scope
  • Comply with and uphold organizational standards.
  • Respond to changing organizational priorities.
  • Obtain needed information from customers to form requirements.
  • Capture information provided in elicitation sessions.
  • Manage conflicts and issues to resolution.
  • Assess impacts of changes to requirements.
  • Prioritize requirements effectively based on factors including business value, cost to deliver, and time constraints.
  • Organize and synthesize large amounts of information provided by customers.
  • Understand appropriate use of various analysis techniques.
  • Develop abstract models that describe a business domain.
  • Identify and communicate factors other than requirements that affect which solutions are viable.
  • Assess solution proposals and demonstrate which proposal will be most effective.
  • Demonstrate skills in creative thinking, decision making, and problem solving.
  • Participate in Business Analysis, project team, or individual meetings with management, preparing discussion topics and presenting information in a professional manner.
  • Motivate and focus on delivering quality results in a team environment (continuous evaluation and improvement).
  • Provide clear, transparent, and frequent communication.
  • Provide continuous attention to technical excellence (self-development).
  • Work as part of a self-organizing team.
  • Perform other relevant duties and projects as assigned.

Education, Experience & Knowledge

  • Ability to apply knowledge of principles, practices, and procedures.
  • Business Intelligence Reporting Tools, such as MicroStrategy or Power BI.
  • SQL query skills against multiple databases such as, Oracle, SQL Server, and Snowflake.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills with an emphasis on confidentiality, tact, diplomacy, and professionalism to communicate effectively with employees, adjusters, agencies, agents, the State Departments of Insurance, and the general public.
  • Advanced organizational and analytical skills; demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Business Process Knowledge – Understanding of the related activities or tasks that are needed to produce a specific service or project.
  • Analytical Thought Process – Ability to think in a logical, step-by-step manner and come to a conclusion or solution to a problem.
  • Problem Resolution – Awareness of the need for problem resolution, the ability to identify and gather the critical resources needed to make a decision, and the facilitation skills to bring the group to an overall consensus.
  • Negotiation – Ability to reach an understanding, resolve points of difference, or gain an advantage to satisfy a project or business need.
  • Familiarity with relational database concepts and client-server concepts.
  • Ability to apply an understanding of one tool to other similar tools.
  • Ability to identify major tools in the marketplace and describe how they are used in any given situation.
  • Knowledge of and ability to use most of the major features of a tool.
  • Understanding of how a change to a component affects the system as a whole.
  • Actively participates in the creation of the technical design and architecture for feature(s) of a product.
  • Knowledgeable of industry changes, legal updates, and technical developments related to applicable area of the Company’s business to proactively respond to changing business environment.
  • Intermediate proficiency and experience using Microsoft Office package (Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Developing analytical skills as well an aptitude for decision-making and problem-solving.
  • Ability to work under pressure.
  • Ability to be given direction once and apply logic in future tasks.
  • Know when to ask questions or when to resolve on own.
  • Time management skills.
  • Flexibility and a willingness to learn.

Tokio Marine offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including:

  • Generous paid time off (PTO), 12 paid company holidays,
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with 6% company match.
  • Health and dental insurance, and vision plan available.
  • Company-provided long-term disability and life insurance.
  • Opportunities for advancement in a successful and growing organization.
  • Flexible work schedules and a great work/life balance.
  • Paid Parental Leave.
  • Volunteer Time Off.
  • Enjoy casual dress and work in a modern, comfortable office with free parking.

The Tokio Marine HCC Group of Companies offers a successful, dynamic organization experiencing rapid growth and are seeking energetic and confident individuals to join our team of professionals. The Tokio Marine HCC Group of Companies is an equal-opportunity employer. Please visit www.tmhcc.com for more information about our companies.

companyDescription: Wilson Elser is the preeminent defense litigation firm in the United States. At any given time, our more than 1,400 attorneys are engaged in some 100,000 defense and coverage matters, with many defending clients in various local, state and federal courts. For more than four decades, our litigation, coverage and trial lawyers have gained a reputation for taking on and prevailing in the most challenging and technical cases, frequently “parachuting in” to assume unresolved matters from other law firms. Our success also derives from winning on our clients’ terms and rigorously adhering to their guidelines. We are ranked 94 in the AmLaw 100 and 30 in the National Law Journal’s NLJ 500.
descriptionHtml:
At Wilson Elser, we are redefining what it means to work at a national law firm. With more than 1,400 attorneys across 46 offices nationwide, we are recognized among the top 100 law firms by The American Lawyer and ranked #30 in the National Law Journal’s survey of the nation’s largest law firms.

Our continued success is built on a culture of collaboration, innovation, client service, and mutual respect. We are committed to fostering an environment where employees are empowered to grow their careers, contribute meaningfully, and thrive professionally.

 

Summary

Data Analyst opportunity focused on turning raw data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will collect, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, uncover trends and patterns and present your findings in ways that help leadership make informed business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with proficiency in data visualization tools and excellent communication skills – able to make complex data clear and actionable in support of the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI,
    Tableau, or Excel.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and provide
    actionable insights.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements to data collection and management
    processes.
  • Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning through data analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics or related field.
  • 1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing databases.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence tools.

descriptionHtml:
This position is onsite at the Corporate Headquarters located in Kenosha, WI.

The Business Intelligence Analyst I designs, builds, and supports reporting and analytics solutions of moderate complexity. This role works with business partners to clarify needs, develops Power BI reports and data models, and helps ensure that data used for decision-making is accurate, timely, and well-documented. The position works with some independence but still receives guidance from more senior analysts on design, standards, and priorities.

Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements into clear report specifications, including metrics, filters, and visual layouts.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards, paginated reports, and reusable datasets following BI team standards.
  • Create and optimize basic to moderately complex data models and DAX measures to support reporting needs.
  • Write and maintain SQL queries or use existing curated data models to retrieve and transform data for reporting.
  • Perform thorough testing and validation of all new and updated reports, including data reconciliation to source systems.
  • Monitor report refreshes and usage; assist in troubleshooting performance or data quality issues.
  • Maintain documentation for owned reports, datasets, and data transformations, including data definitions and lineage.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, application, and business teams to resolve data issues and improve data readiness.
  • Contribute to the BI team’s standards, templates, and best practices; participate in peer reviews.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Management Information Systems, or a closely related field.
  • A bachelor’s degree in a specifically related field is preferred; equivalent work experience is acceptable in place of this requirement.
  • 1–4 years of professional experience in business intelligence, reporting, data analysis, or application development.
  • Hands-on experience building reports or dashboards in Power BI or a similar enterprise BI platform.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for querying and validating data.
  • Understanding of basic data modeling concepts (tables, joins, keys, measures, dimensions).
  • Ability to organize work, manage multiple requests, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Power BI semantic models, row-level security, and performance optimization.
  • Exposure to enterprise data warehouse or cloud data platforms.
  • Experience working within a structured SDLC, using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar.
  • Familiarity with data governance concepts and the use of shared or certified datasets.

Core Competencies

  • Technical Proficiency – Builds reliable BI solutions using standard tools, patterns, and practices.
  • Ownership – Takes responsibility for the quality and timeliness of assigned work and follows through on commitments.
  • Customer Focus – Engages with stakeholders to understand needs, clarify requirements, and provide helpful support.
  • Communication – Explains data and reporting concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Continuous Improvement – Looks for opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve existing reports and processes

Overview

The Business Intelligence Analyst III / IV is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise business intelligence and visual analytics solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. This role transforms complex data into meaningful reports, dashboards, semantic models, and analytical solutions that support operational and strategic business outcomes.

The associate partners with business stakeholders, technology teams, and data engineering partners to deliver scalable visual reporting solutions, establish semantic modeling standards, and translate advanced analyses into clear recommendations. Microsoft Power BI is the primary business intelligence platform for this role; however, the associate is expected to remain agile and use Apache Superset or other visualization tools when they are better suited to the business need.

As a member of an agile team, the incumbent contributes to solution design, development, testing, deployment, optimization, production support, report certification, and modernization of enterprise reporting assets. The role focuses on business intelligence and visual analytics rather than primary ownership of source-data engineering or Power BI tenant administration.

Level Expectations

Business Intelligence Analyst III: Designs end-to-end BI solutions, including semantic and metric layers, data models, reports, and dashboards. Applies advanced analytical and statistical techniques to move reporting from descriptive insight toward diagnostic analysis of performance drivers and customer behavior, while introducing predictive approaches where appropriate. Works independently with minimal guidance, leads solution components, partners with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, and provides technical guidance to peers.

Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Leads the design of complex, reusable BI solutions and serves as a technical lead for reporting and analytics initiatives. Balances regular delivery responsibilities with leadership of cross-functional projects, establishes semantic modeling and reporting standards, reviews technical designs, influences BI architecture and tooling decisions, and mentors analysts and developers across levels.

Responsibilities

  • Design end-to-end business intelligence solutions, including semantic and metric layers, dimensional data models, reports, dashboards, scorecards, and visual analytics products.
  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI semantic models, reports, dashboards, and analytical solutions using DAX, Power Query, and enterprise reporting standards.
  • Apply advanced analytical and statistical techniques to identify trends, performance drivers, customer behaviors, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Translate descriptive reporting into diagnostic insight and introduce predictive approaches where appropriate to the business question and available data.
  • Partner with stakeholders to frame analytical questions, evaluate findings, and translate complex analyses into clear, compelling recommendations.
  • Establish, document, and promote semantic modeling standards, reusable design patterns, visualization standards, and reporting best practices.
  • Support report certification by validating solution quality, consistency, usability, maintainability, performance, documentation, and adherence to established standards.
  • Publish and support Power BI solutions through Power BI Service, including Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Optimize report and semantic model performance, refresh reliability, storage-mode selection, and overall user experience across BI platforms.
  • Assess the downstream impact of design choices involving Import, DirectQuery, composite models, Row-Level Security, refresh strategies, and available Power BI capacity.
  • Evaluate visualization technologies and select Power BI, Apache Superset, or other appropriate tools based on business need, scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
  • Use Snowflake and other approved enterprise data sources to deliver reliable, scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Coordinate with data engineering and technology partners to ensure source data is available, reliable, understandable, and usable for reporting.
  • Document report definitions, calculations, assumptions, semantic models, technical designs, and support procedures.
  • Lead improvements to reporting processes, including automation of recurring outputs and reduction of manual effort.
  • Support report migration and modernization initiatives, including conversion of legacy reporting solutions to modern BI platforms and reusable semantic model architectures.
  • Perform testing, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, performance tuning, and post-implementation support.
  • Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement, estimation, status reporting, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
  • Provide technical guidance to team members through design, DAX, query, and solution reviews.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: Serve as technical lead for complex reporting and analytics initiatives, lead cross-team projects, review technical designs, and mentor analysts and developers across levels.

Qualifications

  • Advanced experience designing, developing, deploying, and supporting business intelligence solutions using Microsoft Power BI or comparable enterprise visualization platforms.
  • Strong proficiency with DAX, semantic modeling, dimensional modeling, Power Query, data visualization, and enterprise BI architecture.
  • Experience publishing and supporting Power BI solutions through Workspaces, Apps, Deployment Pipelines, and semantic model refresh processes.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize complex queries used in reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving, organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an agile delivery environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver reliable solutions with minimal guidance.
  • Must have the following experience:
  • Business Intelligence Analyst III: 4-7 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Business Intelligence Analyst IV: 7-10 years of relevant business intelligence, analytics, reporting, semantic modeling, or data visualization experience.
  • Experience developing enterprise dashboards, reports, semantic models, and visual analytics solutions.
  • Experience partnering with stakeholders to define business questions, gather requirements, assess findings, and deliver actionable reporting solutions.
  • Experience working with enterprise data platforms and large-scale datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Microsoft Power BI administration certification or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of Power BI administration concepts.
  • Strongly preferred experience with Microsoft Fabric features such as Lakehouses, Warehouses, Dataflows Gen2, Data Pipelines, Notebooks, Real-Time Intelligence, and related capabilities.
  • Strongly preferred experience using Snowflake as a primary enterprise data source for reporting and analytics.
  • Experience with Apache Superset or other business intelligence and visualization platforms, with the ability to select the appropriate visual tool for the business use case.
  • Experience developing or supporting Apache Airflow workflows.
  • Experience with Power BI Project (PBIP) formats and collaborative development of Power BI assets.
  • Experience using Git-based version control, including branching, pull requests, code reviews, and collaborative development workflows.
  • Knowledge of Power BI administration and architecture concepts, including capacity management, storage modes, licensing, workspaces, tenant considerations, governance, and performance optimization.
  • Understanding of performance and capacity considerations involving DirectQuery, Import mode, composite models, incremental refresh, and Row-Level Security (RLS).
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to generate or refine scripts, troubleshoot solutions, create documentation, support testing, and accelerate analytics delivery.
  • Working knowledge of Python, scripting, or related programming concepts, with emphasis on effectively reviewing, validating, and applying AI-generated code.
  • Experience supporting report certification, semantic modeling standards, and reporting modernization initiatives.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or a comparable agile work management and delivery platform.
  • Property and Casualty insurance, claims analytics, finance analytics, or enterprise reporting experience.

$109,675.00 - $172,200.00

Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

Sullivan & Cromwell LLP provides the highest quality legal advice and representation to clients around the world. descriptionHtml:
Sullivan & Cromwell (“S&C”) is seeking an analyst who builds and improves the technology behind financial reporting. Within our legal professional services environment, you will write SQL queries, develop reports and analytical datasets, automate recurring processes, and troubleshoot data and reporting issues. Your work will help Finance deliver accurate, timely information for management decisions.

The role combines hands-on technical delivery with an understanding of financial data. You will translate reporting needs into working solutions, reconcile results to source systems and accounting controls, and document how those solutions operate.

Responsibilities

  • Assist with the preparation and delivery of weekly, monthly, and ad hoc management reporting.
  • Write, maintain, and troubleshoot SQL queries to extract, join, aggregate, and validate data for recurring and ad hoc financial reporting.
  • Build and enhance reports, dashboards, and reusable datasets in business intelligence and financial reporting tools; maintain clear definitions for calculations and reporting measures.
  • Automate data preparation, reconciliation, and report production using Python, R, SQL, or other approved scripting and workflow tools.
  • Support data pipelines and scheduled reporting processes; investigate failed refreshes, missing records, duplicate data, and differences between source systems and reports.
  • Support and enhance financial systems and SaaS or cloud reporting applications, partnering with Finance, IT, and vendors on testing, troubleshooting, and controlled changes.
  • Translate stakeholder requests into data requirements, mappings, calculations, and acceptance criteria; test results before reports or changes are released.
  • Develop financial analyses and forecasting models for client and matter profitability, revenue, and compensation planning, using methods appropriate to the business question.
  • Document query logic, data sources, reconciliations, and operating procedures; explain findings and system issues clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.

In addition, responsibilities related to maintaining firm and client information are to be adhered to by all employees. This includes complying with the firm’s information security policies, protecting firm assets from unauthorized access, disclosure, modification, destruction or interference, and reporting security events or potential events or other security risks to management.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, financial systems, data analytics, reporting development, or a closely related technical role.
  • Hands-on SQL proficiency, including joins, common table expressions, aggregate functions, and window functions; ability to explain query logic and diagnose incorrect results.
  • Experience developing and maintaining reports or dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Dodeca, or a comparable reporting platform, including the underlying data preparation and calculations.
  • Experience building or maintaining a repeatable automated data or reporting process using Python, R, SQL, or a comparable approved tool.
  • Understanding of relational data structures, data transformation, reconciliation, and validation controls; ability to trace a reported figure back to its source.
  • Strong Excel skills for modeling, analysis, and reconciliation, together with experience delivering solutions through databases, reporting platforms, or scripts.
  • Working knowledge of financial reporting concepts and ability to learn how revenue, expenses, profitability, and compensation are represented in business systems.
  • Ability to document technical work, gather business requirements, and communicate clearly with Finance and IT colleagues.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with law-firm or professional-services financial data, including client and matter profitability, billing, collections, or compensation analysis.
  • Experience supporting financial SaaS applications or cloud analytics environments, particularly Oracle; AWS or Azure experience is also relevant.
  • Experience applying forecasting or statistical methods to a defined financial business problem.
  • Relevant technical certifications or an advanced degree in information systems, analytics, data science, finance, or a related discipline.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Compensation

The annual base salary range for this New York City position is $90,000–$120,000. When determining a candidate’s compensation offer, elements unique to each person are taken into consideration including but not limited to skill set, experience level, performance, professional certifications, degrees and location, as well as the needs of the Firm. The total compensation package for this position may include overtime pay, discretionary bonuses and other benefits. For a more comprehensive list of employee benefits, please visit Sullivan & Cromwell LLP | Careers | Professional Staff | Employee Benefits .

descriptionHtml:
At Wilson Elser, we are redefining what it means to work at a national law firm. With more than 1,400 attorneys across 46 offices nationwide, we are recognized among the top 100 law firms by The American Lawyer and ranked #30 in the National Law Journal’s survey of the nation’s largest law firms.

Our continued success is built on a culture of collaboration, innovation, client service, and mutual respect. We are committed to fostering an environment where employees are empowered to grow their careers, contribute meaningfully, and thrive professionally.

 

Summary

Data Analyst opportunity focused on turning raw data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will collect, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, uncover trends and patterns and present your findings in ways that help leadership make informed business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with proficiency in data visualization tools and excellent communication skills – able to make complex data clear and actionable in support of the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI,
    Tableau, or Excel.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and provide
    actionable insights.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements to data collection and management
    processes.
  • Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning through data analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics or related field.
  • 1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing databases.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.

descriptionHtml:
At Amentum, we believe that data tells a story — and we're looking for a Data Analyst Sr. who can help us read between the lines. If you're passionate about using analytics to solve complex challenges, improve performance, and support mission-critical decisions, we want to hear from you.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you won’t just crunch numbers — you’ll lead high-level functional and systems analysis efforts that shape how our organization and our clients operate. You’ll play a vital role in identifying trends, uncovering inefficiencies, and recommending actionable solutions grounded in data, experience, and hands-on insight.

This is more than just a technical role — it’s a leadership opportunity. You’ll act as a trusted advisor across multiple teams, applying your deep expertise to guide decision-makers through the full analysis cycle: from initial planning and data gathering to interpretation and implementation. Your contributions will directly impact organizational effectiveness and the mission success of those we support.

If you're ready to use your skills to influence change, drive innovation, and be recognized as an authority in your field — join us at Amentum and transform data into meaningful action.

Work Schedule: 8 hours 5 days a week within the hours of 6:00am – 6:00pm

Essential Responsibilities:

As a Data Analyst Sr. at Amentum, your days will be dynamic, intellectually engaging, and mission-focused. You’ll be a key player in turning complex data into strategic insights that drive organizational success. On a typical day, you can expect to:

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across business, technical, and leadership teams to gather data requirements and understand business challenges.
  • Extract, clean, and validate large data sets from various sources to ensure accuracy and consistency for analysis.
  • Develop advanced data models, dashboards, and visualizations to identify trends, forecast performance, and support decision-making.
  • Perform root cause analyses to uncover underlying issues and identify areas for process or performance improvement.
  • Lead high-level system and functional analysis efforts to recommend data-driven enhancements to business processes or system design.
  • Prepare and deliver technical reports, executive briefings, and visual storyboards that communicate complex findings in an accessible, actionable format.
  • Mentor junior analysts and cross-functional teams, sharing best practices and providing guidance on tools, methodologies, and data strategy.
  • Engage in continuous improvement initiatives, evaluating existing systems and procedures and recommending scalable, data-backed solutions.
  • Monitor key operational metrics, such as inventory trends and resource allocation, and develop models to improve forecasting and efficiency.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert, offering insight and leadership on analytics best practices, emerging tools, and industry trends.

This role calls for someone who thrives under pressure, is technically exceptional, and can see both the big picture and the fine details. Your ability to multitask, stay organized, and lead through complexity will be critical to your success.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or related analytical roles.
  • Proven experience extracting, cleaning, and validating large data sets from multiple sources for analysis.
  • Strong proficiency in analytical tools and languages such as:
    • SQL (T-SQL, PL/SQL)
    • Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables, etc.)
    • Python or R (for statistical analysis or data wrangling)
  • Experience with data visualization and dashboarding tools, such as:
    • Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik
  • Ability to translate complex analytical insights into clear, actionable recommendations through reports, briefings, and visualizations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders at all levels.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting root cause analysis and using data to drive business or operational improvements.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks under tight deadlines.

Clearance Required:

  • TS SCI with Poly

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field.

Minimum Years of Experience:

  • Related discipline with five (5) years of which at least three (3) years specialized experience.

Job Title: Commercial Intelligence Specialist

Location: Houston

Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities:

  • Power BI Development – Design, development, and optimisation of advanced dashboards, reports, and models within Power BI, ensuring usability and scalability across the business. This includes local desktop development as well as in the Power BI / Fabric service.
  • SQL & Data Modelling – Develop, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries to support analytics and reporting requirements.
  • Cross-functional collaboration – Working with a variety of stakeholders and seniority levels to understand business problems and provide solutions through interactive self-service reports.
  • Issue Resolution – Identify root cause of technical issues and responding to queries in a timely manner, including supporting other teams ad-hoc where necessary.
  • Continuous Improvement – Stay current with Microsoft BI & Fabric updates, recommending and implementing improvements to data workflows and reporting.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s STEM degree
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics roles.
  • Expertise in Power BI – advanced DAX, data modelling, performance optimization, and deployment.
  • Strong SQL skills with ability to optimize.
  • Microsoft Excel skills for ad-hoc analysis.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric a plus.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills - able to work effectively with others.
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions and deliver measurable business impact.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive nature.

Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking – Capable of aligning technical solutions with commercial objectives.
  • Collaboration – Adept at working cross-functionally and influencing decision-making in a matrixed organization.
  • Problem Solving – Able to diagnose data issues, propose solutions, and implement improvements quickly.
  • Commercial Acumen – Understands the dynamics of sales and commercial operations, ensuring analytics directly support performance improvement.
  • Professional Output – Strives to deliver solutions that are polished, professional, and easy to use

Commercial at AVEVA

Our Commercial team, comprised of over 2,000 dedicated colleagues, is the backbone of our customer relationships and business growth. From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.

If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team.

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

USA Benefits include:

Flex work hours, 20 days PTO rising to 25 with service, three paid volunteering days, primary and secondary parental leave, well-being support, medical, dental, vision, and 401K.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

First American Title Insurance Company, one of the nation's largest title insurers, provides comprehensive title insurance coverage and professional services for residential, commercial, and new construction purchases, along with refinances and equity loans. Join the global title operations team that supports title and escrow operations across the company, helping create a smoother path through each transaction for the customers, partners, and communities we serve. You’ll work alongside talented operations professionals and business partners to support title and escrow teams, improve the customer experience, help solve complex challenges, and move the industry forward. Along the way, you’ll be part of a supportive, relationship-driven culture where people are invested in your growth and success.

What We Do

As a member of the BI Analytics & Reporting team, you will design, develop, and maintain business intelligence solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights. This role combines traditional business intelligence development with modern AI-enabled analytics, helping drive data-informed decision-making across the Title organization. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, analysts, data engineers, and PMO to deliver scalable reporting solutions, dashboards, and automated analytics that improve operational performance and support strategic initiatives. Leveraging Domo and related technologies, you will develop reporting ecosystems that are AI-ready, automated, and aligned with evolving business needs.

Business Intelligence & Analytics Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain business intelligence solutions, dashboards, reports, and data visualization tools.
  • Build reporting portals, dashboards, data generators, and other end-user information resources.
  • Develop standard and custom reports that summarize business, operational, financial, and performance data.
  • Create scalable analytical solutions using Domo and related BI platforms.
  • Design and maintain semantic data models that support AI readiness, advanced analytics, and chatbot capabilities.

Reporting & Data Management

  • Gather, consolidate, and analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, consistency, and governance across reporting solutions.
  • Maintain and enhance BI tools, databases, dashboards, workflows, and methodologies.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for reporting improvements, automation, and process optimization.
  • Monitor and support existing reports, dashboards, and BI applications.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Communicate complex data findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Present business intelligence insights and trend analyses that support strategic decision-making.
  • Share updates on reporting solutions, tool enhancements, and metadata changes.

Automation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and implement reporting automation that reduces manual effort and improves operational efficiency.
  • Test and validate reporting solutions to confirm they meet business requirements.
  • Anticipate organizational, process, and system changes that may affect existing metrics and reporting.
  • Continuously improve reporting quality, usability, scalability, and performance.

Documentation & Delivery

  • Maintain accurate and timely documentation of requirements, technical designs, data mappings, processes, and operational procedures.
  • Maintain Jira work items, tasks, estimates, statuses, and acceptance criteria to support visibility and alignment with project objectives.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 2-4+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining business intelligence and reporting solutions.
  • Experience creating dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using BI platforms; Domo experience is preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical, quantitative, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Experience working with multiple data sources while maintaining data quality and integrity.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize work, and exercise sound judgment in decision-making.
  • Collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across business and technical teams.

Preferred

  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake and Databricks.
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, JSON, or similar technologies to support data analysis, automation, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience with semantic modeling, AI-enabled analytics, and automation technologies.
  • Understanding of data governance, security, and related best practices.
  • Project management experience or Major Domo certification.

This position will be accepting applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  • Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. ** First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act). First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements.

What We Offer

Our people first culture is built on creating a workplace where different perspectives are welcomed, respected, and valued. We believe teams are stronger when employees feel supported, included, and encouraged to contribute as themselves. Here, you’ll be part of a culture built on collaboration, respect, accountability, and continuous improvement — so you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and help move our customers, communities, and company forward.

Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

descriptionHtml:
The Sr Business Data Analyst role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase General Bonus Plan and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to launch your analytics career in the fast-paced world of supply chain? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst who is eager to apply data-driven thinking, build impactful visualizations, and support operational excellence. This is your opportunity to grow your skills, collaborate with warehouse leaders, and become a go-to resource for data tools and insights. If you're curious, analytical, and ready to lead, this role is for you.

Job Description

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will support warehouse operations by transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build dashboards, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. In addition to core analytics work, you’ll have the opportunity to lead projects across multiple sites, support site startups, and act as a point of contact for analytics community initiatives.


  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Implement and maintain standard reporting tools for the site or sector
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and analytics community initiatives
  • Lead knowledge-sharing sessions to promote data literacy and tool adoption
  • Manage analytics projects independently and across multiple sites
  • Design and implement data pipelines (ETL) from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources
  • Apply Python, R, or other analytics tools to enhance reporting and automation
  • Stay current with modern data analytics trends and apply best practices to improve processes
  • Support site startups as needed by implementing analytics tools and reporting frameworks


Required Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Extensive experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
  • Proficiency in writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
  • Experience designing and managing data pipelines and working with diverse data sources, required
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts, data modeling techniques, and modern analytics trends, required
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, required
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead cross-functional projects, required
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required


Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

Title: Data Analyst

Location: Houston, TX (Hybrid)

Salary Range: $90,000-130,000

Type: Full-Time

No C2C or 3rd Party Vendors at this time.

Reporting To: Director of Business Intelligence / Analytics Manager

Position Overview

A growing organization is seeking a Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across multiple business units. This individual will work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements, analyze operational and financial data, identify trends, develop dashboards, and provide actionable insights that improve business performance. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, experience working with large datasets, and the ability to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze business, operational, and financial data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance reports, dashboards, and data visualizations.
  • Gather reporting requirements from stakeholders and translate business needs into meaningful analytics solutions.
  • Perform data validation, cleansing, and quality assurance activities to ensure reporting accuracy.
  • Create recurring and ad hoc reports for various business departments.
  • Support KPI development, performance tracking, and executive reporting initiatives.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and provide recommendations to improve business processes.
  • Collaborate with IT, business teams, and leadership to improve data accessibility and reporting capabilities.
  • Document reporting processes, business rules, calculations, and data definitions.
  • Assist with data warehouse, ERP, CRM, and business application reporting initiatives.

Project & Data Environment

  • Enterprise business systems including ERP, CRM, HRIS, and operational applications.
  • Reporting and analytics environment supporting multiple business units and executive leadership.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Finance, Operations, Sales, Human Resources, and Information Technology teams.
  • Focus on reporting automation, dashboard development, data governance, and business intelligence.

Required Qualifications & Competencies

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Data Analytics Experience:

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or analytics roles.
  • Experience working with large datasets and transforming raw data into actionable insights.

Technical Skills:

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Power Query).
  • SQL querying and data analysis.
  • Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
  • Experience building dashboards, KPIs, and executive reporting.

Analytical Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis abilities.
  • Experience identifying trends, anomalies, and process improvement opportunities.

Communication Skills:

  • Ability to clearly present findings and recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
  • Strong documentation, organizational, and presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or NetSuite.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Experience with Python, R, or advanced analytics tools.
  • Exposure to financial, operational, or supply chain analytics.
  • Experience working in manufacturing, logistics, energy, construction, or industrial environments.


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, or military or veteran status. We consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with state and local laws, including the California Fair Chance Act, City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

descriptionHtml:
Join Aya Healthcare, winner of multiple Top Workplace awards!

Working closely with business partners and technology teams to transform data into clear, trustworthy information and actionable insight, the BI Analyst will help define business questions, priorities, and key performance indicators; investigate the source, definition, and context behind the data; and ensure that analysis is accurate, relevant, and easy to use.

Who We Are

We’re an $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform.

At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians, and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally.

Responsibilities

  • Business Partnership & Critical Thinking: Partner with business leaders to clarify the decisions behind analytical requests, challenge assumptions constructively, and recommend alternative measures or approaches when the requested analysis may not answer the underlying business question.
  • Problem Framing: Lead analytical discovery with stakeholders to translate ambiguous business problems into measurable questions, hypotheses, KPIs, and analytical approaches.
  • KPI Stewardship: Define, evaluate, and refine key performance indicators to ensure they are actionable, aligned to business objectives, consistently understood, and resistant to misinterpretation.
  • Insight & Recommendation: Explore data to identify meaningful patterns, relationships, anomalies, and trends; translate those findings into clear business implications, recommendations, and questions for leadership.
  • BI Solution Development: Develop reports, visualizations, dashboards, and custom extracts using business intelligence and data visualization tools.
  • Data Quality & Integrity: Analyze and validate data from multiple sources, understand database relationships and interconnections, and collaborate with BI and technology partners to resolve data integrity issues.
  • Solution Delivery: Participate in planning, technical design, development, testing, and delivery of BI solutions; create work plans and manage timelines and workflows to meet commitments.
  • Continuous Improvement: Review existing reports and analytical products for accuracy, consistency, usability, and continued business value; recommend when metrics, reports, or processes should be changed or retired.
  • Standards & Enablement: Research best practices, stay informed on BI tools and business direction, recommend standards and procedures, and design end-user training and supporting materials.
  • Team contribution: Provide guidance, training, and problem-solving assistance to other team members and contribute to a culture of analytical rigor and curiosity.

DISH Business requires streamlined, high-quality data reporting to empower key stakeholders, including executive leadership, sales, and marketing, with actionable insights. This role addresses the challenge of consolidating diverse data streams from multiple sources into cohesive, automated dashboards that highlight critical business trends and financial performance. By identifying reporting gaps and establishing robust quality assurance measures, this position ensures absolute data integrity across the department and drives proactive business decisions.

What Success Looks Like (Objectives)

  • Build, improve, and maintain meaningful dashboards for upper management, sales, and supporting teams to drive strategic decision-making
  • Collaborate cross-departmentally to identify emerging reporting needs and translate stakeholder requirements into scalable data solutions
  • Automate recurring and ad-hoc reporting processes, utilizing modern tools to reduce manual processing time and enhance department efficiency
  • Analyze complex queries and scripts to uncover trends, investigate outliers, and provide actionable business impact suggestions
  • Coordinate department quality assurance efforts, identifying and correcting account or data errors to maintain high-quality outputs
  • Leverage AI-driven tools and automation techniques to streamline repetitive data querying and reporting tasks

Core Skills, Competencies, and Key Experiences (What you’ll bring)

  • Strong analytical skills, with a proven ability to manage competing stakeholder requests and synthesize complex datasets
  • Critical experiences in executing advanced SQL queries and developing insightful Tableau dashboards
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities, allowing for seamless cross-functional interactions with all levels of management
  • Strong attention to detail combined with a problem-solving mindset to identify data trends, discrepancies, and immediate business impacts
  • Adaptability and curiosity, featuring a willingness to take risks, learn from failures, and adopt innovative reporting methodologies
  • Foundational AI literacy, including the ability to apply AI tools for data exploration and prompt engineering to optimize workflows

Additional Qualifications

  • Proficiency in or knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS to support advanced data initiatives

Candidates must be willing to participate in at least one in-person interview.

Visa sponsorship not available for this role.

Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Minimum Experience: 2-4 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting
  • Required Technical Skills:
    • SQL, Tableau, Microsoft Excel, and G-Suite

Compensation: $63,150.00/Year - $90,000.00/Year

Overview

The Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team plays a key role in the company’s planning, forecasting, and performance reporting processes. We are looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst who enjoys working with data, improving reporting workflows, and partnering with teams to enhance data quality and efficiency. This role blends technical skills with business understanding and offers opportunities to contribute to automation and analytics enhancements within FP&A.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize complex SQL queries, ETL processes, Power BI dashboards, and report pipelines
  • Support recurring reporting procedures, including validating and reconciling data from multiple system sources
  • Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes and lead automation initiatives
  • Investigate data discrepancies and resolve root causes
  • Perform various system administration tasks (user access, configuration updates)
  • Communicate effectively with technical and business partners
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, computer science, data analytics, or related field
  • 3-6 years of experience in a financial, data, or analytical role (FP&A experience is a plus)
  • Strong SQL (SSMS) and Microsoft Excel proficiency
  • Proficient with Power BI, Python, and Visual Studio
  • Experience with data validation, reconciliation, and KPI/reporting development
  • Experience with Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud a plus
  • Strong attention to detail, analytical mindset, adaptable, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship at this time.

Compensation

The base pay range for this position is USD $80,000.00/Yr. - USD $120,000.00/Yr. Exact offers will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

descriptionHtml:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are looking for a customer-centric and detail-oriented Data Analyst II to join the Customer Reporting team. Reporting to the Manager, Customer Reporting, you will be responsible for delivering custom and standard reporting that demonstrates the impact of Spring Health to its customers. You will collaborate closely with Customer Success and Subject Matter Experts to refine Spring’s storytelling strategy and data artifacts. This role is expected to support a combination of ad hoc requests and dashboard development.

Please note that this is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, with an expectation to be in the office 2–3 days per week at our 44 Montgomery Street location. Candidates must be based in the San Francisco metro area or able to relocate independently within 90 days of their start date. Occasional travel will be required for team on-sites. Periodic travel of up to 25% is expected for team collaboration and company events. If you are passionate about using data to create meaningful impact and thrive in a dynamic, customer-focused environment, we would love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do

  • Delivering analyses and dashboards to customers and internal stakeholders they need to tell compelling stories about Spring Health’s impact
  • Diving into different data sources, quickly building expertise on what is possible, and developing creative solutions based on your stakeholder’s needs
  • Developing a deep understanding of our products and how we tell the story of their impact to customers
  • Collaborate with Product to inform how we evolve our customer data story and expand our standard suite of reporting
  • Surface opportunities to automate and scale commonly requested reports and data sets
  • Become an expert working with our data stack including Snowflake, Looker, dbt, and Hex

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers and internal stakeholders are highly satisfied with the quality of work produced
  • Customers and internal stakeholders trust the data provided to them; reports and data sets are reviewed for data consistency and data quality
  • Requests are completed in a timely manner while still prioritizing a high standard of quality
  • Bring ideas forward that can reduce the amount of time spent manually pulling data to inform decisions
  • Dashboards and analyses deliver ongoing value to stakeholders

What You’ll Bring

  • You are strong with SQL and are able to effectively query data across many sources
  • You have 3+ years of working experience working with data, data visualization, and dashboarding tools (e.g., Looker, PowerBI, Tableau, etc.
  • Strong analytical skills and a keen eye for detail
  • You focus on impact, finding the things you can deliver that deliver the most value for your stakeholders
  • You have exceptional communication skills, are comfortable explaining technical concepts to a non-technical audience
  • You are humble, highly motivated, and thrive in fast-paced environments
  • You have a passion for successfully navigating ambiguous problem areas and learning new approaches
  • Prior experience with R is nice to have
  • Prior experience with dbt is nice to have
  • You are passionate about changing the face of mental health care, and Spring Health’s mission to remove all barriers to mental health resonates with you

Education

This individual will lead complex analytics initiatives from problem definition through delivery, partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable insights and data driven solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in SQL, Python, data visualization, and data analysis with the business acumen and communication skills needed to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. This is a hands-on role for someone who can independently manage analytics projects, identify meaningful trends and opportunities within data, and communicate findings that influence business decisions.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead complex data analysis initiatives, taking ownership of assignments from initial requirements gathering and problem definition through analysis, mapping, documentation, and delivery.

  • Query and analyze large, complex datasets using SQL to identify relationships, trends, anomalies, and business rules and support data-driven solutions.
  • Apply strong data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables, to support enterprise data initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain clear data documentation while supporting data governance standards, data quality, and integrity across assigned projects.
  • Collaborate closely with data engineers, data architects, analysts, and business users while developing domain expertise and providing guidance and mentorship to junior analysts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data warehousing, including experience supporting complex enterprise data projects.
  • Strong experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, Data Analysis, Data Mapping, and Data Warehousing.
  • Strong hands-on SQL expertise with demonstrated experience performing complex data analysis, data profiling, and source-to-target data mapping.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing and data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze source data, work through ambiguous requirements, and partner with business and development teams to translate business requirements into technical mappings and data solutions.

  • Short-term and long-term Disability Insurance
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan at 5% discount
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Accident Insurance
  • Transportation and Commuting Benefits
  • Banking Benefits
  • Pet Insurance
