As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you'll dive into data, build dashboards, and craft compelling scenarios that help our teams make smarter, faster decisions. Partnering across departments, you’ll transform raw numbers into game-changing knowledge—accurate, reliable, and ready to power the enterprise. Enjoy weekly pay, 401(k) starting day one, and health benefits. Whatever your career goals may be, let Mystic Lake Casino help get you there!

Job Summary: Provides business-related analysis results and reports to the enterprise by preparing comparisons, scenarios, and visualizations using business intelligence tools. Work closely with departments to transform data into critical information and knowledge that can be used to make sound business decisions. Core duties will be to provide data that is accurate, congruent, and reliable; and ensure information is easily available to users.

Elevate & Thrive: Key Responsibilities:

  • Extracts and analyzes performance information, creates reports and makes recommendations accordingly with in-depth analysis of all Gaming Enterprise and SMSC Community programs as requested.
  • Works directly with the Business Intelligence Development team and Sr. Business Intelligence Analysts to make recommendations for improvement to management for decision making purposes.
  • Extracts information, prepares consolidated forecasts, and analyzes trends for the enterprises business units in the areas of revenue, cost of sales, labor, and other operating expenses and makes recommendations accordingly.
  • May be requested to develop and/or assist in the development of special projects, reports, and analyses.
  • Assists in preparing Board, management, and divisional reporting packages, including summaries, analytical support, and graphs and charts.
  • Utilizes business intelligence tools and dashboard reports and provides input on improving source data.
  • Assist Business Intelligence team as a resource for other special projects as needed.


Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor degree in business, analytics or related field and 3+ years of Business Intelligence work experience OR combination of post-secondary education in business, analytics or related field and work experience with a focus in Business Intelligence equal to 7+ years.
  • 2+ years of experience in SQL Server Management Studio and query building including business intelligence tools.
  • 1+ year of experience with Tableau.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a self-directed environment and as a team member with excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, a strong work ethic, and demonstrated teamwork skills.
  • High level of proficiency with Microsoft products specifically Excel, Access, Word, Power Point and financial software packages as needed.
  • Experience with Advanced Data Analytics tools a plus.
  • Work experience in the gaming/casino industry a plus.

Occasionally, the employee is required to lift boxes up to 20 pounds.


SCHEDULING

This is a full-time benefits-eligible position, working Monday through Friday; 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. An employee in this position must be available to work occasionally on weekends and evenings, during peak periods.


TRAVEL

Local travel is required. Out of state travel is limited, but may be required for special training/conferences.

We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

About the Role:

The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a pivotal role in supporting McKesson Pharmaceutical Solutions and Services (PSaS) Group Purchasing Organization (GPO) and Practice Advisory Services through advanced analytics. The Business Intelligence Analyst will be responsible for generating actionable insights and analysis to meet the evolving needs of GPO customers and stakeholders and facilitate the organization's growth. Key areas of focus include GPO contract performance and trends, pharmaceutical manufacturer segmentation and contracting strategies, as well as physician reimbursement and clinical trends.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop and implement analytics, reporting, and visualization tools to effectively address inquiries from stakeholders and customers.
  • Perform ad hoc requests from stakeholders and manage large, complex, or cross-functional projects.
  • Conduct and support data-driven analyses to define and measure operational, financial trends, and strategic insights related to McKesson’s GPO and Provider Solutions Organization.
  • Design, maintain, and distribute customer-facing and internal dashboards that track GPO and membership key performance indicators.
  • Support GPO operational functions by managing internal/external reporting and tracking key performance indicators.
  • Perform data analytics to support strategic planning initiatives and present findings to customers.
  • Collaborate with solution architects and cross-functional teams to enhance automation and visibility of data workflows


Basic Requirements:

  • Degree or equivalent and typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field.
  • Proven proficiency in analyzing and manipulating large data sets, with exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong proficiency in MS Office Suite; expertise in data analytics platforms such as Tableau/Power BI/Databricks; familiarity with back-end data architecture.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.


Education

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master’s degree in Data Analytics or MBA preferred.


Additional Skills/Experience:

  • Experience working in a virtual team-based environment.
  • Flexible and positive attitude.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple concurrent tasks efficiently.
  • High attention to detail, delivering high-quality and accurate outputs.
  • Results-driven, thriving in a fast-paced environment.
  • Pharma/Oncology knowledge and experience preferred.


Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to travel nationwide up to 5%.
  • Commutability to The Woodlands, TX is highly preferred.

Specific in‑office days may be designated according to team needs and business priorities.

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Salary:

$115,000.00 - $158,500.00

Location:

Santa Clara,CA

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

Key Responsibilities

Participates in the design, development and maintenance of ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. used to drive key business decisions.

Works within controls to ensure the accuracy, timeliness and confidentiality of all managerial and business intelligence reports, views, dashboards, and user data. Implements new business reports within the established reporting framework, policies and procedures. Trains and supports end users on accessing of reports.

Analyzes and interprets data and business intelligence reports.

Works with others in the development of data warehouses and other data sources to support managerial and business intelligence reporting needs.

Works with business intelligence manager and other staff to assess various reporting needs. Analyzes reporting needs and requirements, assesses current reporting in the context of strategic goals and devise plans for delivering the most appropriate reporting solutions to users.

Educates & trains user community on the potential uses of the business intelligence system

Extracts financial, statistical and other data from various information systems and other sources.

Designs and develops recurring and ad-hoc business intelligence solutions such as reports, cubes, and dashboards, using industry best practices for presentation, efficiency, and user friendliness. Designs reports to aid in the efficient assimilation of the data by users by engaging exception reporting,

Functional Knowledge

  • Demonstrates conceptual and practical expertise in own discipline and basic knowledge of related disciplines

Business Expertise

  • Has knowledge of best practices and how own area integrates with others; is aware of the competition and the factors that differentiate them in the market

Leadership

  • Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may lead small projects with manageable risks and resource requirements

Problem Solving

  • Solves complex problems; takes a new perspective on existing solutions; exercises judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information

Impact

  • Impacts a range of customer, operational, project or service activities within own team and other related teams; works within broad guidelines and policies

Interpersonal Skills

  • Explains difficult or sensitive information; works to build consensus

SQL , Python and Tableau/Power BI

Full time

Assignee / Regular

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes

Summary: The Business Intelligence Analyst at Travis Credit Union transforms complex data into strategic insights that support senior leadership and enterprise-wide initiatives. This role involves designing reports, dashboards, and analytical tools that guide both daily operations and long-term planning. Working independently and collaboratively across departments, the BI Analyst combines strong business acumen, technical expertise, and problem-solving skills to deliver actionable intelligence that drives informed decision-making and measurable value.


Profile:

  • Designs and maintains analytic solutions such as dashboards, reports, and tools to support performance tracking and data-driven decision-making.
  • Applies analytical techniques and models to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and support operational and strategic improvements.
  • Extracts, integrates, and analyzes data from multiple sources using technical and programming skills to ensure accuracy and relevance.
  • Communicates findings and insights clearly, translating data into actionable recommendations for business units and leadership.
  • Conducts qualitative and quantitative analysis, including forecasting, segmentation, and root-cause evaluation to support business optimization.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders across departments to assess needs, define metrics, and develop solutions aligned with organizational goals.
  • Builds a working knowledge of data sources and structures to support effective analysis, reporting, and BI development.
  • Identifies areas for improvement and contributes to the evaluation of business strategies and operational effectiveness.
  • Ensures data integrity and reliability in reporting to support informed decision-making and performance management.
  • Provides training and support to end users on accessing and interpreting BI tools, dashboards, and reports.


Skills:

  • Proficient in designing and delivering clear, impactful data visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Tableau (strongly preferred), Power BI, or similar platforms.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving abilities, including experience in root cause analysis, trend identification, and performance evaluation.
  • Skilled in making complex data accessible and meaningful through dynamic visualizations tailored to diverse audiences.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL for querying databases, data warehouses, and large datasets to support analysis and reporting.
  • Solid foundation in data storytelling, business acumen, and collaborative consulting across departments.
  • Ability to present findings, recommendations, and insights clearly and concisely to support strategic decision-making.
  • Familiarity with programming languages such as Python for data analysis and automation is a plus.
  • Experience using data to illustrate business performance and develop materials for audiences ranging from operational teams to executive leadership.
  • Understanding of data management tools, relational and multi-dimensional databases, data warehouse design, and BI architecture.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong aptitude for working with data; consistently accurate, thorough, and quality-focused.


Reporting and Experience:

  • Reports directly to AVP, Business Analytics.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or Statistics) and 5-8 years of professional experience in business intelligence or data analytics; or equivalent related work experience. Advanced degree (e.g., MBA with BI focus or MS in Data Science) preferred.
  • At least 4 years of experience with BI tools such as SQL, Tableau, and Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, and performance metric design.
  • Certifications in Tableau, SQL, and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher preferred.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are looking for an ambitious, curious leader to serve as a Business Intelligence Analyst II on the Business Operations team to turn data into meaningful insights that drive smarter decisions, improve operations, and support AAA Life’s growth.

The Opportunity – Why Join

Are You Ready To Redefine How An Entire Industry Engages With Customers? At AAA Life, We Leverage Technology To Put Human Connection At The Heart Of What We Do. If You Are Someone Who Thrives On Purpose And Wants To Make a Tangible Difference In People’s Lives When It Matters Most, Then Join AAA Life — a Company Uniquely Positioned To Reach Tens Of Millions Of Existing AAA Customers, Backed By The Strength Of One Of America’s Most Trusted Brands. We Have Embarked On a Mission To Double In Size, Becoming One Of The Largest Providers In The US. These Facts Showcase Why We're The Right Choice

  • On purpose: a leading professional services firm found that the commitment, empathy and dedication of employees at AAA Life was the highest across a benchmark of top US companies.
  • On growth: we have the privilege to offer our products to tens of millions of Americans who are proud members of AAA.
  • On making a difference: we serve Americans by delivering life insurance products that make a true difference for families during their hardest times, not wealth management instruments.
  • On culture: USA Today named us a 2025 top workplace nationwide. We believe the job of an insurance company is to do good, and our mission is to help our members during what is often the hardest times in their lives. We pick up the phone to people who have lost loved ones and offer our genuine support. That is why we will always put human connection at the heart of what we do – being there to talk to our members person-to-person. Most of our members have real life policies that bring peace of mind during life, and genuine support in the event of death. We are not here to chase the super-rich with annuities and wealth management products. AAA has been one of the most trusted names in America because it believes in providing the services that middle class Americans need.

The Next Phase

Our mission is to provide these services for as many people as we can. To achieve that, we need to continue to grow and evolve. We need to boldly embrace innovation and technology, and your leadership will help us deliver on our mission together and achieve our transformation. At AAA Life, empathy and progress go hand in hand, creating a culture where bright ideas flourish and meaningful impact grows. If you are drawn to an environment that values purpose as much as potential, we invite you to join us. Because here, being there for people isn’t just a promise—it is our driving force.

Responsibilities

The Business Intelligence Analyst II helps AAA Life Insurance make informed business and operational decisions through data analysis, reporting, and business insights. This role partners with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, analyze operational performance, identify trends, and develop solutions that support strategic and operational objectives.

This position works closely with internal teams and customers in the areas of operational and financial analysis. It requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, attention to detail, and effective communication skills. The ideal candidate is curious, results-oriented, and passionate about leveraging data to solve business problems and improve processes. Responsibilities include analyzing data, developing reports and dashboards, supporting business initiatives with actionable insights, and contributing to the design and enhancement of data solutions that provide accurate and meaningful information to decision makers.

Position Responsibilities

  • Access, analyze, and interpret data from multiple sources to develop reports, dashboards, and ad hoc analyses that support business and operational decision making.
  • Monitor and evaluate operational performance metrics, identify trends, and recommend opportunities for process improvement and increased efficiency.
  • Create, maintain, and enhance Power BI reports and dashboards that translate complex data into meaningful and actionable insights for business users.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define reporting needs, and deliver solutions that address business objectives.
  • Conduct analyses of business processes, operational performance, and key metrics to support department initiatives and strategic goals.
  • Support the development and maintenance of automated reporting and data processes that improve consistency, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Present findings and recommendations to business partners and department leadership in a clear and concise manner.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve business outcomes through data-driven decision making and process improvements.
  • Participate in data governance and data stewardship activities by helping define, document, and maintain key performance indicators, metrics, and reporting standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support ongoing reporting, analytics, and data transformation initiatives.
  • Perform quality assurance and validation activities to ensure the accuracy and reliability of reports, dashboards, and analytical outputs.
  • Maintain documentation related to reporting processes, data sources, business rules, and analytical methodologies.
  • Stay current on analytics tools, reporting technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve capabilities and effectiveness.

Core Competencies

  • Achieves Results/Has Bias for Action : Demonstrates accountability for delivering high-quality work within established timelines. Takes initiative to solve problems, follows through on commitments, and effectively manages multiple priorities with moderate supervision.
  • Customer Focus : Understands the needs of internal and external customers and delivers solutions that support their objectives. Builds credibility by providing accurate, timely, and actionable information.
  • Uses Effective Communication Skills : Communicates clearly, concisely, and professionally with technical and non-technical audiences. Effectively presents analytical findings and recommendations to business stakeholders.
  • Relationship Building : Develops productive working relationships across teams and departments. Collaborates effectively with colleagues and business partners to achieve shared goals.
  • Business Acumen : Demonstrates a growing understanding of business operations, organizational goals, and performance drivers. Applies business knowledge to interpret data and provide relevant insights.
  • Technical/Professional Skills : Possesses strong analytical and reporting skills and demonstrates proficiency with business intelligence tools and technologies. Continuously expands technical capabilities and applies best practices to analytical work.
  • Creativity and Innovation : Identifies opportunities for improvement and contributes ideas for enhancing processes, reports, dashboards, and analytical approaches. Uses critical thinking to solve business problems.
  • Attention to Detail : Produces accurate, reliable work by carefully validating data, reports, and analyses. Demonstrates strong organizational skills and commitment to quality.

Qualifications

Required Education/Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • At least 2 years of experience analyzing and interpreting data and communicating insights to business stakeholders.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis techniques.
  • Experience working with large datasets and combining information from multiple data sources.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate analytical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Experience Preferred

  • At least 3-5 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, finance, operations, or a related field.
  • Experience using SQL to query, transform, and analyze data.
  • Experience with Python, R, or other analytical tools.
  • Experience supporting operational, financial, customer service, underwriting, or claims-related analytics.
  • Experience creating automated reporting solutions and improving reporting processes.
  • Familiarity with data governance, KPI development, and performance measurement frameworks.
  • Experience participating in cross-functional projects that leverage analytics to improve business outcomes.
  • Experience within the life insurance, financial services, or insurance industry.

How You’ll Work

  • Work Solution: Hybrid (non-regular cadence) or Remote (USA)

What We Bring To The Table

  • Hybrid or remote work environment that promotes work-life balance
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage starting from your first day
  • Employer 401k match and employer contribution to a pension plan
  • Generous PTO and paid parental leave to support your family needs
  • Various associate resource groups and community involvement initiatives

Essential Job Functions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

This job requires the ability to perform duties contained in the job description for this position, including, but not limited to, the above requirements. Reasonable accommodations will be made for otherwise qualified applicants as needed to enable them to fulfill these requirements.

AAA Life Insurance Company does not offer immigration sponsorship for this position. This includes visa types such as H-1B, TN, and STEM OPT. Please do not apply if you currently require or may require employer-sponsored immigration support now or in the future.

descriptionHtml:
At Siemens, we help organizations transform maintenance and operations through connected insights, AI-powered technology, and intelligent asset management solutions. Our software enables customers to manage the full lifecycle of assets, facilities, and infrastructure while improving efficiency, reducing risk, and optimizing long-term investments. By connecting data, people, and processes, we empower organizations to make smarter decisions, maximize asset performance, and achieve more resilient operations.

Description

The Senior Business Data Analyst translates business needs into scalable, high-quality data and analytics solutions.

This is a hands-on senior analytics role combining strong business ownership with technical depth. You will work directly with stakeholders to understand business problems, clarify outcomes and requirements, investigate data, generate insights, and deliver analytical products from discovery through implementation.

You will join the Smart Infrastructure, Asset Management Software Information Technology (SI AMS IT) Data & AI team and work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and other commercial functions. Marketing will be an important area of focus, making previous experience in Marketing Analytics or related commercial domains particularly valuable.

The role offers significant ownership and visibility within a small, collaborative Data & AI team. You will work with modern technologies including Snowflake, dbt, SQL, Python, Power BI, and Qlik, while contributing to the continued evolution of our analytics, data products, and AI capabilities. We expect you to be an early adopter of generative AI, using it to accelerate delivery and expand into adjacent technical areas.

This role is ideal for an experienced analyst who enjoys owning the full analytics lifecycle, from understanding business problems and defining requirements through data modeling, analysis, visualization, and stakeholder adoption.

You’ll make an impact by

Business Partnership And Requirements Engineering

  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, success criteria, and business value.
  • Handle ongoing business requests as a trusted partner, not a ticket taker, focusing on the business need behind each ask.
  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable data and analytics requirements.
  • Resolve missing or ambiguous requirements and break larger problems into manageable use cases.
  • Build strong understanding of assigned business domains, processes, metrics, and business logic.
  • Lead discovery, solution demonstrations, validation, and business sign off for assigned use cases.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders across North America and Europe, with core working hours aligned to Eastern Time business operations.

Data Analysis and Insight Generation

  • Extract, combine, analyze, and validate complex datasets using advanced SQL and analytical tools.
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and actionable business insights.

Description -

Job Summary

  • We are seeking a highly analytical, business-oriented Data Analyst to support the Print Supplies business. In this role, you will translate consumer and enterprise print telemetry into trusted metrics, dashboards, and actionable insights, with a primary focus on laser printer data. You will partner closely with data engineers and data scientists to improve data reliability, define KPI and metric semantics, and influence cross-functional decisions through clear data storytelling.

Responsibilities

  • Own laser print telemetry business insights for the Print Supplies organization, from problem framing and metric definition through analysis, visualization, and executive-ready recommendations.
  • Partner with stakeholders to clarify goals, translate business questions into analytical requirements, define critical KPIs, and deliver insights that drive decisions.
  • Provide consultative support and ad hoc analyses with clear hypotheses, methods, and assumptions; produce reusable queries, datasets, and shareable outputs with documented limitations.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to align on telemetry instrumentation, data collection methodology, and platform differences to ensure consistent interpretation across printer platforms.
  • Investigate data quality issues (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), perform root-cause analysis across pipelines and sources, and communicate impacts and remediation paths with appropriate caveats.
  • Enable self-service analytics by documenting dashboards and KPI definitions, and coach users on correct interpretation and common pitfalls.
  • Design and maintain measurement frameworks (e.g., adoption, usage, retention, share, funnel/driver analyses); when applicable, support experiment or pre/post evaluation and interpret results for stakeholders.
  • Create clear narratives through written summaries, presentations, and recurring reporting that highlight trends, drivers, risks, and recommended actions for leadership and partner teams.
  • Provide guidance and mentoring to less- experienced staff members.
  • Solve difficult and complex problems with a fresh perspective, demonstrating good judgment in selecting creative solutions and managing projects independently.
  • Lead moderate to high complexity projects, delivering professionally written reports, and supports the realization of operational and strategic plans.

Education & Experience Recommended

  • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.
  • Typically has 4-7 years of work experience, preferably in data analytics, database management, statistical analysis, or a related field or an advanced degree with 3-5 years of work experience.

Preferred Certifications

  • Programming Language/s Certification (SQL, Python, or similar)

Knowledge & Skills

  • Analytics: exploratory analysis, root-cause analysis, and KPI design
  • SQL: complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query performance optimization
  • Python (and/or PySpark) for analysis, data validation, and automation. Familiar with VSCode and Databricks Ideally
  • Ability to interpret telemetry and pipeline outputs in business context, including communicating uncertainty and known limitations
  • Comfort working across multiple data sources/layers and explaining differences in source-of-truth, grain, and transformations
  • Comfort with modern analytics tooling (including AI-assisted development) while maintaining reproducibility and reviewable outputs
  • Dashboarding & data visualization: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, advanced excel / PowerPoint or similar; ability to build stakeholder-ready reporting
  • Data quality and governance: profiling, anomaly detection, metric validation, and documentation
  • Strong documentation habits for metric definitions, data lineage, and stakeholder guidance; familiarity with version control (e.g., Git) a plus. Familiar with Jira and Confluence.
  • Applied statistics: sampling, confidence intervals, and basic experiment/pre-post evaluation

Cross-Org Skills

  • Effective Communication
  • Results Orientation
  • Learning Agility
  • Digital Fluency
  • Customer Centricity
  • Collaboration across technical and non-technical teams

Impact & Scope

  • Impacts function by providing analytics and data quality validation that supports business-critical reporting and stakeholder decision-making for laser telemetry KPIs
  • Serves as a key point of contact for laser telemetry interpretation and investigation requests, partnering across teams to drive consistent definitions and reliable use of outputs

Complexity

  • Responds to moderately complex issues within established guidelines.

Disclaimer

  • This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed in this role. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, skills, responsibilities, knowledge, etc. These may be subject to change and additional functions may be assigned as needed by management.

Salary

The pay range for this role is $83,000 to $127,800 USD annually with additional opportunities for pay in the form of bonus and/or equity (applies to United States of America candidates only). Pay varies by work location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits

HP offers a comprehensive benefits package for this position, including:

  • Health insurance
  • Dental insurance
  • Vision insurance
  • Long term/short term disability insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account
  • Life insurance
  • Generous time off policies, including;
  • 4-12 weeks fully paid parental leave based on tenure
  • 11 paid holidays
  • Additional flexible paid vacation and sick leave (US benefits overview)

The compensation and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. The Company reserves the right to modify this information at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.

Find YOUR fit at Ohio Machinery Co.!  Join a winning culture that strives to be the top-performing, dynamic industry leader and partner of choice for the products and solutions that help our customers build, improve, feed, power, and protect our world.  Come grow your career - See what opportunities await today! 

This role is on‑site and requires current residence in Cleveland, Ohio 
Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. We do not provide employment sponsorship for this role. Summary: The BI Analyst will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help identify, plan, and implement strategic dashboards that drive business goals and results. Success will be measured by demonstrating the ability to make data understandable and will be accomplished by using available tools to access and analyze data sets and present analytical findings through reports, dashboards, graphs, charts, and maps that provide stakeholders with detailed intelligence about the state of the business. Essential Functions and Responsibilities:
  • Develops end-to-end reports and dashboards and modifies existing reports and dashboards, using Microsoft Reporting Services, Power BI, and other tools.
  • Identifies the most impactful layout and presentation of key metrics and translates that vision into easy-to-use self-service reports or dashboards.
  • Serves as subject matter expert for BI solutions and capabilities.
  • Provides analytics, business intelligence, and data visualization for data-driven decision-making.
  • Provides analytic and data consultation to other business areas, leadership, or external customers.
  • Investigates business issues and determines the best way to develop appropriate diagnostic and/or tracking data that will translate business requirements into usable decision-support tools.
  • Designs, constructs, and maintains data views and/or data models.
  • Supports BI solutions by monitoring and tuning queries and investigating data integrity.
  • Writes data requirements for data warehouse and ETL processes.
  • Establishes and continually expands/enhances knowledge of data warehouses, BI and enterprise applications, data, queries/programming, and organizational structure.
  • Produces standard reports according to calendar; ensures accuracy and timeliness of output and deliverables for assigned functional areas.
  • Ensures the integrity and security of enterprise data on host computers, databases, and data transfers by business needs and industry best practices regarding privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Conducts research on emerging products, services, and analytic tools in support of systems and development efforts.
  • Develops, documents, and maintains policies, procedures, and associated training plans for dashboard administration and appropriate use.
  • Provides guidance and serves as an escalation to the Help Desk.
  • Performs research and analysis in the development of program and/or project activities.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned. 
Minimum Skills and Qualifications: 
  • A high school diploma or equivalent is required; Bachelors’ degree in related field is preferred. 
  • Five or more years’ experience; or combination of education, experience, and equivalent background is required.
  • Hands-on experience developing/maintaining strategic reports and dashboards.
  • A highly qualified candidate would be familiar with using MS Analysis Services, Reporting Services, Excel (Pivot Tables), Power BI, and other related business intelligence software.
  • Ideal candidates combine business acumen with technical skills to produce data visualizations that facilitate business decisions.
  • Experience with relational databases and knowledge of query tools and statistical software is required.
  • Full project management and development life cycle experience.
  • Experience with data processing flowcharting techniques and the ability to manipulate large sets of data.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Preference will be given to candidates who provide sample data visualizations.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining configuration and process information with the ability to translate business goals into actionable BI use cases.
  • Knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and laws. 
  • Some after-hours and weekend on-call availability in support of BI systems.
  • Reliable transportation and freedom to travel overnight a few times per year for training and related meetings with stakeholders.
  • Must have excellent communication skills both verbal and written, and interpersonal, time management, multi-tasking, and attention to detail skills. 
Employee Benefits:
  • 401(k): Match and employer discretionary contribution. 
  • Health Insurance: Two options are available, including an HSA with a dollar-for-dollar match of up to $1,200 per year. 
  • Dental & Vision Insurance: Comprehensive coverage options. 
  • Financial Access: Credit Union membership is available. 
  • Insurance: Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability coverage. 
  • Educational Opportunities: Scholarships for employees’ spouses and children through the Ohio Machinery Education and Opportunity Foundation. 
  • Compensation: Base pay, annual bonus potential, and company success share bonuses. 
Physical Requirements:
  • Sitting for extended periods of time.
  • Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard, mouse, power tools, and to handle other computer components.
  • Lifting and transporting of moderately heavy objects, such as computers and peripherals.

 

EEO, Veterans & Disabled Employer and VEVRAA/503 Federal Contractor

descriptionHtml:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives. We have a variety of Data Analytics roles and teams across Stripe and will seek to align you to the most relevant team based on your background.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • MS or MA plus 6 years, or BS or BA plus 8 years, of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
  • Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
  • Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
  • Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
  • Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
  • Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
  • Strong statistical knowledge
  • Working knowledge of Python
  • Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs and MBRs
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding


Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $146,900 - $220,300. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

The role differentiates itself by synthesizing diverse metrics and industry information to provide actionable intelligence to multiple departments. The work impacts the organization by enabling informed strategic planning and enhancing competitive positioning through data-driven insights.

** This is a hybrid role (3 days/week) in the office and is based in Bellevue, WA **

Job Responsibilities:

  • Collect and analyze portfolio data to produce weekly, monthly, and quarterly analytical reports.
  • Synthesize real estate portfolio metrics and news to generate actionable insights for cross-departmental teams.
  • Build automations using Power-Apps to support business intelligence activities. Compare competitive pricing and audit content to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Respond to and fulfill ad hoc reporting and analysis requests from business partners.

  • Conduct ongoing research on Portfolio trends to support business intelligence activities.

descriptionHtml:
Category/Area of Expertise: IT & Technology

Job Requisition: 558342

Address: USA-MA-Quincy-10 Granite St

Store Code: Arch/Data - Business Intell & Analy (5119320)

Ahold Delhaize USA, a division of global food retailer Ahold Delhaize, is part of the U.S. family of brands, which includes five leading omnichannel grocery brands - Food Lion, Giant Food, The GIANT Company, Hannaford and Stop & Shop. Our associates support the brands with a wide range of services, including Finance, Legal, Sustainability, Commercial, Digital and E-commerce, Technology and more.

Primary Purpose:

The Analyst IV, Data performs data analysis, builds dashboards and reports, and contributes to the development of data models and metrics that support day to day and long-term decision making.

  • Our flexible/hybrid work schedule includes 3 in-person days at one of our core locations and 2 remote days. Our core office location for this role is Salisbury, NC or Quincy, MA.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Gather, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Identify patterns, trends, and anomalies through analytical and statistical techniques.
  • Build dashboards, data visualizations, and reporting artifacts.
  • Support KPI creation and performance measurement.
  • Monitor data quality, identify issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to enhance data pipelines and data structures.
  • Document analytical processes and communicate insights to stakeholders.
  • Partners with cross-functional stakeholders to define reporting requirements, refine KPIs, and ensure analytics align to business objectives.
  • Leads key aspects of change management by shaping data-driven recommendations, guiding stakeholders through process or tooling changes, and enabling adoption across multiple teams.
  • Share expertise and best practices with peers through informal coaching, knowledge sharing, and review of analytical approaches to strengthen team capability and consistency.
  • May be called upon to support critical escalations and must be available during urgent IT incidents as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of work experience.
  • 5+ years of data analysis experience.
  • Proficiency with SQL and data visualization tools.
  • Strong analytical and communication skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across business and technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with statistical packages or light scripting (Python, R).

Salary Range NC: $92,640 - $138,960

Salary Range MA: $106,480 - $159,720

Actual compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on their unique qualifications and experience, internal equity, and market conditions. Final compensation decisions will be made in accordance with company policies and applicable laws.

At Ahold Delhaize USA, we provide services to one of the largest portfolios of grocery companies in the nation, and we're actively seeking top talent.

Our team shares a common motivation to drive change, take ownership and enable our brands to better care for their customers. We thrive on supporting great local grocery brands and their strategies.

Our associates are the heartbeat of our organization. We are committed to offering a welcoming work environment where all associates can succeed and thrive. Guided by our values of courage, care, teamwork, integrity (and even a little humor), we are dedicated to being a great place to work.

We believe in collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning in all that we think, create and do. While building a culture where personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth, we invest in our people, empowering them to learn, grow and deliver at all levels of the business.

descriptionHtml:
Join an award-winning company!

Who are we?

 

Since 1967, Toll Brothers has been building luxury homes and communities in the best locations in the U.S. Today, we’re a Fortune 500 company operating in over 60 markets. We’re the country’s premier luxury builder with the widest range of product offerings and price points in the industry, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers. 

 

From the homes we build to the talent we recruit, we know that to be the best, we have to work with the best. Toll Brothers is a place where diverse perspectives and experiences are welcomed and where employees of all backgrounds are treated with fairness, dignity and respect. We believe every employee should feel safe to be their true and authentic self at work. Our employees are our family, and we strive to uphold the values that our founders instilled in us, creating an exceptional place to work that is inclusive to all.

 

Toll Brothers, America's leading builder of luxury homes, seeks an experienced Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join our team located in Fort Washington, Pennsylvania.

 

What is the opportunity?

 

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Enterprise Reporting & Data Analytics Team. In this role, you will help lead the continued evolution and adoption of the company’s enterprise business intelligence platform, delivering trusted reporting, scalable analytics solutions, and actionable insights that improve business performance across the organization.

 

What are the primary responsibilities?

  • Partner with stakeholders across Finance, Sales, Operations, Production and other business functions to understand reporting needs and deliver meaningful insights.
  • Translate business questions into analytical solutions, dashboards, and reports that support operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models that provide accurate, scalable, and user-friendly analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize reporting and analytics requests while communicating timelines, status updates, and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of enterprise reporting assets and key performance metrics.
  • Automate recurring reporting and data processes to improve efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and Data Governance teams to support data quality standards, documentation, and reporting best practices.
  • Participate in testing, validation, troubleshooting, and user acceptance activities to ensure solutions meet business requirements.
  • Support self-service analytics initiatives and help drive enterprise adoption of business intelligence capabilities.
  • Continuously evaluate and enhance reporting solutions while exploring emerging technologies, analytics techniques and artificial intelligence.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

This is an excellent opportunity to join one of the nation's most respected Fortune 500 companies!

 

Does this describe you?

  • Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with multiple areas of the business
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills
  • Logical and efficient with exceptional attention to detail
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment
  • Curious, adaptable, and willing to learn new technologies and applications

Do you have these qualifications?

  • Essential:
    • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
    • 3+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or related disciplines.
    • Experience developing reports, dashboards, and data models using Power BI or comparable BI platforms.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience working with large and complex datasets.
    • Ability to gather requirements, manage stakeholder expectations, and communicate technical concepts to business audiences and leadership.
    • Demonstrated ability to create compelling visualizations and communicate actionable insights.
    • Experience with work management tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Asana, or similar platforms.
    • Ability to work in the office three days per week.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience with Power BI semantic models, DAX, Power Query, and data modeling best practices.
    • Experience with SQL and relational databases for data exploration, validation, and analysis.
    • Experience with data warehousing, ETL processes, or modern cloud data platforms.
    • Experience with Microsoft Fabric or comparable analytics technologies.
    • Familiarity with Git and Azure DevOps repositories.
    • Knowledge of Python, R, JavaScript, or other analytical programming languages.
    • Exposure to advanced analytics concepts such as AI, predictive modeling, or machine learning.
    • Experience supporting enterprise-scale reporting and self-service analytics initiatives.

This position offers great career growth opportunities as well as an excellent benefits package, including comprehensive medical/dental, 401(k) with a company match, discounted stock purchase, discounts on mortgages, homes, appliances, and much more!

APPLY ONLINE TODAY!

 

No walk-ins or phone calls, please.

 

Come and see why Toll Brothers has been attracting and retaining some of the best professionals in the industry!

 

APPLY ONLINE TODAY!

 

Toll Brothers is committed to ensuring equal employment opportunity. All employment decisions, policies, and practices are in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. Toll Brothers will not engage in or tolerate unlawful discrimination (including any form of unlawful harassment) on account of a person's sex (including pregnancy), age, race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, gender nonconformity, status as a transgender individual, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, family responsibility, armed services, or any other status protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
ABS Group is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Artificial Intelligence Practice in support of a major federal modernization program. In this role, you will use business intelligence and visualization tools to turn complex data into clear, decision-ready dashboards, reports, and analytical products.

You will work with stakeholders across technical and operational teams to provide reporting, insight, and performance visibility that supports better decision-making in a large-scale federal environment. The scope of responsibility, degree of technical leadership, and level of independence expected will reflect the level at which this position is filled.

What You Will Do
- Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, scorecards, and other business intelligence products
- Analyze, interpret, and visualize data to support operational, technical, and stakeholder decision-making
- Develop reproducible reports and analyses, including trend analysis, benchmarking, and performance reporting
- Translate stakeholder needs into effective reporting structures, visualizations, and dashboard requirements
- Integrate data from multiple sources to support accurate and consistent reporting outputs
- Present findings and business intelligence products to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Collaborate with data engineers, data scientists, and program stakeholders to improve reporting data structures and insight generation
- Support validation, refresh accuracy, usability, and quality of reporting products
- Produce presentation materials, reporting guidance, and supporting documentation as needed

Level and Compensation: This position may be filled at multiple career levels based on business need and the selected candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and demonstrated capability. Typical leveling for this role is as follows:

- Junior (0 to 4 years)

- Mid-Level (5 to 9 years)

- Senior (10 to 14 years)

- Principal (15 or more years)


These ranges are guidelines only and are not the sole determining factor in level. The posted compensation range reflects the full range across all possible levels. Individual offers will be based on the level at which the candidate is hired, as well as factors such as skills, experience, internal equity, and geographic market considerations where applicable.

Education and Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

- Relevant professional experience in business intelligence, dashboard development, reporting, or analytical visualization roles; the depth and scope of experience required will vary based on the level at which this position is filled

- Experience delivering reporting and visualization products for operational, executive, or stakeholder audiences preferred

- Experience in a complex enterprise, consulting, or government environment a plus


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
- Familiarity with Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI and dashboarding tools
- Working knowledge of SQL and experience with structured data sources
- Familiarity with data visualization, dashboard design, reporting concepts, and analytics
- Ability to analyze data, identify trends, and create clear, useful visual products
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Understanding of validation practices, reporting quality controls, and data governance considerations

Nice to Have
- Experience supporting executive or stakeholder reporting in a large program environment
- Familiarity with survey, demographic, statistical, or public sector reporting environments
- Experience with geospatial or map-based visualizations
- Knowledge of accessibility considerations for dashboards and reports

Location
This position is based in the Washington, D.C. metro area, with primary work performed in Suitland, Maryland. Remote or hybrid arrangements may be available for eligible work, subject to government approval.

Notice: This role has been opened for a future need expected within three months of the original posting date of this position. Potential candidates may not receive communication until the open headcount is confirmed.

descriptionHtml:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides analyst support for data analysis and reporting activities. Responsible for organizing data from multiple sources to produce reports, dashboards, and analyses related to utilization, cost-containment, and business performance. Generates data-related insights that support decision-making and cost-containment. Designs and delivers reporting, analytics, and data solutions across business and healthcare domains, including claims, utilization, finance, and other business areas. Partners with stakeholders to define requirements, develop scalable reporting and data processes, and apply analytical techniques to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and drive business performance. Supports projects, regulatory requests, and initiatives that improve data quality, reporting workflows, and process efficiencies.

Essential Job Duties

  • Analyzes datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  • Designs, develops, and maintains reports, dashboards, and data solutions using tools such as Structured Query Language (SQL), Microsoft Excel, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), that support utilization analysis, cost-containment, and operational performance.
  • Translates business needs into reporting and analytical requirements; partners with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
  • Facilitates healthcare data analysis, including data related to claims, pharmacy, lab, utilization, cost, and other areas.
  • Develops and maintains data processes for extraction, transformation, validation, and integration.
  • Ensures data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through quality assurance and validation processes.
  • Creates forecasts, models, and recommendations based on statistical analysis and business context.
  • Organizes, documents, and maintains datasets and reporting workflows across multiple business areas.
  • Consolidates research and analysis into clear summaries and recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Supports regulatory, contractual, and enterprise reporting requirements, including state mandated submissions.
  • Identifies and implements enhancements or fixes to existing reports and reporting processes.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to define reporting requirements and maintain project/report timelines.
  • Documents methodologies, reporting processes, and business requirements.
  • Identifies and drives process improvements, standardization, and automation opportunities.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Supports projects, including timeline management, requirements gathering, and deliverable execution.
  • Supports regulatory, audit, and ad hoc data requests as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare analytics, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to interpret datasets, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Technical proficiency with SQL, Excel, and reporting/analytics tools, and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy in data validation, report development, and documentation.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements, present data-related findings and solutions.
  • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Crystal Reports, MedInsight, Power BI, relational databases or similar tools.
  • Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) systems (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tools such as SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure data lakes) and business intelligence (BI) tools.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting and healthcare payer systems (e.g., QNXT or similar platforms).
  • Knowledge of healthcare utilization metrics, medical cost analysis, and performance indicators.
  • Familiarity with predictive modeling concepts and trend forecasting.
  • Experience working with healthcare claims, pharmacy, or utilization data.
  • Project management experience.
  • Microsoft certification or similar technical credentials.

Position Title: Data Analyst (AI)

Company: Reef Capital

Salary: $80,000-$110,000

Location: Lehi, UT; On-site

  • Please note that we cannot offer relocation or visa sponsorship for this position

About Reef

Reef is a Utah-based vertically integrated investment and development firm founded in 2005. Reef's team is currently involved in some of the most prominent development transactions in Utah and other targeted geographies across the United States.

Built on two decades of success, our investment approach combines proven expertise with purposeful innovation. Reef's team has completed more than 500 transactions across all lines of business. In addition to our real estate investment strategy, Reef and/or affiliates own and operate various businesses that add significant long-term value to its projects. We have grown rapidly, growing from about 25 employees to well over 400, with managed assets on behalf of over 750 institutional and individual partners worldwide.

With the motto "Expect the Best," Reef's most prominent developments include Black Desert Resort, a $2 billion luxury resort in Ivins, Utah; Marcella, a luxury private golf community in Park City, Utah; Tributer Resort, Virginia's newest premier private lakeside golf destination; Cornerstone Club, a 5,000-acre residential community, private club, and resort in Telluride, Colorado; Sweetens Cove, a renowned and evolving golf destination nestled in the Tennessee Valley; and the restoration of the historic Coco Palms Resort in Wailua, on the island of Kauai, Hawaii.

Our culture is defined by a shared set of principles that guide how we think, collaborate, make decisions, and pursue success together. This mindset serves as the foundation for the five principles that define how we work together: first, we are One Reef, always prioritizing the success of the whole over individual agendas; we speak candidly and respond collaboratively; we move in solidarity once a decision is made; we take full accountability for outcomes in our domain; and we refuse to settle for anything less than extraordinary. These aren't aspirational values posted on a wall. They are the behaviors we hire for, develop, reward, and exhibit each day. Candidates who thrive at Reef bring energy, ownership, and a genuine commitment to raising the bar on everything they touch.

Position Summary

Reef is looking for an AI-forward analytics professional who turns business questions into answers people trust. You will work with leaders across real estate, hospitality, investments, and membership to define the metrics that matter, then build the dashboards and analysis yourself in Reef Analytics, our internal analytics application.

At Reef, AI isn't a side project, but instead, it's how we build. You'll drive your work from the first question to the finished dashboard, using AI agents and coding tools like Claude to get there faster than you thought possible. Work that used to take an analyst weeks takes hours here. We're looking for someone who hands work off to AI without hesitation, takes on projects bigger than anything they've tried before, and owns the result.

If you've been building with Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools, great. If you haven't yet but you're eager to work this way, and you bring strong SQL and data visualization instincts, you'll thrive here. We hold this team to a white-glove standard and you'll own the complexity and ambiguity of every request, so stakeholders, including executives, get a polished, effortless experience.

Responsibilities

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Partner with stakeholders, including executives, to gather, clarify, and translate business questions into defined metrics and analytical solutions.
  • Own the complexity and ambiguity of data requests: ask the right questions, fill in the gaps, and deliver a finished solution rather than handing the problem back.
  • Deliver white-glove work: polished and easy to use, with clear communication from request to delivery and follow-through after launch.
  • Analyze business processes to identify key metrics, KPIs, and opportunities for data-driven improvements.

Data Definition, Modeling, and Quality

  • Define data elements, create and maintain data dictionaries, glossaries, and metadata to ensure consistent understanding and usage across the organization.
  • Design logical and conceptual data models to support reporting, analytics, and dashboard requirements.
  • Make sure the data behind every dashboard is accurate and consistent, validating and testing it before it ships.
  • Work with the Data Engineer to resolve data discrepancies and fix problems at the source.

Dashboard and Report Development

  • Build and maintain dashboards in Reef Analytics, our internal analytics application, using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as your primary development partner.
  • Work with AI as a coding partner: review AI-generated code and queries critically, fix what does not work, and handle the parts AI cannot do alone.
  • Apply data visualization and dashboard design best practices so executives can read and trust what they see.
  • Ship through Git and GitHub pull requests with code review.
  • Create self-service reporting solutions that enable employees to explore data independently while adhering to governance standards.
  • Develop ad-hoc reports and automated recurring reports to support operational and executive decision-making.

Analytics and Insights

  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover insights, trends, patterns, and anomalies.
  • Provide actionable recommendations based on data findings to support business objectives.
  • Monitor dashboard usage and performance, iterating based on user feedback.

Data Governance and Collaboration

  • Support data governance initiatives, including documentation of data lineage, security classifications, and best practices.
  • Partner with the Data Engineer on integration projects and pipeline enhancements to improve data availability for analysis.
  • Train and support end-users on dashboard tools and data interpretation.

Project Management and Delivery

  • Scope, break down, and track work in Jira: clear tickets, acceptance criteria, and priorities for both people and AI agents.
  • Manage a portfolio of stakeholder requests: set expectations, sequence the work, and keep stakeholders informed through delivery.
  • Turn ambiguous requests into well-defined specs that AI agents can build against, then verify the result.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or related fields.
  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a similar role (experience in data engineering tasks is a plus).
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a similar BI tool, with a strong grasp of data visualization and dashboard design.
  • Solid knowledge of SQL for querying and manipulating data; experience with Snowflake SQL is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Microsoft 365, HubSpot, and data platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS S3, data lakes like Microsoft Fabric).
  • Experience in data modeling, creating data dictionaries, and defining business metrics.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present findings clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively in a cross-functional environment.
  • Familiarity with project management basics (e.g., Kanban, Agile/Scrum, Waterfall) and tools like Jira.
  • Experience with FinOps or spend analysis (cloud, software, or AI usage costs), directly supporting an executive, and hands-on experience with ETL processes and tools (e.g., Power Query, SQL-based transformations, or integration platforms) are all considered nice to have

Company Benefits

  • 401(k) Plan with Company Match
  • Generous Health Plan with HSA Match
  • Flexible Paid Time-off
  • Daily Company Lunches
  • Cell Phone Service Allowance
  • Discounts at Company-owned Resorts and Golf Courses

Salary: $80000 - $110000 per year

Summary

This role supports the firm's analytics and reporting capabilities through the development and enhancement of dashboards, executive scorecards, data models, KPI frameworks, and automated reporting solutions that combine internal financial data with market research, benchmarking, and business development insights.

Location

This position can sit in our New York, Short Hills, or Chicago office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analytical support and reporting for strategic planning initiatives for Vertical leads, the Global Finance Committee Head, Practice Group leadership, and Business Development leadership.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to align analytics products with business priorities.
  • Collaborate with the Manager, Strategic Finance & Market Analytics to align recommendations with business priorities.
  • Conduct profitability analysis across clients, sectors, segmentation, matters, and practices.
  • Analyze and highlight growth opportunities and margin risks using financial, market, and benchmarking data.
  • Translate analytical requirements and outputs for strategic business questions.
  • Develop reusable data models that connect financial, operational, revenue, pricing, and market sources.
  • Support the development of KPI definitions, calculation logic, ownership, and governance standards.
  • Automate recurring reporting to improve timeliness, consistency, and efficiency.
  • Support self-service reporting through dashboards, documentation, and user guidance.
  • Maintain reporting quality, metric consistency, and stakeholder confidence in results.

Advanced proficiency in Power BI, Excel, data modeling, visualization, SQL, reporting automation, and data-quality management. Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards, data models, automated reporting, and executive-ready analysis.

Excellent written, verbal, and data storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and analytical findings effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Minimum Education   

  • Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Analytics, Finance, Economics, Accounting, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

  • Master's Degree.

  • 4 years’ experience in business intelligence, data analytics, financial analytics, or a related field. Experience applying financial, market, benchmarking, or BD data to inform business decisions.

  • Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
  • Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
  • Comply with firm policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in SQL, Python, data visualization, and data analysis with the business acumen and communication skills needed to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What You’ll Do

  • Query and analyze large, complex datasets using SQL to identify relationships, trends, anomalies, and business rules and support data-driven solutions.
  • Apply strong data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts, including star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables, to support enterprise data initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain clear data documentation while supporting data governance standards, data quality, and integrity across assigned projects.
  • Collaborate closely with data engineers, data architects, analysts, and business users while developing domain expertise and providing guidance and mentorship to junior analysts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis and data warehousing, including experience supporting complex enterprise data projects.
  • Strong experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, Data Analysis, Data Mapping, and Data Warehousing.
  • Strong hands-on SQL expertise with demonstrated experience performing complex data analysis, data profiling, and source-to-target data mapping.
  • Strong understanding of data warehousing and data modeling concepts, including dimensional modeling, star schemas, dimension tables, and fact tables.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently analyze source data, work through ambiguous requirements, and partner with business and development teams to translate business requirements into technical mappings and data solutions.

  • Accident Insurance

  • Banking Benefits
  • Pet Insurance
