Here, the best people come together to deliver Jackson's mission for our diverse communities. Our employees are committed to providing the best CARE by demonstrating compassion, accountability, respect, and expertise in everything we do.

Summary

The Senior Business Intelligence & Performance Analyst builds, maintains and improves enterprise reports and dashboards, and supports the overall Enterprise Transformation & Performance Office (ETPO), strategic projects and on-demand reporting needs. This role turns complex data into clear, accurate insights that leaders can act on. The analyst works closely with Operations, Finance, Nursing, IT, HR and Quality to gather requirements, validate data and deliver standardized reporting. Helps apply data governance standards, support KPI alignment, and mentor enabled analysts in data storytelling and visualization best practices. Supports operational excellence, financial stewardship, clinical outcomes, throughput, and labor and workforce optimization.

Responsibilities

Analytics and Reporting Delivery



- Carry out the systemwide reporting analytics strategy by building and delivering reports aligned with ETPO priorities, strategic projects and the clinical service lines. Gather and document reporting requirements from stakeholders, translating business questions into clear analytical deliverables. Partner with Operations, Transformation, Finance, Nursing, IT, HR and Quality to define, calculate and maintain KPIs from a consistent source of truth. Respond to on-demand and ad hoc reporting requests with accurate, timely analysis.

Data Quality and Governance



- Apply the data standards, metadata, naming conventions and validation protocols set by the JHS Data Governance Committee; contribute to committee work as a subject matter expert. Perform data validation and quality checks to ensure accuracy, reliability and timeliness across systems (Epic Cogito, Vizient, Snowflake). Identify, document and help resolve data discrepancies in partnership with IT and source system owners. Maintain documentation for data sources, metric definitions and report logic.

Analysis and Quantitative Methods



- Interpret complex datasets, statistical trends and financial data to identify drivers of performance. Apply descriptive, diagnostic and predictive methods, including variance analysis, regression, forecasting and benchmarking. Design and validate performance measures using sound mathematical logic and statistical rigor. Write, optimize and maintain SQL (or similar) queries against relational databases and data warehouses.

Visualization and Data Storytelling



- Design, build and maintain dashboards, scorecards and visualizations for enterprise KPIs (length of stay, readmissions, OR utilization, labor efficiency and financial performance). Convert large datasets into intuitive, visually compelling dashboards using Tableau or Sigma. Build reports that tell a story, moving beyond static data to insights that inspire action and communicate progress on process and outcome metrics. Translate technical analytics into clear visuals and summaries for frontline team members, clinicians and executives. Apply design thinking and data storytelling principles consistently across deliverables.

Training and Enablement



- Develop and maintain standardized templates, toolkits and guides that support consistent design and data interpretation. Mentor and provide technical guidance to analysts, enabled analysts and project managers on visualization best practices and communicating insights.

Collaboration and Partnerships



- Serve as a lead analyst on projects, coordinating analytics work with Operational Excellence, process improvement and project teams. Work with IT data architecture and data science teams to align report development with data infrastructure and governance standards. Help translate predictive models and advanced analytics into operational insights for clinical, efficiency, financial and workforce initiatives. Act as a bridge between technical teams and operational leaders, ensuring outputs are accurate, actionable and aligned with system priorities. Model a culture of curiosity, continuous improvement, collaboration, integrity and shared accountability.
- Perform all other related job duties as assigned.

Experience

Generally requires 5 to 7 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics or performance improvement, preferably within a complex healthcare system.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Statistics, Business Administration or a related field is required. Master's degree is preferred.

Skill

Ability to analyze, organize and prioritize work accurately while meeting multiple deadlines. Ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written form. Ability to handle difficult and stressful situations with critical thinking and professional composure. Ability to understand and follow instructions. Knowledge and skill in use of job appropriate technology and software applications. Must meet and maintain current all unit specific and organizational skills/competencies, certifications/licensures, as required by the clinical area. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex data clearly to operational teams, clinicians and leaders. Advanced proficiency in Tableau, Sigma, Power BI or other visualization tools, including interactive dashboard development. Advanced SQL skills and a solid understanding of data structures and relational databases. Expertise in data storytelling, visualization design principles and user-centered dashboard development. Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver on deadlines in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with modern data architecture concepts such as data lakes, ETL pipelines and cloud analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake). Working knowledge of healthcare operational, clinical and financial metrics.

Credentials

Tableau, Power BI, Sigma or other visualization suite certification is preferred. Epic Cogito/Caboodle certification is preferred.

descriptionHtml:
As a Data Analyst, you will be part of a small and dynamic technology team that is bringing cutting-edge technology solutions to a fast-growing company. You will collaborate closely with our business stakeholders and within the Technology team to create and maintain insights that are delivered either through PowerBI visualizations or via custom applications that the team builds. In this role you should be able to solve problems quickly, but you should also strive to understand the business reasons behind the ask, find root causes and prevent issues from recurring. You shouldn’t accept “that’s the way things are done”, but instead you should work to understand the reasons why things are done and identify ways to improve. You should value documenting your successes and solutions, helping to track challenges and build a knowledgebase to share with the team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights.
  • Develop and maintain PowerBI dashboards and reports to support business decision-making.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data needs and deliver solutions.
  • Perform data cleaning, validation, and transformation to ensure data accuracy and integrity.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data to drive business improvements.
  • Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in data analysis and visualization.
  • Provide training and support to team members on PowerBI and data analysis tools.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Curiosity and a passion for continuous learning.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Qualifications

  • Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and other data analysis tools.
  • Experience with data visualization and reporting using PowerBI.
  • Working knowledge of medallion architecture.
  • Skills in MS Fabric and Azure Data Factory a plus.
  • Experience with Snowflake a plus.
  • Knowledge of the mortgage lending industry is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Minimum 2 years of professional experience in data analysis and PowerBI development.

Physical and Mental Demands

  • Hearing: Ability to listen and communicate effectively in meetings, calls and daily interactions – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Seeing: Ability to read reports, documents, and data on screens or in print – Continuous (over 75%)
  • Sitting or Standing: Prolonged periods of sitting or standing (based on preference of the individual) at a desk. Physical participation in meetings, often working on a computer – Continuous (over 75%)
  • Standing/Walking: Moving around the office, attending meetings, and events – Occasional (15-45%)
  • Manual Dexterity: Regular use of hands for typing, writing, and handling documents – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Communication: Speaking with employees, executives, partners, and vendors – Frequent (50-75%)
  • Attention to Detail: Ensuring accuracy in operational processes – Continuous (over 75%)

Working Environment

This position operates in a fast-paced, dynamic office environment that fosters creativity and collaboration among team members in order to meet deadlines.

Employees are expected to work both independently and as part of diverse teams to meet the organization’s goals.

The in-office work setting is highly digital, requiring proficiency with various online tools and platforms to communicate and manage tasks effectively.

We emphasize a culture of respect and inclusion, where all employees are encouraged to share their ideas and contributions are valued.

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an individual encounters while performing the essential functions of this position.

Newport, an Ascensus company, helps employers offer their associates a more secure financial future through retirement plans, insurance and consulting services. Newport offers comprehensive plan solutions and consulting expertise to plan sponsors and the advisors who serve them. As a provider and partner, Newport is independent, experienced, and responsive.

The Reporting & KPI Analyst will play a key role in monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on the organization’s key performance indicators (KPIs) to support data-driven decision-making. This individual will be responsible for developing and maintaining performance dashboards, generating insights, and creating standardized reports to help stakeholders understand trends and measure progress against targets. This role ensures data integrity, timely reporting, and the accuracy of various performance indicators. The Reporting and KPI analyst will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide clear insights that support strategic decision-making.

Section 2: Job Functions, Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Data Collection & Analysis: Gather, process, and analyze data from various sources to produce insights on KPIs and performance metrics.
  • KPI Monitoring: Track and report on KPIs regularly, highlighting variances from targets and identifying areas of opportunity or concern.
  • Reporting & Dashboard Development: Create, maintain, and improve dashboards, scorecards, and visualizations that present KPIs and trends in a clear, actionable format.
  • Collaborative Insights: Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., Consulting, Client Services, Accounting, Plan Administration, Operations) to understand their KPI needs and provide insights to guide strategic decisions.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data by conducting regular audits and identifying potential data quality issues.
  • Performance Evaluation: Analyze performance against benchmarks, forecasting future performance trends, and providing recommendations for improvement.
  • Process Improvement: Identify and implement process improvements to streamline reporting, enhance data accuracy, and improve KPI tracking systems.
  • Documentation & Training: Document reporting processes and provide training to users on accessing and interpreting reports.
  • Responsible for protecting, securing, and proper handling of all confidential data held by Ascensus to ensure against unauthorized access, improper transmission, and/or unapproved disclosure of information that could result in harm to Ascensus or our clients.
  • Our I-Client service philosophy and our Core Values of People Matter, Quality First and Integrity Always® should be visible in your actions on a day-to-day basis showing your support of our organizational culture.

Supervision

  • N/A

Section 3: Experience, Skills, Knowledge Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Statistics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of KPI frameworks, data analytics, and business intelligence.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Effective communication skills to present findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of experience in a data analysis or reporting role.
  • Proficiency in data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and reporting tools (e.g., SQL, Excel).
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and data modeling is a plus.
  • Experience in a similar industry or domain (e.g., finance, e-commerce, healthcare).
  • Familiarity with ERP or CRM systems and data extraction processes.
  • Experience with scripting or programming languages like Python or R.

For all virtual remote positions, in order to ensure associates can effectively perform their job duties with no distractions, we require an uninterrupted virtual workspace and there is also an expectation of family care being in place during business hours. Additionally, there is an internet work speed requirement of 25 Mbps or better for individual use. If more than one person is utilizing the same internet connection in the same household or building, then a stronger connection is required. If you are unsure of your internet speed, please check with your service provider. Note: For call center roles specifically, it is a requirement to either hardwire your equipment directly to the internet router or ensure your workstation is in close proximity to the router. Please ensure that you are able to meet these expectations before applying.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

Be aware of employment fraud. All email communications from Ascensus or its hiring managers originate from @ascensus.com or @futureplan.com email addresses. We will never ask you for payment or require you to purchase any equipment. If you are suspicious or unsure about validity of a job posting, we strongly encourage you to apply directly through our website.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (STARLINK)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, will deliver low-latency broadband internet worldwide. This role will be responsible for driving data-driven decision making by conducting deep analyses, building scalable metrics and dashboards, automating processes, and partnering across the organization to identify opportunities that improve customer outcomes, accelerate revenue, and increase operational efficiency. You will own end-to-end data integrity and tooling while translating complex insights into clear, actionable recommendations that influence leaders and support the rapid growth of Starlink.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct analyses (SQL queries, other methods) that identify issues and opportunities impacting our customers, including actionable recommendations that quantifiably change outcomes
  • Define and develop department-level metrics and associated dashboards that quantify the health of our customer accounts and influence change
  • Integrate with all levels of the business to understand current workflows and identify systematic gaps
  • Develop automation that accelerate revenue, mitigates business risk or creates efficiencies within Starlink Business Operations and across teams
  • Own data integrity, tool maintenance, and reporting quality
  • Train internal users, external technical teams, and leaders on dashboard, API, and tool usage; assist in troubleshooting
  • Improve data capture for future Account Management use cases, identifying front-end requirements and collaborating with software development teams on table structure
  • Support new market launch, continuous improvement, and cross-functional strategic initiatives

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience in reporting and analytics within customer operations, manufacturing, quality, human resources, purchasing, operations, cost accounting, supply chain management, or consulting
  • 3+ years of professional experience building required datasets to create and manage dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
  • 3+ years of professional experience in at least one analytics language (e.g. Python, R)
  • 1+ years of experience leading projects

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, management information systems, computer science, engineering, or economics discipline
  • Advanced SQL proficiency (i.e. advanced joins, views/table distinctions, and basic query optimizations)
  • Advanced understanding of database structures, query optimizations, ETL development
  • Experience automating analytics tasks (i.e. intermediate coding skills (VBA, Python, C#, etc.)
  • Start-up, consulting, or other demonstrated experience in high-growth, fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Strong project management and self-directed prioritization skills
  • Exceptional ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences at all organizational levels
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships across disciplines and with multiple levels of management
  • Experience working with customer operations teams and tools (e.g. ticketing, account management, communications tools)

Additional Requirements

descriptionHtml:
The Business Intelligence Analyst develops, maintains, and enhances Power BI reports that turn data from relational databases, the enterprise data warehouse, and data marts into reliable, business-facing analytics. You will partner with business stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and take assignments from requirements through implementation and ongoing support. Responsibilities include investigating and transforming data using T-SQL and Power Query, developing Power BI semantic models and DAX measures, building interactive reports, optimizing performance, and validating results against source data and business requirements before release.

The ideal candidate has strong T-SQL and DAX skills and experience working with complex datasets and data relationships. You will work with the business and the Business Intelligence team to resolve data quality issues and identify reporting data needs, document report logic and definitions, and apply sound technical judgment and independent problem-solving skills to deliver accurate, maintainable reporting solutions.

This job might be for you if you're interested in:

  • Working at a member-focused, mission-driven, not-for-profit organization.
  • Joining a welcoming and supportive environment where you can make an impact on patient care.
  • Enjoying excellent work-life balance, reasonable working hours, and generally no evening or weekend work in a hybrid or fully remote environment.
  • Receiving a competitive compensation package that includes outstanding medical and dental benefits, an employer-funded 403(b) retirement contribution of 10 to 15 percent of salary after one year of service, generous time off including a week-long Winter Break, paid parental leave, and more.
  • Expanding your skills through training and professional development, including Microsoft Fabric and AI-assisted analytics.
  • Joining a team with longstanding tenure at RSNA, a culture of continuous improvement, a strong sense of teamwork, and a fabulous sense of humor.
  • Solving a variety of challenges in your day-to-day work.

Responsibilities

  • Write, optimize, and maintain T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures to extract, transform, and aggregate data for reporting.
  • Design, build, and publish Power BI reports, including the semantic model, DAX measures, Power Query transformations, interactive features appropriate to the business need, and scheduled refresh.
  • Meet with business stakeholders to gather and clarify requirements, identify appropriate data sources, and determine the T-SQL and Power BI approach.
  • Validate report output against source data and resolve discrepancies before release.
  • Support and enhance existing reports, including troubleshooting issues reported by stakeholders and updating logic as business rules change.
  • Document report logic, data definitions, and validation so that others can maintain the work.
  • Identify trends and relationships across data sources and translate findings into business insights for stakeholders.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Analytical reasoning and problem-solving: Investigates unfamiliar data, tests assumptions, evaluates potential approaches, and develops solutions without relying on step-by-step direction.
  • Resourcefulness and ownership: Moves work forward independently, recognizes when additional information is needed, asks focused questions, and follows through to completion.
  • Creative report development: Translates business needs into clear, practical, and user-friendly reporting solutions.
  • Troubleshooting: Traces report results through T-SQL queries, Power Query transformations, model relationships, and DAX calculations to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Communication and collaboration: Demonstrates strong verbal and written communication skills, clearly explains technical decisions, raises questions and concerns promptly, and incorporates feedback from peer reviews and QA.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience and certifications.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in business intelligence or data analytics with strong proficiency in writing, reading, and debugging T-SQL queries, views, functions, and stored procedures, including the ability to explore an unfamiliar schema, profile data, and identify the right source tables.
  • 3+ years building Power BI reports in a production environment, including semantic modeling, DAX measures, and Power Query.
  • Demonstrated ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders, translate them into a technical approach, and deliver a complete, validated report independently and on schedule. Candidates should be prepared to walk through a report they built this way.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. This includes, but is not limited to, employer-sponsored H-1B, H-1B1, E-3, TN, O-1, L-1, and other employment-based visa classifications, as well as employer-sponsored extensions, changes of status, or transfers where applicable.

Job Title: Data Analyst

Location: Texas, USA

Experience: 2–4 Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst with 2–4 years of experience in collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data to support business decisions. The ideal candidate will have strong SQL and Excel skills, experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau, and the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, manipulate, and analyze large datasets.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI or Tableau.
  • Analyze business trends, patterns, and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports for business stakeholders and management.
  • Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to identify discrepancies.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
  • Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and track business performance against established targets.
  • Document data processes, reporting procedures, and analytical findings.
  • Present insights and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of professional experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL, including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and data manipulation.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and advanced formulas.
  • Experience with at least one data visualization tool: Power BI or Tableau.
  • Good understanding of data cleaning, data validation, data transformation, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of statistical concepts and analytical techniques.
  • Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and communicate actionable insights.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently as well as collaboratively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python (Pandas, NumPy) for data analysis and automation.
  • Exposure to databases such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Snowflake.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes and data warehousing concepts.
  • Knowledge of cloud data platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Experience working in Agile or cross-functional business environments.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field.
  • Master's degree or relevant certifications in Data Analytics, Power BI, Tableau, or SQL are a plus.

What We're Looking For

  • A data-driven professional with strong attention to detail.
  • Someone who can turn raw data into meaningful business insights.
  • A proactive problem-solver who can work with stakeholders and deliver accurate reports on time.
  • A clear communicator who can explain analytical findings and recommendations effectively.

About SMU

Salary commensurate with experience and qualifications

SMU’s more than 12,000 diverse, high-achieving students come from all 50 states and over 80 countries to take advantage of the University’s small classes, meaningful research opportunities, leadership development, community service, international study and innovative programs.

SMU serves approximately 7,000 undergraduates and 5,000 graduate students through eight degree-granting schools: Dedman College of Humanities and Sciences, Cox School of Business, Lyle School of Engineering, Meadows School of the Arts, Simmons School of Education and Human Development, Dedman School of Law, Perkins School of Theology and Moody School of Graduate and Advanced Studies.

SMU is data driven, and its powerful supercomputing ecosystem – paired with entrepreneurial drive – creates an unrivaled environment for the University to deliver research excellence.

Now in its second century of achievement, SMU is recognized for the ways it supports students, faculty and alumni as they become ethical, enterprising leaders in their professions and communities. SMU’s relationship with Dallas – the dynamic center of one of the nation’s fastest-growing regions – offers unique learning, research, social and career opportunities that provide a launch pad for global impact.

SMU is nonsectarian in its teaching and committed to academic freedom and open inquiry.

About the Department:

The Office of Institutional Insights and Intelligence (OIII) serves as the University’s centralized Decision Support and Institutional Research function, integrating institutional research, enterprise data governance, data management, and advanced analytics, including predictive modeling and artificial intelligence. Working collaboratively with stakeholders across the University, OIII transforms trusted institutional data into actionable intelligence and forward-looking insights that support strategic planning, institutional priorities, and informed decision-making.

Through integrated data, standardized business definitions, and advanced analytical capabilities, OIII strengthens institutional effectiveness, supports student success, and advances the University’s accountability, accreditation, and external reporting responsibilities.

About the Position:

This role is an on-campus, in-person position.

The BI Data Analyst transforms institutional data into trusted analyses, business intelligence products, and evidence-based insights supporting University planning, operations, accountability, and decision support.

Analysts work across academic and administrative domains, mining data from source systems, combining data analysis, visualization, data quality, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration.

Within assigned work, BI Data Analysts exercise initiative and technical judgment to select methods, identify risks, recommend approaches, and deliver results.

Job level and compensation will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience and qualifications.

Essential Functions:

  • Institutional Analytics & Decision Support
    • Mine for and Analyze institutional data to answer institutional planning, operational, strategic, and compliance questions.
    • Synthesize information across sources to identify trends, relationships, anomalies, risks, and opportunities; develop evidence-based observations and recommendations for further inquiry.
  • Business Intelligence, Visualization & Communication
    • Design, maintain, and improve reports, dashboards, visualizations, KPI products, and executive or Board-ready analytical materials.
    • Communicate analytical findings, assumptions, and limitations clearly through appropriate visual and narrative formats.
  • Data Preparation & Reusable Analytics
    • Mine, query, combine, transform, and document data from enterprise systems, warehouses, and other approved sources.
    • Develop reusable queries, analytical datasets, and semantic or data models; coordinate with technical teams to support sustainable and traceable products.
    • Perform analytics engineering to design, develop, and maintain governed, reusable datasets within the enterprise data warehouse, using medallion architecture, SQL, dbt, GitHub, and related tools to ensure data quality, consistency, traceability, and scalability.
  • Data Quality, Governance & Documentation
    • Apply approved definitions, business rules, data governance, privacy, security, and appropriate-use requirements.
    • Validate and reconcile results, investigate discrepancies, document sources and methods, and raise recurring quality or process issues for resolution with appropriate owners.
  • Stakeholder Partnership & Consultation
    • As assigned, consult with academic and administrative stakeholders to understand business processes, clarify questions, and translate needs into analytical requirements.
    • Collaborate with Data Stewards, OIT, institutional research colleagues, and other partners on approved cross-functional work.
  • Continuous Improvement & Professional Practice
    • Maintain relevant BI, institutional research, analytics, and governance knowledge; improve repeatability, usability, and sustainability of analytical products.
    • Contribute to shared standards, documentation, knowledge transfer, and cross-training.
  • Occasional evening and weekend work may be required during critical times.

Education and Experience:

Baccalaureate (bachelor's) degree and five (5) years of work experience conducting complex quantitative and qualitative analyses is required.

OR

Masters' degree and three (3) years of work experience conducting complex quantitative and qualitative analyses is required.

A degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, Management Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Higher Education Administration, Public Policy, Social Science, or a related analytical, quantitative, technical or higher education field is strongly preferred.

Higher-level terminal degree in a related analytical, quantitative, technical, or higher education field is desired.

Experience in social science research, higher education, or other data-intensive environments is plus.

Experience evaluating complex, cross-functional challenges holistically, identifying opportunities for improvement, and helping to develop multi-year implementation plans that align data, business processes, and institutional priorities is highly preferred.

Experience in one or more specializations and in supporting institutional planning, leadership, compliance, governance, or cross-functional analytics is desired.

Technical Specializations:

The Assistant Provost may assign deeper areas of expertise according to institutional priorities and individual strengths. Specializations do not restrict cross-domain assignments or create separate job families.

  • Analytics Engineering & Data Products: Reusable models, curated datasets, transformation frameworks, lineage, and scalable analytics-ready products.
  • Institutional Research, Compliance & Reporting: Official and external reporting, accreditation and regulatory definitions, reconciliation, and audit-ready reporting.
  • BI Visualization & Dashboard Development: Dashboard architecture, BI platforms, interactive reporting, visualization design, and KPI presentation.
  • Institutional Insights, Strategic Review & Communication: Cross-domain synthesis, benchmarking, identification of emerging issues, evidence-based strategic observations, and leadership communication.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Candidate must demonstrate strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate broadly across the University and develop and maintain effective relationships with a wide range of constituencies. Must also demonstrate strong written communication skills. A strong customer service orientation is a must.

Candidate must possess strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and analyze problems, as well as devise solutions. Must also have strong organizational, planning and time management skills. Candidate must exhibit strong collaboration, judgment, and systems thinking.

Demonstrated expertise in hands-on data analysis, SQL query development, data preparation, and particularly advanced data visualization, with the ability to transform complex datasets into compelling, intuitive, and actionable analytical products is a must.

Candidate must exhibit a proven ability to synthesize diverse data sources into strategic intelligence, executive briefings, and evidence-based recommendations that inform organizational decision-making and strategic planning. Must also have a demonstrated ability to work across both strategic and tactical levels, translating analytical findings into practical initiatives and measurable outcomes that advance organizational goals.

Candidate must have an understanding of institutional data governance, quality, privacy, security, documentation, and lineage as well as the ability to learn across enterprise systems and institutional domains.

Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or comparable BI tools is required.

Experience working with enterprise warehouses, student information systems, ERP/CRM, or related platforms is preferred.

Physical and Environmental Demands:

  • Sit for long periods of time

Deadline to Apply:

Priority consideration may be granted to applications received by December 12, 2026.

Position will remain open until filled.

EEO Statement

SMU is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status or other characteristics protected by state or federal law.

Benefits:

SMU offers staff a broad, competitive array of health and related benefits. In addition to traditional benefits such as health, dental, and vision plans, SMU offers a wide range of wellness programs to help attract, support, and retain our employees whose work continues to make SMU an outstanding education and research institution.

SMU is committed to providing an array of retirement programs that benefit and protect you and your family throughout your working years at SMU and, if you meet SMU's retirement eligibility criteria, during your retirement years after you leave SMU.

The value of learning at SMU isn't just about preparing our students for the future. Employees have access to a wide variety of professional and personal development opportunities, including tuition benefits.

Join a team of analytical data users in the Commercial Data Reporting & Insight organization. This is a highly visible role within Huntington’s Commercial Bank and will drive the vision for leveraging data to improve decision making. In this role, you will partner with the Commercial Analytics Product Owners to act as a liaison across business leaders, segment partners, the centralized data leadership team, IT, and Finance partners. Working with the product owner, you will build understanding of their priorities and develop the tools and insights required to deliver results.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Translate business partners' data challenges into automated analytical solutions that reduce time spent on data movement and increase time spent turning data into insights
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to measure performance, activity, and business outcomes across the Commercial Bank
  • Build and modify queries using SAS, R, or Python to create data sets for reporting and analysis in Tableau, Power BI or other data visualization products
  • Mentor and develop peer analysts, advise senior stakeholders and act as a leader in the Commercial Bank data organization
  • Support ad hoc data requests and analysis, delivering insights to highlight areas of growth and opportunity to senior leaders
  • Partner with IT data partners to continue evolving Huntington’s data environment, improving the bank’s ability to automate and work more efficiently

  • 5+ years related of experience

  • Experience designing executive-ready, self-service reporting in Power BI and/or Tableau
  • Proven track record of collaborating with business partners to develop technical solutions in an agile manner

Position Title: Operational Analytics Analyst 2

Description

The Business Analyst III partners with departments across the organization to integrate data from multiple sources, develop analytical solutions, and deliver actionable insights that support data-driven decision-making. This role is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining key performance indicators, leading analytical initiatives, presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders, and supporting enterprise-wide projects that improve operational and business performance.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Strong analytical skills with ability to explore data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations.
    • Define and present business metrics to Stakeholders.
      • Define, develop, and maintain key performance indicators that support business objectives
      • Build analytical story from data points
  • Ability to prepare comprehensive reports accurately, and present complex ideas clearly and concisely.
    • Design and architect advanced data visualizations using various BI tools.
      • Design, develop, and support Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions
      • Create user-friendly self-service analytics experiences for business users
      • Develop and maintain data models, hierarchies, and relationships to support enterprise reporting.
  • Perform ad hoc analysis with large data sets to call out and present key actionable insights.
    • Discover and communicate actionable patterns and trends.
    • Ability to work with transactional level data and create relationships and hierarchies.
    • Highlight exceptions and recommend actionable next steps.
  • Communicate effectively with internal departments to gather requirements and provide status updates.
    • Communicate project status, risks, findings, and recommendations to SMEs and stakeholders.
    • Help guide understanding and knowledge of complicated data sets.
    • Support post-implementation of self-service analytics.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adjust quickly to changing business needs.
    • Retain business requirements and remain adaptive, utilizing various analytical approaches.
    • Produce project documentation and present business user summarizations.
  • Ability to work well in team environment and develop close relationships with all areas of the business.
    • Possess collaborative work style, while partnering with cross-functional teams.
    • Provides analytical leadership on complex business problems while partnering with stakeholders across the enterprise
  • Other duties may be assigned, directed, or requested.
What You Will Be Doing:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, analytics, information systems, supply chain, or a related field is required.
  • Four (4) years of experience in business analytics, business intelligence, data analytics is preferred.
  • Experience with Databricks and cloud-based data platforms is preferred.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 is preferred.
  • Supply chain, logistics, distribution, or inventory analytics experience is preferred.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and dimensional modeling concepts is preferred.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Power Query, and SQL is preferred.
  • Knowledge of enterprise reporting and analysis tools.
  • Problem solving skills with ability to think creatively.
  • Team oriented, hardworking, open-minded, and flexible.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to multi-task and manager multiple projects effectively.
  • Strong to advanced experience in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook is required,
  • Must have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to speak with all levels of the organization and outside partners.
  • Ability to communicate complicated information to others.
  • Must be proficient in basic mathematics: addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
  • Ability to do algebra, calculate figures and amounts and apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.
  • Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
  • A methodical and organized approach to problem-solving.
  • The work performed is in an office environment.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate at low decibels.
  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced, team environment.

Salary: $80,000.00 - $96,000.00

Employee Benefits Include:

Health Plans - Medical, Dental & Prescription

Flexible Spending Accounts - Health & Dependent Care

Life and Accident Insurance

Vacation Pay & Paid Holidays

401(k) with Company Match

descriptionHtml:
The Medpace Analytics and Business Intelligence team is growing rapidly and is focused on building a data driven culture across the enterprise. The BI team uses data and insights to drive increased strategic and operational efficiencies across the organization. As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will hold a highly visible analytical role that requires interaction and partnership with leadership across the Medpace organization.

What’s in this for you?

  • Work in a collaborative, fast paced, entrepreneurial, and innovative workplace;
  • Gain experience and exposure to advanced BI concepts from visualization to data warehousing;
  • Grow business knowledge by working with leadership across all aspects of Medpace’s business.

Responsibilities

What’s involved?

We are looking for a Junior Business Intelligence Analyst to add additional depth to our growing Analytical team in a variety of areas – from Visualization and Storytelling to SQL, Data Modeling, and Data Warehousing. This role will work in close partnership with leadership, product management, operations, finance, and other technical teams to find opportunities to improve and expand our business.

An ideal candidate in this role will apply great analytical skills, communication skills, and problem-solving skills to continue developing our analytics & BI capabilities. We are looking for team members who thrive in working with complex data sets, conducting deep data analysis, are intensely curious, and enjoy designing and developing long-term solutions.

What you bring to the table – and why we need you!

  • Data Visualization skills - Designing and developing key metrics, reports, and dashboards to drive insights and business decisions to improve performance and reduce costs;
  • Technical Skills – either experience in, or strong desire to learn fundamental technical skills needed to drive BI initiatives (SQL, DAX, Data Modeling, etc.);
  • Communication Skills - Partner with leadership and collaborate with software engineers to implement data architecture and design, to support complex analysis;
  • Analytical Skills - Conduct complex analysis and proactively identify key business insights to assist departmental decision making.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Life Science, Computer Science, or Related Degree;
  • 0-3 years of experience in business intelligence or analytics – Power BI and advanced SQL preferred;
  • Strong analytical and communication skills;
  • Excellent organization skills and the ability to multitask while efficiently completing high quality work.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO). We provide Phase I-IV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through its scientific and disciplined approach. We leverage local regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic disease, endocrinology, central nervous system, anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, employing more than 5,000 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

    • Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence
Collaborative Culture

    • Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
    • Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable
Continuous Growth & Development

    • Office based environment with on-site mentors
    • Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
    • Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
    • Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
    • An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

    • Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
    • Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
    • Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
    • Company-sponsored social events and intramural sports
Cincinnati Headquarters Experience

    • A modern corporate campus designed to support collaboration and productivity
    • Multiple on-site dining options in the heart of Madison Square
    • Free on-site parking
    • Convenient access to on-site 24-7 fitness and wellness facilities

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Overview:

The Business Analyst Payer Escalations is responsible for designing, producing, and analyzing data-driven reports to support business operations and special projects. This role involves utilizing various databases, information systems, and analytical tools to monitor, evaluate, and enhance business performance. The Business Analyst also assists in the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of information systems, ensuring data accuracy, accessibility, and usability for decision-making. This role is ideal for an analytically minded professional who enjoys working with data, optimizing reporting systems, and supporting business decision-making through actionable insights.

The Business Analyst is responsible for designing and generating reports, dashboards, and visualizations for business operations. Analyzing trends, patterns, and key performance indicators (KPIs) to provide actionable insights and maintaining data integrity, accuracy, and consistency in reporting.

The incumbent must be able to utilize SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or other analytics tools to extract and manipulate data; conduct statistical analysis to support data-driven decision-making and translate complex data into concise, easy-to-understand reports for stakeholders.

The Business Analyst must be able to assist in the development, implementation, and optimization of business information systems; maintain data structures, queries, and reporting tools to support business needs; and work closely with IT teams to ensure data availability and system functionality. In addition, the incumbent will be responsible for: documenting business processes, data sources, and reporting methodologies, identifying inefficiencies and opportunities for process improvement, providing recommendations for enhancing data collection, storage, and analysis methods while working closely with cross-functional teams, business stakeholders, and IT to understand reporting needs.

Experience working with large datasets and multiple databases.

Knowledge of business intelligence (BI) tools, SQL querying, and reporting software.

3+ years of relevant experience in business analysis, data reporting, or analytics.

Education

  • Bachelor's level degree (Required)


Certification/Licensure

  • No specific certification or licensure requirements


Experience

  • Experience working with Large Datasets and Multiple Databases
  • Knowledge of BI Tools, SQL, querying and reporting software
  • 3 + years relevant experience in business analysis, data reporting or analytics

Description

Join a team of analytical data users in the Commercial Data Reporting & Insight organization. This is a highly visible role within Huntington’s Commercial Bank and will drive the vision for leveraging data to improve decision making. In this role, you will partner with the Commercial Analytics Product Owners to act as a liaison across business leaders, segment partners, the centralized data leadership team, IT, and Finance partners. Working with the product owner, you will build understanding of their priorities and develop the tools and insights required to deliver results.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Translate business partners' data challenges into automated analytical solutions that reduce time spent on data movement and increase time spent turning data into insights
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to measure performance, activity, and business outcomes across the Commercial Bank
  • Build and modify queries using SAS, R, or Python to create data sets for reporting and analysis in Tableau, Power BI or other data visualization products
  • Mentor and develop peer analysts, advise senior stakeholders and act as a leader in the Commercial Bank data organization
  • Support ad hoc data requests and analysis, delivering insights to highlight areas of growth and opportunity to senior leaders
  • Partner with IT data partners to continue evolving Huntington’s data environment, improving the bank’s ability to automate and work more efficiently


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • 5+ years related of experience


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficient in SQL and SAS/R/Python
  • Experience designing executive-ready, self-service reporting in Power BI and/or Tableau
  • Proven track record of collaborating with business partners to develop technical solutions in an agile manner
  • Strong data validation, troubleshooting, documentation, and senior-stakeholder communication skills
  • Background in Financial Services, particularly within commercial banking or financial data organizations


Exempt Status: (Yes = not eligible for overtime pay) (No = eligible for overtime pay)

Yes

Office

Remote roles will also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for moments that matter. Specific work arrangements will be provided by the hiring team.

Tobacco-Free Hiring Practice: Visit Huntington's Career Web Site for more details.

Stord is the physical intelligence layer for independent commerce, giving brands the fulfillment network, software, AI, and robotics they need to own the entire relationship with their customer, from checkout to delivery to returns.

Prime reset what consumers expect from delivery, and every brand competing against it pays with margin, data, and the relationship with their own customer. Stord Labs, our physical intelligence lab in Atlanta, builds and tests AI and robotics on live orders before rolling proven systems out across the full network. The result is intelligence that compounds with every order that runs through it.

Backed by Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Franklin Templeton, and other leading investors, Stord has raised $250M in Series F equity funding at a $3B valuation.

The physical intelligence layer for independent commerce is here.

This is a place for people who want to work at the edge of commerce and applied AI on real, physical problems, not simulations. The pace is intense and the systems you ship move real freight for real brands within days. If you want to build the infrastructure that defines the next era of commerce, this is where you do it.

About Stord

Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. We are looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Strategy team and partner closely with senior leadership. This person will own the reporting, dashboards, and analysis that help our executive team make better decisions and communicate the performance of the business to our Board of Directors, investors, and internal leadership.

This is not a traditional reporting role. You will be responsible for taking complex business questions, finding the right data, turning it into clear insights, and building scalable reporting that can be used repeatedly across the organization.

You will work closely with Strategy, Finance, and senior leadership, with significant exposure to the executive team.

BI Analyst, Office of the President

About The Role

We are looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented Business Intelligence Analyst to join our Strategy team and partner closely with senior leadership. This person will own the reporting, dashboards, and analysis that help our executive team make better decisions and communicate the performance of the business to our Board of Directors, investors, and internal leadership.

This is not a traditional reporting role. You will be responsible for taking complex business questions, finding the right data, turning it into clear insights, and building scalable reporting that can be used repeatedly across the organization.

You will work closely with Strategy, Finance, and senior leadership, with significant exposure to the executive team.

What You'll Do

Executive, Board & Investor Reporting

  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting used for Board of Directors meetings, investor materials, executive reviews, and leadership meetings
  • Own the underlying data and analysis behind key company metrics
  • Partner with Strategy and Finance to prepare recurring reporting and investor materials
  • Translate complex business performance into clear, executive-ready insights and visualizations
  • Quickly investigate changes in performance and identify the key drivers behind the numbers

Business & Financial Reporting

  • Build recurring reporting around revenue, margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, headcount, sales, customer performance, and other key business metrics
  • Support actuals vs. budget vs. forecast reporting
  • Partner with Finance to ensure reporting is accurate, consistent, and aligned with financial statements and company planning
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and reduce reliance on spreadsheets and one-off analyses

Dashboards & Business Intelligence

  • Build and own executive dashboards that provide a clear view of company performance
  • Develop dashboards and reporting for internal leadership meetings across areas such as Sales, Operations, CX, Finance, and People
  • Establish consistent KPI definitions and create a single source of truth for critical business metrics
  • Improve the way leaders access and consume data across the organization

Data & Analytics

  • Pull, analyze, and reconcile data across multiple systems and data sources
  • Strong SQL proficiency and Semantic data layer experience
  • Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to resolve them
  • Turn ambiguous business questions into structured analyses and actionable recommendations
  • Build repeatable processes and automated reporting wherever possible

What We're Looking For

  • 3–6+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, strategic finance, FP&A, or a similar analytical role
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large or complex datasets
  • Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills
  • Experience building dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or a similar BI platform
  • Strong understanding of financial and operational metrics
  • Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for data accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and take an ambiguous question from idea → analysis → executive-ready output
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex data clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

You'd Be Especially Strong If You Have

  • Experience supporting a CEO, CFO, Strategy team, or executive leadership team
  • Experience with Board or investor reporting
  • Experience in FP&A or financial reporting
  • Experience in a high-growth technology, logistics, e-commerce, or SaaS company
  • Experience working with data warehouses and modern data stacks
  • Experience automating recurring reporting
  • Python or other analytical programming experience
  • A strong understanding of how financial, operational, and commercial metrics connect

What Success Looks Like

You will become the person the Strategy and executive teams rely on to answer questions like:

  • How is the business performing?
  • What changed?
  • Why did it change?
  • What are the key drivers?
  • Are we on track against our plan?
  • What should leadership be paying attention to?

You'll build the dashboards and reporting infrastructure that make those answers accessible, accurate, and repeatable.

Most importantly, you'll help turn data into a competitive advantage for how we run the business.

descriptionHtml:
Accelerate the possible by joining a winning Amcor team that’s transforming the packaging industry and improving lives around the world.

At Amcor, we unpack possibility through our innovative and responsible packaging to provide solutions that benefit our customers, our people and our planet. More than 10,000 consumers worldwide encounter our products every second and rely on us for safe access to food, medicine and other goods. We value their trust by making safety our guiding principle. It’s our core value and integral to how we do business.

Beyond this core principle, our shared values and behaviors unite us as we work together to elevate customers, shape lives and protect the future. We champion our customers and help them succeed. descriptionHtml:
Chubb Benefits, is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our fast-paced, high energy, growing company. We are proud of our tradition of success in the insurance industry of over 100 years. Come join our team of hard-working, talented professionals!


Job Summary

This position will be responsible for the development of Business Intelligence dashboards and analysis using Snowflake & Power BI . He/she will work closely with the Director of business Intelligence and functional leadership to deliver on the design, development, programming, meta data, maintenance, and publication of reports that play a key role in driving business decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Create data visualizations and transform data into innovative dashboard designs
  • Maintain large sets of data that require validation, cleansing, and troubleshooting
  • Create and maintain online automated reports using Power BI; update and maintain Excel, SQL sources as well as semantic models & metadata to ensure data quality
  • Debug technical issues when they arise
  • Respond to ad hoc requests for analysis and reports from internal stakeholders including Sales, Operations, Marketing, Underwriting, Legal, Actuarial, Training, and IT
  • Develop skills and leverage Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI & Snowflake to drive functional efficiencies and deliver high-quality information solutions
  • Analyze and integrate data from multiple sources
  • Leverage a foundational understanding of AI tools to support personal productivity


Skills and Experience

  • Three to five years experience. Knowledge of insurance/claim industry plus
  • Excellent technical skills including advanced knowledge of Excel
  • Excellent knowledge of SQL programming language
  • Business Intelligence and/or dashboard experience; DAX programming knowledge and Power BI a plus!
  • Creative design experience a plus!
  • Experience working with large databases in Snowflake or Azure a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and multi-tasking skills
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to self-start and work independently to complete assignments in a timely manner
  • Novice to intermediate ability to leverage AI tools (Claude code) to tune reports/code


Education

  • BA required, preferably in IT, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Finance


Location: Chicago, IL (near Rosemont, IL Triangle Plaza) and or other potential locations: Columbia, SC, Chattanooga, TN, Portland, ME


In-Office Expectation: 4 days in office, 1 day remote.


The pay range for the role is $61,000 to $89,000. The specific offer will depend on an applicant’s skills and other factors. This role may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. Chubb offers a comprehensive benefits package, more details on which can be found on our careers website. The disclosed pay range estimate may be adjusted for the applicable geographic differential for the location in which the position is filled."

This opportunity is in the Business Intelligence & Planning department.

The Business Intelligence & Planning Department is dedicated to empowering informed decision-making and driving strategic growth through comprehensive financial planning, data-driven insights, and governance excellence. Our mission is to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable intelligence to all stakeholders around the company by leveraging the strengths of our integrated teams, including Planning & Reserving, Portfolio Management, BI Analysis, BI Data Analysis, Data Quality and Data Governance. Together, we support a culture of data excellence and financial foresight.

Role Description:

As a Business Intelligence Data Analyst, you will play a key role in transforming data into meaningful insights that drive business decisions across the organization. You will work closely with business partners to understand reporting needs and translate them into technical solutions, building and maintaining reports and dashboards using tools like Power BI and SSRS.

In this role, you will leverage your SQL expertise to query and manage data across multiple systems, ensuring accuracy and consistency in reporting outputs. You will also support data validation, assist in refining reporting processes, and contribute to documentation that enhances transparency and usability.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, solving business problems, and collaborating with stakeholders to deliver impactful analytics solutions in a dynamic and growing environment.

Qualifications:

Education:

Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field is preferred

Required Qualifications:

  • 1 or more years of experience in reporting, data analysis, or analytics within a business environment
  • Prior experience interpreting business requirements and translating to technical requirements
  • Ability to read, write, and modify moderately complex SQL queries
  • Prior experience managing data tables and strong knowledge of common data structures and table joins
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills including proficiency in vlookups, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and writing moderately complex formulas
  • Prior hands-on experience providing reporting and/or data visualization using Power BI or SSRS / Visual Studio
  • Must be presently authorized to work in the U.S. without a requirement for work authorization sponsorship by our company for this position now or in the future
  • This position allows for a hybrid work schedule which includes a minimum of 3 days per week in our St. Louis Corporate Office, located at 1832 Schuetz Rd. Saint Louis, MO. All employees are required to submit work from home requests and follow our Work From Home policy, which will be provided to all candidates selected to interview.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field
  • Prior experience with Snowflake data cloud
  • Exposure to data warehousing concepts or working with large, complex datasets

To support employees in their career journeys, we provide professional growth and development opportunities in addition to employee recognition and well-being programs. Apply today to learn more.

Safety National is committed to fair, transparent pay and we strive to provide competitive, market-based compensation. Compensation for the successful candidate will consider the candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, competencies, experience and geographic location.

descriptionHtml:
CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Analyst who works directly with the business to turn data into decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to scope their reporting needs, build dashboards, and teach teams how to use them. This role is as much about relationships and enablement as it is about building.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs
  • Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations
  • Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate, intuitive, and actionable
  • Write SQL against Snowflake to explore data, validate results, and support ad hoc analysis
  • Work with Data Engineering to shape the semantic layer and data models, define KPI and calculation logic, flag data quality issues, and improve report performance and Snowflake costs
  • Build the business definitions and synonyms that help AI tools (like Snowflake Cortex Analyst or Power BI Copilot) answer questions correctly
  • Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live
  • Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business
  • Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data
  • Gather feedback after launch, track adoption, and iterate on dashboards

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role
  • Strong dashboarding skills in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool
  • Working SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, CTEs, basic window functions)
  • Demonstrated ability to run requirements-gathering conversations and turn vague asks into scoped deliverables
  • Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers.
  • Experience facilitating trainings, workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly
  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of validating numbers before sharing them

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse
  • Familiarity with DAX and dimensional modeling concepts
  • Experience writing business definitions, synonyms, or test cases for AI-driven or natural-language analytics tools.
  • Background in finance, FP&A, or sales operations
  • Exposure to dbt, Fivetran, or modern data stack tools
  • Experience building a data community or champions program
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, IT, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $120,000 - $175,000 per year + annual bonus + additional benefits.

Benefits Summary

The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. Additionally, employees can take advantage of generous parental and maternity leave policies, technology stipends, and wellness reimbursement programs, all designed to support both professional growth and personal well-being. For detailed information about benefits at CrossCountry, please visit our dedicated benefits site: https://www.crosscountry-consulting.com/careers/benefits/.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

CrossCountry provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and believes that respect and fair treatment are critical to creating a productive and inclusive workplace.

As an equal opportunity employer, CrossCountry is fully committed to comply with all federal, state, and local laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetics, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression or any other protected characteristic. The company also complies with pay transparency and labor laws applicable to all terms and conditions of employment.

- Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs 
- Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations 
- Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate, intuitive, and actionable

- Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live 
- Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business 
- Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data

- 5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role

- Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers. 
- Experience facilitating trainings, workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences 
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly

Job Description

As a Data Analytics Consultant, you’ll use data to answer business questions, identify meaningful trends, and provide insights that support better decisions. You’ll work with large and complex data sets from multiple sources, applying analytical and statistical techniques to turn information into clear, actionable recommendations.

You’ll collaborate with business and technical partners to understand questions, conduct analysis, communicate findings, and measure the results of recommendations put into action.

In this role, you will:

  • Gather, integrate, and analyze large volumes of data from multiple sources to address business questions.
  • Identify and interpret trends, patterns, relationships, and opportunities within complex data sets.
  • Apply statistical techniques and analytical tools to develop insights and recommendations.
  • Translate complex analysis into clear, concise findings that enable partners to make data-driven decisions.
  • Develop reports and visualizations that make analytical results accessible and actionable.
  • Collaborate with business, technology, and analytics partners to provide a holistic view of data and findings.
  • Support advanced analytics and predictive modeling initiatives.
  • Measure and monitor the results of implemented recommendations and identify adjustments based on performance.
  • Work with analytics and data tools that may include Python, Power BI, Adobe Analytics, Snowflake, Azure, Databricks, and GitHub Copilot.
  • Apply agile methods and ways of working to support collaboration and delivery.
  • Ensure data acquisition, sharing, analysis, and resulting recommendations comply with company standards.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Four to five years of statistical and/or data analytics experience


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with advanced analytics, statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and complex data sets.
  • Experience with Python, reporting, business intelligence, and data visualization tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience with data platforms and environments such as Snowflake, Azure, and Databricks.
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar web analytics tools and AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Understanding of database architecture, data structures, and source systems.
  • Strong project management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate analytical findings for varied audiences.
  • Experience applying agile ways of working and collaborating across business and technical teams.
  • Experience in financial services and/or progressively responsible reporting, business intelligence, or analytics work; an advanced quantitative degree is a plus.


Location expectations

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.
