descriptionHtml:
The New York City Department of Correction (DOC) is an integral part of the City’s evolving criminal justice system, participating in reform initiatives and strategies aimed to move the City towards a smaller jail system without compromising public safety. The DOC is responsible for maintaining a safe and secure environment for our employees, visitors, volunteers, and people in our custody. Importantly, safe jails enable DOC to provide people in custody with the tools and opportunities they need to successfully re-enter their communities. The DOC operates facilities and court commands across the five boroughs with more than 7,500 diverse professionals and knowledgeable experts.

The Office of Management, Analysis, and Planning (OMAP) is seeking a skilled and proactive Business Intelligence Analyst to transform complex operational data into actionable dashboards, automated reporting pipelines, and strategic insights. Working at the intersection of data engineering and visual analytics, this role supports executive leadership and operational divisions by ensuring high-integrity, real-time visibility into agency performance, compliance metrics, and strategic initiatives.

Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Automated Reporting:

  • Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries across relational databases and centralized data

warehouses to extract, transform, and validate operational records.

  • Design, build, and maintain automated scheduled data pipelines and executive dashboards using tools

like Tableau, Python (Dash), or Power BI.

  • Establish and monitor automated data validation scripts to proactively identify system entry gaps, data

discrepancies, or pipeline failures.

Performance Metrics & Analytics

  • Collaborate with operational stakeholders to translate operational workflows and policy mandates into

structured KPIs and performance scorecards.

  • Conduct exploratory and descriptive data analysis to detect trends, system utilization gaps, and

longitudinal performance shifts.

  • Prepare recurring executive briefings, compliance summaries, and ad-hoc data extracts for leadership,

legal, or oversight reviews.

Data Governance & System Integration

  • Partner with enterprise IT to reconcile discrepancies between front-end data entry applications, legacy

administrative systems, and centralized data warehouses.

  • Contribute to standardizing data dictionaries, field mappings, and master data management practices

across diverse operational units.

  • Document data extraction methodologies, reporting logic, and pipeline workflows to ensure institutional

continuity.

CITY RESEARCH SCIENTIST - 21744

Minimum Qualifications

  • For Assignment Level I (only physical, biological and environmental sciences and public health) A master's degree from an accredited college or university with a specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological or environmental science or in public health.

To be appointed to Assignment Level II and above, candidates must have:

  • A doctorate degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and one year of full-time experience in a responsible supervisory, administrative or research capacity in the appropriate field of specialization; or
  • A master's degree from an accredited college or university with specialization in an appropriate field of physical, biological, environmental or social science and three years of responsible full-time research experience in the appropriate field of specialization; or
  • Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1" or "2" above. However, all candidates must have at least a master's degree in an appropriate field of specialization and at least two years of experience described in "2" above. Two years as a City Research Scientist Level I can be substituted for the experience required in "1" and "2" above.

Note

Probationary Period

Appointments to this position are subject to a minimum probationary period of one year.

Preferred Skills

  • Programming & Data Manipulation: Advanced proficiency in Python for robust data manipulation, exploratory analysis, and visualization. - Database & SQL Expertise: Deep expertise in SQL, with a strong ability to write optimized queries, navigate complex relational databases, and extract data from enterprise data warehouses. - Data Visualization & BI: Extensive experience designing, building, and maintaining interactive, executive-ready dashboards using tools like Tableau, Dash, or Power BI. - Automation & Deployment: Demonstrated experience developing, deploying, and automating server- based analytical resources, including scheduling recurring reports and maintaining automated data pipelines. - Applied Analytical Skills: Solid foundation in applied statistical modeling, performance tracking, and identifying actionable trends within large, complex datasets. - Domain Experience: Prior experience working with public sector, criminal justice, operational, or highly regulated administrative data is desirable. - Project Management & Communication: Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a proven ability to manage multiple deliverables, track cross-functional dependencies, and clearly communicate complex data findings to non-technical stakeholders and agency leadership.

Public Service Loan Forgiveness

As a prospective employee of the City of New York, you may be eligible for federal loan forgiveness programs and state repayment assistance programs. For more information, please visit the U.S. Department of Education’s website at https://studentaid.gov/pslf/.

Residency Requirement

New York City residency is generally required within 90 days of appointment. However, City Employees in certain titles who have worked for the City for 2 continuous years may also be eligible to reside in Nassau, Suffolk, Putnam, Westchester, Rockland, or Orange County. To determine if the residency requirement applies to you, please discuss with the agency representative at the time of interview.

Additional Information

The City of New York is an inclusive equal opportunity employer committed to recruiting and retaining a diverse workforce and providing a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment based upon any legally protected status or protected characteristic, including but not limited to an individual's sex, race, color, ethnicity, national origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity, or pregnancy.

Job Summary

The Senior Enterprise Analytics Analyst transforms complex healthcare and business data into actionable insights that support executive decision-making, organizational strategy, and performance improvement. This role leads complex analytics initiatives, develops executive-level reporting, identifies trends and opportunities, and serves as a subject matter expert promoting best practices in data analysis, visualization, and business intelligence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze healthcare claims, enrollment, provider, pharmacy, clinical, financial, and operational data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and improvement opportunities across all lines of business.
  • Develop financial, operational, and clinical performance analyses using advanced analytics, forecasting, predictive modeling, utilization analysis, financial modeling, and trend analysis to generate actionable insights that improve business performance, operational efficiency, quality outcomes, member experience, and support enterprise decision-making.
  • Develop and deliver executive dashboards, performance scorecards, visualizations, and key performance indicators (KPIs) using Power BI and other business intelligence tools; communicate findings.
  • Develop visualizations that effectively communicate trends, risks, opportunities, and organizational performance.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of strategic initiatives through outcome measurement, root cause analysis, and post-implementation analysis; identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Promote enterprise standards for analytical methodologies, metric definitions, documentation, and reporting practices to ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of analytical outputs.
  • Maintain trusted enterprise data assets, validate data quality, resolve discrepancies, and support data warehouse enhancements and new data source integration.
  • Support enterprise projects involving system implementations, including claims administration platforms, data warehouses, and business intelligence modernization initiatives; recommend process improvements.
  • Validate data quality, resolve reporting discrepancies, and support enterprise data governance through documentation and standardization of analytical processes to ensure analytical outputs are accurate, consistent, and reliable.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert and establish best practices for analytics, visualization, SQL development, documentation, and quality review; provide guidance and oversight to associate analysts.
  • Perform other related job duties as required or assigned.

Qualifications

  • Advanced SQL proficiency including querying, transforming, and validating complex datasets.
  • Proficient in developing interactive Power BI dashboards and reports.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, and data analysis.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to data accuracy and quality.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Knowledge in healthcare claims adjudication systems, enterprise data warehouses, and data lakehouse architectures preferred.
  • Knowledge in financial reporting, population health, value-based care, provider network, clinical utilization management, quality improvement, risk adjustment, and pharmacy analytics preferred.
  • Knowledge in Medicare Advantage, Commercial health insurance, and ACA Marketplace products preferred.
  • Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Public Health, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
  • A minimum of five years of more of progressively responsible experience in healthcare analytics, business intelligence, financial analytics, or data analytics.
  • Prior experience developing executive dashboards using Power BI or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Prior experience analyzing large healthcare datasets.
  • Prior experience within a managed care organization preferred.
  • Prior experience supporting executive leadership preferred.
  • Prior experience with enterprise data warehouse environments preferred.

CommunityCare is an equal opportunity at will employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of age, race, religion, color, disability, sex, sexual orientation or national origin

This role is responsible for understanding business needs, translating requirements into scalable business intelligence solutions, and delivering intuitive analytic experiences that enable leaders to make informed decisions.

This role will combine business acumen, data storytelling, visualization expertise, and technical knowledge to create impactful reporting and analytical solutions. This role requires deep partnership with sales, operations, planning, finance, strategy, and engineering teams to ensure business intelligence products meet stakeholder needs while aligning with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

In addition to business intelligence development, this role will help influence semantic model design, reporting architecture, artificial intelligence (AI) readiness initiatives, and platform optimization efforts. We are seeking a candidate that will be equally comfortable engaging with executives on business challenges, designing user-centric reporting experiences, and collaborating with engineering teams on analytical solutions.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Planning Analytics & Business Intelligence

  • Lead the design, development, and continuous improvement of business intelligence solutions supporting key planning motions across SME&C.

    • Fast Start
    • Segmentation
    • Quota planning
    • Territory performance analysis
    • Coverage and resource planning
    • Investment allocation analysis
    • Business performance management
  • Translate business requirements into scalable analytical products that improve visibility into performance drivers and operational effectiveness.
  • Drive adoption of planning insights and reporting solutions by ensuring data is accurate, trusted, actionable, and easy to consume.
Rapid Analytics & Business Problem Solving

  • Conduct high-priority analytical investigations in response to executive requests, emerging business needs, and strategic business questions.
  • Frame ambiguous business problems, identify appropriate analytical approaches, and generate actionable recommendations on accelerated timelines.
  • Perform root-cause analysis, opportunity identification, trend analysis, performance diagnostics, experimentation assessments, and scenario evaluations.
  • Develop concise executive-ready narratives that clearly articulate key findings, business implications, and recommended actions.
  • Balance analytical rigor with speed, helping leaders make informed decisions when time-sensitive issues arise.
  • Support leadership reviews, planning discussions, investment decisions, and business performance evaluations through timely analytics.

Data Architecture, Semantic Models & AI Readiness

  • Design, develop, and maintain semantic models, analytical data products, and reporting architectures that support planning analytics and self-service business intelligence.

  • Partner with engineering and analytics teams to identify opportunities for model consolidation, architecture simplification, and technical debt reduction.
  • Ensure analytical assets are structured to support AI-enabled experiences, natural language querying, Copilot experiences, agent-based analytics, and self-service insight generation.
  • Lead efforts to certify data assets and reporting solutions for enterprise consumption, ensuring data is trusted, governed, discoverable, and aligned to organizational standards.
  • Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve model performance, user experience, scalability, and platform efficiency.
  • Promote impactful practices for semantic model design, performance optimization, data lineage, and enterprise reporting architecture.

Data Analysis & Evaluation

  • Apply advanced analytical techniques to evaluate business performance and identify opportunities for growth and optimization.
  • Analyze data across multiple systems and business processes to identify trends, drivers, risks, and opportunities.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of planning programs, investments, operational initiatives, and business decisions.
  • Develop reusable analytical frameworks that improve understanding of business performance and support ongoing decision-making.
  • Measure outcomes and communicate recommendations through clear, actionable insights.

Stakeholder Partnership & Influence

  • Build trusted relationships across Planning, Finance, Strategy, Sales Excellence, Operations, Engineering, and Analytics teams.
  • Translate business questions into analytical requirements and communicate results in a business-focused manner.
  • Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders across multiple organizational levels.
  • Influence decision-making through data-driven recommendations, thoughtful analysis, and strong business acumen.
  • Proactively identify opportunities where analytics can improve business outcomes.
  • Serve as a trusted analytical advisor by combining business context, technical expertise, and data-driven insights.

Analytics Excellence & Innovation

  • Promote analytics impactful practices including governance, consistency of metrics, reporting standards, quality assurance, and analytical rigor.
  • Identify opportunities to automate recurring analyses and improve operational efficiency through reusable analytical assets.
  • Continuously explore new technologies, AI capabilities, analytical techniques, and visualization approaches that improve business outcomes.
  • Support the organization's AI-first vision by ensuring analytical assets, semantic models, and reporting solutions are structured to enable self-service insights and agent-powered analytics experiences.

Qualifications

Required/minimum qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 3+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 4+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR equivalent experience.

Additional Or Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 6+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Mathematics, Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing, Business, Economics or related field AND 8+ years experience in data analysis and reporting, business intelligence, or business and financial analysis OR equivalent experience.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Arrive Logistics is a leading transportation and technology company in North America with plans to grow significantly year over year. Our success is a testament to our remarkable team and what we’re building together. We’re committed to providing employees with a meaningful work experience and have established an award-winning culture that supports personal and career development in a fun, casual, and collaborative environment.


Who We Want

Arrive Logistics is seeking a highly-motivated Reporting Analyst I to join our team. Our strong data-driven culture offers a unique opportunity for an analyst looking to make an immediate impact across all functions and at all levels of the organization. As the fastest growing logistics brokerage in history, we are seeking someone who will thrive in a fast paced and evolving environment.


What You'll Do

  • Develop reports, dashboards and interactive visualizations using different components of Microsoft Power BI.
  • Create ad-hoc analysis in support of department leadership using Snowflake SQL queries
  • Continuously monitor performance to identify improvements in models and do related work as required.
  • Create and interpret analytics to share findings and recommendations with the internal team and other stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Stakeholders to understand priorities, business needs, and functions.
  • Collaborate with the Analytics Engineering team to determine and address data and reporting needs for various company projects.
  • Handle sensitive information in a confidential manner.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree or 2 years of equivalent experience.
  • Basic knowledge of database, table, and dataset design is desired.
  • Experience using data analytics tools including Excel, Snowflake, SQL, Power BI, SSRS, MS Report Builder.
  • Detail oriented with strong independent critical thinking, organization, and time management skills to meet strict deadlines in a rapidly changing environment.
  • Ability to learn and understand a business model and fully comprehend operational concepts, relationships between those concepts and data being utilized.


The Perks of Working With Us

  • Take advantage of our comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, and supplemental coverage.
  • Invest in your future with our matching 401(k) program.
  • Build relationships and take part in learning opportunities through our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Enjoy office wide engagement activities, team events, happy hours and more!
  • Leave the suit and tie at home; our dress code is casual.
  • Work in the heart of downtown Chicago, IL!
  • Sweat it out at the LifeStart gym in our office building that includes brand new Peloton bikes, top-of-the-line equipment and personal training options.
  • Maximize your wellness with free counseling sessions through our Employee Assistance Program
  • Take time to manage your physical and mental health - we offer company paid holidays, paid vacation time and wellness days.
  • Receive 100% paid parental leave when you become a new parent.
  • Get paid to work with your friends through our Referral Program!
  • Get relocation assistance! If you are not local to the area, we offer relocation packages.


$62,000 - $78,000 a year

The base salary range for this position is $62,000 - $78,000, plus bonus and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the pay range for the position across all locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on work location, job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training.


Your Arrive Experience

When we say “award-winning culture,” we mean it. We’ve been recognized as a top workplace by Inc. Fast Company, Fortune, and earned Top Workplaces and Great Place to Work, to name a few. We intend on topping many more of those lists in the years to come, but we’re not in it for the trophies. We’re committed to culture because it keeps us connected to each other and invested in our shared success while having a blast along the way. Our employee-founded resource groups create communities within Arrive’s walls, including Women in Logistics, Emerging Professionals, Prisms, Black Logistics Group, Salute and Unidos.


Notice:

To ensure a safe and transparent interview process, we want to note that Arrive Logistics adheres to strict recruitment practices. Candidates undergo an interview process, and Arrive Logistics does not provide unsolicited job offers. If you have concerns about receiving a fraudulent offer, please contact talentacquisition@arrivelogistics.com for verification.

descriptionHtml:
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide, including corporations, governments and individuals, from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career, a place for people to learn, achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

The Analytics & Data (A&D) team within Morgan Stanley Wealth Management Strategy and Analytics delivers management reporting, customer and product behavior insights, and predictive analytics in support of Wealth Management, Banking and Firmwide Marketing. We are seeking an analytical, execution-oriented AVP to support the Private Markets including EquityZen business, with a primary focus on performance reporting, business insights and decision support.

EquityZen, a part of Morgan Stanley, is a leading marketplace for pre-IPO investments, connecting shareholders of private companies with accredited investors. Through its category-leading technology and innovative approach, EquityZen delivers data-driven insights and tools that empower its 800,000 users to navigate the private markets with confidence. Having completed more than 51,000 private placements in nearly 500 private companies, EquityZen is on a mission to deliver “Private Markets for the Public.

Responsibilities

  • Produce and enhance recurring management reporting and executive-ready dashboards that provide clear visibility into commercial performance, client activity, product trends, pipeline health and operating results.
  • Analyze business performance across the customer lifecycle and translate findings into concise insights, and recommendations for Private Markets/EquityZen and Wealth Management stakeholders.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, Finance, Legal/Compliance and Technology to define key performance indicators, reporting requirements and consistent metric definitions.
  • Support forecasting, target setting and performance reviews by preparing trend analyses, variance explanations, scenario assessments and leadership materials.
  • Develop ad hoc analyses to evaluate growth opportunities, operating challenges and emerging business questions
  • Maintain strong controls over reporting outputs by validating source data, documenting business logic, reconciling results and promptly resolving data-quality issues with appropriate partners.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes, reduce manual effort and improve the timeliness, usability and consistency of analytics deliverables.
  • Manage assigned projects from requirements through delivery, coordinate stakeholders, communicate risks and dependencies, and ensure work is completed accurately and on schedule.

Qualifications

  • Minimum education requirement; Bachelor degree
  • 3+ years of experience in analytics and reporting roles within financial services.
  • Strong experience developing executive reporting, dashboards, scorecards and performance analyses that connect business results to actionable insights.
  • Experience working across modern data platforms and analytics tools; familiarity with environments including Snowflake, Hadoop, Dataiku, and Tableau strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including producing executive-ready decks that can be used with minimal editing.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python with hands-on data analytics skills, including the ability to manipulate large datasets, validate results, and defend assumptions.
  • Experience supporting forecasting, planning, pipeline analysis or financial and operating performance reviews.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, controls, documentation and reproducible reporting processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings clearly to senior stakeholders and tailor the level of detail to the audience.
  • Collaborative and organized approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Technology
  • Knowledge of financial services, venture capital or private markets is preferred.

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Expected base pay rates for the role will be between $85,000 and $140,000 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career, a place for people to learn, achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.

The Analytics & Data (A&D) team within Morgan Stanley Wealth Management Strategy and Analytics delivers management reporting, customer and product behavior insights, and predictive analytics in support of Wealth Management, Banking and Firmwide Marketing. We are seeking an analytical, execution-oriented AVP to support the Private Markets including EquityZen business, with a primary focus on performance reporting, business insights and decision support.

EquityZen, a part of Morgan Stanley, is a leading marketplace for pre-IPO investments, connecting shareholders of private companies with accredited investors. Through its category-leading technology and innovative approach, EquityZen delivers data-driven insights and tools that empower its 800,000 users to navigate the private markets with confidence. Having completed more than 51,000 private placements in nearly 500 private companies, EquityZen is on a mission to deliver “Private Markets for the Public.

Responsibilities



- Produce and enhance recurring management reporting and executive-ready dashboards that provide clear visibility into commercial performance, client activity, product trends, pipeline health and operating results.
- Analyze business performance across the customer lifecycle and translate findings into concise insights, and recommendations for Private Markets/EquityZen and Wealth Management stakeholders.
- Partner with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, Finance, Legal/Compliance and Technology to define key performance indicators, reporting requirements and consistent metric definitions.
- Support forecasting, target setting and performance reviews by preparing trend analyses, variance explanations, scenario assessments and leadership materials.
- Develop ad hoc analyses to evaluate growth opportunities, operating challenges and emerging business questions
- Maintain strong controls over reporting outputs by validating source data, documenting business logic, reconciling results and promptly resolving data-quality issues with appropriate partners.
- Identify opportunities to streamline reporting processes, reduce manual effort and improve the timeliness, usability and consistency of analytics deliverables.
- Manage assigned projects from requirements through delivery, coordinate stakeholders, communicate risks and dependencies, and ensure work is completed accurately and on schedule.

Qualifications



- Minimum education requirement; Bachelor degree 
- 3+ years of experience in analytics and reporting roles within financial services.
- Strong experience developing executive reporting, dashboards, scorecards and performance analyses that connect business results to actionable insights.
- Experience working across modern data platforms and analytics tools; familiarity with environments including Snowflake, Hadoop, Dataiku, and Tableau strongly preferred.
- Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint, including producing executive-ready decks that can be used with minimal editing.
- Strong proficiency in SQL and Python with hands-on data analytics skills, including the ability to manipulate large datasets, validate results, and defend assumptions.
- Experience supporting forecasting, planning, pipeline analysis or financial and operating performance reviews.
- Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy, controls, documentation and reproducible reporting processes.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex findings clearly to senior stakeholders and tailor the level of detail to the audience.
- Collaborative and organized approach, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Legal/Compliance, and Technology
- Knowledge of financial services, venture capital or private markets is preferred.

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Job Family

Data Science Consulting

Travel Required

Up to 10%

Clearance Required

Ability to Obtain Public Trust

What You Will Do

The analyst will turn complex, multi-source data into clear dashboards and reports that inform agency leadership decisions. The ideal candidate brings extensive, hands-on expertise in both Tableau and Microsoft Power BI.

Key Responsibilities

Data aggregation

  • Collect, integrate, and consolidate data from multiple agency systems, databases, spreadsheets, and external sources.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines, extracts, and data models that feed reporting tools.
  • Perform data cleansing, validation, and quality checks to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Document data sources, definitions, lineage, and business rules.

Data analytics

  • Analyze large, complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, gaps, and performance drivers.
  • Develop metrics, KPIs, and performance measures aligned with agency mission and strategic goals.
  • Apply descriptive and diagnostic analysis, and support forecasting where appropriate.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for technical and non-technical audiences.

Data visualization

  • Design, build, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports in Tableau and Microsoft Power BI.
  • Gather requirements from agency stakeholders and convert them into intuitive visual products.
  • Apply data visualization best practices and Section 508 accessibility standards.
  • Optimize dashboard performance, manage workbooks and datasets, and administer publishing on Tableau Server/Cloud and the Power BI Service.
  • Brief findings to agency leadership and produce executive-level presentations.

Client support

  • Work closely with federal program managers, analysts, and the LinkVisum project team.
  • Train end users on dashboards and self-service reporting.
  • Support data governance, security, and privacy requirements, including handling of PII.

What You Will Need

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field; FOUR (4) additional years of data analysis, business intelligence, or data visualization can be used in lieu of degree.
  • FIVE (5) or more years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or data visualization. Experience should include:
    • Extensive, hands-on expertise in Tableau (Desktop, Prep, and Server/Cloud), including calculated fields, LOD expressions, parameters, actions, and dashboard design.
    • Extensive, hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power BI (Desktop and Service), including Power Query, DAX, data modeling, row-level security, and workspace management.
    • Strong SQL skills for querying, joining, and transforming data from relational databases.
    • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
    • Proven ability to aggregate and reconcile data from disparate sources.
What Will Be Nice To Have

  • Active Public Trust or Secret clearance.
  • Prior experience supporting a federal agency, preferably in human capital, workforce, or operational performance analytics.
  • Tableau certification (Tableau Desktop Specialist, Certified Data Analyst) and/or Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
  • Experience with Python or R for data preparation and analysis.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS, Databricks, or Snowflake.
  • Knowledge of federal data standards, the Evidence Act, and Section 508 compliance.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.

The annual salary range for this position is $98,000.00-$163,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

Benefits Include

  • Medical, Rx, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Personal and Family Sick Time & Company Paid Holidays
  • Position may be eligible for a discretionary variable incentive bonus
  • Parental Leave and Adoption Assistance

Overview

Join our team of dedicated professionals who provide services and operational support to award winning hospitals through roles in supply chain, IT and cybersecurity, clinical engineering, capital procurement, medical coding, project management and more. We provide services to clinically excellent community hospitals across the country that are dedicated to ensuring quality, compassionate care for every patient, every time.

Responsibilities

The Business Analyst I reports to the Director of Shared Services and provides comprehensive analytical and data enablement support across multiple business domains and data needs. This role manages and leads multiple concurrent projects while delivering new, data-driven insights that shape strategic business decisions through a blend of technical, analytical, and professional skills. In this capacity, the Business Analyst I develops a working understanding of key business systems and data sources, performs ETL-related activities by extracting data from disparate systems, cleansing, and transforming it as needed, and validating data quality to ensure it is reliable and fit for purpose. The role produces actionable reports, forecasts, and analyses; designs and maintains BI dashboards and metrics to support operational and executive decision-making; and enables automation use cases by preparing and structuring data for repeatable workflows. Additionally, the Business Analyst I supports advanced analytics initiatives by curating datasets suitable for machine learning and AI model consumption, ensuring consistent definitions, governance alignment, and documentation. Strong collaboration and communication skills are essential to partner effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, translate business needs into data requirements, and present clear, well-supported recommendations, including proposing a course of action based on analysis, market knowledge, and measurable outcomes.

Qualifications

 EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, TRAINING

  • Education & Experience
  • Master’s degree in business analytics, engineering, mathematics, computer science, or related field required.
  • 0–2 years of experience (internship, co-op, or professional) in data analysis, reporting, business analysis, or related work preferred.
  • Technical Skills
  • Working knowledge of data analysis and reporting tools: Excel (pivot tables, lookups), and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Qlik.
  • Proficient writing SQL queries (joins, aggregations, filters) to extract and validate data from relational databases.
  • Exposure to ETL concepts and practices: extracting data from business systems, cleaning/transforming data, validating results, and documenting assumptions/definitions.
  • Basic scripting experience in Python required for data cleaning, analysis, or automation tasks.
  • Familiarity with data quality practices (reconciliation, exception checks, source-to-report validation) and maintaining consistent metrics/definitions.
  • Analytical & Business Skills
  • Ability to analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and recommend practical solutions supported by data.
  • Ability to visualize data and communicate insights through dashboards, scorecards, and clear written summaries.
  • Professional Skills
  • Strong time management and prioritization skills; able to balance competing stakeholders’ needs, manage multiple concurrent requests, and deliver on deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • High degree of integrity, confidentiality, maturity, tact, and professional ethics; able to collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.

Pay Transparency

BioMedical Services, Inc. offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package that provides employees the flexibility to tailor benefits according to their individual needs. Our Total Rewards package includes, but is not limited to, paid time off, a 401K retirement plan, medical, dental, and vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, and many more voluntary benefit options. Benefits may vary based on employment status, i.e. full-time, part-time, per diem or temporary. A reasonable compensation estimate for this role, which includes estimated wages, benefits, and other forms of compensation, is $79,996.80 to $115,856.00 on an annualized basis. The exact starting compensation to be offered will be determined at the time of selecting an applicant for hire, in which a wide range of factors will be considered, including but not limited to, skillset, years of applicable experience, education, credentials and licensure.

Full Time

Shift

Days

Job Description

Apply now

Job Title: Data Analyst - ANA

Posting Start Date: 10/9/26

Posting Location: Ada (Grand Rapids), MI

Requisition ID: 43339

Job Title: Data Analyst

Department / Division: Data Analytics and Insights

Salary Range: $91,892 - $96,486

Location: Ada, MI (M-Th in Office, WFH Fri)

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who is equal parts curious problem-solver, data storyteller, and business partner. You’ll join the Amway North America (ANA) Data & Analytics team — the crew that turns messy questions, market movement, and performance signals into clear “aha!” moments. In this role, you’ll partner with Go-to-Market and ANA market leadership teams to understand what’s happening, why it matters, and where ANA can act next.

You’ll go beyond “here’s the report” and dig into the good stuff: what changed, what’s driving it, and what we should do about it. You’ll analyze standard and non-standard data, blend quantitative and qualitative insights, and create executive-ready stories that connect promotions, product launches, market activity, and Independent Business Owner (IBO) behavior to practical recommendations. If you love turning data into direction — and making complex business questions feel clear, useful, and maybe even a little fun — this could be your kind of role.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 - 5 years’ experience with data analytics or data operations
  • Experience with data analytics, database management, or a related field
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing business performance, synthesizing insights, and presenting recommendations that influence decisions
  • BA/BS degree in Business, Statistics, Computer Science/Information Technology

Skills To Be Successful In The Role

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational data structures, data validation, and business intelligence tools, as well as Tableau or other data visualization software , with a willingness to deepen technical proficiency through practical experience.
  • Experience managing datasets, building queries to answer business questions, and generating clear data visualizations
  • Ability to craft audience-ready data stories that explain what is changing, why it matters, and which strategic or tactical actions should be considered
  • Strong business acumen with curiosity to connect promotions, product launches, field behavior, and market trends into a broader performance narrative
  • Consultative mindset to partner with internal clients, challenge assumptions, and translate analysis into recommendations for market leadership and Go-to-Market partners
  • Ability to collaborate with global partners and other analytics leaders to identify opportunities for analytics advancement, process improvement and automation that enhances reporting efficiency and scalability across markets

What’s Special About This Team

The ANA Data & Analytics team is a tight, hardworking crew of 7 who love turning big questions into smart, usable insights – and yes, we’re known to bond over the occasional team treat. We partner closely with Sales, Marketing and other cross‑functional friends to create reports and dashboards that help Independent Business Owners (IBOs) share, sell and shine with our products.

You’ll get hands‑on exposure to all kinds of complex business challenges and teams across the organization – the kind of variety that keeps things interesting and opens the door to real growth in the industry. It’s a team where you learn fast, collaborate often and enjoy the kind of camaraderie that makes the work feel meaningful.

This is a full-time W2 position. Amway does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Amway immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, STEM OPT, TN, etc.) now or in the future.

In this role, you’ll partner with Go-to-Market and ANA market leadership teams to understand what’s happening, why it matters, and where ANA can act next.

You’ll go beyond “here’s the report” and dig into the good stuff: what changed, what’s driving it, and what we should do about it. You’ll analyze standard and non-standard data, blend quantitative and qualitative insights, and create executive-ready stories that connect promotions, product launches, market activity, and Independent Business Owner (IBO) behavior to practical recommendations. If you love turning data into direction — and making complex business questions feel clear, useful, and maybe even a little fun — this could be your kind of role.

Required Qualifications



-  Minimum 3 - 5 years’ experience with data analytics or data operations 
-  Experience with data analytics, database management, or a related field 
-  Demonstrated experience analyzing business performance, synthesizing insights, and presenting recommendations that influence decisions 
-  BA/BS degree in Business, Statistics, Computer Science/Information Technology 

Skills To Be Successful In The Role



-  Proficiency in Microsoft Office 
-  Working knowledge of SQL, relational data structures, data validation, and business intelligence tools, as well as Tableau or other data visualization software , with a willingness to deepen technical proficiency through practical experience. 
-  Experience managing datasets, building queries to answer business questions, and generating clear data visualizations 
-  Ability to craft audience-ready data stories that explain what is changing, why it matters, and which strategic or tactical actions should be considered 
-  Strong business acumen with curiosity to connect promotions, product launches, field behavior, and market trends into a broader performance narrative 
-  Consultative mindset to partner with internal clients, challenge assumptions, and translate analysis into recommendations for market leadership and Go-to-Market partners 
-  Ability to collaborate with global partners and other analytics leaders to identify opportunities for analytics advancement, process improvement and automation that enhances reporting efficiency and scalability across markets 

What’s Special About This Team

The ANA Data & Analytics team is a tight, hardworking crew of 7 who love turning big questions into smart, usable insights – and yes, we’re known to bond over the occasional team treat. We partner closely with Sales, Marketing and other cross‑functional friends to create reports and dashboards that help Independent Business Owners (IBOs) share, sell and shine with our products.

You’ll get hands‑on exposure to all kinds of complex business challenges and teams across the organization – the kind of variety that keeps things interesting and opens the door to real growth in the industry. It’s a team where you learn fast, collaborate often and enjoy the kind of camaraderie that makes the work feel meaningful.

This is a full-time W2 position. Amway does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Amway immigration sponsorship (e.g., H-1B, STEM OPT, TN, etc.) now or in the future.

Apply now

descriptionHtml:
Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

As a key member of the Commercial Intelligence and Analytics team, you will take on a strategic role that combines advanced analytics, stakeholder partnership, and AI driven innovation. You will lead the development of scalable data products and analyses that directly support Circle’s Business and Marketing functions, while also identifying opportunities to incorporate AI tools and methodologies to enhance how insights are delivered across the business. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and execution, helping the company make smarter decisions through high quality analysis, forward thinking automation, and technical leadership.

What You'll Work On

  • Delivering high impact analysis and reporting to support the Business and Marketing teams in understanding performance, risk, and opportunity
  • Designing and implementing scalable data models, dashboards, and pipelines that support accurate, self-service analytics
  • Identifying and leading the implementation of AI and ML tools to streamline data workflows and generate predictive insights
  • Partnering with senior leadership and the AI Engineering team to deliver insights and workflows that improve customer experience and maximize the value of strategic partnerships
  • Building and maintaining high quality documentation to support repeatable and transparent analysis
  • Driving operational excellence by applying strong data architecture and AI methods to enhance the effectiveness of business systems and workflows
  • Mentoring team members and contributing to best practices in analytics engineering and AI adoption

Core Requirements

What you’ll bring to Circle:

  • 7+ years of experience in sales analytics, business analytics, or a related field
  • Experience delivering advanced analytics to support strategic business decisions
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills to build scalable, reliable data products
  • Proficiency using APIs and Python to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems
  • Skill in developing prompts for AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar systems
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects that drive measurable impact
  • Ability to partner with senior stakeholders to align data initiatives with business goals
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong knowledge domain of blockchain ecosystem

Preferred Requirements

  • Familiarity with modern analytics tools such as Superset and Hex
  • Understanding of AI models, embeddings, and frameworks
  • Familiarity with advanced Marketing measurement models such as multi-touch attribution
  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $157,500 - $190,833

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

Our cutting-edge technology and innovative financial products empower businesses with more control and flexibility, enabling them to deliver seamless digital experiences, drive customer loyalty, and build long-term value.

Octane supports merchants throughout the sales cycle: connecting dealerships with high-intent buyers, driving transparent, fast, and easy closings with award-winning technology, and providing on-going customer care with superior loan servicing.

Founded in 2014, Octane supports over 60 OEM partner brands and over 4,000 dealer partners, and has a team of over 600. Visit www.octane.co.

We’re looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst to join our cross-functional Strategy BI team. In this role, you will collaborate directly with business leaders to turn data into clear and actionable recommendations. You will work with teams across Operations, Risk, Servicing, Finance, Product, and Sales, tackling their highest-priority questions as we enter our next stage of growth. The right candidate has a strong business mindset, sharp problem-solving instincts, and the ability to distill complex analysis into something any business partner can act on. This position is hybrid in our NYC office.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain core reporting suites and dashboards as needed to support decision-making.
  • Work on analytical projects end to end, helping to scope the approach, dig into the data, and generate recommendations that the business can act on.
  • Partner with your manager and department leads to understand the company’s biggest open questions, generate action-oriented insights, and turn ambiguous problems into a clear path forward.
  • Build and refine models that surface what’s driving a team’s performance and why, so that teams can plan with confidence.
  • Perform ad hoc quantitative analysis as new questions arise and proactively surface opportunities for growth or improvement.
  • Collaborate with Data and Analytics Engineers to ensure the right data is delivered to the right places and is accurate.


Requirements

  • 2+ years experience in strategy, analytics, or related quantitative fields; consulting experience is a plus.
  • Comfortable working with data visualization tools (i.e. Tableau, Power BI) to support analysis
  • Experience with SQL and/or Python. Experience with Databricks is a plus.
  • Expert in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides, with the ability to build clear, persuasive narrative from data.
  • Interest in using AI tools to help solve data or analytical problems.
  • Ability to build analytical stories, using data and visualizations to drive impactful insights that lead to action.
  • Ability to juggle several cross-functional projects and stakeholders at once.


Preferred Skills

  • Business minded: able to connect data to what actually matters based on stakeholder priorities and company goals.
  • Able to break down ambiguous, open-ended business questions into a structured plan of attack, and manage multiple concurrent workstreams for different business partners
  • Strong problem-solver, comfortable moving between big-picture strategy and critical details.
  • Collaborative and proactive, able to build trust with business partners across departments and drive projects forward without heavy oversight.
  • Skilled communicator who can distill complex analysis into simple, actionable stories for non-technical audiences.
  • Flexible and enthusiastic about working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.


Compensation: In addition to salary, Total Rewards include bonus eligibility, a stock option package, and benefits as outlined below. The role described above offers a base salary of $70,000 to $90,000 + corporate bonus eligibility. Your offer will be based on location, the alignment of your qualifications with the requirements of the job and internal equity

Benefits

  • Robust Health Care Plans (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Generous Parental Leave
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) Policy - Time Off When You Need It
  • Retirement Plan (401k) with company match!
  • Educational Assistance/Tuition Reimbursement up to $3K/year
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Short Term / Long Term Disability
  • Robust Ancillary benefits including accident insurance, hospital insurance, etc
  • Wellhub (Gympass) Wellness Benefit
  • Recreational Safety Benefit

descriptionHtml:
Location: Lakewood, CO, Onsite

Reports to: Director of Data & Systems Infrastructure

About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to turn our data into trusted insights that support all areas of the business. You'll own the full path from modeled data to data-driven decision making: building dbt models, defining governed semantic models in Snowflake that both people and AI tools can rely on, delivering Power BI dashboards, and answering the ad-hoc questions that come up along the way.

This role sits at the intersection of analytics and data modeling. You'll work closely with business stakeholders to understand what they need, and with our data engineering team to make sure the underlying data is clean, documented, and consistent.

What You'll Do

Partner with the business

  • Consult with stakeholders to clarify what they need, define how success will be measured, and turn requirements into clear reporting and analysis plans.
  • Train and support end users so they can explore data on their own with confidence.
  • Spot opportunities to improve efficiency through analysis, and recommend new reporting solutions when you see a gap.

Build the foundation

  • Develop and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, tested, well-documented datasets.
  • Create and maintain semantic models in Snowflake that define metrics, relationships, and business context clearly enough for AI tools to return accurate answers. Test them against real business questions and refine as needed.
  • Improve test coverage and pipeline monitoring to ensure our stakeholders always have accurate data.

Deliver insight

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards that put key metrics in front of the people who need them.
  • Use SQL to answer ad-hoc questions quickly and accurately, from one-off requests to deeper dives into trends and anomalies.
  • Interpret results in context and present findings in a way that influences decisions, including being upfront about limitations in the data.

Keep it trustworthy

  • Trace discrepancies back through the pipeline and work with data engineering to fix root causes.
  • Document metric definitions, models, and dashboards so the business uses data consistently.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelors degree in Math, Biostatistics, Engineering, or another data intensive field; Master’s preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or a related role.
  • Strong SQL skills (required), including CTEs, window functions, and query optimization on a cloud data warehouse.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards (required), including data modeling and DAX.
  • Experience with dimensional modeling concepts such as star schemas, facts, and dimensions.
  • Experience with dbt or a comparable transformation framework, or a strong foundation in SQL-based modeling and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Familiarity with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse.
  • Clear communication with non-technical audiences, including the ability to explain what the data can and can't tell us.
  • Attention to detail and a habit of validating results before sharing them.

Preferred

  • Experience working with healthcare data, with knowledge of population health and Accountable Care Organization (ACO) concepts such as quality measures, attribution, risk adjustment, and value-based care reporting.
  • Experience with ELT/ETL pipelines and how data flows from source systems into the warehouse.
  • Python for analysis, automation, or data manipulation.
  • Experience with Git-based workflows and version control for analytics code.
  • Exposure to semantic layers, metric definitions, or AI-assisted analytics tools.

How We'll Measure Success

  • Dashboards are accurate, adopted, and used regularly by their intended audience.
  • Key metrics are defined once and used consistently across reports and AI tools.
  • Ad-hoc requests are answered quickly, with results stakeholders trust.
  • DBT models and semantic definitions are tested, documented, and easy for others to build on.

Compensation And Benefits

Bloom Healthcare offers a competitive compensation package commensurate with experience, including:

Base salary range: $120,000 – $160,000 annually, depending on qualifications and experience

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Employer-sponsored 401(k)

Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and CME/professional development allowance

Hybrid work flexibility (Lakewood-based role; some remote work available)

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bloom Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Bloom Healthcare only contacts through official channels using the @bloomhealthcare.com domain. We are aware of a fraudulent Gmail account impersonating our recruiting team and have reported it to Google.

Brief Description

The Opportunity

Leaders cannot set priorities, defend resources, or measure impact when the data behind those decisions is scattered across systems, inconsistent, and assembled by hand. The Red Gate Group is seeking a Data Analyst to turn operational and administrative data into clear, trustworthy insight for a major Intelligence Community customer. You will collect, cleanse, transform, and validate structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources, then apply statistical, trend, comparative, and forecasting analysis to surface patterns, issues, and opportunities. You will build the dashboards, scorecards, key performance indicators, reports, and briefing materials that executive, operational, and technical audiences rely on, and you will produce recurring and ad hoc analysis supporting resource planning, budgeting, manpower and workforce analysis, logistics, facilities, return on investment, and operational assessments.

You will translate business questions into sound analytical approaches, document the assumptions, methods, limitations, and findings behind every product, and present results and recommendations directly to government stakeholders. Working alongside knowledge managers and data scientists, you will help sustain enterprise decision support products, maintain data governance and data quality, and advise staff at all levels on complex analytical problems. You will also look for ways to make reporting faster and more rigorous, analyzing business processes, mapping workflows, and designing, testing, and documenting automation that reduces manual effort and measurably improves how the work gets done.

You Have

  • 5+ years of experience in analytical support, performance measurement, decision support, and business analytics.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Economics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex analytical efforts and translating business questions into analytical approaches.
  • Extensive experience developing executive-level reporting, dashboards, and performance frameworks.
  • Experience using Excel, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Experience with data cleansing, transformation, validation, and dashboard development.
  • Ability to present analysis clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • TS/SCI with active CI Poly

Nice If You Have

  • Experience with HTML/CSS for web development, graphic design, and photo editing software.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense or Intelligence Community organizations.
  • Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent data visualization certification.
  • DAMA, DCAM, or other data governance or data management certification.
  • Experience with scripting, workflow automation, or low-code platform development.

The Red Gate Group, founded in 2006, is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Company based in Chantilly, VA. RGG delivers high-quality, customer-centric solutions around the world—from the foxhole to the highest levels of Government. Our motto, "Making a Difference for Country and Client," reflects our deep commitment to national security and service excellence. Our employees enjoy 100% company-paid life insurance and disability benefits, along with professional development assistance for degrees and certifications. We foster a culture of growth and work-life balance, backed by our commitment to supporting both our clients' missions and our employees' success. descriptionHtml:
Who we are


Profile Films is a highly respected, customer-focused extruder and converter of plastic film located in Grand Rapids, Michigan. For over 25 years, Profile has succeeded by providing exceptional customer service and value-added product solutions for our customers while creating a great place for our employees to work and contribute. At Profile, we don’t just sell custom plastic packaging; we sell trust and dependability. Our team members provide quality products and exceptional service for our customers every day. At Profile you will find a great work environment in a beautiful modern facility and the opportunity to be an important part of well-established, but rapidly growing company.


We are looking for an enthusiastic Business Intelligence Analyst to add to our business development team. This position will report directly to the Senior Business Systems Manager.


About the Role


The Business Intelligence Analyst will take ownership of Profile's Power BI and Microsoft Fabric environment and lead our transition to Power BI. This is an analyst role focused on data modeling and visualization, with data engineering support from our vendor partner. We're a growing, family-owned manufacturer, and this is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build their skills and grow with us.


What you will do:


Power BI Reporting & Data Visualization


  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that give business teams clear, accurate, and actionable information.
  • Lead the migration of Profile's existing Tableau dashboards and reports to Power BI, rebuilt on the curated data in Profile's new Microsoft Fabric environment.
  • Apply sound visualization design practices (clear layout, appropriate chart choices, consistent formatting, and intuitive filtering and drill-through) so reports are easy to use and trusted.
  • Manage Power BI workspaces, apps, and publishing, ensuring content is well organized and access permissions are accurate.


Semantic Modeling & Analytics


  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI semantic models on top of Profile's Fabric data, using star schema principles and well-defined relationships.
  • Develop and maintain reusable, well-documented DAX measures so key metrics are defined once and calculated consistently across reports.
  • Work with business stakeholders to clarify and document metric definitions, helping Profile move toward agreed, consistent KPIs.
  • Use Power Query for data shaping where appropriate and move reusable transformation logic into the Fabric Gold layer so it is defined once and shared across models.
  • Monitor and tune semantic model performance, storage modes, and refresh schedules.
  • Validate model and report outputs against source systems and legacy reports so the numbers match what the business expects before and after cutover.


Data Platform Partnership & Engineering Growth


  • Build hands-on data engineering skills over time (for example Fabric dataflows, notebooks, and pipelines) with vendor support, taking on more Silver and Bronze layer work as interest and ability grow.
  • Help design and maintain Gold layer tables in Fabric that feed Profile's Power BI semantic models.
  • Serve as the primary internal point of contact for Profile's data engineering vendor, who owns the Silver and Bronze layers, translating business and reporting needs into clear requirements for new or updated data.
  • Review and test vendor-delivered data and pipeline changes, identifying data quality issues and gaps before they reach reports.
  • Coordinate the cutover of reporting from legacy SQL Server / Snowflake / Mozart sourcing onto Fabric: planning timing, validating results, and retiring legacy reports and data sources.
  • Write SQL against Fabric and SQL Server for analysis, data validation, and troubleshooting.


Business Process & Software


  • Work directly with internal customers and Profile's Senior Business Systems Manager to learn Profile's key business processes, support our software platforms, and ensure the data captured is properly structured.
  • Support new process initiatives by advising on adherence to Profile's data quality & governance standards.
  • Assist in defining data and reporting requirements for systems that are in use, under development, or planned for future development.


Documentation & Data Governance


  • Create and maintain clear documentation for semantic models, measures, reports, and data sources (definitions, parameters, aggregation logic) to reduce single-point-of-failure risk in Profile's BI reporting.
  • Help establish and enforce data governance and data quality standards, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and security of data across the organization.
  • Ensure reporting solutions comply with internal data privacy and security policies.


What We’re Looking For (Minimum Qualiﬁcations):


  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience designing and building Power BI dashboards and reports used by business stakeholders.
  • Experience building Power BI semantic models, with a solid understanding of dimensional modeling (star schema, fact and dimension tables, relationships).
  • Strong DAX skills with the ability to build, validate, and troubleshoot reusable business measures.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouses, Warehouses, Direct Lake semantic models, Dataflows Gen2), or a comparable platform with the ability to ramp quickly on Fabric.
  • Intermediate to advanced SQL skills, with the ability to write and troubleshoot queries for performance and data validation.
  • Experience publishing and managing content in the Power BI Service (workspaces, apps, scheduled refresh, gateways, and row-level security).
  • A strong eye for data visualization design and the ability to turn business questions into clear, usable reports.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot data issues independently.
  • Demonstrated ability to document work clearly.
  • Clear communicator who is comfortable working directly with business users and outside vendors.
  • Comfortable taking ownership of work in a growing, fast-moving environment where priorities can shift and not every project is fully scoped up front.
  • Consistently adhere to all Food Safety, GMP, Personal Safety, and Company Policy standards.


Move to the top if you have (Preferred Qualifications):


  • Microsoft Power BI, Fabric or other relevant certification.
  • Experience with platforms such as SQL Server, Snowflake, Mozart Data, Tableau Cloud, Sage 100, Salesforce, or Claris FileMaker.
  • Experience working with manufacturing, ERP, or operations data.
  • Experience designing or maintaining Gold-layer (reporting-ready) tables in a medallion architecture. Silver and Bronze layer engineering experience is not required.
  • Experience with Tableau, especially migrating reports from Tableau or another BI tool to Power BI.
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and an interest in growing data engineering skills.
  • Exposure to Python for data analysis or automation.


Core Strengths & Mindset (Essential for success!):


  • Eagerness to learn and grow
  • Positive and collaborative mindset
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Ability to balance technical work with business needs
  • Attention to quality, reliability, and maintainability


What you can expect from Profile:


  • Positive, supportive environment
  • Competitive compensation
  • Paid time off
  • Tuition and professional certification assistance
  • Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, life, STD and LTD insurance
  • 401k with match
  • Employee Assistance program
  • Clean, modern work environment in newly redesigned office space
  • Onsite fitness facilities
  • Office Happy Hours, Summer BBQ’s, Celebrations!
