Description

Are you passionate about turning data into meaningful action? We are looking for a Business Analyst II who thrives on solving complex problems, building scalable analytics solutions, and partnering with cross-functional teams to drive informed decision-making. In this role, you will analyze business processes, uncover opportunities through data, and deliver insights that shape strategy. You will work with stakeholders to define requirements, build reporting frameworks, and propose solutions that balance business value with level of effort. If you are curious, analytical, and energized by translating numbers into narratives that influence real outcomes, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Analyze large datasets using SQL and other analytical tools to identify trends, diagnose root causes, and generate actionable insights that inform business decisions across your team and partner teams.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated reporting systems and dashboards that provide visibility into business performance, highlight anomalies, and reveal new opportunities.
  • Partner with stakeholders across operations, product, and finance to understand business needs, define requirements, and deliver high-quality analytical solutions on time.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and optimize business and data processes, determining when solutions should be repeatable versus one-time, and implement improvements that increase team efficiency and scalability.
  • Communicate findings clearly through written and verbal channels, tailoring insights to the audience — from detailed technical discussions with peers to concise summaries for leaders up to three levels above.

A day in the life

You will start your day reviewing key metrics and monitoring dashboards to stay on top of business performance. From there, you might dive into a diagnostic analysis to understand a shift in a critical input metric, then join a working session with product or operations partners to scope out a new analytics request. You will regularly evaluate when to leverage generative AI tools to augment your productivity and when more specialized technical expertise is needed to drive a project to resolution.

About The Team

Our team is committed to using data as a catalyst for smarter, faster decisions at Amazon. We partner closely with business and technical teams to deliver analytics that matter — insights that directly influence strategy and improve outcomes for our customers. We value collaboration, continuous learning, and building inclusive environments where every voice contributes. If you are looking for a role where your analytical skills create visible impact and you grow alongside a supportive, high-caliber group, this is the team for you.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
  • Experience with Excel
  • Experience with SQL
  • Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or equivalent
  • AWS Professional level certification
  • Knowledge on Food Safety (Optional)

Job Description

Great decisions start with trusted data. In this role, you will help build the enterprise reporting and analytics engine that gives UL Solutions leaders the clarity to see performance, act faster, and run the business with confidence.

As Lead Finance Data Analyst - Enterprise Performance Reporting, you will turn complex financial, operational, and business data into executive-ready dashboards, KPI frameworks, and self-service analytics that improve decisions across the enterprise.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can connect the dots between data, business performance, and leadership action.

This is a full-time hybrid position (3 days per week in office) located at either our Northbrook, IL or Chicago, IL office.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Reporting & Dashboard Development

  • Build executive dashboards, scorecards, enterprise reports, and KPI frameworks that leaders use to run the business.
  • Standardize financial and operational metrics so reporting is consistent, trusted, and scalable.
  • Design clear, intuitive reporting experiences that make performance easy to understand and act on.
  • Partner with Finance and business teams to deliver reporting solutions that solve real business needs.
  • Support management and executive reporting packages with timely, relevant insights.

Data Analytics & Insights

  • Analyze financial, operational, and business data to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
  • Translate analysis into practical recommendations that help leaders move faster and make better decisions.
  • Strengthen enterprise KPI structures and performance measurement practices.

Data Management & Reporting Solutions

  • Bring together data from multiple systems and make it usable, reliable, and ready for reporting.
  • Maintain reporting datasets and catalogs as trusted enterprise information sources.
  • Improve data preparation, automation, and visualization to reduce manual effort and increase speed.
  • Promote data quality, accuracy, and consistency across reporting processes.
  • Work with IT and data teams to improve architecture, integration, and access to trusted data.

Analytics Product Development

  • Define, build, and launch reporting and analytics products that scale across the enterprise.
  • Create self-service dashboards that give teams faster access to the answers they need.
  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement of enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation, efficiency, and business value.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Accounting, FP&A, Operations, IT, and business leaders to align reporting with enterprise priorities.
  • Present insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build alignment by connecting data insights to business decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on reporting, performance measurement, and analytics practices.
  • Coach analysts and business partners involved in reporting and analytics initiatives.

Governance & Compliance

  • Promote reporting standards, metric consistency, and data governance best practices.
  • Document KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and business rules.
  • Follow the UL Solutions Code of Conduct and all physical and digital security requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required

 QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in business analytics, enterprise reporting, BI, financial reporting, performance management, or related work.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Strong data management, integration, and analysis skills.
  • Ability to organize, analyze, validate, and connect information from multiple sources.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience creating dashboards, scorecards, executive reporting, and analytical solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, Accounting, EPM, or performance reporting functions.
  • Experience with ERP, EPM, enterprise reporting platforms, SQL, data modeling, or automation tools.
  • Experience developing KPI frameworks and management reporting processes.
  • Knowledge of financial and operational performance metrics.
  • Experience supporting executive reporting and decision support.
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization.

What Success Looks Like

  • Success means building reporting capabilities that make performance easier to see, understand, and improve, including:
  • Consistent executive and management reporting built on standardized KPIs.

Why Join the Enterprise Performance Reporting Team?

Join a team helping UL Solutions strengthen how the enterprise measures performance, tells the story behind the numbers, and turns insight into action.

If you enjoy building scalable reporting solutions, partnering with senior stakeholders, and making data more useful to the business, this role offers a visible opportunity to shape enterprise performance reporting.

  • Clearer visibility into financial and operational performance.
  • Faster access to trusted insights and self-service analytics.
  • Less manual reporting through automation and standardization.
  • Better business decisions across the enterprise.

Total Rewards: We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. Job Summary

The Intelligence Analyst-Senior is responsible for transforming complex data into strategic, actionable insights that enable informed decision-making across the organization. This role involves close collaboration with stakeholders to gather and translate both business and technical requirements into effective analytics solutions. It leads the development and optimization of advanced dashboards, reports, and visualizations, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability. The role involves mentoring analysts through work reviews and reinforcing best practices in data quality and visualization. It also supports leadership by uncovering opportunities to streamline processes and drive data-informed decisions.

Education & Experience

Education And Experience Required

Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of work experience in data intelligence analytics.

Certifications, Licenses, Or Registration Required

Epic certification or accreditation in one of the following data models required post-hire within six (6) months: Clinical Data Model, Access Data Model or Revenue Data Model. An Epic assessment will be given to those candidates who pass the initial review step of the interview process.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior experience with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and Microsoft Purview is highly preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

Demonstrates advanced expertise in information systems, systems analysis, and application development, with a strong command of system integration and relational databases. Proficient in SQL with hands-on experience in ETL processes and end-to-end solution delivery. Skilled in analyzing and troubleshooting complex systems, programming, and enhancing custom applications. Possesses strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation and reports. Brings a solid foundation in high-level mathematical analysis to support data-driven insights and system improvements.

Responsibilities

  • Manages complex projects by planning, coordinating, and overseeing all project activities, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and timelines. This includes defining project scope, objectives, and deliverables and ensuring tasks are completed following established standards. Ensures effective communication and collaboration among cross-functional teams, stakeholders, and vendors to achieve project milestones and deliver high-quality outcomes.
  • Acts as a mentor by sharing knowledge, best practices, and providing ongoing support to peers. Provides guidance and mentorship to junior team members to support skill development and team growth.
  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of custom reports, dashboards, and data visualizations within the Epic ecosystem, leveraging Epic BI tools and data visualization platforms such as Qlik to drive operational efficiency and support strategic initiatives. Maintains understanding of ETL processes and interprets ETL code.
  • Utilize in-depth knowledge of Epic data models to build and optimize complex queries, ensuring alignment with business requirements, organizational policies, and compliance with industry and regulatory standards.
  • Analyze research, education, clinical, financial, operational, and patient care data to uncover trends, identify performance gaps, and highlight opportunities for improvement. Deliver automated, high-impact reports that enable data-driven decision-making across departments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to define key performance indicators (KPIs), interpret data findings, and develop actionable recommendations that support organizational goals.
  • Monitor data quality, validate analytical outputs, and implement standardized methodologies to enhance the accuracy, reliability, and usability of reporting and visualization tools.
  • Serve as a liaison between clinical, operational, and IT teams to assess reporting needs and design scalable, integrated solutions that ensure consistent and accurate data across systems.
  • Translate business requirements into detailed system specifications by collaborating with DIS staff, end users, and vendors. Contribute to application development or enhancement efforts and produce technical documentation in accordance with UMMC policies.
  • Develop user guides and training resources; lead end-user training sessions to ensure effective adoption and utilization of analytics tools and reports.
  • Actively participate in technical and governance committees to identify project risks, monitor progress, and support the timely delivery of analytics initiatives and organizational priorities.
  • The duties listed are general in nature and are examples of the duties and responsibilities performed and are not meant to be construed as exclusive or all-inclusive. Management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Physical and Environmental Demands

Requires occasional exposure to unpleasant or disagreeable physical environment such as high noise level and exposure to heat and cold, occasional handling or working with potentially dangerous equipment, occasional exposure to biohazardous conditions such as risk of radiation exposure, blood borne pathogens, fumes or airborne particles, and/or toxic or caustic chemicals which mandate attention to safety considerations, occasional working hours significantly beyond regularly scheduled hours, occasional travelling to offsite locations, occasional activities subject to significant volume changes of a seasonal/clinical nature, frequent work produced subject to precise measures of quantity and quality, occasional bending, occasional lifting and carrying up to 25 pounds, occasional climbing, occasional crawling, occasional crouching/stooping, occasional driving, occasional kneeling, occasional pushing/pulling, frequent reaching, frequent sitting, frequent standing, occasional twisting, and frequent walking. Company Overview

CB&I delivers integrated storage and asset‑management solutions that help customers operate safely, reliably, and efficiently across the lifecycle of their facilities. Through our two global business units - Storage Solutions, the world leader in tanks, terminals, and storage systems, and Asset Solutions, a leading provider of operations, management, wells and decommissioning services - we combine technical excellence with execution capability to extend asset life, optimize performance, and maximize value.

Overview

The Sr Professional Data Visualization Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise reporting, dashboards, scorecards, and data visualization solutions that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role reports directly to the Manager, AI, Data, & Analytics and routinely interacts with Global IT, Global Business Leads, Global Functional Leads, and Project Management.

Responsibilities

Data Visualization & Reporting

  • Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and executive visualizations that translate business requirements into meaningful visual analytics and reporting solutions.
  • Create intuitive executive and operational dashboards that simplify complex data, support business decision-making, and apply visualization best practices to maximize usability, performance, and user adoption.
  • Ensure consistency in reporting standards, branding, definitions, and calculations while optimizing reports and dashboards for performance, scalability, and user experience.

Dashboard & Report Development

  • Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models, datasets, dataflows, and complex DAX measures that support scalable and optimized analytics.
  • Design and implement row-level security (RLS), workspace security models, and support Power BI Service administration and report deployment processes.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams and leverage Microsoft Fabric to ensure data models support reporting and analytics requirements.

Business Analysis & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Partner with business leaders to identify reporting needs and analytics opportunities.
  • Gather, analyze, document, and validate reporting requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to define KPIs, metrics, and dashboard requirements to provide recommendations for improving business processes.
  • Support self-service reporting initiatives and encourage data-driven decision-making.

Data Governance & Quality

  • Adhere to enterprise data governance standards, security requirements, privacy regulations, and reporting policies.
  • Validate data quality, accuracy, and consistency, partnering with data stewards and business owners to resolve data quality issues across reporting environments.
  • Assist with the establishment and maintenance of data definitions, business glossaries, and metric standards.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting automation and analytics processes while leveraging advanced analytics capabilities within Power BI, Fabric, and AI-enabled reporting and analytics capabilities.
  • Monitor report usage and user feedback to continuously improve solutions.
  • Stay current with emerging visualization technologies and Microsoft platform enhancements.

Training & Support

  • Provide end-user training and support for Power BI reports and dashboards while developing documentation, user guides, and knowledge-sharing materials.
  • Mentor business users on reporting best practices and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Assist in troubleshooting reporting and data-related issues.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 5-10 years of experience developing Power BI dashboards and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Experience with data visualization, business intelligence, and analytics platforms.
  • Strong experience with Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, DAX, and Power Query.
  • Experience working with large datasets and relational databases.
  • Experience writing and optimizing SQL queries.
  • Experience gathering and translating business requirements into reporting solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing KPI-based dashboards and executive reporting.
  • Experience working in a structured project environment.

Preferred

  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar cloud analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data governance initiatives.
  • Experience with AI-enabled reporting, predictive analytics, or machine learning outputs.
  • Experience within the Engineering, Manufacturing, and/or Construction industries.
  • Certifications such as:
    • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate
    • Microsoft Certified: Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate
    • Certified Business Intelligence Professional (CBIP)
Skills and Behaviors

Technical Expertise

  • Microsoft Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • DAX (Data Analysis Expressions)
  • Power Query (M Language)
  • SQL Development and Data Analysis
  • Data Modeling and Dimensional Modeling Concepts
  • Data Warehousing and Data Lake Concepts
  • ETL/ELT Processes
  • Microsoft Azure Data Services
  • Data Governance and Data Quality Practices
  • Dashboard Design and Data Visualization Best Practices
  • Business Intelligence and Analytics Platforms
  • AI-Assisted Analytics and Reporting Technologies
  • Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Agents utilized within Power BI framework

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong interpersonal skills.

Business Acumen

  • Understanding of business operations, performance metrics, and key business drivers.
  • Ability to identify opportunities where analytics can improve business outcomes.
  • Understanding of KPI development and performance management practices.
  • Commitment to delivering business value through data and analytics.

descriptionHtml:
Grow With Us

Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

Stay Awesome

Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A Day In The Life

The Data Analyst II supports data-driven decision making by transforming complex data into actionable insights, reports, and analytical solutions. This role partners with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs, integrate and prepare data from multiple sources, and deliver analyses that improve operational effectiveness and business outcomes. This position combines business analytics, data wrangling, and technical development skills using SQL, Python, and modern analytics platforms.

Data Analyst II's Are Also Responsible For

  • Uses SQL, Python, and analytics platforms to prepare, transform, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Ensures data quality through validation, investigation, and documentation of data sources and methodologies.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders across Tandem’s business units to define user needs and develop proof-of-concept analyses, datasets, and visualizations that inform solution design.
  • Analyzes data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, and actionable business insights.
  • Develops reports, dashboards, visualizations, and analytical datasets that support business decision-making.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Identifies opportunities to automate and improve reporting and analytical processes.
  • Ensures compliance with company policies, including Privacy/HIPAA, and other legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Other duties as assigned.

When & Where You’ll Work

Remote: This position is fully remote and is open to candidates throughout the United States, with a preference for those located in San Diego, California. Equipment for the role will be provided, and training will be conducted remotely.

Schedule: This position will work Monday - Friday from 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM PST.

What You'lld Need

  • Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
  • Experience with SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience using Python for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
  • Experience with reporting and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Strong data wrangling and data modeling skills.
  • Ability to work with large, complex datasets.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to data quality.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Minimum Certifications/Educational Level

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field
  • Master's degree in a related field may substitute for the required experience.

Minimum Experience

  • Two (2) years of related experience in Data Analytics.
  • Preferred experience in any of the following areas:
    • Experience translating business questions and stakeholder needs into analytical requirements, metrics, and reporting solutions.
    • Experience working in a regulated industry, such as medical device, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or healthcare.
    • Experience with Databricks or other cloud-based analytics platforms.
    • Experience integrating data from multiple business systems
    • Experience supporting cross-functional business initiatives.
    • Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and supporting team backlog management using tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
    • Knowledge of statistical analysis and modeling techniques preferred.
Compensation & Benefits

The base pay for this position is $82,000 - $100,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes incentive compensation, equity, and a robust benefits package.

Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, a minimum of 20 days of paid time off (with accrual starting on day 1) and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!

You Should Know

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.

SPONSORSHIP: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at https://www.tandemdiabetes.com/careers.

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

Referrals

We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

Application Deadline

The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

descriptionHtml:
Job Description

Great decisions start with trusted data. In this role, you will help build the enterprise reporting and analytics engine that gives UL Solutions leaders the clarity to see performance, act faster, and run the business with confidence.

As Lead Finance Data Analyst - Enterprise Performance Reporting, you will turn complex financial, operational, and business data into executive-ready dashboards, KPI frameworks, and self-service analytics that improve decisions across the enterprise.

This is a high-impact role for someone who can connect the dots between data, business performance, and leadership action.

This is a full-time hybrid position (3 days per week in office) located at either our Northbrook, IL or Chicago, IL office.

Responsibilities

Enterprise Reporting & Dashboard Development

  • Build executive dashboards, scorecards, enterprise reports, and KPI frameworks that leaders use to run the business.
  • Standardize financial and operational metrics so reporting is consistent, trusted, and scalable.
  • Design clear, intuitive reporting experiences that make performance easy to understand and act on.
  • Partner with Finance and business teams to deliver reporting solutions that solve real business needs.
  • Support management and executive reporting packages with timely, relevant insights.

Data Analytics & Insights

  • Analyze financial, operational, and business data to uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers.
  • Translate analysis into practical recommendations that help leaders move faster and make better decisions.
  • Strengthen enterprise KPI structures and performance measurement practices.

Data Management & Reporting Solutions

  • Bring together data from multiple systems and make it usable, reliable, and ready for reporting.
  • Maintain reporting datasets and catalogs as trusted enterprise information sources.
  • Improve data preparation, automation, and visualization to reduce manual effort and increase speed.
  • Promote data quality, accuracy, and consistency across reporting processes.
  • Work with IT and data teams to improve architecture, integration, and access to trusted data.

Analytics Product Development

  • Define, build, and launch reporting and analytics products that scale across the enterprise.
  • Create self-service dashboards that give teams faster access to the answers they need.
  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement of enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation, efficiency, and business value.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Accounting, FP&A, Operations, IT, and business leaders to align reporting with enterprise priorities.
  • Present insights clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build alignment by connecting data insights to business decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on reporting, performance measurement, and analytics practices.
  • Coach analysts and business partners involved in reporting and analytics initiatives.

Governance & Compliance

  • Promote reporting standards, metric consistency, and data governance best practices.
  • Document KPI definitions, reporting methodologies, and business rules.
  • Follow the UL Solutions Code of Conduct and all physical and digital security requirements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required

 QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in business analytics, enterprise reporting, BI, financial reporting, performance management, or related work.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Power BI and Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Strong data management, integration, and analysis skills.
  • Ability to organize, analyze, validate, and connect information from multiple sources.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience creating dashboards, scorecards, executive reporting, and analytical solutions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

  • Experience supporting Finance, FP&A, Accounting, EPM, or performance reporting functions.
  • Experience with ERP, EPM, enterprise reporting platforms, SQL, data modeling, or automation tools.
  • Experience developing KPI frameworks and management reporting processes.
  • Knowledge of financial and operational performance metrics.
  • Experience supporting executive reporting and decision support.
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization.

What Success Looks Like

  • Success means building reporting capabilities that make performance easier to see, understand, and improve, including:
  • Consistent executive and management reporting built on standardized KPIs.

Why Join the Enterprise Performance Reporting Team?

Join a team helping UL Solutions strengthen how the enterprise measures performance, tells the story behind the numbers, and turns insight into action.

If you enjoy building scalable reporting solutions, partnering with senior stakeholders, and making data more useful to the business, this role offers a visible opportunity to shape enterprise performance reporting.

  • Clearer visibility into financial and operational performance.
  • Faster access to trusted insights and self-service analytics.

Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications. The Analyst will work with several databases to pull and integrate data, statistical analysis and data modeling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.
  • Determine, write and present report results with key findings and trends to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Complete multiple concurrent ad-hoc analyses, provide corresponding reports based on customer specifications, determine and communicate analytical conclusions and recommendations.
  • Develop beginner to intermediate level reports and ad-hoc analysis based on specifications outlined by department management. Automate such reports and ensure that they are performed and delivered on schedule.
  • Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
  • Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to converse and write fluently in English.
  • Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree Required. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred.
  • Demonstrated use of analytical software. SAS or SQL preferred.
  • Experience in Power BI, Tableau or similar software preferred.1-2 years of related experience preferred.

descriptionHtml:
Build the Future with Us — EquipmentShare is Hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst

At EquipmentShare, we’re not just filling a role — we’re assembling the best team on the planet to build something that’s never been built before. We’re on a mission to transform an industry that’s been stuck in the past by empowering contractors and communities through innovative technology, real-time support, and a team that truly cares.

We’re hiring a Business Intelligence Analyst at our Corporate Headquarters in Columbia, MO and we’re looking for someone who’s ready to grow with us, bring energy and drive to their work, and help us build the future of construction. This position is fully remote.

As a Business Intelligence Analyst, you will use your data expertise to help departments throughout the company with analytics needs. These projects are wide ranging and could include anything from finance and collections to telematics and fleet data.

Primary Responsibilities
  • Become a technical data and reporting expert in a variety of areas to refine and troubleshoot reporting requirements working across teams and domains
  • Build complex queries and data models based on reporting requirements with minimal errors
  • Produce and support dashboards and reports used across the organization
  • Use your strong development and analytical skills to ideate and solve business problems
Why EquipmentShare?

Because we do things differently — and we think you’ll feel it from day one. We’re a people-first company powered by cutting-edge technology. That means our proprietary T3 platform doesn’t just run our business — it also makes your job easier, safer, and more connected. Whether you’re behind the wheel, under the hood, leading a branch, or closing deals — tech supports you, and you drive us forward.

We’re a team of problem-solvers, go-getters, and builders. And we’re looking for teammates who take pride in doing meaningful work and want to be part of building something special.

Perks & Benefits
  • Competitive compensation

  • Full medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees

  • Generous PTO + paid holidays

  • 401(k) + company match

  • Gym membership stipend + wellness programs (earn PTO and prizes!)

  • Company events, food truck nights

  • 16 hours of paid volunteer time per year — give back to the community you call home

  • Career advancement, leadership training, and professional development opportunities
About You

You want to be part of a team that’s not just changing an industry for the sake of change — we’re transforming it to make it safer, more secure, and more productive. You bring grit, heart, and humility to your work, and you’re excited about the opportunity to grow within a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

We’re looking for people who:

  • See challenges as opportunities

  • Embrace change and continuous improvement

  • Bring energy, effort, and optimism every day
Skills & Qualifications 
  • Strong attention to detail and quality assurance process
  • Knowledge of an analytical language like Python or R is a plus
  • Proven ability to independently approach complex problems with curiosity and an analytical mindset
  • Ability to adapt quickly, manage competing projects and challenge the status quo
  • A keen understanding of data interpretation and the ability to swiftly extract key insights
  • Must be qualified to work in the United States - we are not sponsoring any candidates at this time.
Education and Experience 
  • Bachelors degree, required 
  • At least 4 years of experience programming in SQL
  • At least 4 years of experience designing business intelligence reports (e.g. Looker, PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik, etc.)
Physical Requirements: 
  • Must be able to sit for prolonged periods at a desk and work on a computer.
A Workplace For All

At EquipmentShare, we believe the best solutions come from a team that reflects the world around us. Our initiative — A Workplace For All — is rooted in the belief that we must work together to solve some of the toughest problems in construction. That means attracting, developing, and retaining great people from all walks of life.

We value different backgrounds, talents, and perspectives. We want you to feel like you belong here — because you do.

EquipmentShare is an EOE M/F/D/V.

Employment is contingent on passing a background check. Additionally, some roles require passing a drug test, depending on the job responsibilities.

You’ll operate in a cross functional data team that includes data scientists and analytics engineers, all of whom are working towards this goal with you.   • Partner with the data science team to dive deeper into major trends, helping us understand what is driving those changes.

  • Ensure accurate and consistent reporting and documentation of metrics, collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data alignment across the business.
  • Work with our analytics engineering team to maintain the core data models in dbt that support these metrics and ensure data consistency.
  • Utilize an AI-forward approach, understand key machine learning concepts, and analyze data derived from these technologies to drive clinical and operational insights.
  • Lead meetings with stakeholders on a consistent cadence to update them on the status of work and bandwidth along with sending timely updates on communication channels including (but not limited to) Jira tickets and Slack.

What Success Looks Like In This Role

  • Develop tools and analyses that enable the teams you work with to hit their own KPIs - you’re successful when you help your team be successful!
  • Reduce the amount of time teams spend manually pulling data to inform decisions
  • Develop dashboards and analyses that deliver ongoing value to teams, measured in proxy by the number of monthly active users and total views different dashboards and analyses receive.
  • Contribute to our foundational data model by adding additional fields and tables according to our data style guide

  • You are passionate about changing the face of mental health care and Spring Health’s mission to remove all barriers to mental health resonates with you
  • You are an early adopter of AI and automation tools, you actively experiment with LLMs, AI-assisted analytics, and emerging tooling to accelerate your work and surface insights faster.
  • You have 5+ years of working experience working with data, data visualization, and dashboarding tools
  • You are an expert in SQL, and have at least familiarity with dbt or similar data transformation tools
  • You have exceptional communication skills, are comfortable explaining technical concepts to a non-technical audience, and are comfortable working independently with executive level team members
  • You have strong user empathy - you are curious and collaborative, working closely with stakeholders to deeply understand their core challenges and translate them into data solutions that meaningfully improve their ability to operate.
  • You have experience working with Omni, Hex or other similar data visualization tools (tableau, etc), both creating the data model and building dashboards
  • You focus on impact, finding the things you can deliver that provide the most value for your stakeholders
  • You are humble, highly motivated, and thrive in fast-paced environments
  • You have a proven ability to proactively manage your own priorities and dependencies in alignment with cross-functional dependencies and product/business impact
  • You have a passion for successfully navigating ambiguous problem areas and learning new approaches
  • You are comfortable working in a fast paced environment and navigating changing priorities with multiple stakeholders.

Benefits Provided By Spring Health

Note: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria.

  • Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to One Medical accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type.
  • Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning
  • A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents.
  • We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays.
  • At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non-birthing parents.
  • Access to Noom, a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals.
  • Access to fertility care support through Carrot, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses.
  • Access to Wellhub, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription
  • Access to BrightHorizons, which provides sponsored child care, back-up care, and elder care
  • Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year.
  • $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes.

Overall Job Summary

This role performs advanced business analysis using various techniques including statistical analysis, explanatory and predictive modeling, and data mining. It will determine best practices and develop actionable insights and recommendations for the current business operation or need. This role works closely with others to determine analytical requirements, including operational and project key metrics requests.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (Min 5%)

  • Provide detailed analytics to organizational initiatives
  • Establish centralized reporting & analytics competence within Digital space
  • Analyze large amounts of information to discover trends and patterns
  • Identify and develop reporting around key success metrics to measure project performance and critical operations (ex. Day After Thanksgiving forecasting & Modeling)
  • Provide thought leadership on how to leverage analytics to improve our everyday operation and future business growth
  • Provide weekly, monthly, and quarterly Digital metrics and analysis reporting, including financial reporting, operational reporting, and web analytics reporting
  • Present information using data visualization techniques
  • Propose solutions and strategies to business challenges
  • Identify valuable data sources and automate collection processes
  • Filter and “clean” data to locate and report code problems
  • Work with management to prioritize business and information needs
  • Define and execute audits on key business processes
  • Develop operation procedures
  • Support ad hoc reporting and analysis requests
  • Provide forecasting (ex. sales, shipment volume broken-down in various categories, locations)
  • Manage the “backlogs” to grow sustainable reporting and analytics practices

Required Qualifications

Experience: 5 year’s relevant experience

Education: Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university. Any suitable combination of education and experience will be considered.

Preferred Knowledge, Skills Or Abilities

  • Experience using business intelligence tools
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy
  • Problem-solving aptitude
  • Adept at queries, report writing and presenting findings
  • Knowledge of statistical concepts and techniques
  • Understanding of machine-learning and operations research
  • Experience with business reporting tools such as Business Objects, Tableau, Alteryx, PowerBI, SnowFlake (SQL) or other reporting & analytical tools
  • Experience with web analytics tools such as Adobe Analytics
  • Background in eCommerce
  • Understanding of and familiarity with web and emerging technologies

Working Conditions

  • Normal office working conditions

Physical Requirements

  • Sitting
  • Standing (not walking)
  • Walking
  • Kneeling/Stooping/Bending
  • Reaching overhead
  • Lifting up to 10 pounds

Disclaimer

This job description represents an overview of the responsibilities for the above referenced role. It is not intended to represent a comprehensive list of responsibilities. A team member should perform all duties as assigned by his/ her supervisor.

Company Info

At Tractor Supply and Petsense by Tractor Supply, our Team Members are the heart of our success. Their dedication, passion, and hard work drive everything we do, and we are committed to supporting them with a comprehensive and accessible total reward package. We understand the evolving needs of our Team Members and their families, and we strive to offer meaningful, competitive, and sustainable benefits that support their well-being today and in the future.

Our benefits extend beyond medical, dental, and vision coverage, including company-paid life and disability insurance, paid parental leave, tuition reimbursement, and family planning resources such as adoption and surrogacy assistance, for all full-time Team Members and all part-time Team Members. Part time new hires gain eligibility for TSC Benefits by averaging at least 15 hours per week during their 90-day lookback period. The lookback period starts the first of the month following the date of hire. If the 15-hour requirement was met, the benefits eligibility date will be the first day of the month following 4 months of continuous service.

Please visit this link for more specific information about the benefits and leave policies applicable to the position you’re applying for.

SpaceX designs, manufactures and launches the world’s most advanced rockets and spacecraft. The company was founded in 2002 by Elon Musk to revolutionize space transportation, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary. 

SpaceX has gained worldwide attention for a series of historic milestones. It is the only private company ever to return a spacecraft from low-Earth orbit, which it first accomplished in December 2010. The company made history again in May 2012 when its Dragon spacecraft attached to the International Space Station, exchanged cargo payloads, and returned safely to Earth — a technically challenging feat previously accomplished only by governments. Since then Dragon has delivered cargo to and from the space station multiple times, providing regular cargo resupply missions for NASA.

For more information, visit www.spacex.com.

descriptionHtml:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS ANALYST (STARLINK ENTERPRISE)

Starlink, our revolutionary satellite constellation, will deliver low-latency broadband internet worldwide. The Starlink Enterprise Account Management team serves as the point of contact for Starlink’s growing base of enterprise customers from contract signature, through successful activation, ensuring all contract terms are fulfilled. This role will be responsible for analyzing data about Starlink enterprise customers and translating it into reporting, recommendations, and tooling to improve both our customers' experience and internal Starlink operations. Our ideal candidate has self-starter that has a passion for building analytics from scratch, prototyping tools, and working cross-functionality to simplify systems.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct analyses (SQL queries, other methods) that identify issues and opportunities impacting our customers, including actionable recommendations that quantifiably change outcomes
  • Define and develop department-level metrics and associated dashboards that quantify the health of our customer accounts and influence change
  • Integrate with all levels of the business to understand current workflows and identify systematic gaps
  • Develop automation that accelerate revenue, mitigates business risk or creates efficiencies within Starlink Business Operations and across teams
  • Own data integrity, tool maintenance, and reporting quality
  • Train internal users, external technical teams, and leaders on dashboard, API, and tool usage; assist in troubleshooting
  • Improve data capture for future account management use cases, identifying front-end requirements and collaborating with software development teams on table structure
  • Support new market launch, continuous improvement, and cross-functional strategic initiatives

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of professional experience in reporting and analytics within customer operations, manufacturing, quality, human resources, purchasing, operations, cost accounting, supply chain management, or consulting
  • 3+ years of professional experience building required datasets to create and manage dashboards using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
  • 3+ years of professional experience in at least one analytics language (e.g. Python, R)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, management information systems, computer science, engineering, or economics discipline
  • Advanced SQL proficiency (i.e. advanced joins, views/table distinctions, and basic query optimizations)
  • Advanced understanding of database structures, query optimizations, ETL development
  • Experience automating analytics tasks (i.e. intermediate coding skills (VBA, Python, C#, etc.)
  • Start-up, consulting, or other demonstrated experience in high-growth, fast-paced, rapidly changing environment
  • Strong project management and self-directed prioritization skills
  • Exceptional ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical audiences at all organizational levels
  • Ability to develop and maintain strong relationships across disciplines and with multiple levels of management
  • Experience working with customer operations teams and tools (e.g. ticketing, account management, communications tools)

Additional Requirements

  • Must be willing to work long hours and weekends as needed

Itar Requirements

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C.
  • 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com.

Department: Analytic Support 105604

Reporting To: Ryan Deward

Description

A Taste of Who We Are:

Backed by a tireless commitment to high quality, innovative culinary offerings and unparalleled client and guest services, Continental consistently ranks among the top contract dining and refreshment providers in the nation according to Food Management Magazine, the industry’s source for food service news and trends.

Our Mission

Delight our guest. Every meal. Every day.

Our Core Values

Exceptional – We recruit and retain phenomenal people who consistently go the extra mile to deliver results that lead the industry.

Hospitality – We are tirelessly committed to providing the highest quality food, beverages, and service by anticipating our guests' needs so they can count on memorable experiences every time.

Collaboration – We prioritize working together with a shared vision and effective & transparent communication, we unite as one team to achieve remarkable experiences.

Responsibility – we hold ourselves accountable to be there for our team and clients, to deliver what we say we will, when we say we will and check in on progress along the way.

Innovation – We are forward-thinkers always looking for new processes, technologies, and techniques to increase efficiencies and scalability to improve our services.

The Experience You’ll Create

The Business Intelligence Analyst supports data-driven decision making by building and maintaining reporting, dashboards, forecasting models, and repeatable analysis that translate operational and financial data into clear insights. This role partners with cross-functional teams to understand reporting needs, validate data, and deliver intuitive dashboards, forecasts, and KPI views that help leaders act quickly.

  • Apply statistical techniques, including multiple regression analysis, to identify drivers of performance and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Develop intuitive visualizations to support operational and financial decision making.
  • Perform ad hoc reporting requested submitted through Jira for multiple divisions.
  • Partner with IT and business teams to integrate data sources and validate outputs.
  • Automate recurring reporting and forecasting workflows to reduce manual effort.
  • Provide training and documentation to help users effectively consume insights.
  • Design, build, and maintain automated dashboards, KPI reporting, and forecasting models.

Location: Four days per week in-office in Sterling Heights, Michigan, and one day remote.

Ingredients For Thriving

  • 3+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, forecasting, or reporting roles.
  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel skills including advanced formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, and basic modeling.
  • Experience building reports or dashboards in Power BI is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis, forecasting concepts, and data visualization best practices.
  • Foundational statistics knowledge, including correlation and multiple regression analysis.
  • Basic understanding of data structures, tables, and relationships.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Ability to communicate insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Understanding of how automation and AI can be embedded into analytics and forecasting workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of Python for data cleaning, automation, statistical analysis, or forecasting workflows.
  • Experience using Power Automate to automate workflows, integrate systems, or support low-code solutions.
  • Exposure to building low-code or no-code internal tools or lightweight web applications.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted analysis, including how to structure effective AI prompts and questions to support analysis, documentation, and insight generation.
  • Basic SQL experience for querying and validating data.
  • Experience working with enterprise BI platforms such as Qlik or similar tools.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality, accurate work.
  • Ownership mindset with strong follow-through and accountability.
  • Collaborative and service-oriented approach when working with internal teams.

Savor The Benefits

We offer a range of benefits for eligibles team members, including:

  • Health Coverage – Medical, Dental and Vision
  • Voluntary Life/AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability, Critical Illness, Parental Leave
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Wellness Programs
  • Referral bonus
  • Additional Perks

To see a summary of current benefits, please visit https://www.continentalserves.com/work-at-continental/#benefits.

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What You’ll Be Part Of

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

As a key member of the Commercial Intelligence and Analytics team, you will take on a strategic role that combines advanced analytics, stakeholder partnership, and AI driven innovation. You will lead the development of scalable data products and analyses that directly support Circle’s Business and Marketing functions, while also identifying opportunities to incorporate AI tools and methodologies to enhance how insights are delivered across the business. This role sits at the intersection of data strategy and execution, helping the company make smarter decisions through high quality analysis, forward thinking automation, and technical leadership.

What You'll Work On

  • Delivering high impact analysis and reporting to support the Business and Marketing teams in understanding performance, risk, and opportunity
  • Designing and implementing scalable data models, dashboards, and pipelines that support accurate, self-service analytics
  • Identifying and leading the implementation of AI and ML tools to streamline data workflows and generate predictive insights
  • Partnering with senior leadership and the AI Engineering team to deliver insights and workflows that improve customer experience and maximize the value of strategic partnerships
  • Building and maintaining high quality documentation to support repeatable and transparent analysis
  • Driving operational excellence by applying strong data architecture and AI methods to enhance the effectiveness of business systems and workflows
  • Mentoring team members and contributing to best practices in analytics engineering and AI adoption

Core Requirements

What you’ll bring to Circle:

  • 7+ years of experience in sales analytics, business analytics, or a related field
  • Experience delivering advanced analytics to support strategic business decisions
  • Strong SQL and data modeling skills to build scalable, reliable data products
  • Proficiency using APIs and Python to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems
  • Skill in developing prompts for AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar systems
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional projects that drive measurable impact
  • Ability to partner with senior stakeholders to align data initiatives with business goals
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong knowledge domain of blockchain ecosystem

Preferred Requirements

  • Familiarity with modern analytics tools such as Superset and Hex
  • Understanding of AI models, embeddings, and frameworks
  • Familiarity with advanced Marketing measurement models such as multi-touch attribution
  • Experience/familiarity with Slack, Apple MacOS and GSuite.

Circle is on a mission to create an inclusive financial future, with transparency at our core. We consider a wide variety of elements when crafting our compensation ranges and total compensation packages.

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

Base Pay Range: $157,500 - $190,833

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. Additionally, Circle participates in the E-Verify Program in certain locations, as required by law.

Should you require accommodations or assistance in our interview process because of a disability, please reach out to accommodations@circle.com for support. We respect your privacy and will connect with you separately from our interview process to accommodate your needs.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Grow was born to tackle a critical challenge: making mental health care more effective and accessible for everyone. Since launching in 2020, 15 million sessions have started on Grow, and we've barely scratched the surface. We do it through a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Every solution we build reveals ten more waiting to be delivered, and that's just what gets us going. We've backed that ambition with more than $328M in funding, including our Series D at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

Your Impact At Grow

At Grow, the work you do can literally change someone's life. Your work here doesn't stay on a screen; it impacts whether someone can find, afford, and access quality care. That ambition sets us apart, and offers you an endless runway to impact one of the world's most urgent issues. We don’t have passenger seats here. Everyone is driving something that matters.

This work deserves real commitment. So if you thrive on meeting problems head on, untangling serious complexity, and working at pace with the sharpest yet kindest people around, you've come to the right place.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst, Business Analytics to help leaders across Grow make decisions with data. You’ll partner with business leaders to scope, design, and build the analytical tools and metrics that answer strategic and operational questions, from defining and operationalizing key performance indicators (KPIs) to building scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks. Your impact shows up in the decisions your insights shape, the clarity of the metrics you deliver, and measurable improvements in growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Do more than move the needle: help move a person.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Turn data into clear narratives and recommendations that influence decisions, including recurring business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and ad hoc deep dives.
  • Translate leaders’ business needs into analytical tools and metrics that answer questions such as where the growth levers are, why performance is falling short, and what an initiative achieved.
  • Scope, design, build, and maintain dashboards, reporting tools, and data models that give teams self-service access to accurate, consistent key metrics.
  • Use AI tools to speed up querying, modeling, and synthesizing findings, validate AI-assisted work rather than taking it at face value, and build reusable processes that hold up at scale.

What You’ll Bring

  • You have 3+ years of experience in business intelligence (BI) or data analytics at a high-growth tech startup, and you can spot business challenges in the metrics and recommend solutions while balancing analysis with decisive action.
  • You have expert-level SQL skills and are familiar with tools like Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Hex, and Retool.
  • You use metrics and analyses to uncover insights, validate hypotheses, and guide operational decisions, and you dive into edge cases to understand the full scope of the data.
  • You’re AI-native: AI tools are part of your daily work, and you know when to lean on them and when deeper manual analysis is warranted.
  • You translate complex analytical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and craft compelling data stories for executives, business leaders, engineers, PMs, and peers.
  • You’re mission-driven and connect your work back to the importance of Grow’s mission.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced, unpredictable environment, pivot as priorities emerge, and manage multiple stakeholders, projects, and timelines.
  • You’re collaborative by nature, celebrate group wins, and are a steadfast partner and source of encouragement for your colleagues.

Nice To Have

  • You have experience solving data problems in a healthcare-related field, such as revenue cycle management (RCM), provider operations, value-based care, or health tech SaaS.

Exemption Status: Exempt

The base compensation for this role will vary depending on several factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, and the candidate’s working location.

General Information About Working At Grow

About Us

Grow was born to tackle a critical challenge: making mental health care more effective and accessible for everyone. Since launching in 2020, 15 million sessions have started on Grow, and we've barely scratched the surface. We do it through a three-sided marketplace that empowers providers, augments insurance payors, and serves patients. Every solution we build reveals ten more waiting to be delivered, and that's just what gets us going. We've backed that ambition with more than $328M in funding, including our Series D at a $3B valuation from Sequoia Capital, Transformation Capital, TCV, SignalFire, Menlo Ventures, Goldman Sachs Alternatives, and others.

Your Impact At Grow

At Grow, the work you do can literally change someone's life. Your work here doesn't stay on a screen; it impacts whether someone can find, afford, and access quality care. That ambition sets us apart, and offers you an endless runway to impact one of the world's most urgent issues. We don’t have passenger seats here. Everyone is driving something that matters.

This work deserves real commitment. So if you thrive on meeting problems head on, untangling serious complexity, and working at pace with the sharpest yet kindest people around, you've come to the right place.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst, Business Analytics to help leaders across Grow make decisions with data. You’ll partner with business leaders to scope, design, and build the analytical tools and metrics that answer strategic and operational questions, from defining and operationalizing key performance indicators (KPIs) to building scalable dashboards and reporting frameworks. Your impact shows up in the decisions your insights shape, the clarity of the metrics you deliver, and measurable improvements in growth, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. Do more than move the needle: help move a person.

What You’ll Be Doing



- Turn data into clear narratives and recommendations that influence decisions, including recurring business reviews, strategic planning sessions, and ad hoc deep dives.
- Translate leaders’ business needs into analytical tools and metrics that answer questions such as where the growth levers are, why performance is falling short, and what an initiative achieved.

- Use AI tools to speed up querying, modeling, and synthesizing findings, validate AI-assisted work rather than taking it at face value, and build reusable processes that hold up at scale.

- You have 3+ years of experience in business intelligence (BI) or data analytics at a high-growth tech startup, and you can spot business challenges in the metrics and recommend solutions while balancing analysis with decisive action.

- You use metrics and analyses to uncover insights, validate hypotheses, and guide operational decisions, and you dive into edge cases to understand the full scope of the data.
- You’re AI-native: AI tools are part of your daily work, and you know when to lean on them and when deeper manual analysis is warranted.

- You’re mission-driven and connect your work back to the importance of Grow’s mission.

descriptionHtml:
Medica is a nonprofit health plan with more than a million members that serves communities in Minnesota, Nebraska, Wisconsin, Missouri, and beyond. We deliver personalized health care experiences and partner closely with providers to ensure members are genuinely cared for.

We're a team that owns our work with accountability, makes data-driven decisions, embraces continuous learning, and celebrates collaboration — because success is a team sport. It's our mission to be there in the moments that matter most for our members and employees. Join us in creating a community of connected care, where coordinated, quality service is the norm, and every member feels valued.

Evaluate, design, code, test, optimize and modify Medica's financial or operations systems solutions and reporting capabilities that support multiple lines of Businesses and IT initiatives. Capture, develop, and document data definitions, business rules, and data quality requirements. Conduct data analysis in support of a variety of analytic solutions. Interpret data, analyze results, and provide insights to determine operational impact, trends, and opportunities. Performs other duties as assigned.

Key Accountabilities

  • Partner with internal business customers to establish and develop relationships, establishing credibility as a key internal resource.
  • Use analytic tools such as Power BI and SQL, and other in-house tools to utilize multiple data sources and environments to produce reports to meet needs of business users.
  • Develop analytical and reporting specifications for enterprise healthcare projects through participation in project teams or meetings with internal customers.
  • Develop and maintain business performance reports for operational business units and produce executive analytic summaries to aid decision-making using various reporting and analytic tools.
  • Research subjects surrounding claims, providers, pricing, benefits, government programs or membership, conduct analysis, interpret data, perform data quality checks, identify threats, and present information to internal customers.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguous business and data requirements, independently investigate issues, identify appropriate data driven solutions, and communicate recommendations to business partners.
  • Participate in team activities to identify problems and improve work processes and systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in related field
  • 3 years of work experience beyond degree
  • Advanced SQL, Power BI, data analysis skills

Skills And Abilities

  • Experience with cloud-based technologies such as Snowflake strongly preferred.
  • Healthcare insurance industry experience or interest.
  • Demonstrated examples of taking initiative and being curious with data.

This position is an Office role, which requires an employee to work onsite, on average, 3 days per week. We are open to candidates located near one of the following office locations: Minnetonka, MN, or Madison, WI.

Annual salary range placement will depend on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, education, work experience, applicable certifications and/or licensure, the position's scope and responsibility, internal pay equity and external market salary data.  In addition to compensation, Medica offers a generous total rewards package that includes competitive medical, dental, vision, PTO, Holidays, paid volunteer time off, 401K contributions, caregiver services and many other benefits to support our employees.

The compensation and benefits information is provided as of the date of this posting. Medica’s compensation and benefits are subject to change at any time, with or without notice, subject to applicable law.
