Job Description

About the Role:

This role is a hybrid-based role and requires a local candidate who can travel to the office.

The Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst will design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and the semantic models that support them, ensuring business stakeholders have access to accurate, well-defined, and trusted data.

Reporting to the BI Manager, the Senior BI Analyst will own the design and usability of reports, maintain measures in alignment with certified metric definitions, and support the rollout and training of new and updated reports for users ranging from executives to field sales.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical Power BI expertise with excellent business acumen, communication skills, and a passion for helping teams make data-driven decisions.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

  • Under the direction of the BI Manager, design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that meet the needs of business stakeholders, including field sales, executives, FP&A, Marketing, Product Management, and Medical Education.
  • Develop and maintain DAX measures and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric in accordance with BI metric definitions and certification standards.
  • Collaborate with BI team members on the data that supports reporting, including identifying data quality issues, requesting source changes, and testing upstream changes prior to release.
  • Validate reports and measures against source data, and against Finance figures where required, prior to release.
  • Investigate and resolve reported data discrepancies, tracing each issue to its root cause and routing it to the appropriate owner when necessary.
  • Develop a working understanding of the commercial business, including the distinction between revenue and case data, in order to design reports around the decisions they support.
  • Gather requirements from report users, conduct design reviews, and collect feedback following release.
  • Design mobile-friendly report layouts to support field users.
  • Act as a resource in the rollout and training of new and updated reports, including plain-language release notes and current report documentation.
  • Maintain the report inventory and usage tracking, and retire reports that are no longer in use.
  • Manage report access and row-level security, administer Power BI workspaces, apps, and refresh schedules, and adhere to BI change-control processes.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to incorporate AI and automation into BI workflows, including Copilot in Power BI and Fabric, data-driven alerting, and AI-assisted documentation.
  • Support readiness for natural language querying once certified models are in place.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Systems, Information Technology, Statistics, Economics, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience developing Power BI reports and semantic models in a production environment.
  • Experience in the medical device, healthcare, or another sales-driven industry preferred.
  • Ability to present examples of previously developed reports during the interview process preferred.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Treace's Privacy Policy

It is Treace’s policy not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or any employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Veterans Employer

As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

descriptionHtml:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Service Operations Data Analytics Specialist within Siemens Energy Gas Services North America, you will help business leaders and operational teams turn complex data into clear, actionable insights. You will be partnered with teams supporting industrial equipment maintenance, field service operations, outage execution, resource coordination, and customer support. Your day may include developing dashboards, automating data workflows, validating information across business systems, and presenting performance trends to stakeholders. Your work will improve service delivery, resource utilization, maintenance planning, and overall business performance.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize operational dashboards and reports using Tableau and Power BI to support Central Operations leadership.
  • Translate complex datasets into actionable insights and executive summaries that support strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Use Snowflake and SQL to access, manage, and analyze large datasets from multiple business systems.
  • Build and maintain automated ETL workflows in Alteryx to streamline data collection, preparation, and recurring reporting processes.
  • Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and consistency across Snowflake, Salesforce, and other service operations data sources while documenting standard reporting methods.
  • Partner with operations, IT, and global data teams on process improvements, reporting alignment, corporate data governance, customer satisfaction, and business growth.


What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, operations reporting, or business intelligence, preferably within service operations or the energy sector.
  • Advanced experience developing Tableau and Power BI dashboards, querying Snowflake with SQL, and automating ETL workflows with Alteryx.
  • Experience with Salesforce reporting, KPI development, statistical analysis, trend forecasting, process mapping, and continuous-improvement methods.
  • Strong stakeholder-management, executive presentation, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills, including the ability to translate technical data into clear business recommendations.
  • Relevant Tableau, Alteryx, Snowflake, Salesforce, or Microsoft Power BI certifications are valued.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized for employment in the United States without need for current or future employer-sponsored work authorization. Siemens Energy employees with current visa sponsorship may be eligible for internal transfers.


About The Team

Gas Services

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Rewards

  • Career growth and development opportunities; supportive work culture
  • Company paid Health and wellness benefits
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • 401K savings plan with company match
  • Family building benefits
  • Parental leave

ADP is hiring a Business Intelligence Manager (Individual Contributor) for the HR Outsourcing (HRO) Analytics organization. This senior individual-contributor role is accountable for developing and maintaining reports and dashboards, with an emphasis on generating value-driven insights and KPIs to support business decision-making. The Business Intelligence Manager will lead complex analytics initiatives, leverage advanced business intelligence techniques, and partner with stakeholders to translate data into actionable insights. Through data visualization, analytics, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvement, this role will enable informed organizational decision-making.

What Are We Looking For?

Someone who thinks analytically and enjoys turning complex data into compelling stories and actionable insights. The ideal candidate has a passion for continuous improvement, data exploration, data analysis, and data visualization. They enjoy solving business problems through data and identifying opportunities to drive measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is business-minded, detail-oriented, self-motivated, collaborative, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. They possess strong communication skills, excel at building stakeholder relationships, and are willing to roll up their sleeves to tackle complex challenges and deliver results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of business processes, objectives, and requirements to generate meaningful insights and visualizations.
  • Develop visualizations and analytical insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements, validate data, and ensure the accuracy and relevance of analytical solutions.
  • Apply BI standards and best practices to maintain the quality and integrity of the HRO Analytics brand.
  • Design, develop, and implement intuitive dashboards that enable business stakeholders to easily interpret and act on data.
  • Coach business partners on how to leverage dashboards and analytical insights to support decision-making.
  • Lead complex analytics initiatives from requirements gathering through development, implementation, and stakeholder adoption.

Behaviors

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive self-starter requiring minimal guidance, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrates a can-do attitude and takes initiative to drive solutions and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong adherence to Agile methodologies, with a focus on delivering MVPs, meeting commitments, and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Team-oriented, with a strong focus on business stakeholders and the end-user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical discipline, such as Business Management, Finance, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in exploratory data analysis (EDA).
  • Advanced proficiency in developing and executing ETL processes independently using SQL, Python, Alteryx, or a combination of these technologies.
  • Advanced proficiency in BI and data visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI, as well as Excel.
  • Experience accessing and working with relational databases, large datasets, and analytical data models.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to generate insights and communicate findings through effective presentations and visualizations.
  • Technical expertise in database development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
  • Advanced proficiency in trend analysis, root cause analysis, and other diagnostic analytical methods.
  • Proficiency in prescriptive analytics and hypothesis testing.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, storytelling, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to management, team members, and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in analytics, an MBA, or a related field.
  • Experience in the HCM/PEO industry.
  • Experience supporting change management or large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leveraging AI and agentic development to create assets and insights.

Enterprise Analytics & Data Science Department

The Enterprise Analytics & Data Science department is responsible for leveraging strategic insights, customer analytics, data science, and market intel to understand customer behavior trends, product relationships, competitive positioning, and marketing opportunities to maximize financial performance and deliver exceptional customer experience.

The Business Intelligence team translates raw data into clear, actionable reporting and analytics. We develop efficient reporting solutions that help business leaders make timely, data-backed decisions with confidence.

About The Role

Are you an analytical problem-solver looking to accelerate your career in retail analytics and data visualization? In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex datasets and retail business partners, developing intuitive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that drive strategic decision-making across our retail operations.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for data visualization, solid SQL skills, and a genuine curiosity for understanding retail performance. You will partner closely with business leaders to translate raw data into clear, compelling visual narratives using modern BI platforms, helping the team monitor key metrics and spot operational opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

Dashboard Development, Data Preparation & Retail Analysis

Data Visualization & Reporting: Develop visually compelling, user-friendly, and high-performance dashboards. Our preferred BI platforms are MicroStrategy or Looker, though proficiency in Power BI or Tableau is highly valued.

UI/UX & Report Design: Apply clean visualization and design principles to ensure reporting layouts are intuitive, clear, and optimized for fast business decision-making.

Data Processing & SQL Queries: Write efficient SQL queries to profile, extract, filter, and structure raw data from cloud databases for seamless dashboard integration.

Quality Assurance & Credibility: Embed rigorous quality check standards into development workflows, ensuring high data accuracy and building total user trust in business reporting.

Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot and resolve basic performance issues in dashboards to guarantee a seamless, fast, and reliable end user experience.

Reporting Efficiencies: Maintain and optimize scheduled reporting cadences. Help streamline delivery processes using built-in BI tool scheduling or spreadsheet-based functions.

Legacy Report Optimization: Work to modernize legacy Excel spreadsheets or manual reporting processes, transitioning them into more sustainable, automated, or interactive dashboard solutions.

Ad-Hoc Analysis & Leadership Support: Support senior leadership and business stakeholders by conducting objective, data-driven analyses to answer key business questions. Assist in responding to high-priority inquiries by compiling accurate findings into clear, well-structured briefs and summary reports.

Insight Presentation: Translate data findings into clear, digestible summaries. Present trends and dashboard configurations to cross-functional stakeholders across the business.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with broader Analytics and Data Science teams to incorporate predictive metrics and model outputs into core operational dashboards.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience & Education

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related quantitative/business field.

Experience: 1–2+ years of hands-on experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a similar data-driven role

Industry Experience: Prior experience or a strong interest in retail operations, e-commerce, and key retail performance metrics.

Technical Skills

BI Platforms: Hands-on development experience or strong familiarity with modern BI tools (Looker and MicroStrategy preferred, Power BI or Tableau as alternatives).

SQL: Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, querying, profiling, and backend validation.

Spreadsheets: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for rapid data modeling and analysis.

Scripting (Beneficial): Familiarity with scripting languages (such as Python, JavaScript/Apps Script, or VBA) for task automation is a valuable advantage.

Analytical Mindset & Intellectual Curiosity: A genuine passion for exploring data, asking probing questions, and discovering underlying retail trends.

Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to explain technical layouts to non-technical stakeholders and craft clear, executive-ready performance summaries.

Time Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver quality work in a fast-paced retail environment.

About The Role

Are you an analytical problem-solver looking to accelerate your career in retail analytics and data visualization? In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex datasets and retail business partners, developing intuitive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations that drive strategic decision-making across our retail operations.

The ideal candidate has a strong eye for data visualization, solid SQL skills, and a genuine curiosity for understanding retail performance. Dashboard Development, Data Preparation & Retail Analysis

descriptionHtml:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Data Analyst to support a major office at the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) through data analysis, reporting, business process improvement, and Microsoft Power Platform solutions. This role provides hands-on analytical and business support for operational improvement, digital modernization, workflow analysis, performance measurement, data quality, and decision support.

The analyst will translate business and mission questions into clear data and reporting requirements; identify data needs, assess source quality, prepare and validate information, and deliver accurate, decision-ready dashboards, reports, and recurring analyses. The role combines independent ownership of moderately complex, multi-source analysis and Power Platform work with practical delivery support, including documentation, testing, data maintenance, stakeholder coordination, and request tracking. Working with project managers, developers, technical teams, and VA stakeholders, the analyst will help shape analytical approaches, review outputs for quality, and communicate findings and limitations in plain language.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Build, update, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and visualizations; connect to approved data sources and develop basic measures, calculations, and filters.
  • Write and adapt SQL queries to extract, filter, join, and validate data across relevant sources; apply an understanding of relational tables, relationships, and keys to support accurate reporting.
  • Perform hands-on data entry, cleansing, reconciliation, validation, and quality checks; identify discrepancies and coordinate their resolution.
  • Translate stakeholder questions into data requirements, metrics, filters, business rules, validation checks, and reporting outputs; document processes, assumptions, and known limitations.
  • Support the configuration and maintenance of simple Power Apps, Dataverse tables/forms, and Power Automate workflows such as notifications, approvals, and data movement.
  • Assist with testing, user acceptance testing, issue reproduction, and documentation of defects, enhancements, and change requests.
  • Create, update, prioritize with guidance, and track work items through the sprint or delivery cycle in Jira, Azure DevOps, Aha!, or comparable tools.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders and teammates to track requests, action items, status, dependencies, and follow-ups; communicate progress and escalate blockers.
  • Use Excel, Power Query, and other approved tools for basic analysis, manipulation, and recurring reporting support.
  • Maintain accurate process documentation, user guides, standard operating procedures, data definitions, and project/status materials.
  • Own assigned analysis and reporting work through delivery; perform quality and reasonableness reviews, help improve team standards, and provide guidance or peer review as appropriate while following approved data-handling and Power Platform practices.

Qualifications

 Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or a related field preferred).
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, operational analytics, business analysis, or a comparable role, including independent ownership of complex analytical or reporting deliverables.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, including creating or maintaining reports and dashboards, connecting to data, and building basic visuals and calculations.
  • Practical experience writing SQL queries, including filtering and joining data, and understanding relational tables, primary/foreign keys, and relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, data manipulation, and data quality checks.
  • Ability to gather requirements, document processes, and translate stakeholder needs into actionable reporting, data, and support tasks.
  • Comfort with detailed operational support activities such as data entry, documentation updates, ticket management, and coordination of follow-ups.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, sound data-quality judgment, attention to detail, collaboration, and the ability to independently manage competing priorities and communicate assumptions or limitations to stakeholders.
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

Desired

  • Experience creating simple Power Automate flows for notifications, approvals, or moving information between systems.
  • Exposure to building or configuring basic Power Apps and working with Dataverse tables, fields, forms, and related data.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Microsoft Azure DevOps, Aha!, or similar tools for documenting, updating, and tracking work items in Agile/Scrum delivery.
  • Working knowledge of Power Query and basic data transformation or modeling concepts.
  • Basic familiarity with HTML and JavaScript.
  • Experience supporting federal or government clients, including VA stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with healthcare, program management, or program evaluation data.
  • Exposure to UI/UX or user-centered design concepts and interest in relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., PL-300).
  • Master’s degree in a relevant field; experience providing peer review, mentoring, or shaping complex analysis.

Target Salary Range: $70,000 - $118,000

Disclaimer

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

JOB DESCRIPTION Job Summary

Provides senior level analyst support for data analysis and reporting activities. Responsible for organizing data from multiple sources to produce reports, dashboards, and analyses related to utilization, cost-containment, and business performance. Generates data-related insights that support strategic and operational decision-making and cost-containment. Designs and delivers reporting, analytics, and data solutions across business and healthcare domains, including claims, utilization, finance, and other business areas. Partners with stakeholders to define requirements, develop scalable reporting and data processes, and apply advanced analytical techniques to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and drive business performance. Supports projects, regulatory requests, and initiatives that improve data quality, reporting workflows, and process efficiencies.

Essential Job Duties

  • Analyzes complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities.
  • Designs, develops, and maintains reports, dashboards, and data solutions using tools such as Structured Query Language (SQL), Microsoft Excel, and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), that support utilization analysis, cost-containment, and operational performance.
  • Translates business needs into reporting and analytical requirements; partners with stakeholders to deliver actionable insights.
  • Facilitates healthcare data analysis, including data related to claims, pharmacy, lab, utilization, cost, and other areas.
  • Develops and maintains data processes for extraction, transformation, validation, and integration.
  • Ensures data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through quality assurance and validation processes.
  • Creates forecasts, models, and recommendations based on statistical analysis and business context.
  • Organizes, documents, and maintains datasets and reporting workflows across multiple business areas.
  • Consolidates research and analysis into clear summaries and recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Supports regulatory, contractual, and enterprise reporting requirements, including state mandated submissions.
  • Identifies and implements enhancements or fixes to existing reports and reporting processes.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional teams to define reporting requirements and maintain project/report timelines.
  • Documents methodologies, reporting processes, and business requirements.
  • Identifies and drives process improvements, standardization, and automation opportunities.
  • Leads or supports projects, including timeline management, requirements gathering, and deliverable execution.
  • Presents findings and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Supports regulatory, audit, and ad hoc data requests as needed.
  • Provides training and support to new and existing data analysis team members.

Required Qualifications

  • At least 4 years of experience in data analysis, reporting, or healthcare analytics, or equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills, including ability to interpret complex datasets, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • Technical proficiency with SQL, Excel, and reporting/analytics tools, and ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Experience with healthcare analytics (e.g., claims, utilization, cost containment, medical economics).
  • Experience working with complex datasets/provision of data analysis and insights.
  • Experience with healthcare utilization metrics, medical cost analysis, and performance indicators.
  • Attention to detail, accuracy in data validation, report development, and documentation.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and present data-related findings and solutions.
  • Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Crystal Reports, MedInsight, Power BI, relational databases or similar tools.
  • Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) systems (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tools such as SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure data lakes) and business intelligence (BI) tools.
  • Experience supporting regulatory reporting and healthcare payer systems (e.g., QNXT or similar platforms).
  • Familiarity with predictive modeling concepts and trend forecasting.
  • Project management experience.
  • Microsoft certification or similar technical credentials.

-  Experience working with complex datasets/provision of data analysis and insights.
-  Experience with healthcare utilization metrics, medical cost analysis, and performance indicators.
-  Attention to detail, accuracy in data validation, report development, and documentation.
-  Ability to work cross-functionally across a highly matrixed organization.
-  Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to clarify requirements and present data-related findings and solutions.
-  Microsoft Office suite and applicable software programs proficiency.

Preferred Qualifications



-  Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Crystal Reports, MedInsight, Power BI, relational databases or similar tools.
-  Experience with customer relationship management (CRM) systems (e.g., Salesforce).
-  Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) tools such as SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and data warehousing concepts.
-  Familiarity with cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure data lakes) and business intelligence (BI) tools.
-  Experience supporting regulatory reporting and healthcare payer systems (e.g., QNXT or similar platforms).
-  Familiarity with predictive modeling concepts and trend forecasting.
-  Project management experience.
-  Microsoft certification or similar technical credentials.

Reporting to: Manager, BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE & ANALYTICS

Location: Denver, CO or Remote

Employee Category: Salary, Exempt

About Inspirato

At Inspirato, we believe extraordinary travel should be effortless. We are a luxury destination club built on the pillars: Certainty, Care, and Value while delivering curated experiences that consistently exceed expectations for our members.

We are committed to promoting diversity, equity, and inclusion across everything we do — in our workplace, our business, our marketing, and the causes we support. Our team spans ages, abilities, cultures, races, religions, gender identities, and sexual orientations. We don’t just embrace those differences; we celebrate them.

The Role

Actively contributes to the business intelligence & analytics function. Develops, enhances, and maintains data queries, data models, reports, dashboards, and analytics, collaborating with business partners and customers as required. Advocates and fosters a data-driven approach to decision-making, furthering the evolution of the company’s business intelligence culture.

What You’ll Do

  • Reporting & Analytics (80%)
    • Develop, enhance and maintain reports, dashboards and analytics in the Power BI platform.
    • Conceive and author DAX measures to allow for meaningful calculations and insight.
    • Perform parallel work such as data integration, ETL and data model development and enhancement to support this effort.
    • Work with the I.T. and Data Architecture teams and contracted resources as required to deliver best-in-class business intelligence to business stakeholders.
  • Business Engagement (10%)
    • Engage with business stakeholders across a wide range of functions to identify and capitalize on key opportunities for analytics and reporting enhancements.
    • Identify data sources and help the business to prepare data for integration.
    • Foster a data-driven culture through the adoption and proliferation of data management best practices and advocate BI throughout the organization.
    • Communicate any observed defects in the data and work with the business to remedy.
  • Professional Development (5%)
    • Advance and further develop knowledge of Power BI, DAX, Power Query and other BI and analytics tools through online resources and/or books, training courses, user groups or professional organizations.
    • Stay up-to-date on the latest Power BI and Microsoft Power Platform functionality and developments.
  • Special Assignments & Projects (5%)
    • Contribute business intelligence and analytics expertise to special projects/assignments as required by the company’s expansion or ongoing operation.
Degree of Supervision Received

  • Supervision: The incumbent performs a variety of routine work within established policies and procedures and receives detailed instructions on new projects and assignments. Makes decisions within area of responsibility.

Degree of Decision-Making Responsibility

  • Position enforces company policies and procedures: The incumbent performs a variety of work within established policies and procedures, and ensures policies and procedures are followed.

Experience Required

  • Must have prior knowledge of position/industry (2-3 years previous experience in same or related field)

Education Required

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Power BI, including proficiency in the DAX formula language (required)
  • The ability to develop data extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes via Power Query, with a working knowledge of the M query language (required)
  • Experience creating dimensional data models such as star and snowflake schemas (required)
  • Proven experience using data visualization techniques to create meaningful reports and dashboards (required)
  • Able to translate business requirements into elegant and user-friendly reports and dashboards (required)
  • Eager to effectively articulate to a broad audience ideas and solutions of a complex/technical nature (required)
  • Experience working with and/or developing in Microsoft Power Automate (preferred)
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills and the ability to interact effectively with business unit leadership (preferred)
  • Experience with programming languages such as SQL or Python (preferred)

Compensation

Salary: $92,000 - $100,000

We build compensation structures that reflect comparable market rates for companies of similar size, revenue, and geography, while recognizing individual experience, performance, and demonstrated capability.

Based in Denver, Colorado, Inspirato is a luxury travel company providing affluent travelers access to a managed and controlled portfolio of hand-selected vacation options to ensure world-class service and certainty. Our portfolio features 100+ destinations, 350+ luxury homes, 50+ hotels and resorts, and custom travel experiences worldwide, available exclusively to our members.

At Inspirato, our mission is to inspire lasting memories and relationships by enhancing the way our members experience the world. Join us in our journey to enrich lives through meaningful connections and inspire a world of lasting memories!

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Overview

GovCIO is currently hiring for a Data Analyst to support program management, data analytics, dashboard development and reporting activities at Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE). This role will work with a team of both officers and contractors to interconnect reporting and analytics, tasking responses, and overall information to support the ICE mission. This role will directly support activities with the San Antonio Field Office on-site as they work to integrate processes to make law enforcement initiatives more efficient.

Responsibilities

  • Provide analysis of ICE specific mission data, processes, field operations, strategic planning, or nuanced mission systems.
  • Develop data analytics dashboards, tools and templates to support the efficient collection and analysis of field metrics.
  • Utilize tools such as Power BI, tableau, Excel, and Access to provide visualizations to overall data sets.
  • Support collaboration with multiple stakeholders, such as business, scrum teams, other project managers, to collect and compile information to ensure timely responses to requests and ad hoc assignments.
  • Facilitate the needs, issues, and challenges faced by the clients; perform gap analysis and recommend solutions.
  • Use source data to assess the effectiveness of projects and business processes.
  • Develop, gather and disseminate information and documentation among both business and technical customers.
  • Work with all team members to analyze changes in requirements and recommend the most expedient solutions in a timely manner.
  • Leverage advanced writing skills to translate complicated issues from multiple information sources into a clear point of view to create a compelling, concise, and well-written narrative.
  • Leverage excellent presentation development skills to prepare meeting agendas and synthesize complex information into succinct visualizations using tools such as PowerPoint.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's with 3 + years (or commensurate experience) in dynamic customer delivery environments

Clearance Required: Ability to attain and maintain DHS clearance (US citizenship required)

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines independently.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment when working with confidential or sensitive information.
  • Strong consultation, collaboration, documentation, and presentation skills.

Description

The Finance Data Analyst will play a critical role in supporting finance, executive, and operational teams by ensuring data integrity, delivering actionable insights, and driving financial reporting and operational excellence. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across departments to build business intelligence dashboards and enhance reporting capabilities. The Finance Data Analyst will also interpret data, identify trends, and visualize findings to communicate insights effectively.

This is a full-time, in-office position based at our Westfield, Indiana location. The successful candidate will be expected to work on-site in the Westfield office.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

  • Extract and process data from various sources, including databases, APIs, and reports generated from a variety of internal programs, external sources and software providers
  • Design and optimize enterprise-level reporting data workflows to improve efficiency and scalability
  • Ensure data integrity and consistency by cleaning data, identifying and correcting any errors, troubleshooting missing values and understanding the business to ensure data aligns with and validates business results & KPI’s
  • Analyze and interpret datasets using statistical analysis, focusing on trends and patterns
  • Develop and create reports and dashboards to present findings to stakeholders
  • Communicate visual representations of data using tools such as Tableau or Power BI to make insights understandable
  • Write and optimize SQL queries against large-scale datasets
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand their data needs and provide support for consolidated reporting and data driven decision-making.
  • Develop and deliver ad hoc analysis projects to address urgent business concerns as they develop utilizing data in real time
  • Support strategic objectives by establishing KPIs, refining key performance indicators and other quantifiable business objectives to measure the effectiveness of business initiatives
  • Partner with leadership and act as a business intelligence consultant to executives and other functional leaders to identify improvement opportunities and guide strategic planning

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field (Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, or related)
  • 3+ years of data analysis / business intelligence experience
  • Proficiency in data analysis tools such as SQL, Python, R, and Excel
  • Experience in machine learning, predictive modeling, or statistical analysis
  • Experience with NetSuite ERP, Power BI, Tableau or other visualization tools
  • Demonstrated ability to understand manufacturing business needs and speak to technical and non-technical operational business groups
  • Strong communication skills, with demonstrated ability to present and explain the significance of data to business stakeholders
  • Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, Visio, etc.); NetSuite experience; Web proficiency.

Working Conditions

  • Primarily works in an office environment in Westfield, IN with frequent interaction on the manufacturing floor.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and work at a desk for long periods of time
  • Ability to perform close visual work for prolonged periods of time

Description

Citizens Bank is undertaking a multi‑year transformation of its retail branch network, shifting from a cost‑focused footprint to a performance‑driven, growth‑oriented distribution model. The Senior Business Insights Analyst, Branch Network Distribution will play a central role in enabling that transformation.

This role is responsible for building and maintaining the core reporting, analytics, and management information used to measure and manage branch network performance. The analyst will develop insight across the banker, branch, market, and enterprise levels, translating complex data into clear, decision‑ready perspectives for senior leaders. Key stakeholders include the Head of Distribution Transformation, Head of the Retail Branch Network, and the Head of the Consumer Bank.

This is a hands‑on analytical role with meaningful exposure to executive leadership, requiring both technical depth and strong business judgment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Network Performance Reporting & Insights
    • Design, build, and maintain a comprehensive suite of reporting and dashboards that measure branch network performance using leading and lagging indicators.
    • Develop performance views across multiple levels (banker, branch, market, enterprise) to support day‑to‑day management and long‑term strategic decisions.
    • Proactively identify trends, risks, and opportunities and translate findings into actionable insights for senior stakeholders.
  • Data Knowledge, Wrangling & Preparation
    • Develop deep understanding of branch, banker productivity, customer, and financial data domains.
    • Use advanced SQL and tools such as Alteryx (or equivalent) to source, cleanse, and prepare high‑quality analytical datasets.
    • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and clarity of metrics and definitions across reporting outputs.
  • Business Intelligence & Tool Expertise
    • Build and maintain semantic data models that enable efficient, scalable reporting and analysis.
    • Leverage multiple BI and visualization tools to deliver intuitive, decision‑ready insights.
    • Continuously improve automation, performance, and usability of reporting assets.
  • Business Partnering & Influence
    • Serve as a trusted analytical partner to Distribution and Consumer Bank leadership.
    • Anticipate stakeholder questions and frame insights to support effective decision‑making.
    • Provide thoughtful, data‑driven recommendations with clear implications and trade‑offs.
  • People & Project Leadership
    • Lead analytical initiatives end‑to‑end, including scoping, work planning, execution, and delivery.
    • Develop project plans, manage timelines, and provide clear status updates to stakeholders.
    • Mentor and coach junior analysts, helping elevate overall analytical capability.
  • Executive Communication
    • Produce polished, executive‑ready materials including presentations, memos, and summaries.
    • Distill complex analyses into concise narratives tailored to senior leadership audiences.
  • Ways of Working & Continuous Improvement
    • Operate independently with strong ownership and accountability for outcomes.
    • Identify and implement process improvements to increase speed, accuracy, and scalability.
    • Thoughtfully adopt GenAI tools to enhance analytical productivity while maintaining rigor and governance.
Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or a related role; financial services or retail banking experience preferred.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency; hands‑on experience with Alteryx or similar data preparation tools strongly preferred.
  • Strong experience with BI and visualization platforms and semantic modeling concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex data into clear insights for senior leaders.
  • Experience leading projects and mentoring junior team members.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Analytics, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Insight‑driven — anticipates questions, connects dots, and delivers analysis that informs action.
  • Technically strong — combines analytical rigor with practical execution.
  • Executive‑ready communicator — translates complexity into clear, concise, decision‑focused messages.
  • Self‑directed — takes ownership, prioritizes effectively, and operates with minimal oversight.
  • Collaborative — builds strong relationships across functions and contributes positively to team outcomes.

Continuously curious — actively develops new skills and explores better ways to deliver insight and impact.

  • Preferred Qualifications
    • Master’s Degree in Business Administration
Hours & Work Schedule

  • Hours per Week: 40
  • Work Schedule: Monday - Friday
  • Hybrid: 4 days per week onsite, 1 day remote

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $135,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit https://jobs.citizensbank.com/benefits .

descriptionHtml:
Five Star Parks & Attractions, a trailblazer in the amusement and hospitality industry, is more than just a rating; it's a dynamic workplace where enjoyment and excellence converge. Actively involved in creating vibrant amusement park locations, we are the force behind superior entertainment experiences and lasting success. With a proud portfolio of unparalleled FEC brands, we ensure unforgettable moments at every location. Our commitment to safety, trust, and pride in our work creates a warm and inclusive environment where guests are treated like friends. At Five Star Parks & Attractions, we embrace empathy, acknowledge possibilities for all, and celebrate the unique payoff for each individual guest. Join us in a workplace that's not only safe & secure but also FUN, where every day is exciting. Position Overview

The Database and Business Intelligence Analyst turns our data into answers that drive decisions across the company. Reporting to the FP&A Manager, this role will own routine and custom reporting and analyze point-of-sale, customer, marketing, and promotion data across our portfolio of family entertainment centers, including Scene 75, Malibu Jack's, Celebration Station, Craig's Cruisers, Track Family Fun Parks, and LazerPort. The ideal candidate writes their own SQL, is comfortable taking a vague business question to a clear, data-backed answer, and can explain findings to operators and executives alike. You will work closely with Marketing and Operations, back up FP&A on reporting, and help lay the groundwork for forecasting and AI-driven insights.

This position can be remote but is ideally located in the Dallas, TX or Lexington, KY area.

Key Responsibilities

  • Point-of-Sale & Sales Analysis
    • Analyze POS transaction data across brands, including revenue mix by category (attractions, game cards, food and beverage, redemption, parties and events), average check, per-cap spend, and transaction counts.
    • Track sales trends by park, brand, region, day part, day of week, and season, and explain what drove changes versus prior year and budget.
    • Analyze game card load and play data, attraction utilization, and throughput to inform pricing, packaging, and capacity decisions.
    • Measure the performance of new games, attractions, and capital investments after they open.
    • Combine sales with labor and Placer.ai traffic data to report on conversion, labor productivity, and sales per labor hour.
  • Marketing & Promotion Analysis
    • Measure promotion and campaign results, including redemption rates, incremental revenue, discount cost, cannibalization, and return on spend.
    • Build pre- and post-campaign analyses and test-versus-control comparisons by park or market.
    • Report on online sales, e-commerce conversion, and digital channel performance in partnership with the Marketing team.
    • Use Placer.ai visitation and trade-area data to support market analysis and new-location decisions.
  • Customer Data Analysis
    • Analyze customer data from POS, online booking, loyalty, membership, and email/CRM systems to understand visit frequency, spend, retention, and lifetime value.
    • Build customer segments (e.g., birthday party bookers, members, groups, first-time vs. repeat guests) to support targeted marketing.
    • Follow data privacy and access rules for customer and payment-related data.
  • Routine & Custom Reporting
    • Own recurring daily, weekly, and period reports for General Managers, Regional VPs, brand leaders, Marketing, and executives, delivered accurately and on schedule.
    • Build and maintain dashboards at the location, regional, brand, and company levels so each metric means the same thing at every level.
    • Take ad hoc requests from leaders, clarify the question, and deliver custom analyses with a clear summary and recommendation.
    • Automate manual reports and move them onto the shared BI platform.
    • Present findings to non-technical audiences in plain language.
  • Data Manipulation & Data Quality
    • Write and optimize SQL queries, views, and stored procedures to extract, join, and aggregate data from multiple systems.
    • Clean, transform, and reshape raw data, including deduplicating records, standardizing item and promotion codes across brands, and matching customers across systems.
    • Reconcile reported sales to financials and flag discrepancies.
    • Monitor data feeds from POS, UKG, Placer.ai, and marketing platforms and catch breaks before operators do.
    • Maintain the data dictionary as new fields, metrics, and sources are added.
    • Back up FP&A on period reporting and support forecasting and AI-driven insight projects.
Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, computer science, statistics, finance, marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in Database and Business Intelligence, data analysis, or reporting, ideally with retail, restaurant, hospitality, or consumer sales data.
  • Strong SQL skills (required), including complex joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and aggregations across large transactional datasets; able to write, troubleshoot, and tune queries independently.
  • Working knowledge of relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar), including table design, keys, and indexing basics.
  • Proven experience delivering both routine recurring reports and custom ad hoc analyses to business stakeholders.
  • Hands-on data manipulation skills, including cleaning, transforming, merging, and reconciling data from multiple sources.
  • Experience analyzing point-of-sale or transaction-level sales data.
  • Experience measuring promotion, pricing, or marketing campaign performance.
  • Proficiency with at least one BI tool (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar), including building and publishing dashboards.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups (XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH), Power Query, and modeling.
  • Strong grasp of core retail metrics such as comps, average check, per-cap, conversion, margin, and year-over-year analysis.
  • Ability to explain findings clearly to non-technical leaders and turn analysis into recommendations.
  • High attention to detail; validates that numbers tie out before sharing them.
  • Able to manage multiple requests and deadlines with limited supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in family entertainment, amusement, theme parks, restaurants, or other multi-unit consumer businesses.
  • Familiarity with FEC or hospitality systems, including POS and game card platforms (e.g., Semnox), party and online booking, loyalty and CRM, and UKG or similar timekeeping.
  • Experience with marketing data, including email and CRM platforms, Google Analytics, paid media, and attribution.
  • Customer analytics experience, including segmentation, RFM, cohort and retention analysis, and lifetime value.
  • Experience with A/B testing, test-versus-control design, or basic statistical analysis.
  • Python or R for data cleaning, automation, or analysis.
  • Exposure to ETL tools, data modeling, or data warehouses.
  • Experience with location or traffic data such as Placer.ai.
  • Interest in applying AI tools to forecasting, anomaly detection, and natural-language reporting.

What Success Looks Like

  • 90 Days: Knows our POS, customer, marketing, UKG, and Placer.ai data and the data dictionary; owns the core weekly sales report; delivers a first promotion results analysis; covers routine FP&A reporting backup.
  • 6 Months: Standard post-promotion reporting is in place for every major campaign; location and regional sales dashboards are live and reconcile to financials; first customer segmentation is delivered to Marketing.
  • 12 Months: Leaders use dashboards as their default view; manual reports are largely automated; customer retention and lifetime value are tracked by brand; contributing to forecasting and AI-driven insight work.

Work Environment

  • Primarily office-based computer work with extended periods at a desk and screen.
  • Occasional travel to park locations to meet with General Managers and observe operations.
  • Some flexibility needed around period close and high-volume seasons.

We actively promote diversity and inclusion within our workplace and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Description

The Strategic Vendor Acceleration (SVA) organization is looking for a Senior Business Analyst to be a strategic analytics partner to our WW Stores Business Development, Supply Chain, Brand Protection, and Site Experience teams. In this role, you'll own the full analytics lifecycle: understanding what the business needs across all Amazon stores, designing scalable data solutions, and delivering insights that shape decisions at every level of leadership. You'll work across functions to define how we measure success, build the data foundation that reporting relies on, and replace manual processes with automated, self-service tools. The ideal candidate is good at both technical work and business communication, and has curiosity to utilize AI where possible to make the team more efficient and effective. You're comfortable with ambiguity, care about data accuracy, and want to help teams work smarter.

Key job responsibilities

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted analytics partner by turning complex business questions into clear, useful insights.
  • Design and own scalable ETL queries and data pipelines that serve as the single source of truth for reporting across the organization.
  • Build scorecards and dashboards that help leaders and external vendors see business performance, growth, and operational health clearly.
  • Define the metrics, benchmarks, and methods used to measure business impact, and get cross-functional stakeholders to agree on them.
  • Continuously invent, simplify, and automate your products, tools, services, and methodologies.
  • Protect data integrity through thorough validation, root cause analysis, and proactive monitoring.
  • Find manual work and replace it with automated, self-service solutions that free up time for higher-value work.
  • Own analytics products from start to finish, shaping roadmaps and improving them based on user feedback.
  • Lead data and reporting migrations, including moving dashboards, datasets, and workflows to AWS Quick, while keeping data accurate and disruption to users low.
  • Manage and improve the Salesforce setup: configure objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, and automated workflows; manage users and permissions; and keep Salesforce data clean and connected to downstream reporting

About The Team

Strategic Vendor Acceleration (SVA) is Amazon's unified, global program for managing our most strategically important vendor relationships across Worldwide (WW) Stores. SVA's mission is to make Amazon Retail the first call for global growth for the brands customers care about most — because working with us is faster, simpler, and more valuable than any alternative. We do this by combining executive-level external connectivity, expert-level internal defect elimination, and streamlined vendor access to Amazon's newest programs and innovations across all WW Stores.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of writing SQL queries and creating business intelligence reports using Tableau, Power BI experience
  • Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of as a Data Analyst, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, or a related occupation experience
  • 4+ years of processing large, multi-dimensional datasets from multiple sources experience
  • 4+ years of developing automated reporting experience
  • 4+ years of using SQL, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load), or Oracle experience
  • Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
  • Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building measures and metrics, and developing reporting solutions
  • Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
  • Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

Senior FP&A Business Intelligence Analyst

Position Summary

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain enterprise datasets, semantic models, dashboards, and reporting solutions.

  • Manage data models, reporting frameworks, and key business hierarchies.
  • Automate reporting, analysis, and recurring business processes using AI and modern productivity tools.
  • Continuously improve reporting standards, governance, and analytical methodologies.

Qualifications And Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or data management.
  • Advanced SQL skills, including data transformation, troubleshooting, optimization, and analytical model development.
  • Experience developing analytical, forecasting, or decision-support models using SQL, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, including semantic models, DAX, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric and cloud-based analytics platforms.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, governance, validation, and reporting best practices.
  • Ability to independently investigate problems, validate findings, and develop effective solutions with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills across business and technical teams.
  • Experience using AI and automation tools to improve efficiency while exercising sound business judgment and validating results.
  • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems preferred.
  • Experience with Python, Microsoft Copilot, Power Query, and workflow automation tools preferred.
  • Experience working with relational databases, data modeling, data integration, and enterprise reporting environments preferred.

We are seeking a motivated, high-potential Senior Commercial Data Analyst to

strengthen our commercial analytical capability. This hands-on individual contributor will lead the processes used to gather, validate, analyze and report commercial data. The role will work at the intersection of Sales,

Commercial Finance and IT, translating business needs into scalable reporting and analytical solutions while generating insights that support growth and market-share decisions. This position has no direct reports. Success will come through process leadership, technical credibility, commercial understanding and the ability to influence across functions.

What You Will Do

  • Lead assigned commercial data and reporting processes from business requirement through delivery and adoption.
  • Partner with Sales and Commercial Finance to define KPIs, reporting requirements and analytical priorities.
  • Translate business needs into data specifications, reporting logic, user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, scorecards and recurring reporting using
  • Power BI or comparable tools.
  • Analyze revenue, volume, pricing, margin, customer, product and market performance data.
  • Identify trends, risks, performance drivers and opportunities to support commercial growth.
  • Reconcile data across commercial, financial and operational sources and coordinate resolution of discrepancies.
  • Maintain documentation covering business definitions, mappings, reporting logic, data sources and process ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting and improve scalability.
  • Partner with IT and data teams on source-system changes, integrations, data models and technical delivery.
  • Support testing, user training and adoption of new reporting solutions.
  • Present clear recommendations to business stakeholders and leadership.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • 5 years in commercial analytics, sales analytics, BI, commercial finance, revenue operations or a related field.
  • Strong SQL and advanced Excel capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau or a comparable BI platform.
  • Experience translating business requirements into reports, dashboards or analytical solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, including data validation and reconciliation.
  • Understanding of commercial measures such as revenue, margin, pricing, customers and products.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated self-direction and ownership of projects from initial question through implemented result.
  • Immigration sponsorship not available for this role

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a manufacturing, industrial or B2B environment.
  • Experience with ERP and CRM data.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, SAP, Snowflake, Power Query, Alteryx or Python.
  • Experience with customer or product hierarchies, segmentation, pricing or market data.
  • Exposure to Agile requirements, user-acceptance testing or reporting governance practices.

Annual Or Hourly Compensation Range

The pay range for this position is $85,900.00 - $128,900.00. Many factors are taken into consideration when determining compensation, such as experience, education, training, geography, etc. We comply with all minimum wage and overtime laws.

Benefits

Ecolab strives to provide comprehensive and market-competitive benefits to meet the needs of our associates and their families. Click here to see our benefits.

If you are viewing this posting on a site other than our Ecolab Career website, view our benefits at jobs.ecolab.com/working-here.

Potential Customer Requirements Notice

To meet customer requirements and comply with local or state regulations, applicants for certain customer-facing roles may need to:

  • Undergo additional background screens and/or drug/alcohol testing for customer credentialing.

Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA)

Ecolab will provide reasonable accommodation (such as a qualified sign language interpreter or other personal assistance) with our application process upon request as required to comply with applicable laws. If you have a disability and require accommodation assistance in this application process, please visit the Recruiting Support link in the footer of each page of our career website.

Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion & Belonging

At Ecolab, we believe the best teams are inclusive. We are on a journey to create a workplace where every associate can grow and achieve their best. We are committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance. In all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement, we will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, disability, or status as a covered veteran.

In addition, we are committed to furthering the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) through Affirmative Action (AA).

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

Archer is collaborating with Excella to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Senior Consultant Data Analyst

Arlington, Virginia, United States, Remote

Excella is a transformative technology firm that helps organizations unlock new possibilities. We believe the key to helping clients challenge the status quo and reach new heights lies in our talented people. That’s why we’re committed to developing talent and providing opportunities for career growth at every stage. Join our collaborative team dedicated to solving complex problems with sustainable solutions while building your future as a leader. At Excella, you’re empowered to make lasting impact, turning today’s challenges into tomorrow’s mission successes.

  • Workplace locations look different for everyone. Excellians are a distributed workforce and whether you're working from your home office or a client site, we support a flexible work/life integration regardless of your location.
  • We offer top of industry medical, dental, and vision benefits with multiple options to choose from such as an employer-contributed health savings account, infertility coverage, and orthodontia so you can select the plan that works best for you.
  • Regardless of what stage of life you’re in, Excella wants to support you. We provide 8 weeks of Parental Leave, discounted pet insurance, and a Care.com membership with 3 back-up emergency child or elder care days annually - all available to you on your first day.
  • Starting day one, every employee is bonus eligible and receives 15 days of paid vacation, 6 federal holidays, and 4 floating holidays.
  • Doing your best work means having the best tools! Excella’s TechEleX program provides you with multiple options to suit your technology needs. Choose between a variety of Mac or PC devices, and to ensure your hardware remains current, at the end of a 3-year period Excella will replace your existing computer with a new model from the program. Plus, we’ll even give you the original device to keep for your personal use!
  • With Excella’s Annual Internet Reimbursement benefit, all employees receive an additional $25 per month to help offset the cost of internet access. This initiative reflects our commitment to supporting you in staying connected and productive, no matter where you work.
  • We'll invest in your career by providing 3 days of paid professional development every year, including an allowance for registration fees to attend classes, conferences, or obtain professional certifications.
  • We encourage mindfulness and overall well-being through employee wellness events, a HeadSpace membership, as well as access to TalkSpace and mental health coverage through our medical plans.

Overview

We are looking for an expert in Data Analysis and technical consulting to join our team who is driven to deliver valuable customer experiences. Our analysts are team-oriented, collaborative, and focus on delivering value in everything we do. We use agile methods to analyze, define, and document business requirements for software solutions that align with organizational goals and help our clients achieve their desired outcomes. We support our clients in their digital product needs - from vision to roadmap to execution. 

Responsibilities

  • Develop a thorough understanding of the business context and objectives by eliciting and analyzing requirements from relevant stakeholders (business users, data engineers, data scientists, etc.). 
  • Operationalize business questions using data. 
  • Demonstrate understanding of relational databases, data architecture, and data modeling. 
  • Build complex SQL statements to answer business questions. 
  • Design conceptual data models, entity relationship diagrams, and business process models. 
  • Transform and cleanse data using tools such as R, SQL, or Python. 
  • Interpret, understand, and explain data insights to clients. 
  • Manage and create dashboards (drag and drop) for storytelling of regular information reports and ad-hoc requests. 
  • Build trust and respect, establish relationships, and develop rapport with technical and non-technical team members. 
  • Document Data Analysis processes and outcomes. 
  • Utilize industry or subject matter expertise (e.g., finance, employment, hospitality, web analytics). 

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in IT or a related industry. 
  • Intermediate to advanced SQL skills. 
  • Experience working with Data Visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI. 
  • Preferred experience with cloud analytics products such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure. 
  • Preferred knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets. 
  • Strong analytical aptitude and ability to structure complex or undefined business problems. 
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to report and present findings to varying stakeholders. 
  • Hands-on experience using tools to help clients make data-driven decisions. 
  • Knowledge and practice of core Agile values and principles is a plus. 
  • Initiative to learn new strategies and trends to continue to educate self analytically, technically, and technologically. 
  • Intermediate experience with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. 

This range represents the minimum and maximum base salary that Excella reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Actual compensation within the range will depend on factors such as skills, experience, training, certifications, and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top or bottom of the range.

Your pay also includes the opportunity for an annual bonus in addition to the base salary. This variable pay opportunity is dependent upon the attainment of shared firmwide goals and objectives as determined by Excella’s Executive Team. Certain eligibility and pro-ration rules apply.

Should your experience and knowledge qualify you for a different position or title within Excella, we may consider you for positions that better align with your qualifications. In that case, we will provide the range for those positions as well.

Overview

We are looking for an expert in Data Analysis and technical consulting to join our team who is driven to deliver valuable customer experiences. Our analysts are team-oriented, collaborative, and focus on delivering value in everything we do. We use agile methods to analyze, define, and document business requirements for software solutions that align with organizational goals and help our clients achieve their desired outcomes. Responsibilities



- Develop a thorough understanding of the business context and objectives by eliciting and analyzing requirements from relevant stakeholders (business users, data engineers, data scientists, etc.).  
- Operationalize business questions using data.  
- Demonstrate understanding of relational databases, data architecture, and data modeling.  
- Build complex SQL statements to answer business questions.  
- Design conceptual data models, entity relationship diagrams, and business process models.  
- Transform and cleanse data using tools such as R, SQL, or Python.  
- Interpret, understand, and explain data insights to clients.  
- Manage and create dashboards (drag and drop) for storytelling of regular information reports and ad-hoc requests.  
- Build trust and respect, establish relationships, and develop rapport with technical and non-technical team members.  
- Document Data Analysis processes and outcomes.  
- Utilize industry or subject matter expertise (e.g., finance, employment, hospitality, web analytics).  

Qualifications



- 3+ years of experience in IT or a related industry.  
- Intermediate to advanced SQL skills.  
- Experience working with Data Visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.  
- Preferred experience with cloud analytics products such as Google Cloud, AWS, or Microsoft Azure.  
- Preferred knowledge of statistics and experience using statistical packages for analyzing datasets.  
- Strong analytical aptitude and ability to structure complex or undefined business problems.  
- Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to report and present findings to varying stakeholders.  
- Hands-on experience using tools to help clients make data-driven decisions.  
- Knowledge and practice of core Agile values and principles is a plus.  
- Initiative to learn new strategies and trends to continue to educate self analytically, technically, and technologically.  
- Intermediate experience with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
