Job Description

The Senior BI Analyst will be responsible for developing, advancing, and driving adoption of Vistar’s reporting and analytics capabilities across the organization. This role partners with business stakeholders and IT to understand business needs, translate them into scalable, high-performing BI solutions, and transform data into actionable insights. The Senior BI Analyst will help shape data structure, integration, and reporting standards while enabling self-service analytics across the organization.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Design and optimize dimensional models and semantic layers to support scalable BI solutions, self-service analytics, and a single source of truth.
  • Develop insightful and visually compelling Power BI reports and dashboards that transform data into actionable business insights.
  • Perform data analysis to validate assumptions, support decision-making, troubleshoot issues, and identify improvements in data quality and structure.
  • Communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders to define KPIs, gather requirements, and translate business needs into effective BI solutions.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on Power BI, data modeling, Power Query, and DAX, providing guidance on best practices to team members and stakeholders.
  • Promote data accessibility, self-service analytics, and data literacy across the organization.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance standards, including data quality, privacy, security, and integrity.
  • Manage multiple priorities and collaborate across teams to deliver high-quality solutions within defined timelines.
  • Drive continuous improvement by evaluating tools, techniques, and best practices that improve the effectiveness and performance of BI solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Must be local to the Denver area; out-of-state candidates will not be considered.
  • 5+ years of Power BI experience, with advanced expertise in developing and optimizing complex DAX calculations, data modeling, and data visualization.
  • Strong SQL experience, including data extraction, manipulation, and querying from relational databases.
  • Expertise in performance tuning and optimization of Power BI reports and SQL queries
  • Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling and Business Intelligence/Data Warehousing concepts.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills, with keen attention to detail and a passion for data-driven decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities effectively.

Compensation

$90,000 - $110,000 + 15% Annual Incentive Potential

  • Prioritize, monitor, and manage multiple requests and projects while meeting deadlines.

  • Strong multitasking and organizational skills

We are seeking a talented Business Intelligence Analyst to join our dynamic team. This role will focus on designing and delivering high-quality dashboards and data solutions that provide actionable insights across the organization. While today’s reporting leverages on-premises data sources, we will be transitioning to Microsoft Fabric in 2026, moving our data warehouse into the Fabric Data Lake. The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a key role in ensuring a smooth transition by building reporting solutions that align with both current practices and future architecture. Embrace the opportunity to innovate, collaborate, and make a meaningful impact.

This position is 100% on-site Monday through Friday from 800am to 500pm in Stevens Point, WI.

This position requires candidates to be authorized to work in the U.S.A. without the need for visa sponsorship.

Application Deadline (Estimated) Applications will be accepted through December 9th, 2026, however, this timeline may be adjusted based on business needs and candidate volume.

What to Expect

  • Develop, manage, and maintain data solutions and interactive dashboards using Power BI.
  • Collaborate with business units to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights that address key challenges.
  • Build and adapt data models to support evolving reporting needs, optimizing for both performance and usability.
  • Partner with BI developers and analysts to design efficient data flows and ensure high-quality report outputs.
  • Write clear specifications and documentation for new and updated reports, ensuring accuracy through thorough testing.
  • Support the transition of reporting from on-premises sources to Microsoft Fabric, leveraging the Fabric Data Lake as the primary data source.
  • Seek opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process improvements.
  • Stay current with Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related BI technologies to bring forward best practices and innovative solutions.


What You Will Contribute

  • Bachelor’s degree or 3 - 4 years of data analyst experience in a related field.
  • Strong understanding of Power BI and dashboarding tools.
  • Advanced experience using Microsoft Excel, SQL, Data warehouse.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of creating/improving business processes.
  • Ability to understand and perform business and functional requirement analysis.
  • Strong mathematical skills for writing Excel formulas and applying statistical concepts.
  • Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
  • Experience with SQL, DataMarts, PowerQuery, and PowerAutomate.
  • Strong analytical and logical skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Certifications related to Microsoft Fabric are preferred.
  • Character qualities thoroughness, dependability, orderliness, persistence and responsibility


What You Will Receive

  • The salary range for this position is $70,000 - $80,000 per year, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life, 401(k) with matching, HSA with company contribution.
  • Earn up to 15 paid days off annually.
  • Paid Holidays on business workdays.
  • Company-paid on-site wellness meals.
  • Gym membership reimbursement.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Voluntary benefits short-term disability, whole/term life, hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident expense.
  • Opportunities for growth and development such as company university and tuition reimbursement options.
  • On-staff health coach, one-on-one or group coaching.
  • Health and wellness initiatives walking challenge, weight loss challenge, health risk assessment and more!


Why Work at Ortho Molecular Products

Simply put, our healthcare system is broken. It is expensive, complicated, and dysfunctional. At Ortho Molecular Products, our vision is to transform the practice of medicine. Every day, across America and the world, we help health care providers implement better solutions for health challenges that include lifestyle medicine and nutritional therapies proven to improve patient outcomes. We do this by manufacturing science-based products and developing innovative clinical programs for doctors that help their patients get better faster.

We are looking for people who align with our mission and want to invest their lifework and passion into transforming the practice of medicine. Our team is purpose-driven, values-based, and service-focused. We are looking for like-minded people who want to join the movement that is changing the way healthcare is being delivered.

We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.

Universal Music Group is looking for an Analyst to join the Strategic Analytics team. This role is located on-site in UMG’s Santa Monica office.

How We LEAD

The Analyst will consult on projects for Senior Executives, as well as individuals within Business Development, Finance, Communications, Marketing, and UMG’s various label groups. The ideal candidate should be an expert at analyzing large data sets in SQL and highly skilled at understanding new or messy data. Additional expertise in financial modeling, Excel, PowerPoint, and data visualization is a strong plus. Candidates should also demonstrate a solid understanding (or an eagerness to learn) the business models that are currently revolutionizing digital and subscription-based media.

How You’ll CREATE

  • Write complex SQL scripts to extract necessary data for projects
  • Explain the benefits and pitfalls of various data sets based on deep understanding of data quality
  • Comfortable dealing with many disparate data sources and reconciling against the source of truth

Job Description

The Senior Strategic Data Analyst drives institutional success by transforming raw data into actionable strategic insights. This role designs complex data architecture, develops predictive analytics, and builds enterprise-level dashboards. The primary focus is providing the Muma College of Business with necessary data and monitoring and forecasting key performance indicators (KPIs) related to student success and Florida State University System performance metrics.

Responsibilities

Strategic Plan KPI Dashboards and Analytics Development

  • Build, publish, and maintain interactive enterprise-level visualization dashboards.
  • Translate complex institutional data into clean, understandable visual narratives.
  • Provide leadership and stakeholders with real-time access to strategic data.
  • Establish automated workflows for continuous dashboard data updates.


Advanced Data Extraction and Querying

  • Write, optimize, and maintain complex, end-to-end SQL queries.
  • Extract data from student, human resources, and financial information systems.
  • Blend cross-functional data to uncover institutional correlations and efficiencies.
  • Ensure data integrity, consistency, and security across all query models.


Predictive Modeling and Strategic Forecasting

  • Develop predictive models to anticipate performance outcomes and trends.
  • Identify potential shortfalls in state and institutional metrics well in advance.
  • Recommend data-driven, proactive interventions to ensure college success.
  • Conduct scenario modeling to assess the impact of proposed policy changes.
  • Maintain expert knowledge of the Florida State University System Performance-Based Funding (PBF) model and Preeminent metrics.
  • Monitor critical undergraduate and graduate student success and retention metrics.
  • Present complex analytical findings clearly to executive leadership and board members.
  • Document data definitions, query logic, and dashboard methodologies thoroughly.


Cross-Level University and MCOB Constituent Engagement and Collaboration

  • Partner with institutional constituents at all levels, including executive leadership, faculty, and administrative staff.
  • Facilitate discovery sessions with diverse stakeholders to capture business requirements.
  • Adapt communication style to effectively collaborate with both highly technical IT staff and non-technical academic leaders.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor across departments to promote a culture of data-informed decision-making.


Qualifications

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Five (5) years of experience in data management, business intelligence, or institutional research.
  • Expert-level proficiency in writing complete, advanced SQL queries from scratch.
  • Proven experience building production-level dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated experience successfully collaborating with multi-level institutional stakeholders.
  • Experience utilizing predictive analytics tools or statistical programming (Python, R).


Preferred Experience

  • Master's Degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Three (3) years of experience in data management, business intelligence, or institutional research.
  • Prior experience working within the Florida State University System.
  • Deep familiarity with Banner and OracleHR, or equivalent higher education ERP systems.


This is not a visa supporting position.

descriptionHtml:
Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

  • Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
  • What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
  • It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

  • Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
  • Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
  • Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
  • And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
  • Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.
  • Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Data Analyst to help us turn data into useful insights and make better business decisions while contributing to the continued development of our data infrastructure. In this role, you’ll independently partner with stakeholders across the organization to explore data, improve reporting, answer business questions, define meaningful metrics, and develop practical, reusable solutions. You’ll also help test, validate, and execute new data models, processes, and tools as we build a more scalable data foundation. This is an opportunity for someone who brings strong analytical fundamentals, sound judgment, and a practical approach to solving complex problems while helping establish sustainable analytics practices across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Independently partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into reliable analyses, reports, dashboards, metrics, and data solutions.
  • Explore, clean, reconcile, and validate data from operational systems and emerging data infrastructure to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities.
  • Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reports, SQL queries, analytical datasets, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making.
  • Test and execute new data models, reporting processes, and analytical workflows; identify issues, document findings, and provide feedback to improve scalability and usability.
  • Help establish consistent metrics, data definitions, documentation, quality checks, and reporting practices as our data capabilities scale.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operations analysis, finance, product analytics, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own analytical projects from requirements gathering through analysis, validation, communication, and delivery.
  • Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and the ability to investigate and validate query results.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, datasets, or analytical tools used by business stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment when working with complex or imperfect data.

Preferred Skills And Experience

  • Experience with a BI or visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or a similar platform.
  • Experience validating data models, reporting pipelines, data transformations, or analytical workflows across multiple systems.
  • Familiarity with data modeling concepts such as tables, dimensions, measures, data grain, reusable reporting datasets, and metric definitions.
  • Exposure to Python, R, APIs, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, dbt, lakehouse concepts, Git, or other data development practices.
  • Experience improving data quality, automating manual reporting, documenting data processes, or helping establish analytics standards.

Compensation

  • Base Salary: $80,000 - $150,000
  • Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

Additional Requirements

  • Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach, CA. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

To protect candidates and our company from application fraud and impersonation, we use third-party tools to verify applicant identity and detect fraudulent applications. Learn more in our Privacy Notice.

In this role, you’ll independently partner with stakeholders across the organization to explore data, improve reporting, answer business questions, define meaningful metrics, and develop practical, reusable solutions. You’ll also help test, validate, and execute new data models, processes, and tools as we build a more scalable data foundation. This is an opportunity for someone who brings strong analytical fundamentals, sound judgment, and a practical approach to solving complex problems while helping establish sustainable analytics practices across the organization.

Responsibilities



- Independently partner with stakeholders to understand business objectives and translate them into reliable analyses, reports, dashboards, metrics, and data solutions. 
- Explore, clean, reconcile, and validate data from operational systems and emerging data infrastructure to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities. 
- Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, recurring reports, SQL queries, analytical datasets, and ad hoc analyses that support business decision-making. 
- Test and execute new data models, reporting processes, and analytical workflows; identify issues, document findings, and provide feedback to improve scalability and usability. 
- Help establish consistent metrics, data definitions, documentation, quality checks, and reporting practices as our data capabilities scale. 

Qualifications



- 4+ years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, operations analysis, finance, product analytics, or a related field. 
- Demonstrated ability to independently own analytical projects from requirements gathering through analysis, validation, communication, and delivery. 
- Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, aggregations, CTEs, window functions, and the ability to investigate and validate query results. 
- Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, datasets, or analytical tools used by business stakeholders. 
- Strong problem-solving, communication, organization, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to exercise sound judgment when working with complex or imperfect data. 

Preferred Skills And Experience



- Experience with a BI or visualization tool such as Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or a similar platform. 
- Experience validating data models, reporting pipelines, data transformations, or analytical workflows across multiple systems. 
- Familiarity with data modeling concepts such as tables, dimensions, measures, data grain, reusable reporting datasets, and metric definitions. 
- Exposure to Python, R, APIs, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, dbt, lakehouse concepts, Git, or other data development practices. 
- Experience improving data quality, automating manual reporting, documenting data processes, or helping establish analytics standards. 

Compensation



- Base Salary: $80,000 - $150,000
- Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave 

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

Additional Requirements



- Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach, CA. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site. 

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

True Anomaly is committed to equal employment opportunity on any basis protected by applicable state and federal laws. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please do not hesitate to let us know.

Responsibilities

  • Interact with Senior leaders in the organization to develop and refine requests for analyses. Identify potential business opportunities and pursue them through analytics and creative solutions in consultation with team leadership
  • Conduct objective, rigorous analytics to help the business improve profitability, operational processes, and customer service with minimal guidance from management – e.g., identification and evaluation of revenue growth opportunities, resource optimization, optimal investment mix, competitive market dynamics, customer behavior, and pricing optimization
  • Distill vast datasets into actionable insights and recommendations that guide decisions and strategies. Develop presentation materials that synthesize analyses into a format ready for senior management consumption and assume a substantial role in communicating analysis findings clearly, concisely and compellingly to senior management, in both verbal and written formats. Assist Analyst I &II team members in structuring and executing their analytics and in developing presentation materials
  • Participate actively in discussions with senior clients, and assist in driving the development, implementation and evaluation of strategic projects
  • Develop and support reporting for operating departments to provide senior leaders visibility into trends and business performance drivers
  • Use technology (e.g., SQL, R, Tableau, Google BigQuery, Python) to develop analytics and reporting tools; take an active role in integrating new technologies and tools into the department’s processes. Experienced in working in both Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
  • Propose and implement improvements that drive material efficiencies in processes and reporting
  • Lead projects that require input from other Analytics team members; contribute to cross-Analytics team projects
  • Help to train, on-board, and develop junior analysts in technical skills, tools & processes

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college
  • 2+years of professional work (or equivalent experience)
  • Demonstrated business acumen for the casino industry; can articulate the fundamental drivers of business performance
  • Advanced skills in querying, analyzing, and visualizing large data sets. Proficiency in SQL and ideally one or more of the following programming languages: R, VBA, SAS, Python, and experience in working with Google BigQuery. Experienced in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint

Additional Requirements

  • Strength in critical thinking, problem solving, and written and verbal communication. Comfort in articulating complex information and analyses to a variety of audiences
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to quickly learn relevant database applications and software

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

As a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst you will be responsible for working with various business teams and IT teams, extracting data through relational databases or cloud platforms; designing, developing, and supporting reports and dashboards using Qlik/MicroStrategy or other BI technologies to inform business critical decisions. One will be expected to analyze complex business challenges within the store environment. This position is expected to identify and implement departmental and company strategic initiatives that result in measured operating efficiencies and improved customer/associate experience

What You’ll Do

  • Compile financial or operational information - Prepare and summarize data, comparing actual or expected results to the prior period or plan
  • Identify trends and outliers to inform partners
  • Ensure accuracy and reconciliation of information prior to communication
  • Leverage data and business experience to make informed recommendations that drive operational efficiencies and customer experience
  • Evaluate broad business impacts related to recommendation outcomes
  • Influence cross-functional partners on existing initiatives and identify opportunities for future initiatives
  • Simplify and communicate results and recommendations with senior leaders
  • Develop Business Intelligence (BI) solutions to support business needs, following BI development best practices and innovative use of appropriate technologies and systems.
  • Consult with partners to identify KPIs required to support critical business decisions.
  • Work effectively with business teams in all phases of BI development projects, including requirements gathering, design, testing and change management
  • Applies complex data derivations, business transformation rules, and data requirements
  • Creates data visualizations to help support data exploration & translate analytic insights into tangible, actionable solutions
  • Identify and collect primary and secondary data variables to holistically answer business questions.
  • Maintain an understanding of the structure and location of various data sources to be utilized.
  • Present recommendations for optimizing data structures to drive greater insights in the most effective manner
  • Pull and manipulate data to best integrate with BI toolsets.
  • Identify and set up processes for data quality checks.
  • Additional tasks may be assigned

Required

What Skills You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of relevant professional experience in a data analysis role
  • Advanced skills in SQL with Big Query, MY SQL, etc and programming with Python and R
  • Proficiency in data visualization (Qlik, MicroStrategy, Tableau, etc) with experience in designing and delivering cross functional custom analytical solutions.
  • Experience using cloud data warehouses such as Google Big Query
  • Strong knowledge of data modeling and visualization techniques

Preferred

  • Advanced degree
  • Retail experience or retail operations business acumen

Description

Connecting People. Uniting the World. There’s never been a more exciting time to join United Airlines! As a global company that operates in hundreds of locations around the world — with millions of customers and tens of thousands of employees — we have a unique responsibility to uplift and provide opportunities in the places where we work, live and fly.

We’re on a path to becoming the best airline in aviation history. Join our Cybersecurity and Digital Risk (CDR) team to help lead the industry in cyber safety, security and resilience. United's CDR team plays a critical role in protecting our operations by enabling secure and resilient systems, managing threats and vulnerabilities, and ensuring swift response and recovery. Our mission is to seamlessly embed cybersecurity and digital risk management into every aspect of our business. We help drive progress and growth through trusted digital solutions, safeguarding assets and empowering our team, all while promoting a cyber-safe and secure environment that supports resilient airline operations.

United offers a competitive benefits package aimed at keeping you happy, healthy, and well-traveled. From employee-run "Business Resource Group" communities to world-class benefits like parental leave, 401(k), and privileges like space-available travel, United is truly a one-of-a-kind place to work. Are you ready to travel the world and help us keep our airline cyber safe? Apply today!

Job Overview And Responsibilities

The Analyst – Fraud Data provides fraud business intelligence, analysis and storytelling that explains how fraud affects customers, operations, revenue and enterprise risk. This role integrates operational data on fraud detected, prevented and realized to quantify exposure, control outcomes, customer friction and financial impact. The Analyst uses approved artificial intelligence and automation tools to accelerate analysis, identify patterns, summarize findings, develop reporting content and improve the productivity and consistency of recurring workflows, with appropriate human validation and data-governance controls. The individual in this position develops clear narratives, dashboards and executive insights that connect fraud trends to business priorities and support informed decisions across the enterprise.

Fraud Business Impact Intelligence

  • Integrate fraud detected, prevented and realized-loss data to explain the scale, drivers and business implications of fraud across products, channels and customer journeys

Executive Storytelling & Insights

  • Translate complex operational and analytical findings into clear narratives, presentations and recommendations tailored to senior leaders and business stakeholders; use approved AI tools to accelerate synthesis, drafting and audience-specific communication with human review

Operational Performance Reporting

  • Develop and maintain dashboards and scorecards covering fraud volumes, prevented loss, realized loss, recovery, customer friction, operational workload and control outcomes; automate recurring data preparation, quality checks and reporting workflows where appropriate

Trend & Root-Cause Analysis

  • Analyze shifts in fraud activity and operational results to identify material trends, root causes, emerging risks and changes in business exposure; use approved AI-assisted methods to accelerate exploration, pattern identification and summarization

Financial & Customer Impact Measurement

  • Quantify the revenue, loss, cost, customer and operational effects of fraud and fraud controls, including tradeoffs between risk reduction and customer experience

Data Quality, Reporting Governance & Responsible AI

  • Establish consistent definitions, validation checks, documentation and reconciliation practices for fraud performance metrics, reporting datasets and AI-assisted outputs; protect sensitive data and validate accuracy, bias and business context

Cross-Functional Business Partnership

  • Partner with Fraud Strategy, Operations, Loyalty,
  • Digital Technology, Customer Insights, Sales and other teams to align metrics, interpret results and turn insights into action

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • Bachelor's degree. with preference for Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Information Systems or a related quantitative or business field; equivalent experience accepted
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in fraud analytics, business intelligence, operational analytics, financial analysis, risk analytics, ECDLP or a related discipline
  • Demonstrated ability to quantify business impact, create clear data visualizations and translate analytical findings into concise recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to use approved generative AI and automation tools to improve analytical, reporting and documentation productivity while validating outputs
  • SQL proficiency and experience reconciling, analyzing and interpreting large operational datasets
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Master's degree
  • Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Finance, Economics or a related discipline
  • Developing executive-ready reporting, presentations and narratives for senior business stakeholders
  • Experience with fraud, retail, e-commerce, airline, financial services or another high-volume customer environment
  • Knowledge of fraud operations, loss prevention, customer experience metrics, financial measurement or operational performance management; experience with enterprise AI assistants, natural-language analytics or workflow automation
  • Tableau, Power BI, Looker or comparable visualization and reporting platform experience

Post Expiration 11/18/2026

The base pay range for this role is $89,965.00 to $117,212.00.

The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Responsible for the measurement, analysis and reporting of key performance indicators and operational performance for the Legal and Corporate Affairs team. Prepares recurring and ad hoc reports and assists with analysis and presentations to support management and compliance reporting, inform business decisions and identify process improvements.

Responsibilities

Job Description

  • Prepare recurring reports on key performance indicators and operational performance for the Legal and Administrative Affairs team.
  • Develop insights and understanding of business performance based on data and statistical methods, identifying trends, variances and opportunities for improvement.
  • Compile, validate and analyze data on executive expenses and use of corporate resources; maintain supporting documentation and prepare timely, accurate reports for management and compliance reporting purposes.
  • Conduct ad hoc reporting and in-depth analysis; communicate findings and recommendations through reports and presentations to support process efficiencies and business decisions.
  • Maintain a thorough knowledge of the business and systems within the supported group; partner with stakeholders to clarify reporting needs, reconcile data and improve reporting processes.
  • Assist in resolving technical issues, such as report/query malfunctions, data discrepancies and lapses in visualization stability or functionality.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a business-related field or equivalent experience.
  • Three years of experience in data analytics, process improvement or other relevant work.
  • Understanding of data tools for visualization, extraction, modeling, CRM solutions and SQL.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills to analyze and create reports.
  • Communication and presentation skills for delivery of reports and analysis.
  • Ability to multi-task and work as part of a team in a dynamic and complex environment.
  • Proficiency using MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in the insurance/financial services industry.
  • Experience using Tableau, SQL and Power BI.

Working Conditions

  • Hybrid Office Environment

descriptionHtml:
Description

Position at Consumer Tech

The Opportunity:

We are looking for a highly skilled and intellectually curious Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to completely modernize how we extract, automate, and present data. This role sits at the exact intersection of AI automation and data storytelling. We need a hands-on builder with 3 to 5 years of experience who can translate complex data models into trusted, easily digestible insights.

This is not a backend data engineering or data science role. Our data is already structured in Snowflake and BigQuery. We need an analyst who is a wizard with SQL and BI tools, knows how to connect AI APIs (like Claude or Gemini) to automate routine analysis, and can package those insights into clear, business-ready slides.

You will act as your own stakeholder. We expect you to bring a proactive, consulting mindset - architecting robust data pipelines, using cutting-edge generative AI technologies to automate manual reporting, and stepping up to confidently deliver a "single version of truth" to leadership without waiting for a script.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Be a true stakeholder and lead data-driven alignment meetings across all major business dependencies, explaining complex data narratives clearly to non-technical teams.
  • Connect our existing cloud data platforms (Snowflake / BigQuery) with advanced language models (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) using APIs and connectors to automate routine data discovery, anomaly detection, and performance summaries.
  • Develop and optimize intuitive Looker Explores and dashboards using LookML to ensure our cross-functional teams have a single, accurate version of the truth for all commerce metrics.
  • Move away from generic data dumps. Build specific, actionable reports for Editorial, Sales, and Finance, dynamically slicing the data to uncover root causes and category-level trends when basic metrics drop.
  • Implement validation, monitoring, and reconciliation frameworks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and a single version of truth across all financial and commerce datasets.
  • Run data alignment meetings and proactively drive the business conversation. Partner with Editorial and SEO teams to optimize content monetization and work with Product to enhance user conversion funnels.
  • Act as the internal champion for practical AI use. Train and mentor the existing analytics team on how to use generative AI tools, prompt engineering, and database connectors to speed up their daily reporting tasks.

Job Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a highly consultative data role. We are looking for a hungry, upward-trajectory builder.
  • Beyond SQL and Looker, you are an absolute surgeon in Excel (advanced modeling, pivots, complex formulas) and highly skilled at building compelling, executive-level pitch decks (Google Slides / PowerPoint).
  • Direct, practical experience utilizing AI to automate workflows. You know how to set up connectors, write advanced prompts, and leverage LLMs (Claude, Gemini) alongside SQL databases to automate data analysis.
  • Intermediate-level SQL skills with strong, daily hands-on experience querying enterprise cloud data platforms (specifically Snowflake, BigQuery, or GCP).
  • Deep experience with modern BI platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI) to design complex, user-friendly, and scalable dashboards. If you have specific experience with Looker and LookML, that is a strong advantage.
  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills. You must be able to translate complex data into clear, non-technical business terms and confidently run meetings with senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • A strong grasp of e-commerce and site performance metrics, including conversion rate (CVR), click-through rate (CTR), revenue per visit (RPV), and traffic sourcing.
  • Familiarity with performance tracking and affiliate marketing networks (Impact, Partnerize, Rakuten, CJ, Amazon Associates).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Business, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.

Special Working Conditions:

  • This role requires working on major shopping holidays (e.g., Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Prime Day) to monitor live data analysis, provide insights, and system integrity.
  • Shift Timings: EST hours

About CNET Group:

CNET Group (part of Ziff Davis) represents a growing portfolio of trusted digital media brands—including CNET, PCMag, Mashable, Lifehacker, and ZDNet—specializing in tech reviews, news, and advice. Reaching over 81 million monthly users, we help consumers navigate, purchase, and enjoy technology through expert analysis and in-depth reporting. Our content empowers the world to use tech for personal development in all areas of life, and we seamlessly guide our readers toward the products and services that make their lives better.

About Ziff Davis:

Ziff Davis (NASDAQ: ZD) is a vertically focused digital media and internet company whose portfolio includes leading brands in technology, shopping, gaming and entertainment, connectivity, health, cybersecurity, and martech. Today, Ziff Davis is focused on seven key verticals – Technology, Connectivity, Shopping, Entertainment, Health & Wellness, Cybersecurity and Marketing Technology. Its brands include IGN, Mashable, RetailMeNot, PCMag, Humble Bundle, Spiceworks, Everyday Health, BabyCenter, Moz, iContact and Vipre Security.

Our Benefits:

CNET Group offers competitive salaries in addition to robust, health and wellness-focused benefits, including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as life and disability benefits. Our employees enjoy Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs), a 401(k) with company match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

We are committed to work-life balance with Flexible Time Off, Volunteer Time Off, and paid holidays. We offer family building and caregiving support and generous Family Care and Parental leave, when you need it. We also provide Fitness Reimbursement and access to wellness programs, ensuring our team stays healthy both physically and mentally.

At Ziff Davis, we remain dedicated to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to succeed. We offer Employee Resource Groups, company-sponsored events, and regular opportunities for professional growth through educational support, mentorship programs, and career development resources. Our employees are recognized and celebrated through employee engagement programs and recognition awards.

If you're seeking a dynamic and collaborative work environment where you can see the direct impact of your performance and thrive both personally and professionally, then CNET Group is the place for you.

Compensation Range:

Ziff Davis provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is $85,000 to $95,000. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

Ziff Davis is an Equal Opportunity Employer. At Ziff Davis, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) has always been about fairness, equal opportunity, and belonging. DEI enables us to attract and retain the best talent, regardless of background or circumstances, while enabling our thousands of employees worldwide to thrive .

Summary

The Senior Enterprise BI and Analytics Analyst serves as the lead analytics partner between advancement leadership, frontline fundraisers, Alumni Relations, Prospect Management and Research, Data Information Services, and MCW enterprise IT. This position combines knowledge of fundraising and advancement operations with advanced skills in data analysis, data modeling, and visualization. The analyst translates advancement business questions into requirements, transformation logic, and functional specifications, then designs and builds dashboards, metrics, and data products that guide fundraising strategy.


The role owns reporting for the Grateful Patient program, fundraiser performance, campaign progress, and donor pipeline, and ensures advancement data is accurate, trusted, and aligned with institutional and industry reporting standards. The analyst collaborates with units across MCW and the clinical enterprise to expand the advancement analytics footprint and supports the transition to a modern CRM platform.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Designs, builds, and maintains dashboards and reports in Tableau or Power BI for advancement leadership, gift officers, and campus partners covering fundraising production, campaign progress, pipeline health, donor retention, and portfolio performance.
  • Leads the design and ongoing development of Grateful Patient program metrics, including patient identification and referral volume, physician and clinician engagement, conversion from identification to solicitation, time to first gift, and revenue attributed to clinical relationships.
  • Partners with clinical enterprise units and compliance staff to define secure, HIPAA compliant data flows that support Grateful Patient screening, referral tracking, and reporting.
  • Builds and implements reports to support fundraising metrics and business rules for gift and pledge counting, soft credit, campaign counting, and fiscal year reporting consistent with CASE Global Reporting Standards.
  • Partners with enterprise units including Business Development and Government Relations to deliver reporting on corporate and foundation relationships, industry partnership pipeline, and sponsorship revenue, along with analysis that connects donors, board members, and community partners to elected officials and government stakeholders in support of advocacy and relationship strategy.
  • Partners with Prospect Management and Research to accelerate prospect identification through reporting and metrics, including identification queues that surface constituents with strong capacity and affinity, pipeline and portfolio coverage analysis, and data quality checks that ensure wealth screening results, research ratings, and relationship data are accurately associated with constituent records.
  • Develops planned giving analytics, including identification models for bequest and legacy prospects, tracking of expectancies and realized gifts, and reporting on legacy society growth.
  • Partners with Alumni Relations to deliver engagement scoring, participation and retention trends, reunion and event performance, and analysis of how alumni engagement converts to giving.
  • Formulates calculations, transformation logic, data analysis, and rapid prototypes for advancement analytics applications, dashboards, and data products.
  • Develops requirement analysis, functional specifications, and solution designs for analytics and data visualization in partnership with the Business Analyst and advancement stakeholders.
  • Writes SQL scripts for data acquisition, transformation, and validation from the CRM, data warehouse, and related advancement and institutional sources.
  • Builds and maintains data models supporting fundraiser performance metrics, prospect and moves management, events, and constituent engagement reporting, and applies predictive modeling, RFM analysis, and donor lifecycle modeling to segment constituents from acquisition through retention, upgrade, and lapse.
  • Serves as the analytics subject matter expert during any advancement platform changes by mapping legacy reports and data structures to the new environment and validating data accuracy.
  • Coordinates quality control and accuracy of information by identifying data issues, recommending corrective action to be in line with data governance and stewardship standards.
  • Produces analysis for board and leadership presentations, annual reporting and executive ad hoc requests.
  • Supports and improves the advancement analytics intake and triage process to increase efficiency and responsiveness.
  • Trains and supports end users to expand adoption of self-service reporting across the Office of Institutional Advancement.
  • Provides guidance and peer mentoring to reporting analysts and data staff.
  • Provides technical and functional documentation on project requirements and deliverables.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Knowledge of fundraising operations in higher education, healthcare, or nonprofit settings, including gift and pledge accounting principles and advancement reporting standards.
  • Advanced proficiency in a business intelligence platform such as Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik, including data modeling, predictive modeling, calculated measures, and dashboard design for executive and operational audiences.
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience working with relational databases and data warehouses.
  • Experience working with a CRM or constituent database, such as Raiser's Edge NXT, Blackbaud CRM, Salesforce, Slate, Ellucian CRM Advance, or a comparable system.
  • Familiarity with grateful patient fundraising and HIPAA requirements governing the fundraising use of protected health information, or the ability to develop that knowledge quickly.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insight for fundraisers and senior leadership.
  • Excellent oral and written communication, strong critical thinking and problem solving, and close attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.


All remote work must be performed within one of the MCW registered payroll states, which currently includes: WI, AZ, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, MD, MI, MN, MO, NC, TN, TX, and UT.


Qualifications

Appropriate experience may be substituted for education on an equivalent basis.

Minimum Required Education: Bachelor's degree

Minimum Required Experience: 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or reporting, including SQL development, data modeling, and dashboard design in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool.

Preferred Education: Bachelor's Degree or Master's degree in data analytics, information systems, statistics, business, or a related field

Preferred Experience: 3 or more years of experience in higher education, healthcare, or nonprofit advancement, including analytics supporting prospect research, planned giving, alumni relations, business development, government relations or grateful patient programs. Experience with predictive modeling, RFM segmentation, or donor lifecycle modeling and with CRM data migration or conversion.

Preferred Certification/Licensure(s): Microsoft Certified Power BI Data Analyst Associate, Tableau Certified Data Analyst, or comparable analytics certification


Physical Requirements

Work requires occasionally lifting moderate weight materials, standing, or walking continuously.

Work Environment

Occasional exposure to dust, noise, temperature changes, or contact with water or other liquids. Work is performed in an environmentally controlled environment.

Sensory Acuity

Ability to detect and translate speech or other communication required. May occasionally require the ability to distinguish colors and perceive relative distances between objects.


Target salary range for this position is between $87,100 and $111,500 annually. The final offered salary will depend on the applicant’s education, experience, skills, and knowledge, as well as considerations of internal equity and market alignment.


Why MCW?

  • Outstanding Healthcare Coverage, including but not limited to Health, Vision, and Dental. Along with Flexible Spending options
  • 403B Retirement Package
  • Competitive Vacation and Paid Holidays offered
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP)
  • Pet Insurance
  • On campus Fitness Facility, offering onsite classes
  • Additional discounted rates on items such as: Select cell phone plans, local fitness facilities, Milwaukee recreation and entertainment etc.

Qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Position Purpose

The Data Analyst will be part of the OWI Analytics team, partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate business questions into structured analyses that drive decision-making. This role goes beyond report production — it requires understanding the "why" behind a request, identifying the right data and methodology, and delivering insights that business partners can act on.

Duties, Tasks, And Responsibilities

  • Learn and map business processes end-to-end with stakeholders to identify the KPIs that genuinely measure performance for that process, then determine what data is required to analyze both the KPI itself and the underlying factors driving its performance
  • Partner with the Data Engineering and Data Science teams to translate those KPI and data requirements into validated data models — confirming the models actually deliver on the business objective identified in the step above, not just that they're technically complete
  • Partner with business stakeholders to scope analytical requests, clarify objectives, and identify the right metrics and data sources before analysis begins
  • Create visualizations that provide business insights for our global customers — dashboards, cash-flow projections, histograms, projective analysis, financial analysis, KPIs, and SLA reporting
  • Use SQL to independently mine data and translate business needs into clear, creative visualizations
  • Validate data and reporting outputs against SAP as the source-of-truth ERP, identifying and resolving discrepancies before they reach stakeholders
  • Assess data quality and flag data quality issues to the Data Warehouse team; support data governance practices
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot in Power BI, generative AI for data exploration and narrative summaries) to accelerate insight generation and surface patterns in large datasets
  • Demonstrate critical thinking and sound judgment to offer thoughtful, concise input toward problem resolution
  • Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, functional teams, and other data analysts to develop insight-driven visualizations
  • Support requirements gathering, design, deployment, and change management for reporting projects (entry-level project management)
  • Build and demo prototypes to stakeholders — peer groups, business partners, and senior leaders
  • Support and train peers/SMEs on report usage, troubleshooting, and results analysis
  • Develop leadership skills to promote ideas, coordinate work, and plan deliverables within a project team

Education, Skills And Abilities

  • Experience with Microsoft Power BI (required); DEX (Deployment Pipelines/Dataflows Experience) knowledge strongly preferred
  • Working knowledge of SAP as an ERP/data validation source
  • Entry-level SQL proficiency for data querying and mining
  • Exposure to AI-assisted analytics tools (Copilot, generative AI for BI) a plus
  • Entry-level experience with data analytics concepts — data dictionaries, data mapping, normalization concepts
  • Basic project management and business process modeling
  • Minimum Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, Computer Science, or closely related field
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical issues to both technical and business audiences
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve problems effectively and in a timely manner

This Opportunity Offers a Competitive Benefits Package Including

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with wellness benefits
  • Company-matching 401(k) plan
  • Company-paid life insurance and accidental death & dismemberment benefits
  • Company-paid long-term care coverage
  • Company-paid disability
  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts
  • Company-paid employee assistance program
  • Paid time off and paid holidays
  • Additional benefits included: voluntary life insurance, legal benefits, critical illness, accident insurance, and pet insurance

descriptionText:
Position Purpose

The Data Analyst will be part of the OWI Analytics team, partnering closely with business stakeholders to translate business questions into structured analyses that drive decision-making. This role goes beyond report production — it requires understanding the "why" behind a request, identifying the right data and methodology, and delivering insights that business partners can act on.

Duties, Tasks, And Responsibilities



- Learn and map business processes end-to-end with stakeholders to identify the KPIs that genuinely measure performance for that process, then determine what data is required to analyze both the KPI itself and the underlying factors driving its performance 
- Partner with the Data Engineering and Data Science teams to translate those KPI and data requirements into validated data models — confirming the models actually deliver on the business objective identified in the step above, not just that they're technically complete
- Partner with business stakeholders to scope analytical requests, clarify objectives, and identify the right metrics and data sources before analysis begins 
- Create visualizations that provide business insights for our global customers — dashboards, cash-flow projections, histograms, projective analysis, financial analysis, KPIs, and SLA reporting 
- Use SQL to independently mine data and translate business needs into clear, creative visualizations 
- Validate data and reporting outputs against SAP as the source-of-truth ERP, identifying and resolving discrepancies before they reach stakeholders 
- Assess data quality and flag data quality issues to the Data Warehouse team; support data governance practices 
- Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot in Power BI, generative AI for data exploration and narrative summaries) to accelerate insight generation and surface patterns in large datasets 
- Demonstrate critical thinking and sound judgment to offer thoughtful, concise input toward problem resolution 
- Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, functional teams, and other data analysts to develop insight-driven visualizations 
- Support requirements gathering, design, deployment, and change management for reporting projects (entry-level project management) 
- Build and demo prototypes to stakeholders — peer groups, business partners, and senior leaders 
- Support and train peers/SMEs on report usage, troubleshooting, and results analysis 
- Develop leadership skills to promote ideas, coordinate work, and plan deliverables within a project team

Education, Skills And Abilities



- Experience with Microsoft Power BI (required); DEX (Deployment Pipelines/Dataflows Experience) knowledge strongly preferred 
- Working knowledge of SAP as an ERP/data validation source 
- Entry-level SQL proficiency for data querying and mining 
- Exposure to AI-assisted analytics tools (Copilot, generative AI for BI) a plus 
- Entry-level experience with data analytics concepts — data dictionaries, data mapping, normalization concepts 
- Basic project management and business process modeling 
- Minimum Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering Technology, Computer Science, or closely related field 
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical issues to both technical and business audiences 
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve problems effectively and in a timely manner

Job Purpose and Impact

The Consultant, Data Modeling & Analytics Reporting job is responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing moderately complex datasets to generate actionable insights and builds detailed reports and dashboards using specifics tools. With limited supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to ensure data accuracy and integrity performing data and statistical analysis using various programming languages. This job supports the effective presentation of data findings to partners to meet business objectives.

Key Accountabilities

  • DATA COLLECTION & ANALYSIS: Gathers, processes, prepares, and analyzes moderately complex datasets to extract significant insights, develop and maintain automated reporting systems to streamline data analysis.
  • REPORTING & VISUALIZATION: Implements detailed reports and dashboards using various tools, designs and completes data visualizations to communicate moderately complex data clearly.
  • STATISTICAL ANALYSIS: Supports statistical analysis execution to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data using statistical software and programming languages for data manipulation and analysis.
  • PROCESS IMPROVEMENT: Implements found opportunities to improve data collection and reporting processes and applies standard methodologies for data management and reporting.
  • COLLABORATION: Works closely with multi-functional teams to support data needs, value opportunities and delivers solutions in partnership with digital technology and data engineering teams to help ensuring data integrity and accuracy.
  • DATA ANALYSIS: Conducts moderately complex data analyses to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights for decision making.
  • QUALITY ASSURANCE & DATA VALIDATION: Performs moderately complex reports and analyses in support of the accuracy, consistency, and security of data.

Qualifications

  • Minimum requirement of 2 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 3 years or more of relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in the chemicals manufacturing, sales, procurement, or supply chain
  • 2+ years of experience using SQL and Power BI to build analytics solutions
  • 2+ years working with SAP and SalesForce data objects structures
  • 2+ years of experience working in a global team and company

The business will not sponsor applicants for work visa for this position.

The expected salary for this position is $80,000- $120,000. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to the specific location, certifications, education, and level of experience. descriptionHtml:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Data Analysis - Sr Professional II

About Your Role

You will analyze, validate and deliver data products, metrics, dashboards and reporting solutions that support business and operational decision-making. You will work with Data Engineering, Product, Operations and business stakeholders to confirm data accuracy, translate requirements into reporting assets and improve access to trusted information. Your work will help teams make decisions using consistent, reliable data.

What You'll Do

  • Validate data pipelines, transformations, metrics and reporting outputs to confirm accuracy, consistency and reliability.
  • Perform data reconciliation and root-cause analysis to identify, document and support resolution of data quality issues.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering to understand data structures, source systems, business rules and data flows.
  • Design, develop and maintain dashboards, reports and scorecards using Streamlit, Tableau, Qlik or similar visualization tools.
  • Translate business requirements into reporting solutions, reusable datasets and data assets that support operational needs.
  • Document metric definitions, data mappings, reporting logic and dashboard standards for business and technical users.
  • Support testing and validation of new reporting capabilities, self-service analytics features and data products.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience You'll Need To Have

  • 4+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence or a related technical role using data to support business or operational decisions.
  • 4+ years of experience working with relational databases or cloud data warehouses, including Snowflake or a similar platform.
  • 4+ years of experience writing Structured Query Language (SQL) queries to analyze, validate and reconcile large datasets.
  • 4+ years of experience developing dashboards, reports or scorecards using Streamlit, Tableau, Qlik or similar visualization tools.
  • 4+ years of experience troubleshooting data quality issues, documenting findings and coordinating resolution with technical teams.
  • 4+ years of experience working with structured and semi-structured data, including JavaScript Object Notation (JSON), Extensible Markup Language (XML) or similar data formats.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Business Analytics or a related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience That Would Be Great To Have

  • Experience with Snowflake and cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience supporting data, reporting or analytics initiatives in banking, financial services or financial technology environments.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git and Agile development practices.
  • Experience with artificial intelligence-assisted reporting, self-service analytics or modern data product delivery.

How You'll Work

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

Sponsorship

You must currently possess valid and unrestricted U.S. work authorization to be considered for this role. Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

This role is not eligible to be performed in Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Illinois, Massachusetts, Maryland, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Nevada, Rhode Island, Vermont, Virginia, Maine or Washington.

It is unlawful to discriminate against a prospective employee due to the individual's status as a veteran.

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

About The Role

Peraton is seeking an experienced Data Insights & Visualization Specialist remote role supporting TDAC at APG, MD.

The successful candidate will transform complex data into meaningful, actionable business insights through the development of interactive dashboards, automated reporting solutions, predictive analytics, and AI-powered capabilities.

This position will leverage Microsoft Power BI, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, Azure technologies, generative AI, and machine learning to enhance organizational reporting, improve operational efficiency, identify business trends, and support strategic decision-making.

The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service and data analytics, combined with the ability to identify and implement innovative AI solutions that improve how the organization accesses, analyzes, and utilizes information.

What you'll do:

  • As the Data Insights & Visualization Specialist for Peraton, you will support cross-functional team members across our Sustainment Modernization Data Analysis Team.
  • Deliver automation and visualization across our customer processes and standards.
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into the data layer design to provide meaningful insights based on best practices.

About Kirkland & Ellis

At Kirkland & Ellis, we don’t just meet the standard for legal excellence — we set it. Our culture is built on teamwork, ingenuity and an unwavering commitment to continuous growth. We tackle the most sophisticated legal challenges with bold ideas and innovative solutions, powered by the exceptional experience and ambition of our 7,000+ people, including 4,000+ attorneys, across 24 offices worldwide. Our dedicated professionals share our lawyers’ commitment to excellence and show up each day to do meaningful work that helps drive global business, investment and innovation forward.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Financial Data Analyst on the Finance Data & Analytics team in Chicago, you will use advanced analytics, financial modeling, Structured Query Language (SQL), and Microsoft Power BI to help senior leaders understand financial performance, business operations, and critical management issues. Reporting to the Finance Data & Analytics Manager, you will investigate data flows, translate business needs into effective solutions, enhance the Finance data mart, and make trusted information more accessible to business users.

  • Deliver strategic insights: Support key initiatives through financial modeling, data mining, and analysis, bringing together information from multiple sources for specialized firm and client reporting.
  • Build scalable data models: Transform transactional data into intuitive fact-and-dimension models that enable efficient analysis by technical and non-technical users.
  • Advance business intelligence: Design and enhance Power BI models, reports, measures, and Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) solutions that improve access to meaningful financial information.
  • Translate business needs: Partner with senior management, firm partners, functional leaders, and other stakeholders to understand their goals and identify the most effective data and delivery approach.
  • Develop complex queries: Use Transact-SQL and related data tools to extract, organize, validate, and present information in clear, useful formats.
  • Uncover trends and opportunities: Analyze complex datasets to identify patterns, correlations, gaps, and insights that support informed decision-making.
  • Improve tools and processes: Introduce practical analytical approaches, evaluate the effects of process changes, and contribute to system and process re-engineering efforts.
  • Support executive reporting: Prepare accurate, timely reporting for committees, the Chief Financial Officer (CFO), and other members of senior management.
  • Strengthen analytics capabilities: Stay current with Power BI developments and collaborate across teams to improve how financial data is used throughout the firm.

What You’ll Bring

  • Education: A bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance, or comparable experience, is required. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) status or a Master of Business Administration (MBA) is preferred.
  • Experience: At least six years of progressively responsible accounting or finance experience; experience in a law firm or professional services environment is a plus.
  • SQL expertise: Strong SQL querying skills and experience building complex queries, supported by a solid understanding of relational database concepts.
  • Analytics technology: Advanced Microsoft Excel skills are required. Experience with PySpark, Microsoft Fabric notebooks and batch jobs, Power BI reporting, DAX, or tabular modeling is highly valued.
  • Analytical thinking: The ability to collect, organize, interpret, and communicate complex information accurately while connecting detailed findings to broader business objectives.
  • Initiative and problem-solving: A proactive approach to identifying next steps, exploring solutions, anticipating potential barriers, and gathering input from relevant stakeholders.
  • Communication and collaboration: Strong written, verbal, interpersonal, and organizational skills, with the ability to work effectively across all levels of the firm, both independently and as part of a team.
  • Service and precision: Excellent attention to detail, sound judgment, a commitment to confidentiality, and a strong customer-service mindset.

If you’re excited to transform financial data into actionable insight and help leaders make well-informed decisions, we’d love to hear from you for this Senior Financial Data Analyst opportunity!

Compensation

The base salary range below represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position in Chicago. This range may differ based on your geographic location and cost of living considerations. At Kirkland & Ellis, we consider compensation more than just a base salary. We offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits including comprehensive healthcare, paid time off, and retirement. We also offer personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work.

Compensation Range

Chicago $100,000 - $138,000

How to Apply

Thank you for your interest in Kirkland & Ellis LLP. To complete an application and submit your resume, please click "Apply Now."

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others at Kirkland.
