descriptionHtml:
Location: Dallas, Alpharetta, Charlotte, Jacksonville, and San Antonio

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Position Summary

This role will help consolidate identity and access data across enterprise systems, strengthen operational reporting, and provide timely insights into the client’s access-risk posture.

The analyst will engage with data-source owners, engineers, product owners, architects, and business partners to define data requirements, profile and validate source data, document lineage, and translate business needs into scalable data models and ingestion patterns. The role will support access-governance applications, enterprise controls, remediation activities, and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with IAM data-source owners and stakeholders to gather requirements, identify authoritative data, and define data needed to support risk-reduction objectives and access-governance processes.
  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into conceptual, logical, and physical data models that address data quality, performance, lineage, and scalability.
  • Create, maintain, and scale repeatable data-ingestion patterns supporting operational reporting across thousands of enterprise systems.
  • Profile, map, reconcile, and validate identity, account, entitlement, credential, inventory, activity, and control-related data from multiple source systems.
  • Document source-to-target mappings, data lineage, transformation logic, control points, and data-flow diagrams.
  • Combine data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, coverage gaps, and actionable IAM risk insights.
  • Define data-quality rules, metrics, and exception-handling processes; investigate data discrepancies and support remediation with source owners and engineering teams.
  • Write and interpret SQL and scripts to query, manipulate, reconcile, and profile data across cloud and on-premises platforms.
  • Support engineers in designing and validating ETL pipelines, data transformations, operational data-store structures, and reporting datasets.
  • Develop requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and supporting evidence for new data sources, reporting features, and control enhancements.
  • Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that clearly communicate access-risk posture, control coverage, data quality, operational trends, and remediation priorities.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, testing, release readiness, and continuous-improvement activities.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, requirements documentation, analytical findings, process flows, operating procedures, and stakeholder-ready materials.
  • Work independently through ambiguity while proactively seeking decisions, clarifications, and support when necessary.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, information systems, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 6–9 years of experience in data analysis, systems analysis, business analysis, data engineering support, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated experience with requirements elicitation, gap analysis, data mining, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, and data-quality assessment.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional, relational, and unstructured data-modeling concepts.
  • Experience developing conceptual, logical, and physical data models, including third normal form in relational database environments.

Ready for a career glow up? As Senior Analyst, Omni Analytics, you’ll turn complex data into strategic insights that help shape Sephora’s Omni, Digital, and Retail business. The work you do will impact beauty, as you uncover client behaviors, measure the performance of key programs and initiatives, and translate digital client journeys into meaningful business impact across both digital and store channels.

You’ll be part of Sephora’s Business Intelligence & Analytics team, united in beauty and supported by partners who are equally passionate about using data to drive smarter decisions and elevate the client experience. You’ll collaborate across Omni, Digital, Retail, Tech, and Product, bringing curiosity, analytical rigor, and innovative thinking to the opportunities that matter most.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner independently with stakeholders to support key Omni Convenience initiatives, delivering strategic analyses, channel performance insights, forecasting, and analytics guidance that inform business decisions.
  • Build and maintain accurate, intuitive, and actionable dashboards and reports that give business partners clear visibility into program performance, trends, and opportunities.
  • Conduct ad hoc analyses to answer strategic business questions, uncover actionable insights, and troubleshoot data or performance issues.
  • Translate complex data and digital client journey insights into compelling narratives and recommendations that help influence decision-making across the organization.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to enhance analytics communications, streamline reporting and dashboards, simplify complex analyses, and scale data-driven decision-making.
  • Collaborate with Tech and Product teams to gather requirements and ensure effective tracking and reporting across digital platforms and in-store digital initiatives.
  • Manage multiple projects and stakeholder priorities independently, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high standard for data accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail.
  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships and communicate insights effectively with stakeholders, including senior leadership.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in an analytics role, with strong analytical and quantitative capabilities across data extraction, analysis, interpretation, and visualization.
  • Advanced SQL skills, advanced Excel and PowerPoint capabilities, and experience with data visualization; R or Python experience is a plus.
  • Proficiency with analytics platforms and tools including Databricks, Databricks Genie, and Tableau; Adobe Analytics knowledge is a plus.
  • Experience using AI, automation, and self-service analytics tools such as Copilot, Databricks Genie, or Claude to improve productivity, simplify complex analyses, and expand access to data-driven insights.
  • Proven ability to analyze large, complex datasets, identify meaningful trends and gaps, and turn findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Exceptional problem-solving, critical-thinking, and attention-to-detail skills, with a strong commitment to data accuracy and consistency.
  • Strong interpersonal, collaboration, influence, and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex analyses into compelling narratives for senior leaders.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and creative approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, and prioritize multiple projects against tight deadlines.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field; programming or analytics certifications are a plus.

What You’ll Get

The annual base salary range for this position is $119,840.00 - $134,820.00 The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include, as applicable, the applicant’s qualifications for the position; years of relevant experience; specific and unique skills; level of education attained; certifications or other professional licenses held; other legitimate, non-discriminatory business factors specific to the position; and the geographic location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will perform the job. Individuals employed in this position may also be eligible to earn bonuses. This job will be posted for a minimum of five days.

Rewards As Unique As You

Some benefits have eligibility requirements and may depend on job classification and length of employment.

  • Health. Choose a healthcare plan to fit you and your family’s needs with medical, dental, and vision coverage. Sephora also fully covers our employees’ disability and life insurance.

  • Balance. You’ll be empowered to find the perfect blend of work/life balance that actually works for you with PTO, flexibility, protected leave, and more.
  • Growth. Career growth is built into every role, with access to training, development, and tuition reimbursement.
  • Perks. Think you’ve tried it all? Enjoy a 30% discount on all merchandise/services, opportunities for free product or “gratis,” and flash sale discounts on LVMH brand products.
  • Support. Join a team that truly cares – with free mental health and financial coaching resources with 24/7 access to Modern Health and Financial Finesse. Plus, volunteer and donation matching.

Sephora values a diverse and inclusive workplace and considers all applicants without regard to sex, pregnancy, race, color, national origin, gender (including gender identity and gender expression), age, religion, sexual orientation, military/veteran status, disability, or any other protected category. Sephora is committed to providing reasonable accommodation ta applicants with disabilities or other medical conditions. 

Sephora will consider all qualified applicants, including those with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with the requirements of all applicable laws, including the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

Headquartered in Minnesota, Entrust is an industry leader in identity-centric security solutions, serving over 150 countries with cutting-edge, scalable technologies. But our secret weapon? Our people. It’s the curiosity, dedication, and innovation that drive our success and help us anticipate the future. 

The Data Analyst will report to the Manager of Data Analytics and support Entrust’s Revenue Operations, Sales, Compensation, and Customer Success organizations through the development, maintenance, validation, and improvement of business reporting and analytics.

The role works with stakeholders across the organization to investigate data questions, maintain accurate customer and account mappings, support compensation-related reporting, troubleshoot reporting discrepancies, and turn business requirements into reliable analytical solutions.

This is a hands-on analytics role requiring someone who can move comfortably between business questions, detailed data investigation, Tableau development, Excel-based analysis, source-system research, and stakeholder communication.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain Tableau dashboards and reporting supporting NRR, GRR, ACV, retention, sales performance, pipeline analytics, and customer analytics, including ongoing enhancement. Must stay up to date with emerging trends and technologies in data management, BI, and analytics, making recommendations for their adoption and integration into existing systems
  • Communicate analytical findings clearly to stakeholders, explaining dashboard methodology, underlying data, assumptions, refresh timing, and known limitations. The role includes presenting and explaining reporting to business users.
  • Develop repeatable and scalable processes that reduce manual work and improve the efficiency, integrity, and reliability of recurring reporting.
  • Investigate discrepancies across invoices, contracts, customer mappings, dates, transactions, products, and other source data, and determine how those issues affect downstream reporting.
  • Prioritize and translate business requirements into new/enhanced data solutions or services in a clear and concise manner.
  • Monitor and optimize the performance of data systems, implementing proactive measures to address bottlenecks and improve efficiency
  • Maintain and improve customer and sales-account mappings used in retention and compensation reporting, including identifying customers with missing assignments and coordinating corrections with business stakeholders.
  • Work closely with Business Intelligence teams to architect, develop, and continuously improve data sources, ensuring data quality, scalability, and alignment with evolving business and reporting requirements.
  • Research complex contract and billing scenarios by working across source systems and with Revenue Ops, Contracts, BI, and other subject-matter experts
  • Design, build, and maintain Tableau dashboards that provide actionable insights across business functions

Data Analyst

Blue & Co., LLC is an independent advisory and accounting firm providing tax, audit, and consulting services with a focus on practical, client-centered solutions. We combine deep industry expertise with a collaborative culture to help clients navigate complex financial and operational challenges.

Help Shape the Future of Data-Driven Consulting

Blue & Co. is making a significant investment in Data & Analytics as a strategic growth initiative for the firm. We are building a modern Data & Analytics practice focused on developing proprietary data products, AI-enabled consulting services, and scalable analytics capabilities that help healthcare organizations make better business decisions.

We believe AI is fundamentally transforming how consulting is delivered. Successful candidates will be comfortable leveraging modern AI tools to accelerate analysis, uncover deeper insights, automate repetitive work, and solve complex business problems while exercising sound professional judgment.

This role is centered on understanding the business behind the data. You will partner with healthcare consultants and client stakeholders to uncover business challenges, define meaningful KPIs, recommend analytical approaches, and design reporting solutions that enable better decision-making. Rather than simply responding to reporting requests, you will help determine what should be measured, why it matters, and how insights should be communicated to create lasting value for our clients.

While this position will spend most of its time supporting our nationally recognized Healthcare Consulting practice, the analytical frameworks, dashboards, and reporting strategies you help create will establish scalable capabilities that extend across the entire firm.

This is an opportunity to influence how data drives consulting decisions, helping shape client strategy rather than simply delivering reports.

Ideal Locations: Louisville, Indianapolis. Candidates in other Blue & Co., LLC locations will also be considered.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with consulting teams and client stakeholders to understand business objectives, identify opportunities where data can improve decision-making, and recommend analytical solutions that deliver meaningful business value.
  • Challenge assumptions and help define the questions that should be answered, not simply the reports that should be built.
  • Design reporting strategies, KPI frameworks, and interactive dashboards that enable healthcare leaders to make better operational and financial decisions
  • Develop analytics and dashboards supporting healthcare revenue cycle operations, including billing, collections, denials, underpayments, and contract performance.
  • Analyze healthcare claims (835/837), EHR/EMR, accounting, and reimbursement data to identify trends, improve operational performance, and support client decision-making.
  • Develop reporting and analytical solutions supporting CMS reporting, HCRIS/cost reports, wage index, reimbursement analytics, price transparency, and healthcare benchmarking initiatives.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities within recurring reporting and analytics workflows to improve efficiency and data consistency.
  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance Power BI dashboards and semantic models.
  • Work with Microsoft Fabric to support data-driven application features, including data analysis and reporting through Power BI dashboards and reports

Technical Requirements

  • Business Intelligence: Power BI development, including DAX, Power Query (M), semantic models, and report optimization.
  • Data Foundations: Strong understanding of dimensional modeling , ETL/ELT concepts, and data integration.
  • Data Platforms: Exposure to Microsoft Fabric and/or Snowflake. Experience with Financial ERP
  • Healthcare Data Domains: Experience working with healthcare claims (835/837), EHR/EMR, accounting, reimbursement, and other healthcare operational data sources.

Preferred & Related Skills

  • Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate operational needs into scalable analytical solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively leverage AI tools (Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, improve reporting quality, and solve complex business problems.
  • Ability to translate healthcare operational questions into meaningful KPIs, dashboards, and actionable business insights.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills with the ability to lead discovery discussions, ask insightful questions, and translate business objectives into analytical solutions.

Nice to Haves

  • Exposure to healthcare reimbursement support analytics, wage index analysis, or healthcare price transparency initiatives.
  • Understanding of healthcare revenue cycle operations including billing, collections, denials, underpayments, and contract performance.
  • Experience working in an accounting firm or with accounting software
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques to leverage LLMs

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years in data analytics, business intelligence, or healthcare consulting.
  • Experience working in an agile environment with a desire to learn and adopt emerging technologies.

We are responsive. We are caring. We are advocates.

Blue & Co., LLC, is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.

Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship.

Agency candidates will not be considered for this position.

The Inbound Operational Analytics team serves as Walmart Transportation’s intelligence engine for inbound operations. Combining operational expertise, advanced analytics, data engineering, continuous improvement, and AI, the team transforms transportation data into actionable insights. Standard Job Description

You will be the Data Analyst Sr - Level 3 for the Lockheed Martin Aeronautics team which is responsible for turning raw data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.

What You Will Be Doing

As the Data Analyst Sr - Level 3 you will be responsible for collecting, transforming, and analyzing data to provide clear, data‑driven recommendations to cross‑functional stakeholders.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

  • Extract, clean, and transform data from multiple sources while maintaining data integrity and documentation.
  • Perform exploratory analysis, develop statistical models, and create forecasts to support business planning.
  • Build and maintain standard and ad‑hoc reports, dashboards, and visualizations using tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Translate technical findings into concise business recommendations and collaborate with data engineers, product owners, and leaders.
  • Identify automation opportunities and contribute to data‑governance best practices to improve workflow efficiency.

What’s In It For You

We are committed to supporting your work‑life balance and overall well‑being, offering flexible scheduling options. Learn more about Lockheed Martin’s comprehensive benefits package here. Do you want to be part of a company culture that empowers employees to think big, lead with a growth mindset, and make the impossible a reality? We provide the resources and give you the flexibility to enable inspiration and focus – if you have the passion and courage to dream big, work hard, and have fun doing what you love then we want to build a better tomorrow with you.

Who You Are

You are a collaborative analyst with strong quantitative skills and the ability to communicate complex insights clearly. Your proactive approach to problem‑solving, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement make you an essential partner for driving data‑centric decisions.

Further Information About This Opportunity

MUST BE A U.S. CITIZEN - This position is located at a facility that requires special access.

Fort Worth, TX

This position is in Fort Worth, TX Discover Fort Worth.

Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems.Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Finance, related field considered.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Experience with data analysis tools such as Python (pandas, NumPy) or R.
  • Strong data visualization skills (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
  • Ability to obtain and maintain Secret Clearance per business requirements, Interim clearance required to start.

Desired Skills

  • Ability to communicate complex results to non‑technical audiences.
  • Strong problem‑solving mindset and attention to detail.
  • Bachelors degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, with 5 years of professional experience; or 3 years of professional experience with a related Masters degree
  • Demonstrated ability to work at all levels of the organization to develop data analytical models, drive positive change, and communicate across multi-functional stakeholders.
  • Secret Clearance

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $85300.00 - $158300.00

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. - Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights

- Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
- Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
- Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting



- Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
- Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
- Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
- Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
- Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality



- Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
- Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
- Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
- Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration



- Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
- Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions

- Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows

descriptionHtml:
Work Model: You’ll work in a hybrid model, onsite at your designated Regal Rexnord location at least 3 days per week (Monday–Thursday), with flexibility to work remotely up to 2 days, including Friday.

____________________

Position Summary

The Logistics Business Analyst II will support all aspects of data analytics for the Logistics & Fulfillment organization, providing expertise in data analytics and data mining to help create solutions across the Regal Rexnord network. This role will support our strategy for business intelligence solutions and reporting tools with a focus on data mining and analysis. Working as part of the Data & Analytics team, you will create standardized approaches to data mining, reporting, and visualization, providing leaders with the business insights needed to make informed decisions in a fast-paced environment. Your engagement and insights will support all tactical and strategic needs, ensuring expectations across Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Growth (SQDCG) are met. At Regal Rexnord, you are expected to model our company values and be a brand ambassador. This role will report directly to the Senior Manager, Data & Analytics.

Major Responsibilities

  • Conducts analysis for Logistics & Fulfillment to create accurate and timely decisions for business results.
  • Utilize structured and unstructured data sets to create reporting that is descriptive, diagnostic, predictive and / or prescriptive to drive improvements across the business.
  • Maintain and analyze metrics to assess performance and identify improvements across the areas of Safety, Quality, Delivery, Cost, and Growth (SQDCG).
  • Develop and maintain standardization related to data visualization. Conduct training when needed to ensure end users can fully leverage reporting tools.
  • Provide effective and actionable scenario analysis and communication of trade-offs to support business needs.
  • Understand organizational priorities to assist with the design and identification of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) that align with the business.
  • Creates, identifies and implements effective dashboards for tracking and KPI Metrics to improve SQDCG performance.
  • Ensures that daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly KPIs are prepared and published as appropriate.
  • Balance competing priorities while ensuring initiatives maintain momentum delivering against expected ROI.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Required Education / Experience / Skills

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or Operations is preferred
  • 3+ Years of experience in a logistics operations or analytics related position
  • Understanding of basic programming concepts and languages (SQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, Java, C+, etc.)
  • General knowledge of Logistics and Fulfillment operations
  • Knowledgeable in all modes of Transportation: TL, LTL, Ocean, Air, Small Package
  • Proficient with Microsoft office products
  • Proven ability to take on tasks and drive continuous improvement
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Power BI with demonstrated ability to create intuitive dashboards
  • Experience using data and analytics to measure, track, and action KPIs
  • Intellectual curiosity with a desire to take initiative and find new opportunities for improvement

This role may require up to 5% travel.

Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States without requiring company sponsorship to obtain or keep U.S. work authorization.

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Prescription Drug Coverage
  • Spending accounts (HSA, Health Care FSA and Dependent Care FSA)
  • Paid Time Off and Holidays
  • 401k Retirement Plan with Matching Employer Contributions
  • Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance
  • Paid Leaves
  • Tuition Assistance

About Regal Rexnord

Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

descriptionHtml:
Standard Job Description

Responsible for collecting, processing, and analyzing data to develop immersive stories that answer business questions. Using proven and sound statistical methods, the analyst draws insights from data, and translates those insights into action that drive business results. Data Analysts are extremely resourceful and able to find novel new data sources to enrich their analysis. They apply mathematical and statistical methods to business and risk management problems.Mine, process, and summarize data; Manage the quality assurance of data scraping, query databases for stakeholder requests, and triage data issues for timely resolutions; Analyze large datasets, draw valid inferences and prepare insights in narrative or visual forms, including dashboards; Set up and maintain data processes and new analytics capabilities; Produce and track key performance indicators; Ability to formulate functional and technical requirements from business problems; Program management of key tasks and resources to achieve cost and schedule

Proficient in AI prompting as it applies to this position and practice.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical field, relative experience considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Experience translating business objectives into technical requirements and functional specifications.
  • Strong project management skills, including experience with status reporting, risk tracking, and roadmap development.
  • Demonstrated experience leading change management and user adoption initiatives for new systems or processes.
  • Experience with modern analytical software (Tableau, Alteryx, or similar)
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite with emphasis on Excel and Power Point

Desired Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in a rapid change technical environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to facilitate collaboration across multiple departments and senior leadership.
  • Systems architecture and integration expertise (e.g., model based engineering, data fusion platforms)
  • Advanced project management tools (MS Project, JIRA, OpenPlan) and Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and negotiation abilities across technical and business teams
  • Ability to craft clear, persuasive communications (presentations, executive briefs, PR style messages)
  • Experience with technology road mapping and long term vision planning (1-3 year horizons)

Pay Information

Full-Time Salary Range: $85300.00 - $158300.00

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

  • Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
  • For (Washington state applicants only) Non-represented full-time employees: accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons; receive at least 90 hours for holidays. Represented full time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month; accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually; receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.

descriptionHtml:
The Business Data Analyst I role follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home. The position also requires 10-15% local travel to other sites.

The Business Data Analyst I role has a national salary range of $70,000 - $115,000.

For roles within California the range is $70,304 - $115,000 and Washington is $80,169 - $115,000.

DHL Supply Chain offers multiple benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription, Discounted Stock Purchase, and a generous PTO policy.

Are you ready to turn data into decisions that drive real impact in the supply chain world? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Business Data Analyst I who thrives on solving complex problems, creating powerful visualizations, and delivering actionable insights. This is your chance to be at the heart of operations, influencing strategy and performance in a dynamic warehouse environment. If you're passionate about analytics, innovation, and making a difference, this role is for you. If you're a curious, self-driven problem solver with a passion for analytics, innovation, and impact—this role is for you!

Job Description

As a Business Data Analyst I, you will play a key role in transforming operational data into strategic insights that identify opportunities, improve performance, and reduce costs. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build reports, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. This role is ideal for someone with foundational analytics experience who is ready to take ownership of projects and grow into a trusted resource for data solutions.


  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Collaborate with site and sector leadership to identify opportunities for efficiency and cost reduction
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through presentations and reports for internal and customer use
  • Ability to leverage data from various systems that support our operations (Warehouse Management System, Timekeeping systems, etc.)
  • Manage analytics projects independently, from concept to delivery
  • Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and support


Required Experience


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 1+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Hands-on experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
  • Experience writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts and data modeling techniques, preferred
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, preferred
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines, required
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required


Our Organization is an equal opportunity employer.

descriptionHtml:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Senior Financial Data Analyst, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, in the Data Analytics group is responsible for data-driven forecasting, leading analytics projects, advancing the firm’s data innovation efforts, and applying advanced analytical techniques to support strategic decision-making. This role requires strong analytical and technical skills, financial acumen, and a passion for leveraging data to drive business outcomes.

The Sr Financial Data Analyst uses tools such as Power Desktop/Power BI Report Builder (SSRS) to deliver high-impact analytics, reporting, and dashboards; develop complex data models; and identify and resolve data quality issues. This individual leads large-scale analytical initiatives, mentors’ junior analysts, and collaborates with stakeholders to prioritize business needs and deliver actionable insights.

Key skills include proficiency in programming/query languages, data analysis, and strong presentation skills. The role also involves fostering collaboration, driving continuous improvement, contributing to the firm’s data strategy, and ensuring timely, accurate deliverables. Working closely with functional leads across the firm, this position conducts research, analyzes and presents data to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and support informed decision-making related to financial performance. Duties will include financial performance data analysis and presentation, interpreting data from analysis using statistical techniques, reporting, forecasting, developing and implementing data collection techniques to optimize statistical efficiency.

Location

This position can sit in our New York, Chicago, Reston, or Short Hills office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Power BI and other advanced analytics tools to deliver comprehensive and high-impact analytics, forecasting, reporting and insight-driven solutions.
  • Collaborate with FP&A, Service Delivery, Senior Finance leadership and other key stakeholders to identify and prioritize complex business problems.
  • Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance data integrity.
  • Drive and manage large-scale analytical projects that span multiple teams and functions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure project alignment with business objectives and successful execution.
  • Analyze trends and derive actionable insights to address complex business challenges.
  • Design and develop advanced solutions to streamline processes, improve data quality, and drive intelligent automation.
  • Champion continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Engage with stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs and provide tailored data solutions.
  • Strong communication and financial storytelling skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Skills  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret large complex datasets, identify trends and provide actionable data-driven insights. Highly proficient in data visualization tools (PowerBI Report Builder/SSRS or Tableau). Experience in management reporting, report creation process and dashboard design. Highly proficient in Microsoft office, with advanced skills in Excel, including complex formulas, pivots tables, data analysis, VBA, and data visualization techniques. Experience with advanced statistical methods and data modeling techniques. High proficiency in programming languages.

Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing business needs. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Attention to detail and high level of accuracy in work.

Minimum Education   

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Data Science/Analytics, Computer Science or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

  • 4 years’ experience as a Financial/Business/Data Data Analyst or similar role including experience with data modeling, statistical analysis and processes.

Essential Job Expectations

All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include:

  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences.
  • Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
  • Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
  • Comply with firm policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement combining remote and in-office work. The specific arrangement will be determined at the time of hiring and may be modified at the firm's discretion.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Interested candidates must apply directly online. Application materials sent via email will not be accepted.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position or participate in the selection process. For accommodation requests, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship or support.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Mathematics, Data Analysis, MIS, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting or Business related with at least 3 years’ experience
  • Experience with modern analytical software (Tableau, Alteryx, Knime, or similar)
  • Experience with Microsoft Office Suite products with emphasis on Excel and Power Point
  • Experience developing and utilizing pivot tables and databases to obtain data and develop reports

Desired Skills

  • Digital Transformation experience
  • Experience with SAP preferred
  • Previous F&BO Experience
  • Experience with Electronic Contracting Environment (ECE)
  • Experience with Enterprise Toolsets (ADAR, Hyperion, SAP, or other comparable systems)
  • Experience developing affirmative work relationships in order to interface with all levels of personnel in a positive manner
  • Organizational skills, attention to detail and quality are required
  • Experience multi-tasking to meet deadlines in a fast- paced, team environment

descriptionHtml:
Husch Blackwell LLP is a full-service litigation and business law firm with multiple locations across the United States, serving clients with domestic and international operations.

At Husch Blackwell we believe that diverse, equitable and inclusive teams lead to better outcomes. Husch Blackwell is committed to retaining, recruiting, developing, and promoting talented lawyers and business professionals with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We foster an engaged, diverse, and inclusive team culture of accountability and purpose that makes our Firm and our communities better.

Our firm is committed to attracting and retaining professionals who value each other and the service we provide by embracing Teamwork, Collaboration, Client Service, and Innovation. If you are a motivated professional looking for a long-term fit where you can grow in a role, and will be valued and empowered, then we invite you to apply to our Enterprise Data Analyst position. This position may be filled remotely or in a hybrid capacity in any of our Central and Eastern Time locations. Strong candidates located in Mountain Time will also be considered.

The Enterprise Data Analyst is a firmwide shared-services role within the Firm’s Data Science function. The analyst turns the Firm’s data, client data, and the extensive internal data the Firm maintains into clear, actionable insight, delivered primarily through Power BI dashboards and reports that teams across the Firm rely on. The role will initially support a key business unit, with scope expanding to serve additional practice groups and functions across the Firm over time. The right candidate will be skilled in the visual display of quantitative information and have a passion for high impact data storytelling. Essential functions include:

Data Analysis & Insight

  • Analyze large, complex datasets from client and internal Firm sources to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights
  • Clean, transform, and structure data to ensure accuracy, consistency, and readiness for analysis
  • Apply statistical and data-modeling techniques to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Leverage AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate routine tasks, and enhance data products
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clearly defined analytical problems, prioritizing work by impact and urgency

Dashboarding & Reporting

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards that serve as the Firm’s primary, everyday reporting tools
  • Build automated, self-service reports and visualizations in Power BI and Tableau, tailored to different audiences across the Firm
  • Use data storytelling to deliver client-facing data presentations and executive-level reports that communicate findings clearly to key partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders, and drive action
  • Collaborate with the Data Science Information Design and Engineering function to deliver data visualization and information rich analyses across various media types
  • Streamline and standardize reporting processes to ensure timely, accurate delivery of key metrics

Data Management & Quality

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to source, integrate, and validate data from across the Firm
  • Develop and apply data quality standards to ensure reliable, trustworthy outputs
  • Document data sources, definitions, and methodologies to support consistency and reuse
  • Maintain and enhance existing datasets, models, and reporting pipelines

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with teams across the Firm; including Finance and client-facing groups to gather requirements and align on objectives
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients to understand needs and deliver solutions
  • Connect analytical findings to business outcomes and Firm priorities

Continuous Improvement & Growth

  • Share knowledge and best practices to elevate data and analytics capabilities across the Firm
  • Identify opportunities to automate, improve, and scale analytics as the function grows
  • Contribute to building out the Firm’s enterprise data and analytics capabilities over time
  • Develop and improve reporting and business intelligence techniques to align the firm with leading edge information and business intelligence delivery
  • Engage in research and study to continuously improve the Firm’s reporting and business intelligence

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, economics, computer science, information design, or a related quantitative communications field; commensurate professional and educational experience shall also qualify
  • 3+ years in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related analytical role
  • Advanced, demonstrable proficiency in Power BI is required; including building, publishing, and maintaining production dashboards
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and SQL, with experience querying and working with large, complex datasets
  • Proficiency with basic statistical and analytical tools including the Python statistical ecosystem
  • Experience working with data warehouses, databases, and modern BI/data platforms
  • Strong data storytelling skills, with a proven ability to design clear, effective data visualizations and deliver client-facing presentations to partners, clients, and other internal and external stakeholders
  • Experience with statistical modeling, regression analysis, and null hypothesis significance testing
  • Proven ability to independently scope and lead complex data analysis projects
  • Experience analyzing financial and operational performance metrics and the drivers behind them
  • Fluent in translating complex data into clear implications and actionable recommendations for the business
  • Comfortable working with large, complex datasets and developing data quality standards
  • Experience working directly with senior stakeholders and, where appropriate, clients
  • Operates with a client-service mindset; responsive, proactive, and a trusted advisor
  • Comfortable working at both strategic and tactical levels
  • Thrives in fast-paced environments with shifting priorities
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
  • Eager to contribute beyond assigned tasks and play a key role in the growth of a new, firmwide analytics function
  • Understanding of data confidentiality and the sensitivity of legal and client information

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple business units or functions in a shared-services or enterprise environment
  • Experience with data pipeline or ETL processes and working alongside data engineers
  • Experience applying AI and generative-AI tools to accelerate and enhance analytics
  • Familiarity and comfort with executive level communication and presentations

descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. The Analyst will collaborate with key stakeholders and determine the needed result including any special specifications. The Analyst will work with several databases to pull and integrate data, statistical analysis and data modeling.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.
  • Determine, write and present report results with key findings and trends to appropriate stakeholders.
  • Complete multiple concurrent ad-hoc analyses, provide corresponding reports based on customer specifications, determine and communicate analytical conclusions and recommendations.
  • Develop beginner to intermediate level reports and ad-hoc analysis based on specifications outlined by department management. Automate such reports and ensure that they are performed and delivered on schedule.
  • Perform tasks related to maintenance of Departmental Data Warehouse and its documentation.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Ability to apply advanced mathematical and statistical techniques and principles into the analysis of health-related data.
  • Possess strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate results in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to converse and write fluently in English.
  • Successful completion of Health Care Sanctions background check.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

Education/Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree Required. Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science or other quantitative discipline preferred.
  • Demonstrated use of analytical software. SAS or SQL preferred.
  • Experience in Power BI, Tableau or similar software preferred.1-2 years of related experience preferred.

descriptionHtml:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Data Science at Stripe is a vibrant community where data analysts and data scientists learn and grow together. You'll work with some of the most fundamental data at Stripe, and use that data to help drive company-wide initiatives.

What you'll do

In this role, you'll partner deeply with teams across Stripe to ensure that our users, our products, and our business have the models, data products, and insights needed to make decisions and grow responsibly. You'll work closely with partners to extract insights from the rich and complex data at Stripe. You'll also work with leaders to translate business needs into data problems. You'll build metrics, scalable data pipelines, dashboards, and reports to inform and run the business. You'll deliver actionable business recommendations through analyses and data storytelling.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

  • MS or MA plus 2 years, or BS or BA plus 3 years, of full-time experience exclusive of internships in Business Intelligence Engineering, Data Analyst, and Business Analyst roles
  • Proficiency in SQL
  • Proven ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with great attention to detail
  • Ability to clearly communicate results and drive impact
  • Ability to design, implement, and maintain data pipelines and dashboards to generate actionable insights based on stakeholder requirements
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver strategic insights, benchmarks, and analyses that provide recommendations
  • Ability to enable stakeholders and partners by building self-service tooling and providing training to empower stakeholder teams to be data literate and self-sufficient in autonomous reporting capabilities


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company
  • Experience with distributed data frameworks like Spark to write and debug data pipelines
  • Good understanding of development processes and best practices like engineering standards, code reviews, and testing
  • Strong statistical knowledge
  • Working knowledge of Python
  • Experience creating leadership-level reporting, such as QBRs and MBRs
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding


Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $121,800 - $182,800. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Please find our California applicant personal information notice here.

The application window will remain open for 100 days after the Job Post is published. However, this opportunity will remain open based on the needs of the business, which may cause the application window to close before or after the 100-day mark.

At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

As a Data Analytics Consultant, you’ll use data to answer business questions, identify meaningful trends, and provide insights that support better decisions. You’ll work with large and complex data sets from multiple sources, applying analytical and statistical techniques to turn information into clear, actionable recommendations.

You’ll collaborate with business and technical partners to understand questions, conduct analysis, communicate findings, and measure the results of recommendations put into action.

In this role, you will:

  • Gather, integrate, and analyze large volumes of data from multiple sources to address business questions.
  • Identify and interpret trends, patterns, relationships, and opportunities within complex data sets.
  • Apply statistical techniques and analytical tools to develop insights and recommendations.
  • Translate complex analysis into clear, concise findings that enable partners to make data-driven decisions.
  • Develop reports and visualizations that make analytical results accessible and actionable.
  • Collaborate with business, technology, and analytics partners to provide a holistic view of data and findings.
  • Support advanced analytics and predictive modeling initiatives.
  • Measure and monitor the results of implemented recommendations and identify adjustments based on performance.
  • Work with analytics and data tools that may include Python, Power BI, Adobe Analytics, Snowflake, Azure, Databricks, and GitHub Copilot.
  • Apply agile methods and ways of working to support collaboration and delivery.
  • Ensure data acquisition, sharing, analysis, and resulting recommendations comply with company standards.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • Four to five years of statistical and/or data analytics experience


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with advanced analytics, statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and complex data sets.
  • Experience with Python, reporting, business intelligence, and data visualization tools such as Power BI.
  • Experience with data platforms and environments such as Snowflake, Azure, and Databricks.
  • Experience with Adobe Analytics or similar web analytics tools and AI-assisted coding tools such as GitHub Copilot.
  • Understanding of database architecture, data structures, and source systems.
  • Strong project management, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to translate analytical findings for varied audiences.
  • Experience applying agile ways of working and collaborating across business and technical teams.
  • Experience in financial services and/or progressively responsible reporting, business intelligence, or analytics work; an advanced quantitative degree is a plus.


Location expectations

This role requires working from a U.S. Bank location three (3) or more days per week.

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

Our approach to benefits and total rewards considers our team members’ whole selves and what may be needed to thrive in and outside work. That's why our benefits are designed to help you and your family boost your health, protect your financial security and give you peace of mind. Our benefits include the following:

  • Healthcare (medical, dental, vision)
  • Basic term and optional term life insurance
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Pregnancy disability and parental leave
  • 401(k) and employer-funded retirement plan
  • Paid vacation (from two to five weeks depending on salary grade and tenure)
  • Up to 11 paid holiday opportunities
  • Adoption assistance
  • Sick and Safe Leave accruals of one hour for every 30 worked, up to 80 hours per calendar year unless otherwise provided by law


Review our full benefits available by employment status here.

descriptionHtml:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Senior Financial Data Analyst, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm’s strategic initiatives, in the Data Analytics group is responsible for data-driven forecasting, leading analytics projects, advancing the firm’s data innovation efforts, and applying advanced analytical techniques to support strategic decision-making. This role requires strong analytical and technical skills, financial acumen, and a passion for leveraging data to drive business outcomes.

The Sr Financial Data Analyst uses tools such as Power Desktop/Power BI Report Builder (SSRS) to deliver high-impact analytics, reporting, and dashboards; develop complex data models; and identify and resolve data quality issues. This individual leads large-scale analytical initiatives, mentors’ junior analysts, and collaborates with stakeholders to prioritize business needs and deliver actionable insights.

Key skills include proficiency in programming/query languages, data analysis, and strong presentation skills. The role also involves fostering collaboration, driving continuous improvement, contributing to the firm’s data strategy, and ensuring timely, accurate deliverables. Working closely with functional leads across the firm, this position conducts research, analyzes and presents data to identify trends, forecast outcomes, and support informed decision-making related to financial performance. Duties will include financial performance data analysis and presentation, interpreting data from analysis using statistical techniques, reporting, forecasting, developing and implementing data collection techniques to optimize statistical efficiency.

Location

This position can sit in our New York, Chicago, Reston, or Short Hills office and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Power BI and other advanced analytics tools to deliver comprehensive and high-impact analytics, forecasting, reporting and insight-driven solutions.
  • Collaborate with FP&A, Service Delivery, Senior Finance leadership and other key stakeholders to identify and prioritize complex business problems.
  • Implement best practices and innovative solutions to enhance data integrity.
  • Drive and manage large-scale analytical projects that span multiple teams and functions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts to ensure project alignment with business objectives and successful execution.
  • Analyze trends and derive actionable insights to address complex business challenges.
  • Design and develop advanced solutions to streamline processes, improve data quality, and drive intelligent automation.
  • Champion continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Engage with stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs and provide tailored data solutions.
  • Strong communication and financial storytelling skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Desired Skills  

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret large complex datasets, identify trends and provide actionable data-driven insights. Highly proficient in data visualization tools (PowerBI Report Builder/SSRS or Tableau). Experience in management reporting, report creation process and dashboard design. Highly proficient in Microsoft office, with advanced skills in Excel, including complex formulas, pivots tables, data analysis, VBA, and data visualization techniques. Experience with advanced statistical methods and data modeling techniques. High proficiency in programming languages.

Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to adapt to changing business needs. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Attention to detail and high level of accuracy in work.

Minimum Education   

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Data Science/Analytics, Computer Science or related field.

Minimum Years Of Experience  

  • 4 years’ experience as a Financial/Business/Data Data Analyst or similar role including experience with data modeling, statistical analysis and processes.

Essential Job Expectations

All DLA Piper employees are expected to demonstrate excellence in how we serve our clients and develop our people, upholding our firm values as part of our culture. Specific expectations include:

  • Communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and external audiences.
  • Produce high-quality work and respond to correspondence in an efficient, timely, and professional manner.
  • Meet deadlines, manage competing priorities, and commit to meeting high standards.
  • Comply with firm policies and procedures.
  • Maintain confidences as required in a law firm environment.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: This is primarily sedentary work, requiring occasional exertion of up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects. The role involves sitting for extended periods, with occasional walking and standing, and occasional travel, both domestic and international.

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement combining remote and in-office work. The specific arrangement will be determined at the time of hiring and may be modified at the firm's discretion.

Disclaimer   

The purpose of this job description is to provide a concise statement of the work elements and to organize and present the information in a standardized way. It is not intended to describe all the elements of the work that may be performed by every individual in this classification, nor should it serve as the sole criteria for personnel decisions and actions. The job duties, requirements, and expectations for this position may be modified at the Firm’s discretion at any time. This job description does not change the at-will nature of employment.

Application Process    

Interested candidates must apply directly online. Application materials sent via email will not be accepted.

Accommodation   

Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position or participate in the selection process. For accommodation requests, please contact careers@us.dlapiper.com.

Agency applications will not be considered.

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship or support.

The compensation offered for employment will also be dependent on other factors including the candidate’s experience, skills, educational and professional background, and overall qualifications. We offer a comprehensive package of benefits, including medical/dental/vision insurance, and 401(k).

Applicants who are not based in the jurisdiction in which this position is posted and who apply for this role are doing so voluntarily and are not eligible for relocation assistance. About Us

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.

Marketing Analytics is a strategic partner to Target's Marketing organization, delivering trusted insights that influence enterprise decisions and create meaningful guest experiences. The Loyalty Analytics team sits at the intersection of customer behavior, marketing strategy, personalization, and business performance. We partner with Loyalty, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Technology to measure performance, uncover growth opportunities, and shape strategies that strengthen guest engagement and drive profitable growth.

As a Sr Data Analyst, this role is an exciting opportunity for a curious and collaborative analyst who is energized by connecting with stakeholders, simplifying complexity, and shaping strategy through insights. While a foundational understanding of technical tools is expected, the heart of this role lies in storytelling—helping the business understand what’s happening, why it matters, and what we should do next.

You’ll sit at the intersection of data and strategy, serving as a trusted advisor and insight translator across teams. Your analysis won’t just inform; it will inspire decisions that drive the business forward.

Some Of What You Will Do Includes

  • Explore and interpret data to uncover the story behind business performance—what happened, why it matters, and what comes next.
  • Conduct ad hoc and deep-dive analyses that identify new opportunities, answer strategic questions, and support decision-making.
  • Work closely with marketing and other cross-functional partners to understand business needs and translate insight from guest performance data into data-driven strategies.
  • Develop intuitive, action-oriented dashboards and visualizations that highlight key takeaways—not just numbers.
  • Lead storytelling sessions and presentations with key leaders and stakeholders, communicating insights clearly and effectively.
  • Build strong relationships across the business to stay plugged into evolving priorities and ensure analytics stay relevant and impactful.

At Wilson Elser, we are redefining what it means to work at a national law firm. With more than 1,400 attorneys across 46 offices nationwide, we are recognized among the top 100 law firms by The American Lawyer and ranked #30 in the National Law Journal’s survey of the nation’s largest law firms.

Our continued success is built on a culture of collaboration, innovation, client service, and mutual respect. We are committed to fostering an environment where employees are empowered to grow their careers, contribute meaningfully, and thrive professionally.

 

Summary

Data Analyst opportunity focused on turning raw data into meaningful business insights. In this role, you will collect, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources, uncover trends and patterns and present your findings in ways that help leadership make informed business decisions. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with proficiency in data visualization tools and excellent communication skills – able to make complex data clear and actionable in support of the business.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using tools such as Power BI,
    Tableau, or Excel.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements and provide
    actionable insights.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Identify data quality issues and recommend improvements to data collection and management
    processes.
  • Present findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic planning through data analysis.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics or related field.
  • 1–4 years of experience in data analysis or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing databases.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Python or R for data analysis and automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure.
  • Knowledge of data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Experience working with large datasets and business intelligence tools.


.
