descriptionHtml:
About CirrusMD

CirrusMD is redefining virtual care by delivering a Physician-first Care & Guidance solution that meets patients at their moment of need. Our text-based (or web) app connects patients with licensed physicians in under a minute, allowing them to engage in care at their own pace and convenience. Available 24/7/365, CirrusMD’s integrated care spans multiple specialties—from acute and chronic care to behavioral health. Our platform serves 10 million users across all 50 states and is offered exclusively through employers and health plans. Learn more at cirrusmd.com .

About The Role

There’s data everywhere. The real value comes from knowing what it means, what matters, and what we should do next.

That’s where you come in.

As a Lead Business Intelligence Analyst at CirrusMD, you’ll sit at the intersection of data, technology, healthcare, and business strategy. You’ll partner with teams across Product, Clinical, Client Success, Finance, and Engineering to turn complex questions into trusted data, meaningful insights, and better decisions.

This isn’t a role where you’ll simply take requests and build dashboards.

You’ll help shape how CirrusMD measures success, demonstrates the value of our solutions, and builds a stronger data-informed culture. You’ll be comfortable talking strategy with business leaders one minute and getting into SQL, LookML, data models, or reporting logic the next.

If you love digging into complex data, connecting dots others might miss, and turning analysis into action, we’d love to meet you.

Location: This position can work remotely from anywhere within the U.S.

What You'll Do (Essential Responsibilities)

  • Connect data to the business. Serve as a trusted data partner across Product, Clinical, Client Success, Finance, and Engineering, helping teams connect business goals with technical execution.
  • Show the value. Build measurement frameworks that translate our product, clinical, and commercial work into meaningful performance metrics and help demonstrate the value and ROI of CirrusMD’s solutions.
  • Own the data journey. Lead analytics projects from the first question and feasibility assessment through modeling, analysis, reporting, and client-facing delivery.
  • Build data people can trust. Partner with Engineering to define data structures and strengthen our Looker semantic layer, creating scalable, reusable, high-confidence data.
  • Turn complexity into clarity. Dig into complex datasets and uncover insights that help teams understand what’s happening, why it matters, and where we should go next.
  • Bring performance to life. Build thoughtful dashboards, visualizations, and reporting frameworks that make important metrics understandable and actionable.
  • Protect the integrity of the data. Balance client and stakeholder needs with strong governance, privacy standards, and organizational data practices.
  • Get into the weeds when it matters. Investigate anomalies, challenge assumptions, validate results, and make sure the story the data tells is actually true.
  • Help us get smarter. Identify opportunities to evolve our analytics capabilities, improve existing data models, reduce technical debt, and make trusted insights easier to access across the organization.
  • Take on other responsibilities as needed to support our clients, teams, and business.

What You'll Bring (Qualifications)

  • Experience: 5+ years of relevant analytics or business intelligence experience.
  • Strong to advanced SQL skills and experience working with cloud data platforms such as Snowflake.
  • Hands-on experience with business intelligence platforms such as Looker.
  • Experience building and maintaining semantic layers using LookML.
  • Experience using GitHub or similar version-control practices within a modern analytics environment.
  • A track record of translating complex or ambiguous business questions into well-defined technical and analytical solutions.
  • Experience owning analytics work from initial idea through feasibility, modeling, validation, visualization, and delivery.
  • The ability to build new data solutions while also improving, refactoring, and simplifying existing ones.
  • Strong two-way communication skills that allow you to explain technical concepts to business partners and translate business needs for technical teams.
  • Experience balancing complex, client-facing data requests with established data governance standards.
  • Experience working with high-integrity data processes where accuracy is non-negotiable, such as billing, invoicing, financial, or clinical reporting.
  • Knowledge and application of analytical and statistical concepts such as confidence intervals, hypothesis testing, sentiment analysis, and anomaly detection.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and know when a problem requires a deep dive and when it’s time to zoom back out.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with modern data transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt or Airflow.
  • Experience using Python or R when the analysis needs to go beyond SQL.
  • Knowledge of healthcare data and standards, including HIPAA, FedRAMP, PII/PHI, or clinical quality measures such as HEDIS, NCQA, or NQF.
  • Experience with event-based product analytics or Customer Data Platforms such as Segment.
  • A strong understanding of modern data architecture and how upstream engineering decisions affect downstream analytics.
  • Experience working within digital health or the broader U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
  • Experience using AI to make data easier to access and understand, including natural-language querying, conversational analytics, or AI-enabled self-service BI.

What's In It For You

CirrusMD is paving the way to a better healthcare future and our work truly matters! Our solution is exceptionally accessible, instantly available, and simply scalable. If you are looking to make a lasting impact where your voice matters, consider joining our team and help us deliver care without barriers. We take the health and happiness of our employees seriously and offer great benefits including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Deeply subsidized medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family
  • Unlimited PTO / Vacation
  • 401(K) + match
  • Paid maternity & paternity leave
  • Remote friendly
  • Growth opportunity
  • A positive, collaborative and diverse culture
  • Social events onsite & remote
  • Free, unlimited access to our text-first platform

Reasonable Accommodation

Should you require reasonable accommodation(s) to participate in the application/interview/selection process, or in order to complete the essential duties of the position upon acceptance of a job offer, click here to submit a recruitment accommodation request.

Recruiting Scams

Unfortunately, scams targeting job seekers are common. To protect our candidates, we want to remind you that authorized representatives of Quantum Health will only contact you from an email address ending in @quantum-health.com. Quantum Health will never ask for personally identifiable information such as Date of Birth (DOB), Social Security Number (SSN), banking/direct/tax details, etc. via email or any other non-secure system, nor will we instruct you to make any purchases related to your employment. If you believe you’ve encountered a recruiting scam, report it to the Federal Trade Commission and your state’s Attorney General .

If you are a California resident, Quantum Health may collect personal information in connection with your application for employment and, if hired, during the course of your employment. The categories of personal information collected and the purposes for which that information is used are described in our California Employee and Job Applicant Notice of Collection of Personal Information.

Please Review The Notice Here

California Employee and Job Applicant Notice

Use Of Technology Notice

Quantum Health and its authorized service providers may contact applicants by email, phone, and text message about their application and related employment opportunities. Text messages may cover application status, interview invitations, and reminders, and applicants will have the option to opt out at any time. Message frequency varies. Message and data rates may apply.

Quantum Health uses AI-assisted recruiting technology to support communication, scheduling, and candidate evaluation, including tools that may review application materials and analyze recorded interviews. These tools assist our recruiting team; final employment decisions are made by human reviewers. Applicants who will be interviewed using these tools receive advance notice describing the technology and what it evaluates, are asked for permission before the interview is recorded or analyzed, and may request deletion of their recording.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
As a Business Intelligence Analyst - Journeyman at Kearney & Company, you will support the FASTR program within the War Data Platform as a member of the Business Intelligence, Reporting & Decision Support team. Working under the direction of the BI / Reporting Functional Lead and senior analysts, you will develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical products supporting Department of the Air Force financial management. You will translate documented requirements into visualizations, validate data and calculations, troubleshoot reporting issues, and collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to deliver reliable decision-support capabilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and maintenance of interactive dashboards, recurring reports, scorecards, and ad hoc analyses for Department of the Air Force financial management stakeholders.
  • Implement documented reporting requirements, KPIs, business rules, and acceptance criteria in BI visualizations and reporting products.
  • Create and maintain data transformations, measures, calculated fields, and basic semantic models under the guidance of senior BI analysts.
  • Query, join, aggregate, and analyze financial datasets to support reporting, trend analysis, and operational decision-making.
  • Work with Financial Management SMEs to verify financial definitions, calculations, filters, aggregations, and drill-down results.
  • Coordinate with data engineering and platform teams to identify data dependencies, document integration issues, and support resolution.
  • Perform data quality checks and reconcile report outputs to approved source datasets; document discrepancies and escalate complex issues.
  • Execute assigned BI testing and user acceptance testing scenarios, document defects, verify corrections, and support release readiness.
  • Follow established development standards, version control practices, and peer review processes to maintain reliable reporting products.
  • Maintain report documentation, data dictionaries, user instructions, and training materials; assist with demonstrations and end-user support.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 3 years of relevant experience in business intelligence, data analytics, reporting development, data visualization, or related information systems work.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience developing dashboards and reports using Power BI or a comparable enterprise business intelligence platform.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including querying, joining, filtering, and aggregating structured datasets.
  • Experience implementing documented reporting requirements and validating calculations, metrics, and report outputs.
  • Ability to investigate data discrepancies, document findings, and troubleshoot routine reporting issues.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to collaborate with functional SMEs and technical teams.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret level security clearance (requires US Citizenship)
  • Must be willing and able to travel as required, up to 25% of the time

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of War or Department of the Air Force financial management, audit, budget, or reporting initiatives.
  • Familiarity with the War Data Platform or similar secure government enterprise data environments.
  • Experience with Power BI, DAX, Power Query, Python, or related data transformation and automation tools.
  • Knowledge of financial management data structures, accounting classifications, data governance, or source-system reconciliation.
  • Experience supporting user acceptance testing, dashboard performance improvements, and end-user training.

Overview

Exclusively focused on the Government, Kearney & Company provides financial services, including auditing, consulting, and technology services. Our commitment to our employees and clients as well as to dedication and trust, critical values to our Firm, have led to Kearney’s recognition as one of the leading accounting firms in the country. Based on our employees’ feedback, we are also consistently rated a Best Place to Work. Employment at Kearney means a flexible, collaborative, and open-minded work environment. We hope it is your “first easy decision.” Learn more at www.kearneyco.com/careers." ,"

The expected salary range for this position is between $69,000 and $105,000 . This range is representative of base pay only and does not include straight time pay for hours worked over 40 per week, company contributions towards paid benefits, and/or bonuses.  Actual compensation (meeting or exceeding the range) will be determined based on specific experience, education, work location, clearance level, and other factors permitted by law.  This position is eligible for bonuses (when applicable). 

  

We also offer a competitive benefits package that includes: 

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance 
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan and 529 Education Savings Plan 
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Account 
  • Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity Insurances 
  • Legal Insurance and Pet Insurance 
  • Employee Assistance Program, fitness and wellness benefits, and other firm benefits. 
  • Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time

Company Overview

 Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, services, and solutions for the LNG and industrial gases industry. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with over $1.5 B in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Nikkiso Cryogenic Pumps & Expanders is an engineering and manufacturing company specializing in machinery designed to operate at cryogenic temperatures as low as – 420 degrees Fahrenheit, the boiling point of Liquid hydrogen. For over 50 years, Nikkiso ACD has specialized in centrifugal and reciprocating pumps as well as turbines for air separation. Nikkiso ACD has the most diversified product line in the industry covering nearly every application requiring pumps or turboexpanders.

Job Overview

Nikkiso Cryogenic Pumps & Expanders is seeking a Power BI Developer and analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our global operations. This role will focus on delivering advanced analytics, business intelligence solutions, and operational insights that improve performance in manufacturing, service, and project execution. This is an onsite position.

The ideal candidate will combine strong analytical and problem-solving skills with business acumen to transform complex data into actionable insights that support efficiency, cost optimization, and strategic growth. He/she must have the ability to connect data insights to operational and financial impact and be detail-oriented with a focus on data accuracy and quality

Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Operational Insights

  • Analyze data from sales, manufacturing, engineering, financials, and supply chain systems to identify trends and improvement opportunities
  • Perform root cause analysis on operational issues (e.g., delivery delays, cost overruns, profitability losses, etc.)
  • Support global entities in the development of local KPIs that will allow them to forecast, plan to meet existing backlog, and support the development of project dashboards
  • Deliver actionable recommendations to improve KPIs such as throughput, margins, utilization, and on-time delivery

Business Intelligence & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain standardized KPI dashboards aligned with Cryogenic Pumps and Expanders operational and business objectives
  • Partner with stakeholders across engineering, operations, finance, and leadership to define reporting and analytics needs
  • Enable self-service BI by creating intuitive, scalable datasets and reports
  • Ensure consistency of metrics across all global locations (e.g., revenue, backlog, delivery, quality, etc.)
  • Translate complex data into clear business narratives and executive-level insights
  • Support strategic initiatives in the cryogenic pumps and expanders through data analysis

Power BI Development

  • Design and develop interactive dashboards and reports in Power BI for:
    • Manufacturing performance
    • Project tracking & analytics
    • Financial reporting
    • Sales and backlog
  • B uild and maintain robust data models and semantic layers
  • Develop advanced DAX calculations and functional unit KPIs
  • Use Power Query (M) to transform and prepare data
  • Optimize performance for large datasets and enterprise reporting
Data Integration & Management

  • Extract and integrate data from systems such as:
    • ERP systems (e.g., Encompix, MAAS500, Manfact or similar)
    • Manufacturing systems (MES)
    • Service and field data systems
    • SQL databases and cloud platforms
    • SharePoint, excel files, etc.
  • Collaborate with IT and local entities to collect data from multiple teams to improve data pipelines and data quality
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reports
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Governance & Quality

  • Implement data governance standards and security controls (e.g., row-level security)
  • Maintain documentation for data models, KPIs, and reporting logic
  • Ensure compliance with internal data standards and audit requirements

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The knowledge, skills, and abilities listed above are typically acquired through the levels of education and experience listed. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience that provides an applicant with the listed knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job, may be accepted.

Qualifications

 Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in Power BI, data analysis, or business intelligence
  • Strong proficiency in:
    • Power BI (Desktop & Service)
    • DAX and Power Query
    • SQL
  • Experience analyzing operational or manufacturing data, sales data, and financial data
  • Strong understanding of business processes, KPIs, and performance metrics
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical stakeholders
Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing , energy, or industrial environments
  • Familiarity with ERP systems
  • Experience with Azure, Snowflake, or cloud data platforms
  • Knowledge of Python or R for advanced analytics
  • Experience with data warehousing and ETL tools
  • Microsoft Power BI certification (PL-300)

Environmental Safety Requirements

  • New Employee Safety Training is required by all newly hired employees, including Safety Awareness
  • All safety related training is provided and tracked by the EHS Director
  • Job specific training modules deemed necessary by employee’s Manager or Director will be required of all employees on an ongoing basis
  • Employees are required to wear ACD provided PPE as/when needed. PPE includes safety shoes, safety glasses, face shields, FR clothing, cryogenic gloves, cryogenic apron, cut resistant gloves, safety gloves, hearing protection, hard hats & dust masks. Failure to comply with ACD safety requirements will result in disciplinary actions, up to and including termination.

Salary Range: $55,000-$70,000

EEOC Statement

Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled

Nikkiso CE&IG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

descriptionHtml:
Description

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will turn a federal program's operational data into figures its people can rely on. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your First Project Will Likely Have You Building The Reporting a Federal Program Runs On. Depending On The Assignment, You May

  • Work with the people who own each process to define its measures, and document the business rules behind every figure.
  • Write the Structured Query Language (SQL) that turns platform data on Amazon Aurora and related Amazon Web Services (AWS) data stores into clean, reconciled analytical datasets.
  • Build the recurring reports, dashboards, and data visualizations the program actually uses, with documented measures, refresh schedules, and access controls, designed to answer the question, load fast, and never mislead with a scale or a label.
  • Trace each discrepancy to its source, whether a definition, timing, a filter, or a source system, until the figure is explained.
  • Produce the quality evidence behind the reporting: validation checks, reconciliation reports, and issue logs that hold up in an audit.
  • Replace manual reporting with repeatable, tested workflows.
  • Make AI-assisted analysis standard practice, using coding assistants and language models across the work with your own judgment on top.

You help deliver figures a federal program can run on, each with the provenance to show where it came from, and clean datasets that give every later analysis solid ground.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of data analysis experience using SQL
  • Bachelor's degree
  • A strong working command of SQL
  • Experience building reports and dashboards in a business intelligence tool, such as Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable tool
  • Familiarity with Python or R for analysis scripting
  • The ability to own an analysis from the first question to a delivered, documented answer
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Experience with cloud data platforms on AWS
  • Experience with federal program, financial, or performance data
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and analysis tools

Who You Are

You are exact with numbers and wary of any you cannot explain: an anomaly is something to run down, not a footnote. You move easily between a stakeholder's question and the data that answers it, and you would rather hand a program one figure it can trust than ten it cannot. You adapt, and you pick up new concepts, systems, and tools fast enough to stay ahead of what the program needs as projects finish and priorities shift. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What You Bring

  • A practical command of SQL and spreadsheets, with Python or R scripting where it makes the work faster or safer.
  • The discipline of defined measures: rules written down, sources reconciled, and reports that refresh without surprises.
  • The judgment to pick the chart that serves the reader, and the restraint to leave out the one that does not.
  • The care to work where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $67,000 to $123,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What We Offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What We Commit To

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

Serves as a Medicare business data analyst, leveraging data, performance metrics, and effective reporting to inform performance initiatives and strategy for Medicare Stars and Risk Adjustment team and cross-functional collaborating teams. Supports efforts with internal and external partners by providing relevant and actionable data. Works independently to support the team with data-driven performance management including: data management and synthesis of disparate sources, data analysis, reporting and data visualization. Designs and develops data automation and streamling that create workflow efficiencies by interfacing disparate IT systems through APIs, ETLs, or other technological solutions.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in information systems, data analytics, mathematics or statistics and four (4) years of related work experience; or equivalent combination of education and related work experience.
  • Demonstrated knowledge in identifying issues, collecting data, and analyzing and interpreting data.
  • Knowledge of managed care/health care business processes, systems and applications for delivered services such as claims, encounters, provider data, and/or patient/member data.
  • Intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications including Word, PowerPoint and Outlook.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
  • Intermediate working knowledge of MicroStrategy, SQL, SAS, Access, R or other business intelligence language/tools.
  • Intermediate working knowledge of Tableau or other data visualization tools.


Duties And Responsibilities

  • Report Development, Research and Analysis:
    • Develop and present reports that provide organizational awareness, insights and action plans to internal and external partners supporting Stars and Risk Adjustment performance improvement initiatives.
    • Integrates data and uses advanced analytical methods/tools to identify trends, issues, root causes and focused population segments, translating data into actionable visualizations using tables, graphs, charts, written reports and presentations.
    • Develops, implements and/or enhances methods to extract complex data sets from available sources (e.g., HMSA data repositories, HEDIS software, external party extracts, etc.).
    • Applies understanding of standard quality measures (e.g., HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS) to identify strategic improvement levers (e.g., supplemental data, benefit alignment) to impact Stars performance.
    • Applies understanding of Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) and Hierarchial Care Conditions (HCC) to identify strategic improvement levers to improve Risk Adjustment
    • Ensures Stars measure data and Risk Adjustment data is complete and accurate by implementing effective controls and validation activities.
    • Work as part of an agile quality team supporting quality improvement initiatives, Medicare quality pilots programs and member incentive programs.
    • Ensure compliance to regulatory standards and requirements
  • Stars and Risk Adjustment Performance Monitoring
    • Maintains a thorough understanding of the Medicare Part C & D Star Ratings Technical Notes, Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) and Hierarchical Care Conditions (HCC). Monitor proposed changes, proactively identify potential risks to performance, as well as associated mitigation strategies.
    • Gathers data to create and publish Stars and Risk Adjustment dashboards and related metrics on a monthly basis. Proactively identifies and supports acquisition of new data sources.
    • Create and update reports for committees and other program-related teams, distributes actionable data to facilitate performance monitoring against current targets and year-end projections.
    • Works with internal and external teams to proactively identify and implement Stars and Risk Adjustement dashboard enhancements.
    • Validates CMS Stars plan performance reports (e.g., First Plan Preview, Westat MCAHPS reports) against internal data.
    • Suports ad hoc reporting requests for Stars and Risk Adjustment
  • Data Automation and Streamlining
    • Reasearch, design and develop data automation between disparate data systems through interfacing, APIs, ETLs, or other technological solutions.
    • Work collaboratively as part of project teams to understand, research and document requirements for data, workflows, and business needs.
    • Works independently to progress assigned work according to timeline and deadlines, work collaboratively to ensure that projects are meeting defined requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Participates in projects and cross-departmental teams that support the Stars program and Risk Adjustment.
    • Serves as the Stars and Risk Adjustment performance data subject matter expert in various workgroups and efforts (e.g., data strategies, HEDIS performance, provider performance platforms such as Cozeva, Cotiviti etc.).
    • Coordinates Stars performance data activities with related quality team activities (e.g., HEDIS data team, Primary Care Payment Model quality team, FQHC/RHC quality team). Coordinates Stars improvement activities with the HCC risk adjustment team to ensure integration and alignment of quality goals with HCC risk adjustment objectives.
    • Represents HMSA in Blues plan and/or other industry work groups to compare best practices for improving Stars performance data.
  • Performs all other miscellaneous responsibilities and duties as assigned or directed.

Description

As we strive to be Earth's most customer-centric company, Amazon has reinvented how hundreds of millions of people shop online – providing customers with the opportunity to find and discover virtually anything they want to buy and providing millions of sellers with a platform for growing successful businesses. We are looking for an exceptional business analyst to help us develop new ways to build trust and loyalty with sellers, a crucial component of our flywheel

Sellers’ trust in Amazon is our top priority and in this role, you will be tasked with building that trust over time by diving deep into how we measure our progress and helping to identify and prioritize key areas of focus. Amazon’s growth requires leaders who move fast, have an entrepreneurial spirit to create new solutions, have an unrelenting tenacity to get things done, and are capable of breaking down and solving complex problems.

The successful candidate will be a self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and be able to create and maintain efficient & automated processes. They will set the vision, strategy, and roadmap, and work alongside with stakeholders in the organization to make it happen. They know and love working with business intelligence tools, can model multidimensional datasets, and can partner effectively with business leaders to answer key business questions. They are analytical and creative, and don’t quit. This is a role with high visibility to senior leadership and with high opportunity for impact for those willing to roll up their sleeves and dive deep to achieve results.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the design, development, and maintenance of scalable solutions for ongoing metrics, reports, analyses, dashboards, etc. to support analytical and business needs.
  • Work with team leadership to understand the customer needs and concerns as well as define solutions.
  • Translate basic business problem statements into analysis requirements. Work with internal customers to define best output based on expressed stakeholder needs.
  • Use analytical and statistical rigor to solve complex problems and drive business decisions.
  • Develop queries and visualizations for ad-hoc requests and projects, as well as ongoing reporting.
  • Design and drive experiments, A/B testing, outlier deep dives and form actionable recommendations. Manage the implementation of those recommendations.
  • Write queries and output efficiently, and have in-depth knowledge of the data available in area of expertise. Pull the data needed with standard query syntax; periodically identify more advanced methods of query optimization. Convert data to make it analysis-ready.
  • Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, and documentation.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot operational or data issues in the data pipelines
  • Review and audit existing ETL jobs and SQL queries.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
  • 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
  • Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
  • Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
  • Experience with Excel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SQL

Are you ready to launch your analytics career in the fast-paced world of supply chain? At DHL Supply Chain, we’re looking for a Senior Business Data Analyst who is eager to apply data-driven thinking, build impactful visualizations, and support operational excellence. This is your opportunity to grow your skills, collaborate with warehouse leaders, and become a go-to resource for data tools and insights. If you're curious, analytical, and ready to lead, this role is for you.


Job Description

As a Senior Business Data Analyst, you will support warehouse operations by transforming data into actionable insights that improve performance and efficiency. You’ll collaborate with site leadership and key stakeholders to build dashboards, implement standard tools, and support data-driven decision-making. In addition to core analytics work, you’ll have the opportunity to lead projects across multiple sites, support site startups, and act as a point of contact for analytics community initiatives.

  • Develop and maintain Power BI reports to support operational and strategic decisions
  • Full development of Power BI including data visualization and back-end data model design
  • Clean, model, and analyze data using SQL, DAX, and statistical techniques to uncover trends and drive improvements
  • Implement and maintain standard reporting tools for the site or sector
  • Assist various functional teams (HR, Finance, etc.) with customized analytical solutions to meet evolving business needs
  • Serve as a point of contact for Power BI-related questions and analytics community initiatives
  • Lead knowledge-sharing sessions to promote data literacy and tool adoption
  • Manage analytics projects independently and across multiple sites
  • Design and implement data pipelines (ETL) from structured, semi-structured, and unstructured sources
  • Apply Python, R, or other analytics tools to enhance reporting and automation
  • Stay current with modern data analytics trends and apply best practices to improve processes
  • Support site startups as needed by implementing analytics tools and reporting frameworks


Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or 4 years of equivalent professional experience, required
  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, required
  • Extensive experience using SQL or other scripting languages (such as Python or R) to query, clean, and transform data, required
  • Proficiency in Power BI, including building dashboards and reports from scratch, required
  • Proficiency in writing DAX expressions to automate and enhance Power BI reports, required
  • Experience designing and managing data pipelines and working with diverse data sources, required
  • Strong understanding of statistical concepts, data modeling techniques, and modern analytics trends, required
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights, required
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead cross-functional projects, required
  • Must be able to work fully onsite if role based out of a warehouse, required

descriptionHtml:
Senior Analyst, Reporting & Analysis


About the Role


The Senior Analyst, Reporting & Analysis partners with leadership and cross-functional teams to transform complex data into actionable financial and operational insights.

In this role, you will leverage SQL, advanced Excel, financial modeling, and compelling PowerPoint storytelling to evaluate business performance, develop customer lifetime value and ROI models, and translate data into recommendations that support strategic decision-making. You will also manage ad hoc reporting and analytical requests and support strategic initiatives that contribute to the financial health and growth of Hilton Grand Vacations.


What You’ll Do

  • Develop and maintain customer lifetime value, ROI, sensitivity, and other financial models using SQL and advanced Excel.
  • Build profitability and cost-benefit models to evaluate business opportunities and support investment decisions.
  • Analyze large and complex data sets to identify trends, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.
  • Conduct variance, forecasting, profitability, and financial analyses to support business planning and decision-making.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, fact-based insights and actionable business recommendations.
  • Design executive-ready PowerPoint presentations, Excel visualizations, and reporting packages that communicate insights clearly and effectively.
  • Present findings and recommendations, both verbally and in writing, to key stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Manage end-to-end ad hoc operational and financial reporting requests while balancing competing priorities and deadlines.
  • Prepare, enhance, and distribute recurring operational and financial reporting packages.
  • Partner with IM&A and cross-functional teams to monitor critical initiatives, track performance, and communicate progress.
  • Support project management activities, including milestone tracking, status reporting, issue identification, and cross-functional coordination.


What We’re Looking For

To fulfill this role successfully, you must possess the following minimum qualifications and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in financial analysis, reporting, business analytics, or a related discipline, preferably within hospitality or a consumer-focused industry.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data analysis, and financial modeling.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to develop polished, executive-ready presentations.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and interpreting customer lifetime value and ROI models.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate complex data and financial concepts into meaningful business insights and recommendations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple ad hoc reporting and analytical requests while meeting competing deadlines.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to coordinate across teams and track key milestones.


Work Location & Authorization


  • This position is onsite in our Orlando, Florida office.
  • Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

- Prepare, enhance, and distribute recurring operational and financial reporting packages.

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field.
- 2+ years of experience in financial analysis, reporting, business analytics, or a related discipline, preferably within hospitality or a consumer-focused industry.
- Proficiency in SQL for data extraction, manipulation, and analysis.
- Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, complex formulas, data analysis, and financial modeling.
- Strong PowerPoint skills with the ability to develop polished, executive-ready presentations.
- Demonstrated experience developing and interpreting customer lifetime value and ROI models.
- Strong analytical, quantitative, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to translate complex data and financial concepts into meaningful business insights and recommendations.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
- Proven ability to manage multiple ad hoc reporting and analytical requests while meeting competing deadlines.
- Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to coordinate across teams and track key milestones.


Work Location & Authorization



- This position is onsite in our Orlando, Florida office.

Demonstrate strong project management and organizational skills.

Continue to learn the software and increase their knowledge over time.

N/A

Bachelors degree is required

Bachelors Degree with 1-2 years computer related experience required. Degree in IT, business, or health care field preferred.

Preferrably one (1) or more years of experience or more years of experience developing applications/reports within Epic, a Business Intelligence tool such as Tableau or, Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, DB2 or other RDBMS platform.

Preferably proficient in SQL or expertise in analytics tools such as Tableau.

Exposure to reporting tools such as Microsoft SQL Server Reporting (SSRS); Crystal Reports or Business Objects.

Proficiency in data manipulation and extraction techniques.

Exposure to Extract, Transform and Load (ETL) technology, Microsoft SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) preferred.

Experience with integrating data from heterogeneous systems (flat files, Excel as well as relational database systems.)

Team Orientation, Problem Solving, And Communication Skills Required.

Proficient with Microsoft Excel.

Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with ability to collaborate at multiple organization levels across the health system as required, including both technical and non?technical staff.

Epic trained and / or certified preferred.

Working knowledge of data models from EMRs and/or healthcare.

Physical/Mental Requirements And Typical Working Conditions

Exposure to stressful situations, including those involving public contact, as well as, trauma, grief and death.

Able to wear personal protective equipment that includes latex materials or appropriate substitute if required for your position.

Is able to move freely about facility with or without an assisted device and must be able to perform the functions of the job as outlined in the job description.

Overall vision and hearing is necessary with or without assisted device(s).

Frequently required to sit/stand/walk for long periods of time. May require frequent postural changes such as stooping, kneeling or crouching.

Some exposure to blood borne pathogens and other potentially infectious material. Must follow MidMichigan Health bloodborne pathogen and TB testing as required.

Ability to handle multiple tasks, get along with others, work independently, regular and predictable attendance and ability to stay awake.

Overall dexterity is required including handling, reaching, grasping, fingering and feeling. May require repetition of these movements on a regular to frequent basis.

Physical Demand Level: Sedentary. Must be able to occasionally (0?33% of the workday) lift or carry 0?10 lbs.

Job Description

About the Role:

This role is a hybrid-based role and requires a local candidate who can travel to the office.

The Senior Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst will design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports, dashboards, and the semantic models that support them, ensuring business stakeholders have access to accurate, well-defined, and trusted data.

Reporting to the BI Manager, the Senior BI Analyst will own the design and usability of reports, maintain measures in alignment with certified metric definitions, and support the rollout and training of new and updated reports for users ranging from executives to field sales.

This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical Power BI expertise with excellent business acumen, communication skills, and a passion for helping teams make data-driven decisions.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

  • Under the direction of the BI Manager, design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards that meet the needs of business stakeholders, including field sales, executives, FP&A, Marketing, Product Management, and Medical Education.
  • Develop and maintain DAX measures and semantic models in Power BI and Microsoft Fabric in accordance with BI metric definitions and certification standards.
  • Collaborate with BI team members on the data that supports reporting, including identifying data quality issues, requesting source changes, and testing upstream changes prior to release.
  • Validate reports and measures against source data, and against Finance figures where required, prior to release.
  • Investigate and resolve reported data discrepancies, tracing each issue to its root cause and routing it to the appropriate owner when necessary.
  • Develop a working understanding of the commercial business, including the distinction between revenue and case data, in order to design reports around the decisions they support.
  • Gather requirements from report users, conduct design reviews, and collect feedback following release.
  • Design mobile-friendly report layouts to support field users.
  • Act as a resource in the rollout and training of new and updated reports, including plain-language release notes and current report documentation.
  • Maintain the report inventory and usage tracking, and retire reports that are no longer in use.
  • Manage report access and row-level security, administer Power BI workspaces, apps, and refresh schedules, and adhere to BI change-control processes.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to incorporate AI and automation into BI workflows, including Copilot in Power BI and Fabric, data-driven alerting, and AI-assisted documentation.
  • Support readiness for natural language querying once certified models are in place.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Systems, Information Technology, Statistics, Economics, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • 4+ years of experience developing Power BI reports and semantic models in a production environment.
  • Experience in the medical device, healthcare, or another sales-driven industry preferred.
  • Ability to present examples of previously developed reports during the interview process preferred.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Treace's Privacy Policy

It is Treace’s policy not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or any employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. EEO/Disabled/Veterans Employer

ADP is hiring a Business Intelligence Manager (Individual Contributor) for the HR Outsourcing (HRO) Analytics organization. This senior individual-contributor role is accountable for developing and maintaining reports and dashboards, with an emphasis on generating value-driven insights and KPIs to support business decision-making. The Business Intelligence Manager will lead complex analytics initiatives, leverage advanced business intelligence techniques, and partner with stakeholders to translate data into actionable insights. Through data visualization, analytics, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvement, this role will enable informed organizational decision-making.

What Are We Looking For?

Someone who thinks analytically and enjoys turning complex data into compelling stories and actionable insights. The ideal candidate has a passion for continuous improvement, data exploration, data analysis, and data visualization. They enjoy solving business problems through data and identifying opportunities to drive measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is business-minded, detail-oriented, self-motivated, collaborative, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. They possess strong communication skills, excel at building stakeholder relationships, and are willing to roll up their sleeves to tackle complex challenges and deliver results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of business processes, objectives, and requirements to generate meaningful insights and visualizations.
  • Develop visualizations and analytical insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements, validate data, and ensure the accuracy and relevance of analytical solutions.
  • Apply BI standards and best practices to maintain the quality and integrity of the HRO Analytics brand.
  • Design, develop, and implement intuitive dashboards that enable business stakeholders to easily interpret and act on data.
  • Coach business partners on how to leverage dashboards and analytical insights to support decision-making.
  • Lead complex analytics initiatives from requirements gathering through development, implementation, and stakeholder adoption.

Behaviors

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive self-starter requiring minimal guidance, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrates a can-do attitude and takes initiative to drive solutions and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong adherence to Agile methodologies, with a focus on delivering MVPs, meeting commitments, and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Team-oriented, with a strong focus on business stakeholders and the end-user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical discipline, such as Business Management, Finance, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in exploratory data analysis (EDA).
  • Advanced proficiency in developing and executing ETL processes independently using SQL, Python, Alteryx, or a combination of these technologies.
  • Advanced proficiency in BI and data visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI, as well as Excel.
  • Experience accessing and working with relational databases, large datasets, and analytical data models.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to generate insights and communicate findings through effective presentations and visualizations.
  • Technical expertise in database development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
  • Advanced proficiency in trend analysis, root cause analysis, and other diagnostic analytical methods.
  • Proficiency in prescriptive analytics and hypothesis testing.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, storytelling, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to management, team members, and non-technical audiences.

  • Advanced degree in analytics, an MBA, or a related field.
  • Experience in the HCM/PEO industry.
  • Experience supporting change management or large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leveraging AI and agentic development to create assets and insights.

descriptionHtml:
Job Details

Description

Third Federal is a leading lender of conventional home mortgages lending in 27 states, plus the District of Columbia, with retail branch offices in Ohio and Florida. Our mission is to help people achieve the dream of home ownership and financial security while creating value for our customers, our communities, our associates, and our stockholders. Our value system of love (concern for others), trust, respect, a commitment to excellence, and fun is at the heart of our commitment to our mission, and just as importantly, to our company culture. Through this, we help people find the loan or savings product that makes sense for them.

At Third Federal, you will find strength and stability in your career. In our nearly 90-year history, we have never had layoffs, and have one of the lowest annual turnover rates at 6% (versus an industry average of nearly 19%). We have been certified as a ‘Great Place to Work’ multiple times in the last decade alone, and have been recognized with several additional workplace awards and recognitions. Because Third Federal associates are the foundation of our success, we take a genuine interest in each of them – from their professional development to their health and wellness.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Power BI Reporting & ETL Analyst to join our team here at Third Federal. This role will be responsible for leveraging data and analytics to support enterprise-scale, data-driven decision making, improving business processes, and executing organizational objectives. This role will focus on designing, developing, and maintaining standardized reporting and analytics solutions while partnering closely with business stakeholders to ensure reporting aligns with business needs and enterprise data standards. The Power BI Reporting & ETL Analyst will work directly with business owners, management, and end users across departments to intake, document, prioritize, and deliver reporting and analytics requests. This role will also support and maintain data management platforms, ETL processes, and data warehouse solutions used for data storage, transformation, analysis, and reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with business owners and stakeholders to intake, document, prioritize, and deliver enterprise reporting and analytics requests.
  • Design, develop, and maintain standardized enterprise reports, dashboards, and analytical datasets that support data‑driven decision making.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries and analytic datasets, ensuring data accuracy, performance, and consistency across reporting solutions.
  • Support and maintain data management platforms, ETL processes, and data warehouse solutions used for data storage, transformation, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with data management and technology teams to ensure data integrity, security, and governance standards are met across analytics efforts.
  • Act as a data advocate, identifying opportunities to improve data quality, analytics maturity, reporting efficiency, and business processes.
  • Enable business user self‑sufficiency by designing intuitive analytical solutions, promoting self‑service reporting, and establishing a network of power users to support ad hoc analytics needs.
  • Gain knowledge of core banking systems and ancillary products to support the integration of reporting data across disparate systems.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related role, preferably in banking or financial services
  • Strong proficiency in SQL for data analysis, reporting, and data validation
  • Experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or SSRS
  • Experience working with data warehousing concepts and ETL processes
  • Ability to communicate complex data and analytics concepts in a clear, user-friendly manner
  • Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and consistency
  • Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple reporting and analytics requests simultaneously
  • High school diploma or GED (bachelor’s degree in data science, statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics, or a related field preferred)

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud)
  • Prior experience working with data, analytics, reporting, or data management solutions within the banking, financial services, or fintech industry is preferred
  • Familiarity with enterprise reporting standards, KPI definition, and metric governance
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSRS, SSMS and SSAS
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word

Third Federal Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation packages
  • Medical, dental, vision, and more
  • 401k match
  • 11 Bank Holidays + vacation/sick time
  • Stock Ownership Allocation
  • Exceptional culture and value system
  • Strong work/life balance
  • Growth opportunities
  • Mortgage Discount Program
  • Education Reimbursement Program

Our anticipated pay range for this position is $70,000.00 - $100,000.00. At Third Federal, we’re committed to transparency throughout the hiring process. The pay range listed is based on relevant market data, role responsibilities, and skills required for the position. Individual pay will be thoughtfully determined by a candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other relevant factors.

Third Federal is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, gender identification or sexual orientation, disability, protected veteran status or any other classification protected under law.

Extracts data from the source and describes the data visually and statistically via simple project work. Performs routine business analysis using various techniques, e.g. statistical analysis, explanatory and predictive modeling, data mining. This position follows a hybrid work schedule and requires employees to work on-site at our El Dorado, AR office Monday through Thursday.

Since the creation of its Community Impact initiative in 2018, ESL has reinvested more than $173 million in grants throughout the community. ESL Federal Credit Union is headquartered at 225 Chestnut Street, in Rochester, and can be found online at www.esl.org.

Business Intelligence Analyst

The Business Intelligence Analyst serves as a strategic partner to FP&A, business leaders, and IT, translating financial, operational, and strategic business needs into scalable reporting, analytics, and business intelligence solutions. This role combines strong technical expertise with financial and business acumen to improve data accessibility, reporting capabilities, operational efficiency, and decision support across the organization. The Business Intelligence Analyst partners closely with FP&A, business leaders, and the data warehouse team to transform complex financial and operational data into trusted insights that support informed business decisions.

Position Information

  • Primary Work Location: Fargo, ND or St. Louis Park, MN
  • Work Environment: On-Site
  • Work Type: Full-time, Exempt

Responsibilities

Finance and Business Partnership

  • Partner with Finance, FP&A, business leaders, and IT to understand reporting, planning, forecasting, and analytics needs and develop practical solutions that support business goals.
  • Lead conversations with stakeholders to understand business needs, current processes, challenges, data sources, and desired outcomes.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, process documentation, report specifications, and prioritized projects.
  • Manage and prioritize reporting and analytics requests, balancing ongoing reporting, strategic projects, data quality, and ad hoc needs.
  • Develop a strong understanding of business systems and processes to identify gaps, clarify responsibilities, and recommend improvements.

Business Intelligence, Reporting, and Analytics

  • Design, develop, maintain, and improve Power BI dashboards, reports, scorecards, and analytical tools for executive and operational audiences.
  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, risks, opportunities, and performance drivers, and communicate insights clearly.
  • Establish consistent reporting definitions, calculations, measures, and business rules while reducing manual reporting, consolidating duplicate reports, and increasing automation and self-service capabilities.
  • Use advanced Excel capabilities for analysis, reconciliation, forecasting, scenario modeling, and business reporting.
  • Support self-service reporting by creating reliable datasets, reusable report templates, clear documentation, and user guidance.

Data Modeling and Technical Development

  • Develop and maintain Power BI semantic models using dimensional-modeling principles, well-defined relationships, measures, dimensions, and hierarchies.
  • Use SQL, DAX, and Power Query to query, validate, transform, and analyze data.
  • Leverage Microsoft Fabric and related Microsoft data tools to support reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Partner with technical resources to ensure reporting requirements are reflected in data models, transformations, and reporting structures.
  • Support appropriate data security, access controls, and report performance optimization.

Data Warehouse and Systems Integration

  • Partner with IT, data engineering resources, external consultants, and business stakeholders to define data requirements and improve data integration, automation, and accessibility.
  • Understand how financial and operational data flows across source systems, Rayfin, data warehouse layers, semantic models, and reporting solutions.
  • Participate in testing and validation of data pipelines, integrations, and reporting outputs and maintain documentation of KPI definitions, business rules, data sources, and reporting logic.

Data Quality, Governance, and Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and resolve data quality, reconciliation, access, performance, and reporting issues in partnership with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement by automating manual processes, simplifying analysis, improving reporting efficiency, and expanding access to trusted information.
  • Develop and execute testing, coordinate user acceptance testing, and reconcile reporting to source systems and approved business totals.
  • Document report purpose, data sources, definitions, assumptions, business rules, and ownership to support consistency and long-term maintainability.
  • Train and support business users on Power BI, trusted datasets, report interpretation, and self-service analytics.
  • Support emerging AI and advanced analytics initiatives by helping define business value, data requirements, validation criteria, risks, and governance considerations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analysis, financial analysis, reporting, business analysis, or a related field.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Fabric Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, Data Factory, or related Microsoft cloud analytics capabilities.
  • Hands-on experience developing Power BI reports and semantic models using DAX and Power Query.
  • Working proficiency with SQL for data analysis, reconciliation, testing, and validation.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements and translating them into reporting, analytics, or process-improvement solutions.
  • Experience with dimensional data modeling, KPI development, data visualization, data quality, and user acceptance testing.
  • Working knowledge of financial and operational reporting, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and performance metrics.
  • Ability to communicate complex data and technical concepts clearly to both business and technical audiences.
  • Ability to lead requirements discovery, clarify ambiguous requests, define KPIs and business rules, and establish measurable acceptance criteria.

Physical Environment

The physical requirements listed here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • This position requires the ability to sit or stand for extended periods of time while performing office tasks and have the capacity to maintain proper posture and ergonomics to prevent discomfort or injury.
  • This position requires manual dexterity and proficiency in using computer keyboards, mice, and other office equipment.
  • This position must have the ability to handle and manipulate paperwork, files, and office supplies.
  • This role may occasionally visit construction sites to where they will be exposed to the outdoors and possible inclement weather conditions.

Culture & Total Rewards Approach

Why Join Enclave?

When you become part of Enclave, you join a team of trailblazers in the real estate, construction, and property management industry. Our collaborative and fun-loving culture encourages you to thrive both professionally and personally. Our Core Values define what we say and do.

  • Care For Each Other: We value people for who they are and take pride in our relationships with team members, clients, and partners
  • Do The Honorable Thing: We are committed to upholding the highest standards in our words and actions.
  • Be Empowered: We encourage true autonomy, which results in team members who are remarkably inspired and high-performing.
  • Promote Innovation: We constantly reach further and don't accept the status quo to bring the best service and product to the marketplace.

Total Rewards Approach

Our salary ranges are established based on a combination of market data, internal equity, and the unique characteristics of our organization such as our size, revenue, and industry. Within the range, individual pay is determined by multiple factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

At Enclave, we’re proud to offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports your personal well-being, professional growth, and financial future.

Financial Wellbeing

  • Competitive base salary with ongoing performance review
  • Role specific bonus potential
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Various supplemental insurance options
  • Employee referral program

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental & vision plans
  • Company-paid life & disability insurance
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) with employer contribution
  • Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Mental health resources & employee assistance programs
  • Paid bereavement & parental leave program
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) plans, paid holiday and volunteer programs

Career & Culture

  • Tuition reimbursement and leadership development opportunities
  • Team-building and community engagement opportunities
  • Employee recognition programs
  • Supportive, values-driven work environment
  • Regular team member feedback surveys to drive workplace improvements

At Enclave, we build more than spaces—we build rewarding careers. Join a team where your growth is supported, your contributions are valued, and your future is invested in.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future (e.g., H-1B, TN, F-1 OPT).

About the Role:

We are seeking an exceptional Data Analyst to join our DIG (Data & Insights Group) team. Our team delivers insightful, high-quality dashboards, pipelines, and reports to internal teams delivering value that would have otherwise been overlooked. Think of us like bridge builders: we build the support beams, develop the infrastructure, and create the custom analyses that allow other teams to leverage data to make decisions.

The Data Analyst leverages advanced analytical techniques and business knowledge to support data-driven decision-making across multiple business departments. Since one of DIG’s main goals is to uncover hidden but valuable insights, you will explore ad data for opportunities and bring them forward with evidence and recommendations.You will also collaborate with stakeholders to develop visualizations and reports that effectively communicate findings, while supporting process improvements and project delivery.



Key Responsibilities

  • Own internal client-facing analysis end-to-end. This means you will build, maintain and produce key reports for internal clients across our data ecosystem, from scoping to delivery
  • Be a thought partner for our client-facing teams (especially sales). Here you will use a deep understanding of both the external client’s needs and the adtech ecosystem to partner with stakeholders, answering questions via analytically robust reports and presentations.
  • In order to carry out the responsibilities of the second bulleted item, you will need to develop deep domain expertise. Ad tech is an exciting, ever-evolving landscape that takes patience to fully understand (and even then you’ll still need to continue learning) so you need to have a love for learning.
  • Build scalable report automation. You will need to collaborate with data engineers to create maintainable automations to build a library of reports.


Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Bachelor's Degree OR 3+ years of related experience (Required)
  • 2-4 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, Analytics Engineering or a similar data-centric role.
  • Modern data stack: AWS, SQL at scale, Python, PostgreSQL, BASH
  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Python libraries, Tableau, AWS Quicksight or PowerBI to create clear and impactful graphical representations.
  • Track record of translating data insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders.
  • Automation mindset with a bias towards scalability over one-off work.

Benefits

  • Full-time position with a competitive base salary
  • Access to benefits, including Healthcare, Dental, and Vision
  • Unlimited PTO - take what you need
  • HSA/FSA match program
  • Participation in Big Happy’s stock program
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Half-Day Fridays (except Q4)
  • Team Happy camaraderie—celebrating wins, learning from challenges, and fostering continuous career growth
  • A workplace culture where you can be yourself, contribute meaningfully, and be valued for your impact
Compensation: $75,000 - $95,000 total compensation, inclusive of base pay ($67,500-$83,000) and bonuses. Compensation range will be determined by each candidate's location and expertise.

Location: This opportunity is Remote in the United States, except for candidates within commuting distance of our NYC or Chicago offices, where this opportunity is hybrid with 3 days in the office.
