Job Description

The BI Developer (Intermediate) at UT Health San Antonio supports clinical, operational, and financial decision making by transforming complex healthcare data into meaningful, actionable insights. Working under supervision, this role designs, develops, tests, and maintains reporting and analytics solutions, with Epic serving as the primary platform.

The BI Developer partners with clinical, operational, and Health Information Systems stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable dashboards, reports, and key performance indicators. This role applies strong analytical thinking, data modeling principles, and SQL expertise to ensure accurate, reliable, and high quality reporting solutions. In addition to Epic reporting tools such as Radar, Reporting Workbench, SlicerDicer, and Clarity or Caboodle, familiarity with Advanced Analytics Plus capabilities, including data science and artificial intelligence tools, is valued.

The position participates in Epic upgrade activities, including testing and validation, and provides limited after hours on call support during designated rotation periods a few weeks per year. The BI Developer contributes to continuous improvement efforts, data governance practices, and the ongoing evolution of the organization’s analytics environment.

Responsibilities

  • Gather and analyze business requirements to perform data modeling and mapping across multiple platforms for enterprise-wide BI initiatives
  • Apply research and evaluation standards, descriptive statistics, and data management principles to translate complex data into meaningful content.
  • Extract, load and transform data from transactional software systems into analytical software/BI systems.
  • Design, create, test, and maintain a portfolio of reports, scorecards, and dashboards.
  • Role activities include problem analysis, break/fix, design/modeling, implementation/coding, and testing.
  • Responsible for navigating a wealth of data and turning it into actionable and insightful information.
  • Work autonomously and collaboratively with other team members, as well as cross functionally, providing guidance to define report requirements and validate results.
  • Develop and maintain appropriate documentation on all work products. Consult with business customers in the use of analytical & reporting tools to develop effective clinical, cost, quality & satisfaction outcomes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Critical and analytical thinking proficiencies
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Demonstrate the ability to understand troubleshoot software issues
  • Organizational management skills and ability to multitask

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a scientific, technical, healthcare informatics, or mathematics field or four (4) years of comparable experience may be substituted for a degree.

Experience

Zero to one (0-1) years of experience is required.

Licenses/Certifications

  • Certified in Tableau preferred.
  • Familiarity with Business Intelligence and Data Analytics tools preferred.
  • As specified by the department director, Epic certification for assigned modules are required within eighteen (18) months of hire. Epic certification must be maintained per Epic Corporation standards.
  • As specified by the department director, additional certifications for assigned software analytical tools (such as Tableau) are required within thirty-six (36) months of hire. Certification must be maintained per Health-IT standards.

Required Skills

ABOUT US

The University of Texas at San Antonio (UT San Antonio) is a nationally recognized, top-tier public research university that unites the power of higher education, biomedical discovery and healthcare within one visionary institution. As the third-largest research university in Texas and a Carnegie R1-designated institution, UT San Antonio is a model of access and excellence — advancing knowledge, social mobility and public health across South Texas and beyond. UT San Antonio serves approximately 42,000 students in 320 academic programs spanning science, engineering, medicine, health, liberal arts, AI, cybersecurity, business, education and more. With 17,000 faculty and staff, UT San Antonio has been recognized by Forbes as one of America’s Best Employers for Company Culture .

Benefits Overview

UT Health San Antonio offers an excellent benefits package for its employees. Employees who work at least 20 hours a week, with an appointment of at least 4.5 months, are eligible for benefits.

Medical - UT SELECT Medical insurance is offered free for employees and administered by Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Texas. Family members can be added to the plan through payroll deduction. Description

The Amazon Mobile Business Development (MBD) team creates convenience for our customers to experience Amazon services wherever they are by acquiring partner distribution for Amazon Subscriptions (e.g., Prime, Prime Video, Amazon Music Unlimited) and Amazon mobile applications (e.g., Shopping, Video, Music, Kindle, Photo-Cloud Drive, Audible, and IMDB) through mobile operators and OEMs. We are in growth mode, currently expanding our distribution footprint launching our service offerings with partners across the globe and need strong team members to help us achieve our goals.

Fuse Billing Operations Team is looking for a Business Analyst to analyze business trends, define and build reporting and analytic solutions that allows us to make scalable data-based product and business decisions. This role will also identify root causes, implement solutions, and resolve data discrepancies spread across multiple distinct/standalone internal Amazon systems and external partner systems. This role will require regular engagement and alignment with business development, finance operations, product/engineering teams, accounting, tax, and external partners.

This role requires a self-starter who actively engages with cross-functional teams and senior leaders to deliver results. The ideal candidate must be highly analytical, an expert with SQL and Excel, possess a strong passion for analytics, hold high standards for their product, and insist on accuracy and accountability. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required along with the ability to anticipate, identify, and communicate risks to business and leadership. The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous and demanding work environment is critical to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities

Enable effective decision making by retrieving and aggregating from multiple of large data sources and compiling it into a digestible and actionable format

Solve reconciliation issues by diving-deep into the data and implementing solutions to resolve defects

Communicate complex analyses and insights at scale to stakeholders and senior business leaders, both verbally and in writing

Proactively identify, analyze, and solve business problems with focus on understanding root causes and discovering significant forward-looking opportunities

Create and maintain tools, reports, and analyses which support senior leadership and various teams throughout the organization

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
  • 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
  • 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience with Excel
  • Experience with SQL
  • Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
  • Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of driving process improvements experience

descriptionHtml:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
  • Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

Basic Qualifications

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 5 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree plus at least 3 years performing data analytics with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
  • At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
  • At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool
  • At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
  • At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
  • At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
  • At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

On any given day you will be challenged on three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation



- Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
- Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
- Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence



- Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
- Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management



- Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
- Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
- Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

- Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
- Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
- Experience utilizing and developing within AWS services

-  At least 3 years of experience working with at least one scripting language
-  At least 3 years of experience utilizing a business intelligence visualization tool 
-  At least 3 years of experience in querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:



- Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
- At least 4 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
- At least 4 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc. 
- At least 2 years of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
- At least 2 years of experience delivering Data Governance and Data Quality Management concepts and practices within the financial services industry

POSITION: Business Intelligence Analyst

FULL-TIME/PART-TIME: Full Time

LOCATION: Bothell, WA - Hybrid

React Health is a fast-paced, growth-driven manufacturer and distributor of medical equipment, dedicated to supporting patients, caregivers, physicians, and healthcare providers. With a focus on respiratory and sleep health sectors, we offer a comprehensive range of products and services across acute care, non-acute care, and home medical equipment. By integrating manufacturing and distribution, React Health addresses the needs of both undiagnosed individuals and those requiring therapy after diagnosis, particularly within the sleep and respiratory care sectors.

General Summary

The Business Intelligence Analyst will play a pivotal role in supporting data-informed decision-making across our organization. This position will encompass both analytical and development responsibilities - gathering, analyzing, and interpreting business operations data to generate actionable insights, while also designing and maintaining the data infrastructure, pipelines, and BI solutions that enable reporting and analytics at scale.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of experience in the same or similar role.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with business intelligence/data analytics tools (Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, etc.)and proficiency in SQL including complex queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Experience building or maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and familiarity with data warehouse concepts and tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, or similar).

Preferred Education

  • Master’s degree in related field

Preferred Experience

  • Medical / health industry experience
  • Experience with NetSuite
  • Working proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, automation, and analysis (e.g., pandas, numpy, or equivalent libraries).
  • Excellent attention to detail and project management skills.
  • Excellent written/oral communication skills required. Must be able to work effectively with diverse groups of people.

Physical Demands

  • Requires normal visual acuity and hearing.
  • Typically, employees sit comfortably to do their work, interspersed by brief periods of standing, walking, bending, carrying papers and books, and extensive periods requiring the use of computer terminals to accomplish work objectives.
  • Required to sit and use their hands and fingers to handle or feel and manipulate keys on a keyboard.
  • Additional skills may be required to perform additional task(s) specific to work location, department or line of business.

Working Conditions

  • Predominantly operates in an office environment. Some work (less than 5%) requires moving and lifting of computer or networking equipment.

Duties And Essential Functions

Each Employee consistently demonstrates the following essential functions:

  • Perform data analysis to gain insights into various aspects of business performance, including revenue generation, customer behavior, market trends, and operational excellence.
  • Support the assessment of the effectiveness of business strategies and initiatives by providing data-driven insights and recommendations for optimization.
  • Analyze metrics related to business growth and customer retention, identifying patterns and opportunities for improvement.
  • Conduct analyses to identify root causes behind business challenges and contribute to proposing actionable solutions for improvement.
  • Development of visually appealing dashboards and data visualizations using industry-standard tools to present key business metrics and insights.
  • Assist in creating interactive visualizations that enable stakeholders to explore data and gain actionable insights to inform decision-making.
  • Support the design and maintenance of dashboards and reports to monitor performance across various business functions, such as sales, finance, and operations.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and data models to extract, transform, and prepare data from multiple source systems.
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT data pipelines to ensure reliable, timely, and accurate data delivery from source systems to the data warehouse or reporting layer.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and assist in translating them into meaningful data insights and visualization solutions.
  • Support documentation efforts by capturing methodologies, data sources, and key findings to establish a comprehensive knowledge base for business intelligence.
  • Participate in knowledge-sharing sessions with stakeholders to enhance their understanding of data insights and contribute to fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.
  • Attends and participates in departmental meetings. Attends seminars and training sessions necessary to maintain appropriate level of professional competence. Ensures all department compliance guidelines are met.
  • Attends all meetings, in-services training, or continuing education as delegated by the supervisor.
  • Provides customer focused interactions.
  • Performs all duties necessary for the department as per department policies and procedures.
  • Performs other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the supervisor within the scope of practice and the responsibilities in the department.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to accommodate individuals with disabilities to perform the basic functions of the position without compromising client care. React Health is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to providing a drug-free workplace. We are an Equal-Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

Location: Dallas, Alpharetta, Charlotte, Jacksonville, and San Antonio

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Position Summary

This role will help consolidate identity and access data across enterprise systems, strengthen operational reporting, and provide timely insights into the client’s access-risk posture.

The analyst will engage with data-source owners, engineers, product owners, architects, and business partners to define data requirements, profile and validate source data, document lineage, and translate business needs into scalable data models and ingestion patterns. The role will support access-governance applications, enterprise controls, remediation activities, and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage with IAM data-source owners and stakeholders to gather requirements, identify authoritative data, and define data needed to support risk-reduction objectives and access-governance processes.
  • Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into conceptual, logical, and physical data models that address data quality, performance, lineage, and scalability.
  • Create, maintain, and scale repeatable data-ingestion patterns supporting operational reporting across thousands of enterprise systems.
  • Profile, map, reconcile, and validate identity, account, entitlement, credential, inventory, activity, and control-related data from multiple source systems.
  • Document source-to-target mappings, data lineage, transformation logic, control points, and data-flow diagrams.
  • Combine data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, coverage gaps, and actionable IAM risk insights.
  • Define data-quality rules, metrics, and exception-handling processes; investigate data discrepancies and support remediation with source owners and engineering teams.
  • Write and interpret SQL and scripts to query, manipulate, reconcile, and profile data across cloud and on-premises platforms.
  • Support engineers in designing and validating ETL pipelines, data transformations, operational data-store structures, and reporting datasets.
  • Develop requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, and supporting evidence for new data sources, reporting features, and control enhancements.
  • Create dashboards, reports, and visualizations that clearly communicate access-risk posture, control coverage, data quality, operational trends, and remediation priorities.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, sprint planning, demonstrations, testing, release readiness, and continuous-improvement activities.
  • Maintain data dictionaries, requirements documentation, analytical findings, process flows, operating procedures, and stakeholder-ready materials.
  • Work independently through ambiguity while proactively seeking decisions, clarifications, and support when necessary.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, information systems, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Approximately 6–9 years of experience in data analysis, systems analysis, business analysis, data engineering support, or a related role.
  • Demonstrated experience with requirements elicitation, gap analysis, data mining, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, and data-quality assessment.
  • Strong understanding of dimensional, relational, and unstructured data-modeling concepts.
  • Experience developing conceptual, logical, and physical data models, including third normal form in relational database environments.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with one or more scripting languages such as Python, R, Unix shell scripting, or PL/SQL.
  • Working knowledge of database and data-platform technologies such as Snowflake, Oracle, and Microsoft SQL Server.
  • Experience supporting data warehouses, operational data stores, ETL processes, data pipelines, or comparable data-integration solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to combine complex data from multiple systems, identify meaningful trends, and translate findings into clear recommendations.
  • Experience developing dashboards and data visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, or comparable reporting tools.
  • Ability to communicate complex data concepts, issues, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment with changing business and technology priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with identity and access management, identity governance, cybersecurity, technology risk, or access-control data.
  • Familiarity with IAM data domains such as identities, accounts, entitlements, applications, credentials, access activity, certifications, and lifecycle events.
  • Experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ or AccessHub and related access-governance reporting.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, Confluence, or comparable workflow and Agile-delivery platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake and modern cloud-based data platforms.
  • Experience using data-modeling or lineage-documentation tools.
  • Familiarity with graph databases or analytics platforms such as Neo4j.
  • Experience in a regulated financial-services environment.
  • Familiarity with audit evidence, control reporting, data governance, and risk-remediation processes.

Technology Environment

  • Data analysis and scripting: SQL, PL/SQL, Python, R, and Unix shell scripting.
  • Data platforms: Snowflake, Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, relational databases, operational data stores, and enterprise data warehouses.
  • Data integration: ETL pipelines, repeatable ingestion patterns, source-to-target mapping, data profiling, reconciliation, transformation, and lineage management.
  • Reporting and visualization: Tableau, Power BI, operational dashboards, control reporting, and data-quality metrics.
  • IAM ecosystem: SailPoint IdentityIQ / AccessHub and identity, account, entitlement, credential, inventory, activity, certification, and lifecycle data sources.
  • Delivery and collaboration: Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, Agile delivery methods, documentation repositories, and cross-functional engineering processes.
  • Emerging analytics: Neo4j graph analytics and AI-assisted use cases for IAM insights, analysis, impact assessment, and remediation decision support.

Success Measures

  • Accurate, timely, and scalable data-ingestion patterns supporting IAM operational reporting across in-scope systems.
  • Improved completeness, quality, traceability, and reliability of identity and access data.
  • Clear source-to-target mappings, lineage documentation, and data-quality controls.
  • Actionable dashboards and analyses that improve visibility into access risk, control coverage, operational trends, and remediation priorities.
  • Well-defined requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and test evidence that enable successful engineering delivery.
  • Timely resolution of data issues through effective collaboration with data-source owners, engineers, architects, product owners, and business partners.
  • Consistent delivery against sprint and release commitments while adhering to Fidelity security, data, architecture, and engineering standards.

What We Offer You

At EY, we harness our collective strength to empower you to shape your future with confidence through professional growth, personal fulfillment and an inclusive culture. Learn more at ey.com/us/careers.

  • The salary range for this job is:
    • New York City, Boston, and Washington DC Metro Areas, Washington State, and Southern California offices – $92,900 to $153,900
    • Bay Area California offices – $96,000 to $160,500
    • All other offices locations in the US, including Sacramento – $77,500 to $140,900
  • Individual salaries within these ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.

  • To make the most of your application experience, please limit yourself to two applications within a six-month period.
  • EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.
  • For those living in California, please click here for additional information.

Any misrepresentation or falsification of information or lack of integrity at any point in the recruiting process may result in withdrawal of your candidacy, revocation of an offer or immediate termination of employment.

descriptionHtml:
Why This Role Matters

The decisions our leaders make every day, from operations and growth strategy to customer experience, depend on having the right data at the right time. As our Business Intelligence Analyst, you'll be the person who transforms complex data into clear insights, helping teams across the organization make smarter, faster decisions that drive measurable business results.

This is a role for someone who enjoys owning projects from discovery through delivery, partnering directly with stakeholders, and seeing their work influence real-world outcomes.


What You'll Actually Do

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports used across the business to monitor performance and support decision-making.
  • Partner with business leaders and department stakeholders to understand challenges, uncover reporting needs, and deliver practical, user-friendly solutions.
  • Manage BI projects from initial requirements gathering through development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement.
  • Connect Power BI to our Databricks environment and develop scalable, well-structured data models that support reporting needs.
  • Create and maintain star schema data models, advanced DAX calculations, and Power Query (M) transformations.
  • Administer Power BI Service, including workspace management, report deployment, refresh schedules, row-level security, and governance.
  • Analyze trends, identify opportunities, and present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate with teammates to establish and improve BI standards, documentation, and best practices.


What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you'll have:

  • Built strong working relationships with key business stakeholders across multiple departments.
  • Taken ownership of several active reporting initiatives and delivered at least one end-to-end Power BI solution.
  • Developed a clear understanding of our Databricks environment, core datasets, and reporting standards.
  • Become a trusted resource for translating business questions into actionable reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Contributed improvements to existing dashboards, data models, or BI processes that increase usability, performance, or adoption.

What You'll Actually Do in Your First 30 Days

  • Meet with department leaders and key stakeholders to understand existing reports, business priorities, and recurring reporting challenges.
  • Learn the Databricks data environment, reporting architecture, and Power BI governance standards.
  • Review current dashboards and identify opportunities for performance, usability, or visualization improvements.
  • Take ownership of your first reporting project, including requirements gathering, development planning, and stakeholder communication.


Must Have

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in Power BI.
  • Strong expertise in DAX, Power Query (M), and dimensional data modeling.
  • Experience using Databricks as a reporting data source, including writing SQL against Databricks tables.
  • Experience administering Power BI Service, including workspaces, refresh schedules, security, and deployments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading reporting or analytics projects from stakeholder request through final delivery.

Nice to Have

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Experience with Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, or Power BI performance optimization on large datasets.
  • Experience working with Agile tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Familiarity with the Oil & Gas industry.
  • Experience presenting analytical findings to executive or senior leadership audiences.


Why Join Us

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with decision-makers, see the impact of your work, and help shape how data is used across the organization. This is a role where strong ideas, curiosity, and practical problem-solving are valued as much as technical expertise.

Role Details

  • Location: Chicago (onsite)
  • Compensation: Starting at $90,000 (based on experience)
  • Direct Reports: None


What We Offer

In addition to competitive pay we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your physical, financial, and personal well-being:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Voluntary life, AD&D, and short-term disability coverage
  • Paid holidays and time off
  • $50,000 basic life/AD&D and long-term disability at no cost
  • Propane discount


Our Culture

We're a collaborative team that values thoughtful questions, open communication, and continuous improvement. You'll work alongside people who genuinely enjoy solving problems together and who care more about delivering results than protecting titles or silos.

  • Lead reporting initiatives related to Oracle ERP and associated business systems, including implementations, upgrades, data migrations, and building and maintaining SQL-based reporting to support Sales Operations
  • Design, optimize, and maintain complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and scripts across multiple data environments and sources
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions using Power BI, Oracle reporting tools, Microsoft Excel, and other business intelligence platforms
  • Deliver high-impact reporting and actionable insights on sales performance, forecasting, and key business metrics to support strategic decision-making
  • Collect, cleanse, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources to support business intelligence initiatives
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, consistency, and performance across all reporting and analytics environments
  • Partner with IT and cross-functional stakeholders to enhance data accessibility, reporting capabilities, and decision-support tools
  • Establish and champion best practices for reporting development, documentation, testing, deployment, and data governance
  • Lead and support strategic initiatives focused on process improvement, operational excellence, and reporting modernization
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities that streamline reporting and data management activities
  • Perform root-cause analysis and resolve data, reporting, visualization, and system integration issues
  • Develop and maintain advanced VBA solutions, macros, and automated workflows to improve efficiency
  • Mentor analysts and business users on reporting tools, data interpretation, and analytics best practices

Additional Essential Functions Of The Position

  • Demonstrate consistent, reliable, and professional work performance.
  • Successfully manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Exercise sound judgment and independent decision-making
  • Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and business stakeholders
  • Maintain strong attention to detail while balancing strategic priorities
  • Perform additional duties and special projects as assigned

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Finance, Statistics, Mathematics or related field, or demonstrated equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 5+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field
  • 3+ years of advanced Power BI development experience, including complex data modeling and DAX
  • Expert-level SQL skills with demonstrated experience developing complex queries, views, stored procedures, and data transformation logic
  • Experience working with Oracle ERP or other Oracle reporting environments
  • Advanced experience designing and maintaining reporting and dashboard solutions
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including advanced formulas, Power Query, and VBA/macros development
  • Strong experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple systems and sources
  • Proven ability to gather business requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking abilities
  • Highly effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to travel 10%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or related discipline
  • 7+ years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a related field
  • 5+ years of Power BI development experience
  • 3+ years of Oracle ERP or other Oracle reporting experience
  • 3+ years sales operations experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology or medical device industry
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Services, and cloud-based analytics platforms

Other Requirements

  • Ability to regularly walk, sit, or stand as needed
  • Ability to occasionally bend and push/pull as needed
  • Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and background check

descriptionHtml:
Purpose Brands, the parent company of Orangetheory, Anytime Fitness, Waxing the City, and The Bar Method, is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst II, to join its team. This is a great position for someone who is looking to expand their career, and join a company with a fun, fast-paced and inspirational culture.

As part of our Analytics team, this data and analytics professional analyzes business questions, assesses the impact of business initiatives. They think critically, are mathematically savvy, know how to query data, and apply analytical methods to derive insights. They work with our data engineers to augment datasets to enable dashboarding, reports, and operationalizing insights. They partner with business stakeholders to help them make use of analysis results and deploy data-informed decision-making processes.

Purpose/Impact: (Duties & Essential Functions)

Reporting & Analytics

  • Analyze business questions and communicate findings through briefs, presentations, reports or other media. Clarify and document the questions, how findings may be used, and the analysis approach.
  • Conduct impact analyses, leading to a deeper understanding of business performance, the member experience and fitness results. Guidance on approach provided by senior analyst or BI Manager.
  • Develop simple deterministic models that project outcomes based on observed relationships, e.g., break-even projections, simple systems models.
  • Develop reports and dashboards for an entire problem space, such as website performance, lead conversion or studio portfolio analysis. These are product features that are supported and evolved over time as opposed to one-off analyses.
  • Develop internal and external documentation and training on Analytics products, such as dashboards, reports, KPI's, source data collection and transformation, data lineage and suggested use cases.
  • Develop end-user applications with low-code tools to surface actionable analytics insights, collect data or execute analytics driven workflows/actions.
  • Work with data engineers to augment existing datasets with metrics and categorizations that make it easier to answer common business and analysis questions and publish appropriate reports.
  • Build the company knowledge base of data-informed insights, documenting findings and promoting and communicating those findings through appropriate internal channels.

Performance Expectations

  • Able to develop or collaborate with a data engineer on the design (metrics, attributes) of “last mile” datasets for analyzing common questions in a specific business domain.
  • Well versed in most of the functionality our BI platforms offer and able to make efficient use of them.
  • Uses a toolkit of analytic methods, e.g., variance analysis, sampling, establishing correlations, methods of analyzing causality to answer business questions with data.
  • Able to ask questions to fully understand the context and business question asked and how answering it will make a difference. Occasionally still needs help from senior analyst or manager to frame the problem.
  • Chooses or proposes a path of inquiry that is logical and coherent.
  • Follows applicable COE (Center of Excellence) tenets and methodologies when analyzing business questions or developing reports and dashboards.
  • Makes accurate inferences from the data most of the time. Still needs some help from more senior analysts or manager to validate conclusions.
  • Presents findings in an easy-to-understand way for business stakeholders, using COE practices.
  • Shares and documents approach and findings, making sure the rest of the team has visibility and can build on them.
  • Is recognized by business stakeholders as contributing to their decision-making processes or improving their operations.
  • Regularly reviews work with more senior analysts, seeks to learn and incorporates learnings into work products.

Background and Strengths

  • BS/BA in computer science, statistics, mathematics, business administration, economics, or related field with a focus on logic and quantitative analysis.
  • 3-5 years of experience in reporting and analysis. Experience with implementing, maintaining or developing reporting in Power BI, Tableau or comparable platforms is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of statistics (sampling, statistical significance).
  • Proficiency in querying and manipulating data using SQL. Know how to use subqueries, window and analytic functions, regular expressions.
  • Experience with Python, R or similar languages.

Strengths

  • Well organized. Thinks about how to do the work, then acts. Seeks to contextualize the work.
  • Demonstrates understanding of which analytic methods to use to answer certain types of questions.
  • Good interpersonal skills, seeks to understand others’ viewpoints, motivations, ways of thinking.
  • Communicates clearly and knows best practices for presentations.
  • Shows curiosity about the industry and can explain how our brands are differentiated.

Salary Range: $90k - $115k

What’s in it for you?

We offer a competitive salary along with exceptional benefits such as:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage
  • Hybrid Work Environment
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Unlimited Time off + Paid Holidays
  • Flexible Friday's between Memorial Day and Labor Day
  • 401(K) Savings Plan Matching at 4%
  • 10 Coaching and Therapy sessions
  • Mental Health Benefits
  • Brand Discounts & Reimbursements
  • In-house workout facilities
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Team Building, Employee Engagement Activities & so much more

WORK SCHEDULE

Purpose Brands LLC, Currently Observe The Following Hybrid Work Model For Employees At Our Boca Raton (FL), Woodbury (MN), And Seattle (WA) Offices

  • Remote optional: Fridays
  • On-site days: Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION STATEMENT

Purpose Brands is committed to encouraging, facilitating, and upholding an environment centered on diversity, equity, and inclusion across every facet of the Purpose Brands. We will work to create a sustainable culture that supports a healthy space for learning and growing, valuing, and empowering every employee, inspiring a diverse franchise network, and uplifting the members and communities we serve.

descriptionText:
Purpose Brands, the parent company of Orangetheory, Anytime Fitness, Waxing the City, and The Bar Method, is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst II, to join its team. This is a great position for someone who is looking to expand their career, and join a company with a fun, fast-paced and inspirational culture.

As part of our Analytics team, this data and analytics professional analyzes business questions, assesses the impact of business initiatives. They think critically, are mathematically savvy, know how to query data, and apply analytical methods to derive insights. They work with our data engineers to augment datasets to enable dashboarding, reports, and operationalizing insights. They partner with business stakeholders to help them make use of analysis results and deploy data-informed decision-making processes.

Purpose/Impact: (Duties & Essential Functions) 

Reporting & Analytics



- Analyze business questions and communicate findings through briefs, presentations, reports or other media. Clarify and document the questions, how findings may be used, and the analysis approach.
- Conduct impact analyses, leading to a deeper understanding of business performance, the member experience and fitness results. Guidance on approach provided by senior analyst or BI Manager.
- Develop simple deterministic models that project outcomes based on observed relationships, e.g., break-even projections, simple systems models.
- Develop reports and dashboards for an entire problem space, such as website performance, lead conversion or studio portfolio analysis. These are product features that are supported and evolved over time as opposed to one-off analyses.
- Develop internal and external documentation and training on Analytics products, such as dashboards, reports, KPI's, source data collection and transformation, data lineage and suggested use cases.
- Develop end-user applications with low-code tools to surface actionable analytics insights, collect data or execute analytics driven workflows/actions.
- Work with data engineers to augment existing datasets with metrics and categorizations that make it easier to answer common business and analysis questions and publish appropriate reports.
- Build the company knowledge base of data-informed insights, documenting findings and promoting and communicating those findings through appropriate internal channels.

Performance Expectations



- Able to develop or collaborate with a data engineer on the design (metrics, attributes) of “last mile” datasets for analyzing common questions in a specific business domain.
- Well versed in most of the functionality our BI platforms offer and able to make efficient use of them.
- Uses a toolkit of analytic methods, e.g., variance analysis, sampling, establishing correlations, methods of analyzing causality to answer business questions with data.
- Able to ask questions to fully understand the context and business question asked and how answering it will make a difference. Occasionally still needs help from senior analyst or manager to frame the problem.
- Chooses or proposes a path of inquiry that is logical and coherent.
- Follows applicable COE (Center of Excellence) tenets and methodologies when analyzing business questions or developing reports and dashboards.
- Makes accurate inferences from the data most of the time. Still needs some help from more senior analysts or manager to validate conclusions.
- Presents findings in an easy-to-understand way for business stakeholders, using COE practices. 
- Shares and documents approach and findings, making sure the rest of the team has visibility and can build on them.
- Is recognized by business stakeholders as contributing to their decision-making processes or improving their operations.
- Regularly reviews work with more senior analysts, seeks to learn and incorporates learnings into work products. 

Background and Strengths



- BS/BA in computer science, statistics, mathematics, business administration, economics, or related field with a focus on logic and quantitative analysis.
- 3-5 years of experience in reporting and analysis. Experience with implementing, maintaining or developing reporting in Power BI, Tableau or comparable platforms is a plus.
- Basic understanding of statistics (sampling, statistical significance).
- Proficiency in querying and manipulating data using SQL. Know how to use subqueries, window and analytic functions, regular expressions. 
- Experience with Python, R or similar languages.

Strengths



- Well organized. Thinks about how to do the work, then acts. Seeks to contextualize the work.
- Demonstrates understanding of which analytic methods to use to answer certain types of questions.
- Good interpersonal skills, seeks to understand others’ viewpoints, motivations, ways of thinking.
- Communicates clearly and knows best practices for presentations.
- Shows curiosity about the industry and can explain how our brands are differentiated.

Salary Range: $90k - $115k

descriptionHtml:
ADP is hiring a Business Intelligence Manager (Individual Contributor) for the HR Outsourcing (HRO) Analytics organization. This senior individual-contributor role is accountable for developing and maintaining reports and dashboards, with an emphasis on generating value-driven insights and KPIs to support business decision-making. The Business Intelligence Manager will lead complex analytics initiatives, leverage advanced business intelligence techniques, and partner with stakeholders to translate data into actionable insights. Through data visualization, analytics, stakeholder engagement, and continuous process improvement, this role will enable informed organizational decision-making.

What Are We Looking For?

Someone who thinks analytically and enjoys turning complex data into compelling stories and actionable insights. The ideal candidate has a passion for continuous improvement, data exploration, data analysis, and data visualization. They enjoy solving business problems through data and identifying opportunities to drive measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is business-minded, detail-oriented, self-motivated, collaborative, and comfortable operating in ambiguity. They possess strong communication skills, excel at building stakeholder relationships, and are willing to roll up their sleeves to tackle complex challenges and deliver results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of business processes, objectives, and requirements to generate meaningful insights and visualizations.
  • Develop visualizations and analytical insights that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define requirements, validate data, and ensure the accuracy and relevance of analytical solutions.
  • Apply BI standards and best practices to maintain the quality and integrity of the HRO Analytics brand.
  • Design, develop, and implement intuitive dashboards that enable business stakeholders to easily interpret and act on data.
  • Coach business partners on how to leverage dashboards and analytical insights to support decision-making.
  • Lead complex analytics initiatives from requirements gathering through development, implementation, and stakeholder adoption.

Behaviors

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive self-starter requiring minimal guidance, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrates a can-do attitude and takes initiative to drive solutions and business outcomes.
  • Demonstrates strong adherence to Agile methodologies, with a focus on delivering MVPs, meeting commitments, and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Team-oriented, with a strong focus on business stakeholders and the end-user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical discipline, such as Business Management, Finance, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Advanced proficiency in exploratory data analysis (EDA).
  • Advanced proficiency in developing and executing ETL processes independently using SQL, Python, Alteryx, or a combination of these technologies.
  • Advanced proficiency in BI and data visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI, as well as Excel.
  • Experience accessing and working with relational databases, large datasets, and analytical data models.
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to generate insights and communicate findings through effective presentations and visualizations.
  • Technical expertise in database development, data mining, and segmentation techniques.
  • Advanced proficiency in trend analysis, root cause analysis, and other diagnostic analytical methods.
  • Proficiency in prescriptive analytics and hypothesis testing.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, storytelling, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to management, team members, and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in analytics, an MBA, or a related field.
  • Experience in the HCM/PEO industry.
  • Experience supporting change management or large-scale transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leveraging AI and agentic development to create assets and insights.

A little about ADP: We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down-to-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition for our work by many esteemed organizations, learn more at ADP Awards and Recognition.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at ADP: ADP is committed to an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace, and is further committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic including: race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, protected veteran status or disability. Hiring decisions are based upon ADP’s operating needs, and applicant merit including, but not limited to, qualifications, experience, ability, availability, cooperation, and job performance.

Ethics at ADP: ADP has a long, proud history of conducting business with the highest ethical standards and full compliance with all applicable laws. We also expect our people to uphold our values with the highest level of integrity and behave in a manner that fosters an honest and respectful workplace. descriptionHtml:
At Capital One, data is at the center of everything we do. When we launched as a startup we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.

As a Data Analyst at Capital One you will leverage analytic and technical skills to innovate, build, and maintain well-managed data solutions and capabilities to tackle business problems.

On any given day you will be challenged by three types of work – Innovation, Business Intelligence and Data Management:

Innovation

  • Use Open Source/Digital technologies to mine complex, voluminous, and different varieties of data sources and platforms
  • Build well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers
  • Demonstrate ability to explore and quickly grasp new technologies to progress varied initiatives

Business Intelligence

  • Partner with the business to provide consultancy and translate the business needs to design and develop tools, techniques, metrics, and dashboards for insights and data visualization
  • Drive analysis that provides meaningful insights on business strategies

Data Management

  • Drive an understanding and adherence to the principles of data quality management including metadata, lineage, and business definitions
  • Work collaboratively with appropriate Tech teams to manage security mechanisms and data access governance
  • Build and execute tools to monitor and report on data quality

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Degree specialized in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • Scripting experience in (Python, R, Spark, and SQL)
  • Strong desire and experience with data in various forms (data warehouses/SQL, unstructured data)
  • Experience utilizing and developing within Snowflake services

Basic Qualifications:

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor’s Degree in quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field) plus at least 2 years of experience performing data analytics, or currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Master’s Degree with an expectation that required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date.
  • At least 1 year of experience working with at least one scripting language
  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing business intelligence visualization tool
  • At least 1 year of experience querying, analyzing and working with data languages and platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s Degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics discipline
  • At least 2 years of experience coding in Python, R, Spark, or SQL
  • At least 2 years of experience working within process management and improvement methodologies – Agile, Lean, Six Sigma, etc.
  • At least 1 year of experience utilizing and developing within AWS services
  • At least 1 year of experience working with and demonstrating knowledge of data governance, data quality management concepts and data quality tools (i.e. Informatica DQ)

Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position.

This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

McLean, VA: $111,200 - $126,900 for Sr. Data Analyst

Richmond, VA: $101,100 - $115,400 for Sr. Data Analyst

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

descriptionHtml:
NREIG is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join our team in the Oklahoma City or Kansas City metropolitan areas. This entry-level role is ideal for professionals looking to grow their analytical skills in a dynamic, data-driven environment. You will support business decisions by collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data to uncover trends, patterns, and insights.


Essential Functions

  • Collect, clean, and validate data from internal and external sources.
  • Analyze datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI.
  • Write and optimize SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data needs and deliver insights.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining data documentation and reporting standards.
  • Support ad hoc analysis and contribute to ongoing data initiatives.
  • Perform exploratory data analysis to identify trends and anomalies.


Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
  • Proficiency in Power BI for data visualization and reporting.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL for querying and data manipulation.
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks.
  • Strong communication skills to present findings clearly and effectively.
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, and/or Python
  • Understanding of data modeling and ETL processes.
  • Exposure to business intelligence or analytics projects.


Please note that candidates outside of the Oklahoma City or Kansas City metropolitan areas will not be considered at this time. We will only consider candidates who are eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship at this time.

We believe NREIG is for everyone - we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

The opportunity

Delaware North Sportservice is hiring a Regional Analytics Analyst to join our team at KeyBank Center, home of the Buffalo Sabres in Buffalo, New York, while also supporting the Sportservice operations at other assigned units.

As a Regional Analytics Analyst, you will leverage data and analytics to drive informed decision-making, operational excellence, and revenue growth. This role focuses on executing revenue-generating initiatives, developing innovative analytical approaches, and supporting long-term strategic planning across assigned client locations. As the lead analytics partner for your assigned units, you will serve as the primary point of contact for all business intelligence and analytics-related initiatives.

Must be legally authorized to work in the US without sponsorship.

Pay

Minimum – Anticipated Maximum Base Salary: $62,354 - $66,800 / year

In addition to base salary, we offer an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. The advertised pay range represents what we believe at the time of this job posting, that we would be willing to pay for this position. Only in special circumstances, where a candidate has education, training, or experience that far exceeds the requirements for the position, would we consider paying higher than the stated range. Information on our comprehensive benefits package can be found at https://careers.delawarenorth.com/benefits/.

What We Offer

At Delaware North, we care about our team members' personal and professional journeys. These are just some of the benefits we offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
  • Annual performance bonus based on level, as well as individual, company, and location performance
  • Paid vacation days and holidays
  • Paid parental bonding leave
  • Tuition and/or professional certification reimbursement
  • Generous friends-and-family discounts at many of our hotels and resorts

What will you do?

  • Conduct ongoing, in-depth analysis to uncover actionable insights from transactional sales data sourced from point-of-sale systems and other operational platforms
  • Develop data visualizations, dashboards, and reporting tools in Tableau to support internal and external performance reporting and KPI tracking
  • Partner with clients and operators to understand core business needs and help develop strategic action plans tailored to market opportunities
  • Collaborate closely with clients’ analytics and business intelligence teams, serving as an extension of their organizations to support strategic decision-making, align reporting and analytics priorities, and drive data-informed business outcomes across assigned venues and markets
  • Utilize business intelligence, research, and industry trends to support brand growth and identify opportunities to expand market impact Prepare presentations, reports, and dashboards that communicate fact-based findings, strategic recommendations, and next steps from analytics initiatives
  • Support data architecture and warehousing efforts while gathering feedback from site teams and clients to maximize data usability and value
  • Assist in the development and rollout of value-added programs, platforms, initiatives, and processes that strengthen client relationships
  • Collaborate with the Delaware North IT team on technology implementations, including POS systems, with a focus on building scalable and effective data categorizations
  • Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and operational leaders to share and implement best practices, systems, and processes
  • Partner with the broader data and analytics team to identify and execute initiatives that improve operational efficiency and business performance
  • Support the Manager, Business Insights & Analytics and department leadership with ad hoc analytics and strategic projects
  • Perform additional responsibilities as assigned by GMs, VPOs, and other business stakeholders

More About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, mathematics, engineering, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in business analytics, business intelligence, or a related function within a high-volume, fast-paced environment; hospitality or sports industry experience preferred
  • Strong proficiency in analytics and predictive modeling tools such as Advanced Excel, R, or similar platforms
  • Experience with data warehousing and querying tools such as SQL
  • Proficiency in data visualization platforms, with Tableau strongly preferred
  • Experience and/or expertise in using generative AI tools and implementing them in business processes
  • Prior experience working with point-of-sale systems preferred
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to translate analytics into compelling business narratives for stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to connect analytics and insights to broader business objectives, including marketing strategy, revenue optimization, and industry trends
  • Experience supporting sales strategy, business planning, and long-term growth initiatives
  • Ability to travel up to 10% as needed

Shift details

Days

Who We Are

Delaware North operates concessions, clubs, and suites for the NHL's Buffalo Sabres at KeyBank Center and has been a partner of the Sabres since 1970, the year the team was founded. We manage concession outlets, suites, and clubs, including a members-only fine dining restaurant, at the 19,200-seat arena.

Our business is all about people, and that includes you. At Delaware North, you’re not just part of a team — you’re part of a global legacy: a family-owned company with 100+ years of history behind it. Our operations span the world, offering you unique paths to growth and success.

Who says you can’t love where you work? With jobs in iconic sports arenas, stunning national parks, exciting casinos, and more, we pride ourselves on giving the world great times in great places. And whether you’re interested in restaurants, hotels, sports, gaming, operations, or retail, part-time or full-time, we’re invested in helping you achieve your career goals.

Together, we’re shaping the future of hospitality — come grow with us!

Delaware North, along with its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer, showcasing job opportunities and considering applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected status.

$ 62354 per year

descriptionHtml:
Business/Reporting Data Analyst

Remote (US-based)

Salary: Starting at $90K


ABOUT US

Come Near is a group of people moved to raise the public conversation about Jesus. They create, curate, and connect people to authentic Jesus stories and experiences. Most widely recognized is the group’s “He Gets Us” campaign, which invites people to reconsider Jesus and has reached millions of Americans since launching in 2021. To learn more, visit comenear.org.


Candidates for this role are required to sign the organization’s Statement of Faith, which closely aligns with Come Near’s mission-driven focus of inviting all people one step closer to the authentic Jesus from wherever they are.


POSITION SUMMARY

Come Near is the nonprofit behind He Gets Us, a campaign that invites people to reconsider Jesus through national media and hegetsus.com. Our analytics team measures how media campaigns turn into visits, engagement, and connection, and helps decide what to do next.


The Business/Reporting Data Analyst turns business questions into clear, well-supported answers. You will identify what the team needs to measure, plan and carry out the analysis, and advise us on which statistical methods to use and how confident we can be in the results. The work ranges from creating dashboards, data reports, and ad hoc requests to deeper analysis, such as estimating how campaigns affect visitor behavior.


You will report to the Director of Analytics and work closely with engineers, product managers, and marketing colleagues, including external agency partners.


We're looking for someone with 4-6 years of experience, and the ability to work independently. You should be equally comfortable with the technical work and with stakeholder conversations.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Meet with stakeholders to understand the decisions they are trying to make, and turn those into clear questions and requirements.
  • Plan analysis work from start to finish, and propose analyses that would help create mission-related insights.
  • Advise the team on how to design tests and experiments: which statistical test to use, how large a sample we need, and how to tell whether a result is significant.
  • Present findings and recommendations in plain language, and be clear about how confident we can be and what the data can't tell us.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards for internal stakeholders.
  • Run in-depth analysis using Python, Pandas, and SQL, including causal analysis of campaign and site data.
  • Answer ad hoc data requests: pull the data, check that it's right, and summarize what it shows.
  • Run recurring data audits and quality checks, including checks that data is complete and up to date, and investigate discrepancies.
  • Handle sensitive audience data, including faith-related journey data, responsibly and in line with our privacy practices.
  • Use git so that analysis is reproducible and reviewable.
  • Track requests in our ticketing system.
  • Keep documentation of reports, metrics, and business definitions current.


REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • 4-6+ years of professional data analytics experience
  • High fluency in Python and Pandas, experience with cleaning, merging, and aggregating messy data, and writing analysis that others can rerun
  • SQL: joins, subqueries, aggregations, and validating results
  • Statistics: regression and its assumptions, hypothesis testing, statistical significance, and confidence intervals
  • Sound statistical judgment: able to choose the right method for a question and explain the result in plain language
  • Git for version control
  • AI-assisted coding tools, with the habit of checking the output for errors
  • Building reports and dashboards in Tableau, Power BI, Looker or other modern BI tools
  • Attention to detail, including spotting data quality problems such as missing, duplicate, or outdated data
  • Clear communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders


BONUS EXPERIENCE

  • Causal inference or experiment design (A/B testing, quasi-experimental methods)
  • Marketing, media, or funnel analytics, or survey data analysis
  • Ticketing tools such as Linear, Jira, or Asana
  • Degree in statistics, economics, data science, or a related field


PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • A personal relationship with Jesus and a passion for Come Near’s mission
  • A heart for service, humility, and collaborative leadership
  • An initiative-taking, meticulous approach to planning and execution


BENEFITS

  • Competitive base salary
  • Annual performance bonus (based on organizational performance)
  • 80% employer-paid health and wellness coverage
  • 403(b) retirement plan with 7% employer match
  • Very generous PTO
  • Three annual company rest weeks (around July 4 and between Christmas and New Years)
  • Flourishing Fund stipend
  • Education Reimbursement stipend annually
  • Much more!

descriptionHtml:
We are partnering with a highly quantitative, data-driven organization seeking a Data Analyst to support reporting, analytics, and data management initiatives across a complex business environment. This role sits at the intersection of data, operations, and business stakeholders, helping answer critical questions, deliver trusted reporting, and improve access to information across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to answer business questions and support decision-making
  • Develop and run SQL-based data extracts from multiple databases and systems
  • Deliver reporting and analytical support for operational, compliance, finance, and business functions
  • Handle ad hoc requests and time-sensitive reporting deliverables
  • Validate data accuracy through reconciliations, cross-checks, and quality control processes
  • Investigate discrepancies and work with stakeholders to ensure reporting integrity
  • Document reporting methodologies, business rules, and data definitions
  • Identify recurring reporting needs and partner with technical teams to develop scalable solutions
  • Help define requirements, business logic, edge cases, and testing criteria for new reporting tools and dashboards
  • Contribute to the development of self-service reporting and business intelligence capabilities


Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, analytics engineering, or a related field
  • Advanced SQL skills with experience writing complex queries, joins, aggregations, and CTEs
  • Python experience for data analysis, automation, and repeatable reporting workflows
  • Experience working with large-scale transactional, operational, or financial datasets
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
  • Ability to communicate methodologies and findings to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience gathering requirements and working with engineering or development teams
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, technical, or related discipline


Preferred Experience

  • Exposure to regulatory, compliance, audit, tax, or financial reporting processes
  • Experience creating scalable reporting frameworks and self-service analytics solutions
  • Familiarity with data governance, controls, and reporting best practices

Niowave is advancing cancer treatment by producing Actinium-225 (Ac-225) with cutting edge linear accelerator technology and radiochemistry. Our innovative approach provides reliable, scalable solutions to help accelerate the fight against cancer.
 
The system uses a superconducting linac instead of a nuclear reactor which is simpler to operate and less costly to license. It also eliminates the need for a nuclear reactor and weapons grade uranium (HEU). The small batch radiochemistry operations can be automated, and do not require licensing as a nuclear reprocessing facility.
 
Isotope production and distribution utilize existing radiopharmaceutical supply chain and FDA approval processes.
