descriptionHtml:
Who We Are…

We are a team of scientists, engineers, technicians, and innovators dedicated to changing the world by developing medical isotopes to treat and eradicate cancer. We believe in building an environment where collaboration, curiosity, and camaraderie thrive. We also enjoy darts, cornhole, ping-pong, chili cook-offs, and other fun events that makes our company a community where we make a life, not just a living.

Who You Are…

You are a data-driven problem solver who enjoys transforming raw information into clear, actionable insights. You thrive in collaborative environments, ask great questions, and enjoy gaining deep understanding of how various processes work.

You are skilled at building dashboards, modeling data, and clarifying the story behind the numbers. You love designing reports that real people rely on every day and you care about data accuracy, structure, and usability. Words that describe you are analytical, curious, precise, proactive, and customer-focused.

What You Can Expect To Work On…

The Senior Data Analyst serves as the primary owner of analytics, reporting, and data insights across the organization. This role blends business-facing analysis with technical data modeling to support various teams.

The Senior Data Analyst develops Power BI dashboards, performs advanced analysis, improves data accessibility, and builds repeatable workflows using Power Apps, Power Automate, and SQL. The role partners closely with subject matter experts to define reporting requirements, translate operational needs into analytics solutions, and promote consistent use of data across Niowave.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets for cross-functional teams
  • Build semantic models, DAX measures, dataflows, and reusable data structures
  • Translate operational and quality requirements into reliable and audit-ready analytics outputs
  • Write SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from internal systems
  • Perform data validation, cleansing, and consistency checks
  • Build analytics and dashboards using data from MasterControl, SharePoint, and other internal platforms


What You Need To Succeed…

  • Embraces and models the Niowave Core Values of Teamwork, Courage, Integrity, and Upright Zeal
  • Understands how to integrate into a new team/organization – appreciates the history of current state, know how and when to make suggestions, as well as using just the right pace to reach the improved future state
  • Understands your own communication and learning styles, can assess others’ styles, and is able to find the right path to best connect with colleagues
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field
  • Advanced proficiency with Power BI, including DAX, data modeling, and dataflows
  • Strong SQL skills for querying and transforming data
  • Experience with Power Apps and Power Automate
  • Experience building reports using data from SharePoint, MasterControl, or similar platforms
  • Experience with Azure SQL and/or Azure analytics tools at the user level
  • Ability to document analyses, models, and workflows clearly


Great to have…

  • 10+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field Experience supporting analytics in regulated, manufacturing, or laboratory environments
  • Experience preparing data requirements for ERP implementations
  • Familiarity with MasterControl reporting structures
  • Experience with Python for analysis or automation


Other Things To Know…

  • Full-time position
  • Niowave’s standard operating hours are Monday – Friday 6:00 a.m. – 6:00 p.m. with production related activities requiring 24/7/365 shifts
  • This position will have regular working hours during Monday - Friday with an expectation of adjusting to working outside of the standard operating hours as needed
  • Niowave has multiple locations within the Lansing area and travel between locations is expected in the role


Please provide a cover letter specifically describing the nature of your background and experience as it relates to this position.

Job Summary

The Justice Services Division of the Community Resources Department is on the hunt for our next "Data Dominator" — a new Data Analyst role!

This isn't a "request comes in, report goes out" job — it's a chance to build something from the ground up. We're bringing data work in-house to strengthen our infrastructure, close longstanding reporting gaps, and turn metrics into real tools for decision-making.

You'll have a hand in it all: building division-wide dashboards from scratch, shaping reporting standards that don't fully exist yet, contributing to a new database management system, and supporting high-stakes work like CJC extended-custody reviews and EPSO quarterly reporting. It's a foundational, division-wide scope that'll only grow as the role matures.

We're looking for 3+ years of experience in data collection, synthesis, or analysis — hands-on with databases, queries, and visualization tools (SQL, BI tools, and beyond). Just as important: the ability to tell a story with data, translate numbers for courts, boards, and the public, and stay steady across stakeholders who each see the data differently.

 If you're curious, comfortable with ambiguity, and as driven by mission as by mechanics — this role was built for you. Apply today!

Hiring Range: $70,000.00 - $79,140.00 Annually

This position has an anticipated work schedule of Monday – Friday 8:00AM – 4:30PM; Hybrid schedule available upon successful completion of the probationary period

 Please be advised this position may close without advance notice, should we receive a sufficient number of qualified applications.

This position analyzes, evaluates, and documents data requirements. Develops a comprehensive data collection and analysis strategy based on functional assignment to evaluate the quality of services, performance, or other business indicators. Identifies and utilizes data solutions to implement data collection; performs data extraction and analysis and presents data. Employment is subject to the terms, conditions, and policies detailed in the Personnel Policies Manual (PPM). This position requires regular in-person presence as an essential job function. This position may be subject to grant funding.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

  • Performs a variety of complex activities involved in the collection, analysis, documentation, and interpretation of data and information related to applicable requirements, initiatives, services, and other activities. Independently draws reasonable and sound conclusions consistent with findings and provides presentations.
  • Develops data solutions, tools, and capabilities to improve data-driven efforts, frameworks, data delivery, or dashboards.
  • Conducts research, compiles data, and uses statistical tools to identify, analyze, and interpret patterns and trends. Isolates potential root causes, projects consequences, draws conclusions from analyzed data, organizes and explains data and assumptions, and provides solutions or recommendations.
  • Designs, validates, and assesses methods of data collection and analysis; develops and implements protocols for data extraction and analysis. Monitors data collection methods and audits data to ensure data collection methodologies and protocols are followed.
  • Works collaboratively with cross-functional teams to produce qualitative and quantitative data analysis that supports organizational objectives and processes, aligning with the strategic plan and associated efforts.
  • Conducts comprehensive and special purpose data analysis, audits, and/or examinations; reviews, evaluates, and measures compliance of programs and processes for quality, effectiveness, and outcomes; assesses adherence to internal policies, regulatory requirements, and other legal mandates. Recommends and implements practices/processes to support data analytics and program
  • Identifies, recommends, and helps to implement process improvement opportunities. Proposes system modifications and devises data management strategies for the organization to improve the quality and usability of data.
  • Serves as the organization’s subject matter expert for function/assignment-specific systems, databases, and data integrity. Develops and oversees training and development of staff on the use of data collection systems and quality assurance, ensuring alignment with policies, procedures, and best practices. Provides technical assistance, troubleshooting, and user support for databases and systems.
  • Leads or participates in data-driven work groups or committees; collaborates with internal and external partners to improve the efficiency of databases and systems; provides recommendations.
  • Utilizes function/assignment knowledge to provide guidance and recommendations to leadership, staff, and external sources regarding department data, policies, procedures, and best practices.
  • Maintains a highly technical working knowledge of industry standards and best practices, as well as relevant regulations, policies, standards, and procedures to improve the organization's operations.
  • Contributes to unified efforts to measure organizational and departmental performance; participates in supporting initiatives, services, and other activities.
  • Gathers, organizes, and prepares data and presentations; provides data-driven presentations at leadership meetings, conferences, or other forums as needed.
  • Performs other duties as required.


Supervision Exercised: This classification does not have supervisory authority; however, may be required to provide expertise or limited guidance or direction to employees, such as overseeing work quality, training, and guidance. Typically serves as a subject matter expert on the scope of functional area.

Supervision Received: Receives general supervision. This classification typically performs job duties by following established standard operating procedures and/or policies. Regular direction, guidance, and coaching from supervisor may be expected. There is a choice of the appropriate procedure or policy to apply to duties. Performance reviewed periodically.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Extensive knowledge and proficiency in the use of automated data systems to perform a variety of complex tasks. Must be receptive to the adoption and application of new and innovative technologies and technological platforms.
  • Working knowledge of office and data analytic software, databases, and business applications.
  • Working knowledge of research methodology, principles, and procedures.
  • Proficiency in Toad, Crystal Reports, Microsoft Power BI, SPSS, and SQL preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to quickly and accurately wrangle, analyze, and interpret data, as well as identify and define data integrity issues and make recommendations for resolution. Ability to collect, synthesize, and analyze data. Ability to develop sound and valid recommendations.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail.
  • Must possess exceptional interpersonal communication skills. Ability to communicate and work effectively with co-workers, clients, other agencies, and the public. Ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Must possess a high level of professionalism and integrity to handle sensitive and confidential situations and information.
  • Ability to build strong working relationships, internal and external to the organization. Ability to work cross-functionally with teams and key stakeholders, utilizing analytical skills in understanding data flows, dissecting problems, and delivering clear recommendations and guidance.
  • Ability to maintain a high level of proficiency related to research and analysis of a variety of data and systems used by the organization and in conjunction with applicable laws, regulations, and policies.
  • Ability to articulate data findings using both technical and non-technical language.
  • Ability to prepare reports and proposals to meet leadership objectives. Ability to write clearly and concisely and with proper respect to spelling, grammar, and punctuation.
  • Ability to assess situations and make prudent and appropriate decisions; ability to apply conflict resolution and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to respond in a flexible manner and reprioritize work as situations change.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Maintain regular and punctual attendance.


Required Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent education.
  • Three years of data collection, synthesis, or analysis experience, including working with databases or statistical software.
    • Associate’s degree in a related field may substitute for one year of the required experience.
    • Bachelor’s degree in a related field may substitute for two years of the required experience.
    • Education substitutions are not cumulative; only the highest qualifying degree will be considered.


Preferred Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in statistics, information systems, or related field.
  • Experience with writing SQL and other data queries and with managing databases.
  • Experience with data visualization tools, such as Power BI.


Licenses/Certificates

  • Must obtain and maintain necessary certifications/licenses as applicable to the position.
  • If assigned to the Digital, Strategy, & Technology Department:
    • Must obtain and maintain Criminal Justice Information System (CJIS) Compliance within six months of employment based on regular access to the Sheriff's Office buildings, systems, and/or networks.


Pre-Employment Requirements

  • Must pass conditional post-offer background investigation and drug screen.


Work Conditions

Duties are primarily performed in an office and remote work environment dependent upon Department discretion and business needs. May be required to work evening and weekend hours.

The classification specification above is intended to describe the general nature of work, key responsibilities, and minimum qualifications. Minimum qualifications reflect the baseline experience required for the classification. Departments may establish additional or preferred qualifications to address operational needs, assignment complexity, and specialized functions, provided such qualifications are job-related, consistent with the intent of the classification, and as approved by the Human Resources department. Specific job assignments, duties, education, experience, licenses/certifications, and working conditions may vary based on the department or office's needs and the requirements of the assigned position. Changes to this classification specification may only be made by the Human Resources Department.

descriptionHtml:
What you'll be part of

Garner is on a mission to transform the U.S. healthcare system — and we're the only proven player doing exactly that. We partner with employers to redesign how healthcare works: applying 550+ proprietary clinical metrics across 80+ specialties to a dataset of 320M+ patients to identify the best-performing doctors, then using compelling incentives to steer members to the care that helps them get healthier, faster.

The result is a rare "win win" — better care and lower costs for both members and employers. In just five years, our work has helped over 2.5 million people access higher-quality care and saved $1B in healthcare costs. We recently raised our Series E and have doubled five years running. If you've ever wanted your work to solve a problem that touches every person in this country, this is the opportunity to do exactly that. You'd be joining a team fundamentally reimagining healthcare in the U.S. — and using AI to scale that impact further and faster than anyone else can.

About the role:

We are seeking an exceptional AI-Native Data Analyst to join Garner and drive how data shapes business decisions at scale. You'll be the person the business trusts to turn fuzzy questions into the metrics, dashboards, and deep-dive analyses that decisions actually get made on — owning that work end-to-end.

Where you will work:

This role will be based in our New York City office (in the Financial District). You must be willing to work in the office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

What you will do:

  • Own KPIs and dashboards end-to-end. Build, maintain, and govern key KPIs and dashboards across business domains, managing the full lifecycle of analytics projects from scoping to delivery.
  • Be a thought partner on measurement. Partner with stakeholders to define how success is measured across Garner's products and operations.
  • Build scalable data pipelines. Collaborate with the data engineering team to create maintainable pipelines that power reliable reporting.
  • Develop deep domain expertise. Build a strong understanding of your analytical domain so you can independently drive meaningful insights.
  • Close reporting gaps. Identify where coverage is missing and proactively develop new dashboards and insights to fill them.
  • Raise the bar on data practices. Advocate for best practices in visualization, documentation, metric consistency, and stakeholder communication across teams.
  • Answer high-stakes, ambiguous questions. Run deep-dive investigations into complex business problems — the kind of analysis leadership uses to make strategic calls.

The ideal candidate has:

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or a similar data-centric role.
  • Cross-functional translation. Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into data-driven solutions and to work effectively with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Autonomy and ownership. Comfortable working independently and owning reporting projects end-to-end.
  • Automation mindset. Attention to detail with a bias toward automation and scalability over one-off work.
  • AI Nativity. Comfort with and excitement about building analytics, building dashboards, and validating results by harnessing the power of AI agents.
  • Making data accessible. A track record of getting stakeholders trustworthy, self-serve access to the information they need. Experience with a BI/visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar) helps — but the outcome matters more than the specific tool.
  • Modern data stack. Hands-on with Snowflake (or a comparable cloud warehouse) and SQL at scale; experience with dbt strongly preferred — you'll partner with Data Management in governed pipelines, not just consume their outputs.
  • A desire to be part of a high-performing, mission-driven team that operates with intense urgency, a strong sense of individual accountability, and a commitment to authentic feedback.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing company in a transformative role, helping shape the future of healthcare.

What you'll get here:

You'll work on problems that matter, at a company working to change healthcare at scale. You'll work at the intersection of AI and systemic healthcare reform, where the problems we solve are as interesting and compelling as the mission.

At Garner, you'll take on real, ambitious problems with real ownership and autonomy, alongside exceptional, principles-based people who genuinely want you to win. It's demanding by design. You'll be challenged to stretch beyond what you thought possible and receive consistent coaching to help you grow and do the best work of your career. This isn't the right fit for everyone, and that's intentional. The people here are driven by what's at stake for real people, and that's what gives our intensity its purpose.

Compensation Transparency:

The target salary range for this position is $167,000 - $210,000. Individual compensation for this role will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, and applicable laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans, including but not limited to: flexible PTO, Medical/Dental/Vision plan options, 401(k), Teladoc Health and more.

Fraud and Security Notice:

Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our recruiters use getgarner.com and garnerhealth.com email domains exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a Garner recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement here and to candidateprotection@garnerhealth.com.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Garner Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Garner Health is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@garnerhealth.com.

Boyd Gaming Corporation has been successful in gaming jurisdiction in which we operate in the United States and is one of the premier casino entertainment companies in the United States. Never content to rest upon our successes, we will continue to evolve and retain a position of leadership in our industry.

Our past success, our current business philosophies and our sound business planning, combine to position Boyd Gaming Corporation to maximize value for our shareholders, our team members and our communities.

Job Description

POSITION IS ON SITE IN LAS VEGAS, NV

As a Data Analyst, you will deliver reports and analyses that look at historical and current views of the business to support key partners in decision making. You will be responsible for the analysis of your assigned region and properties marketing initiatives. Success will be measured by your ability to provide insights that solve business challenges as well as your ability to provide highly consumable data to the organization.

  • Support direct marketing, special events, and promotional activities through robust performance analysis, test design and analysis, and ad-hoc analysis.
  • Analyze large data sources to understand key drivers of the business.
  • Execute assigned projects from inception to completion. This includes clearly understanding the problem or question, executing the analysis, developing insights, and presenting findings to the business.
  • Design, create, and maintain dashboards and reports that track key metrics across the business for the purpose of monitoring the health of the business.
  • Provide clear, insightful, and meaningful analysis that supports decision making.
  • Create and maintain documentation of processes.
  • Develop and maintain a positive working relationship with the properties and other corporate departments.
  • Apply predictive modeling, segmentation, forecasting, and multivariate analysis techniques to solve business challenges and maximize business performance.
  • Assist properties with their marketing campaigns when needed.
  • Write SQL, Python, R, SSIS, etc. to extract, manipulate, and move data within the Boyd Gaming technology stack.

Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as business analytics, statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or closely related field required.
  • Working knowledge of tools such as SQL, Python, R, SAS, or SPSS required.
  • Working knowledge of BI tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, or Power BI required.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office.
  • Inquisitive analytic thinking.
  • Organized and detail oriented with strong attention to accuracy.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain any necessary licenses and/or certifications.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Boyd Gaming is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Analyst, Operations Analytics is a highly visible role focused on using data to shape business strategy, improve operational performance, and strengthen the client and participant experience. This individual will partner directly with senior leaders across Operations, Client Experience, Product, and Technology to tackle complex, often ambiguous business problems. The role goes beyond reporting and traditional analytics: you will help define the right questions, connect insights across the organization, develop recommendations, and influence how leaders make decisions. This is an opportunity for someone who wants broad business exposure, meaningful ownership, and the ability to help shape a growing analytics capability.

Key Responsibilities


  • Partner with senior business leaders to frame complex problems and determine how data and analytics can inform decisions.
  • Lead high-impact analytical work from problem definition through insight, recommendation, and measurement of results.
  • Connect operational, client experience, digital, and other data to develop a more complete view of business performance.
  • Identify emerging trends, risks, friction points, and opportunities before they become established business problems.
  • Translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and executive-ready narratives.
  • Develop measurement frameworks and trusted metrics that help leaders understand performance and prioritize action.
  • Partner across Operations, Product, Technology, and Client Experience to influence strategy and improve business outcomes.
  • Challenge existing assumptions and identify opportunities to improve processes, experiences, and analytical capabilities.
  • Help evolve how analytics is used across Operations—from primarily reporting what happened to proactively influencing what happens next.
  • Mentor other analysts and contribute to analytical standards and best practices across the team.


In This Role, You Will


  • Have direct exposure to senior leaders and high-priority business initiatives.
  • Own meaningful business problems rather than simply execute analytical requests.
  • Influence decisions that affect operational performance and the participant and client experience.
  • Work across multiple business areas and datasets rather than being limited to a single product or initiative.
  • Help define new metrics, analytical approaches, and ways of measuring business performance.
  • Turn data into recommendations that drive action.
  • Play an important role in shaping the future of the Operations Analytics function.


Qualifications

Required


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 4–7 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, product analytics, strategy, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working through complex and ambiguous business questions.
  • Experience using data to develop insights and recommendations, not simply produce reporting.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with large, complex datasets.
  • Experience with visualization and analytical tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex ideas to senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated ability to build relationships and influence across teams without direct authority.


Preferred


  • Experience with Python, R, or other advanced analytical tools.
  • Experience in product analytics, customer experience, operational analytics, or business strategy.
  • Financial services or other complex, regulated-industry experience.
  • Experience developing measurement frameworks or using analytics to influence product or operational strategy.


Success Profile

The strongest candidate will:


  • Be intellectually curious and naturally ask why, not simply what.
  • Be comfortable taking an ambiguous problem and creating structure around it.
  • Think like a business leader who happens to have strong analytical capabilities.
  • Look across organizational boundaries to connect data, problems, and opportunities.
  • Bring a point of view and recommendations rather than waiting to be told what analysis to perform.
  • Communicate with credibility and simplicity at senior levels.
  • Balance strategic thinking with the ability to get into the data when necessary.
  • Take ownership and drive work forward in an environment where priorities continue to evolve.


Why Join Our Team

Operations Analytics is evolving from a traditional reporting and analytics function into a strategic capability that helps leaders understand what is happening, why it is happening, and what they should do next.

This role provides the opportunity to work on some of the organization’s most important operational and client experience challenges, partner directly with senior leaders, and help shape how analytics is used to make decisions. For someone who wants to broaden their business exposure, take on meaningful ownership, and build toward larger leadership opportunities, this role provides a strong platform to do so.

Special Factors

Sponsorship

Vanguard is not offering visa sponsorship for this position.

About Vanguard

At Vanguard, we don't just have a mission—we're on a mission.

To work for the long-term financial wellbeing of our clients. To lead through product and services that transform our clients' lives. To learn and develop our skills as individuals and as a team. From Malvern to Melbourne, our mission drives us forward and inspires us to be our best.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About The Role

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will design, build, and own the analytics that ShipStation Global’s business teams use to make decisions. This role sits between the data platform built by data engineering and the business and is responsible for performing data discovery, defining and governing metrics, and analysis activities to identify specific information required to support client decisions and then present these results in a meaningful and intuitive format, using a variety of BI tools and techniques.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, genuinely curious about how the business operates, and comfortable working through ambiguity — able to sit down with a stakeholder, ask the questions that surface the real decision behind the request, define the problem, and then engineer a durable solution. Equally important is the judgment to push back when what was asked for is not what is actually needed, and the communication skills to explain why.

This position is hybrid (3 days per week in office) and is located in Austin or Dallas, Texas.

About The Team

The Senior Data Analyst designs, builds, and owns the analytics that ShipStation Global’s business teams use to make decisions. This role sits between the data platform built by data engineering and the business and is responsible for performing data discovery, defining and governing metrics, and analysis activities to identify specific information required to support client decisions and then present these results in a meaningful and intuitive format, using a variety of BI tools and techniques.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, genuinely curious about how the business operates, and comfortable working through ambiguity — able to sit down with a stakeholder, ask the questions that surface the real decision behind the request, define the problem, and then engineer a durable solution. Equally important is the judgment to push back when what was asked for is not what is actually needed, and the communication skills to explain why.

What will you be doing?

  • Partner directly with business stakeholders to turn ambiguous requests into well-defined analytics deliverables.
    • Lead discovery conversations with Finance, Accounting, Sales, Marketing, and Product to uncover the underlying decision or business problem behind each request.
    • Translate open-ended asks into documented requirements: metric definitions, grain, dimensionality, filters, refresh cadence, and clear acceptance criteria.
    • Challenge assumptions and propose better framing when the requested output would not actually answer the question being asked.
  • Design, build, and maintain analytics data models.
    • Develop modular, tested, version-controlled transformation models in dbt on BigQuery — and on Databricks as the ShipStation Global platform expands — following layered staging, intermediate, and mart patterns.
    • Write advanced SQL: window functions, incremental logic, complex joins, and query tuning through partitioning, clustering, and cost-aware design.
    • Implement data quality controls such as dbt tests, source freshness checks, and anomaly monitoring so that breakages are caught before stakeholders find them.
    • Work in Git with pull-request review and CI/CD, treating analytics code as production software.
  • Own the semantic layer and BI delivery.
    • Develop and maintain LookML views, explores, derived tables, and reusable measures so that each metric is defined once and reported consistently everywhere.
    • Build and maintain Looker dashboards, Looks, schedules, and alerts; develop Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and reports as the ShipStation Global reporting stack consolidates between data & reporting platforms.
    • Optimize dashboard performance and query cost; manage content organization, folder structure, and row-level access controls.
    • Enable self-service by documenting metric definitions, training stakeholders, and building durable assets that reduce recurring ad hoc requests.
  • Deliver analysis and insight, not just reports.
    • Perform exploratory and root-cause analysis to explain what is driving movement in sales volume, revenue, margin, customer retention, and operational performance.
    • Reconcile analytics output against source systems and finance reporting, investigating discrepancies and explaining them clearly.
    • Write up findings, caveats, and recommendations in plain language for a non-technical executive audience.
  • Support platform modernization and post-merger integration.
    • Contribute to migrating, rationalizing, and consolidating reporting assets as ShipStation Global standardizes its data and BI stack across GCP and BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, and Power BI.
    • Automate recurring manual reporting using Python and scheduled orchestration.
  • Maintain documentation, standards, and data governance.
    • Document models, metric definitions, and data lineage in dbt docs and Confluence so that institutional knowledge does not live in a single person’s head.
    • Follow and help improve team standards for naming, testing, code review, and release management.
    • Handle sensitive customer, financial, and employee data in accordance with company security and privacy policy.
The ideal candidate is highly analytical, genuinely curious about how the business operates, and comfortable working through ambiguity — able to sit down with a stakeholder, ask the questions that surface the real decision behind the request, define the problem, and then engineer a durable solution. Equally important is the judgment to push back when what was asked for is not what is actually needed, and the communication skills to explain why.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Analytics, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or a related quantitative field; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • 5+ years of experience building business intelligence and analytics solutions on a cloud data platform.
  • 3+ years of advanced SQL in a production analytics environment.
  • 3+ years of hands-on dbt experience building and maintaining production models.
  • 3+ years of dashboard and report development in a modern BI tool; Looker and LookML strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering requirements directly from business stakeholders with limited direction or supervision.
  • Working experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery.
  • Proficiency with Python and with Git-based development workflows.

What will make you stand out?

  • Advanced SQL, including complex analytical queries, window functions, and performance and cost optimization against columnar cloud warehouses.
  • Hands-on analytics engineering with dbt: modular models, tests, macros, snapshots, documentation, and deployment through CI/CD.
  • Working depth in at least one modern cloud data warehouse or lakehouse — BigQuery, Databricks, or equivalent — including partitioning, clustering, incremental strategies, and cost management.
  • Semantic layer development in LookML or an equivalent metrics modeling layer.
  • Dashboard and report development in a modern BI platform such as Looker, Power BI, or Tableau, with a strong grasp of visualization and information design principles.
  • Python for automation, data manipulation, and API integration.
  • Adept at using AI tools such as Claude Code, Gemini Enterprise, Replit, etc
  • Git-based version control and collaborative code review.
  • The ability to operate effectively without fully specified requirements: define the problem, scope the work, state assumptions, and communicate trade-offs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain a metric definition or an analytical caveat to a non-technical audience.
  • Genuine business curiosity and a willingness to learn how shipping, logistics, and subscription revenue actually work by digging into source systems and talking to the people who run the business.
  • Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent stakeholders and shifting priorities.

The Tech

  • Databricks experience such as Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, SQL Warehouses, or PySpark.

  • Experience supporting Finance and Accounting analytics, such as revenue, billing, and margin reconciliation.

We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

descriptionHtml:
The Business Analyst is a hands-on role on the Business Intelligence team in CSP's IT department. You will report to the Business Intelligence Manager and work day to day with users in Finance, Operations, Sales, and Procurement. You will also work closely with the Technical BI team in IT, who build our data platform and production dashboards.

We want to replace manual Excel reporting with automated, self-service dashboards built on agreed data definitions and standard KPIs. Much of that work lands with you. You will document how each report gets produced today, write user stories and KPI definitions, build mockups and prototypes, test what the Technical BI team builds, and teach people to use it. You will also analyze what is driving business performance and present your findings to stakeholders, sometimes including the Senior Leadership Team.

This is a new role on a new team. We haven't yet settled how BI work gets requested, built, tested, and rolled out here, and you will help decide. You will also see how every major function in the business uses its numbers.

Responsibilities:

1. Discovery and requirements:

  • Stay informed on new dashboard, report, and analytics requests as they come through intake, so you are ready to support Discovery once a request is prioritized and assigned.
  • Support the BI Manager in Discovery sessions with the Dashboard Sponsor and Dashboard Owner. Help map how business users produce their reports today, including data sources, manual steps, and where things break.
  • Own BI Spec Development. Turn business needs into functional requirements the Technical BI team can build from, such as user stories, acceptance criteria, KPI definitions, data mappings, and dashboard mockups. The BI Manager reviews and approves each spec.
  • Pull program metrics for the BI Manager’s reviews, including request volume, cycle time, adoption, and data quality issues.

2. Build support and analysis:

  • Support the BI Data Engineers during Data Mapping by answering requirement questions and confirming each KPI connects to the right source data.
  • Support the dashboard development partner during Dashboard Building by clarifying requirements and checking that each build matches the spec.
  • Write SQL queries and build Power BI prototypes to test requirements, explore data, and answer one-off business questions.
  • Run variance, trend, and driver analysis on financial and operational data, and write up what you find with a recommendation.

3. Data quality, definitions, and testing:

  • Work with dashboard owners to reconcile BI outputs to source systems and financial statements. When the numbers don’t tie, work with dashboard owners and the technical team until they do.
  • Lead user acceptance testing with the Dashboard Owner before each release. Write test scripts, log defects, and follow each one until it is fixed.
  • Log data quality issues and explain their business impact to the BI Manager so the team can work with dashboard owners to discuss corrective actions

4. Deployment, training, and adoption:

  • Own Deployment Prep for each release. Make sure documentation, and access are ready before a dashboard goes live, and coordinate the rollout and training with the Dashboard Owner.
  • Develop user guides, and quick-reference sheets for new dashboards and BI tools.
  • Answer first-line questions from business users about dashboards, what the data means, and access. Pass technical issues to the Technical BI team.
  • Track active users, report usage, and the share of reporting done through self-service. Tell the BI Manager where adoption is falling behind.

Preferred experience and skills:

We want an analyst who likes digging into data, asks good questions, and can explain a finding to someone who doesn’t work with data every day. If you enjoy chasing down the one number that doesn’t tie out, you will do well here.

  • 2-4+ years in business analysis, business intelligence, data analytics, or financial analysis. Manufacturing or industrial experience is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in a major BI platform. Power BI is strongly preferred, and we will also consider Tableau or Qlik.
  • Working SQL skills and an understanding of basic data modeling, such as fact and dimension tables, joins, and relationships.
  • Advanced Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, and Power Query.
  • A solid grounding in finance and accounting, including the P&L, balance sheet, and cost accounting. You need to understand the data well enough to question it.
  • An understanding of manufacturing and operations would be helpful.
  • Experience gathering and documenting business requirements through user stories, process maps, or functional specifications.
  • Experience with data validation, reconciliation, and user acceptance testing.
  • Clear writing and speaking, including explaining analysis to non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to juggle several requests at once, work on your own or with a team, and keep the details right.

Education:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or another quantitative field is required.

Personal attributes:

  • Storyteller. You can turn a table of numbers into one chart and two sentences a busy plant manager will read.
  • Careful with numbers. You reconcile to the source before you hit send. You would rather find your own mistake than have a VP find it.
  • Curious. When a number moves, you want to know why.
  • Collaborative. You are comfortable working with plant supervisors and data engineers in the same week, and you can translate between them.
  • Eager to grow. You take pride in your work and want to keep building your analytics and BI skills.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.

About The Role

Rho’s data has two types of consumers: people and AI agents. As our data analyst, you will empower both with reliable data and meaningful insights. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role that involves everything from data pipelining to delivering recommendations. You will model new data for Rho’s latest features and product lines. You will build the semantic layer that defines how Rho measures itself and turn analyses into decisions with stakeholders across the whole business.

The increased adoption of agentic tools and the acceleration of Rho’s own product velocity result in more people consuming data, more data-backed outputs, and even more business questions to answer. More than ever, it’s imperative that a data team ensures reliable self-service data for routine reporting or inbound requests while being hands-on for deeper analysis that drives decision-making.

You’re accountable for faster and data-driven decision-making, not for the number of dashboards or reports built. This is a cross-functional role that will interface with data engineering as well as business-side stakeholders from GTM, Product, and other departments. This role is based in our New York office and reports to our Manager, Product Analytics who is also based there.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive business decision-making by working directly with stakeholders across the company to scope ambiguous questions, conduct analyses, and transform analyses into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Proactively uncover opportunity areas as a holder of domain knowledge across verticals. Operate flexibly across verticals and function as a subject matter expert on data sources and key metrics.
  • Empower Rho’s internal data consumers. Enhance data enablement through building and maintaining models via dbt. Own the end-to-end process: onboard raw warehouse data, add relevant tests and documentation, curate end-user tables, and debug any subsequent breakages.
  • Ensure that data is accurate and useful for end-users, analysts, and AI agents by collaborating with data engineering and sharing relevant business context.
  • Uphold data integrity and governance standards by maintaining consistent metric definitions within the dbt semantic layer.
  • Own BI reporting for multiple verticals, ranging from Compliance to GTM. Build or tune any required reporting, and safely deprecate obsolete assets.

What You Bring

  • 2 to 4 years of experience as a data analyst, business analyst, analytics engineer, business intelligence engineer, or similar role
  • A growth mindset and ability to quickly learn about new business domains or product surface areas in a fast-moving environment
  • Outstanding SQL ability, and particularly comfortable with debugging complex logic
  • Track record of translating data insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders
  • Hands-on experience building models in dbt or similar data transformation frameworks
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to adapt to audiences of varying technical backgrounds
  • You already use AI to move faster, whether it’s by automating repetitive tasks or drafting initial analyses. You are curious about what’s next.
  • Prior experience in building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Omni, Hex, Tableau, and other business intelligence or analytical tools

Nice to Have

  • Experience working in financial services, banking, technology or a fast-paced startup
  • Experience supporting multiple verticals or departments simultaneously
  • Experience building out a dbt semantic layer and refining the warehouse as a surface area for both humans and AI agents
  • Familiarity with machine learning concepts and predictive analytics

Pay

  • Our target compensation range for this role is: $120K to $150K, with variation based on relevant experience, skills, and business needs. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

You will build the semantic layer that defines how Rho measures itself and turn analyses into decisions with stakeholders across the whole business.

The increased adoption of agentic tools and the acceleration of Rho’s own product velocity result in more people consuming data, more data-backed outputs, and even more business questions to answer. More than ever, it’s imperative that a data team ensures reliable self-service data for routine reporting or inbound requests while being hands-on for deeper analysis that drives decision-making.

You’re accountable for faster and data-driven decision-making, not for the number of dashboards or reports built. This is a cross-functional role that will interface with data engineering as well as business-side stakeholders from GTM, Product, and other departments. This role is based in our New York office and reports to our Manager, Product Analytics who is also based there.

What You’ll Do



- Drive business decision-making by working directly with stakeholders across the company to scope ambiguous questions, conduct analyses, and transform analyses into clear, actionable recommendations.
- Proactively uncover opportunity areas as a holder of domain knowledge across verticals. Operate flexibly across verticals and function as a subject matter expert on data sources and key metrics.
- Empower Rho’s internal data consumers. Enhance data enablement through building and maintaining models via dbt. Own the end-to-end process: onboard raw warehouse data, add relevant tests and documentation, curate end-user tables, and debug any subsequent breakages.
- Ensure that data is accurate and useful for end-users, analysts, and AI agents by collaborating with data engineering and sharing relevant business context.
- Uphold data integrity and governance standards by maintaining consistent metric definitions within the dbt semantic layer.
- Own BI reporting for multiple verticals, ranging from Compliance to GTM. Build or tune any required reporting, and safely deprecate obsolete assets.

What You Bring



- 2 to 4 years of experience as a data analyst, business analyst, analytics engineer, business intelligence engineer, or similar role
- A growth mindset and ability to quickly learn about new business domains or product surface areas in a fast-moving environment
- Outstanding SQL ability, and particularly comfortable with debugging complex logic
- Track record of translating data insights into actionable recommendations for stakeholders
- Hands-on experience building models in dbt or similar data transformation frameworks
- Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to adapt to audiences of varying technical backgrounds
- You already use AI to move faster, whether it’s by automating repetitive tasks or drafting initial analyses. You are curious about what’s next.
- Prior experience in building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Omni, Hex, Tableau, and other business intelligence or analytical tools

Nice to Have



- Experience working in financial services, banking, technology or a fast-paced startup
- Experience supporting multiple verticals or departments simultaneously
- Experience building out a dbt semantic layer and refining the warehouse as a surface area for both humans and AI agents
- Familiarity with machine learning concepts and predictive analytics

Pay



- Our target compensation range for this role is: $120K to $150K, with variation based on relevant experience, skills, and business needs. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

descriptionHtml:
Position Details


Lakeland Regional Health is a leading medical center located in Central Florida. With a legacy spanning over a century, we have been dedicated to serving our community with excellence in healthcare. As the only designated Level 1 Trauma Center for Polk, Highlands, and Hardee counties, and the second busiest Emergency Department in the US, we are committed to providing high-quality care to our diverse patient population. Our facility is licensed for 910 beds and handles over 200,000 emergency room visits annually, along with 49,000 inpatient admissions, 21,000 surgical cases, 4,000 births, and 101,000 outpatient visits.


Work Hours per Biweekly Pay Period: 80.00

Shift: Monday - Friday

Location: 210 South Florida Avenue Lakeland, FL

Pay Rate: Min $85,488.00 Mid $106,870.40


Position Summary


Join our dynamic Analytics team supporting high level strategic priorities directly connected to Executive Leadership's top priorities. The Business Intelligence Developer role is responsible for understanding and gathering business requirements, solution design, implementation and testing. Utilizing data visualization best practices is a must to ensure that the message is communicated in the most effective way possible.


Position Responsibilities


People At The Heart Of All We Do

  • Fosters an inclusive and engaged environment through teamwork and collaboration.
  • Ensures patients and families have the best possible experiences across the continuum of care.
  • Communicates appropriately with patients, families, team members, and our community in a manner that treasures all people as uniquely created.


Safety And Performance Improvement

  • Behaves in a mindful manner focused on self, patient, visitor, and team safety.
  • Demonstrates accountability and commitment to quality work.
  • Participates actively in process improvement and adoption of standard work.


Stewardship

  • Demonstrates responsible use of LRH's resources including people, finances, equipment and facilities.
  • Knows and adheres to organizational and department policies and procedures.


Standard Work: Business Intelligence Developer II

  • Using reporting tools to help your stakeholders improve their performance, and understand the who, what, where, when and why behind their outcomes.
  • Understanding your business stakeholders’ objectives, the metrics that are the most important to them, and how they measure their performance.
  • Turning business requirements into technical requirements.
  • Finding and understanding the correct data sources for a given analysis.
  • Learning from, and sharing knowledge and skills with your teammates to grow impact to the organization.
  • QA Audits and troubleshooting issues.


Competencies & Skills


Essential:

  • Experience with EPIC EHR
  • Critical thinking, collaboration, flexibility, project/task ownership, system improvement (computerized or manual), project management, consultation and conflict management, organization and time management and attention to detail.
  • Knowledge and skills in business intelligence methodologies and tools (Tableau, Business Objects, OBIEE, Qlikview, ect..)
  • T-SQL or equivalency to query data from data warehouse


Nonessential:

  • Experience with Tableau or equivalency to create impactful reports, visualizations, and interactive dashboards.


Qualifications & Experience


Essential:

  • Bachelor Degree


Essential:

  • Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field


Other information:

Experience Essential:

  • 5+ years building reports/dashboards


Certifications Essential:

  • Epic - Cogito

Data Analyst - Salaried/Exempt Position

City Electric Supply (CES)

Hybrid schedule: 4 days onsite, 1 day remote

Office Address: 400 South Record Street, Dallas, TX 75202


Looking to start an exciting new career? City Electric Supply offers excellent career opportunities for people who are friendly, motivated, and passionate about providing incredible customer service.


About City Electric Supply

CES is a family-owned electrical wholesaler with the benefits of a worldwide service network and the personal service of a neighborhood store. Our "customer service first" core value has allowed us to grow continually for over 65 years while keeping our founding principle of empowering people to make local business decisions. CES now employs more than 7,400 people at over 1,000 branches world-wide of which there are over 500 branches across North America. Our vision is to add 30-35 branches a year, while staying true to our Company values.


Summary

Reporting to the BI Manager, the Data Analyst is a hands on Power BI expert who builds and supports the reports our Wholesale and Inhouse divisions rely on every day. You will design and own Power BI reports and dashboards, serve as first line support for BI tickets and incidents, and help raise the level of our BI team by bringing strong technical depth, sound modeling practices, and ideas for streamlining and automating how we work.


Essential Job Functions

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards for the Wholesale and Inhouse divisions.
  • Develop data models, DAX measures, and Power Query transformations that keep reports accurate, fast, and easy to use.
  • Optimize existing Power BI reports for performance and usability.
  • Publish and manage reports in the Power BI Service, including workspaces, refresh schedules, and security.
  • Serve as first line support for BI tickets, emails, and incidents, replying to tickets within 24 hours.
  • Call stakeholders to understand issues and guide them through basic troubleshooting.
  • Pick up minor changes, enhancements, and bug fixes from the BI Support board as part of business as usual work.
  • Own initial contacts on the BI feedback process and convert IT tickets into feedback requests when raised by the Wholesale division, with senior support as needed.
  • Adhere to core SLAs for incoming tickets and share support performance with senior team members in stand ups.
  • Identify automations and optimizations that streamline BI support and reporting.
  • Work with other IT teams to find answers or redirect requests where appropriate.
  • Assist with other administrative duties as assigned by the BI Manager when support workload is low.


Education/Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in a Data Analyst role.
  • 5+ years of hands on Power BI experience, including DAX, Power Query, and data modeling.
  • 3+ years of SQL experience.
  • Experience publishing and managing reports in the Power BI Service.
  • IT literate, preferably with the Microsoft Office package.
  • JIRA and AWS Redshift experience is a plus.


Competencies

  • Advanced Power BI skills with a track record of building reports that stakeholders actually use.
  • Good conversational and stakeholder facing communication skills.
  • Genuine interest in data and the impact it has on a business.
  • Positive attitude and self starter mindset, with strong accountability and a good sense of what professional support looks like.
  • Ability to manage multiple tickets and priorities at the same time.


Benefits Offered

  • Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance.
  • 401(k) company match program.
  • Telehealth.
  • Short-term and Long-term disability insurance.
  • Basic and AD&D Life Insurance paid for by the company.
  • Critical Illness, Hospital Confinement, Accident Insurance, Supplemental Life Insurance.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Mental, physical, financial wellness.
  • Auto and Home Insurance discount.
  • Paid Time Off and 7 paid Holidays.
  • Paid Pregnancy, Parental, and Adoption Leave programs.
  • Employee Discount Program.
  • Training Programs.
  • Internal growth opportunities in a fast-growing company.
  • In some jurisdictions, state or local laws address sick leave or other leaves of absence. The Company complies with all such laws. This policy shall apply only to the extent it does not conflict with applicable law.


Supervisory Responsibility

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.


Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, stooping, and climbing. The employee must be able to lift and move items up to 50 pounds.

Overview

At KeHE, we’re obsessed with creating solutions, unboxing potential, and serving others - and it all starts with you. As an employee-owned distributor of natural and organic, specialty, and fresh products, we’re committed to making a positive impact and scaling our success together. With a culture that fosters development and opportunity, you’ll be embarking on a career that’s moving forward. When you join KeHE, you’re becoming part of a team that is a force for good.

Primary Responsibilities

The Sr Analyst, Revenue Reporting will help drive profitable revenue growth at KeHE by developing dashboards and ad hoc analysis that deliver strategic insights. Drawing on expertise in reporting, this role will develop dashboards giving visibility into performance drivers, predictive KPIs, and financial outcomes like revenue performance, customer margin, pricing impact, and profitability and maintain a structured commercial reporting cadence, leveraging large datasets for predictive analysis, improving dashboard usability in Power BI, and delivering executive-ready insights that support strategic decisions. As with all positions at KeHE Distributors, we expect that all actions will be consistent with KeHE’s Mission, Vision, and Values.

Essential Functions

DUTIES, TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop expertise in KeHE’s revenue, profitability, and KPI data, existing reporting, and standard measurements with areas of focus including revenue by channel and product, event ROI, pricing impact, gross-to-net performance, customer churn, and margin dynamics.
  • Design, optimize, and maintain effective Power BI semantic models to enable scalable, high-performance reporting.
  • Establish standardized measures and reusable data structures to ensure dashboard consistency throughout the organization.
  • Build and maintain a structured weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting cadence that consolidates insights from multiple sources into actionable, easy-to-digest summaries aligned to Commercial and Revenue Management priorities.
  • Analyze historical performance and trends to identify actionable insights and present findings in a clear, concise format tailored to executive and commercial stakeholders.
  • Continuously improve management reporting through automation, refined KPI frameworks, and enhanced dashboard usability in Power BI; improve data visualization, layout, and user experience (UX/UI).
  • Leverage large, complex datasets to deliver customer- and product-level insights via statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and segmentation analysis.
  • Perform ad hoc analytics to support leadership requests, using data visualizations and written narratives summarize findings.
  • Identify and address data quality issues and upstream data dependencies impacting the revenue reporting.
  • Maintain documentation of Power BI models, business rules, data sources, and system knowledge to ensure transparency and accountability for published reports.
  • Leverage SQL and DAX to extract, transform, and model data across large, complex datasets.
  • Leverage workflow automation tools (e.g., Power Query, Power Automate, Power Apps) to streamline reporting processes, reduce manual effort, and improve accuracy.

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES:

  • Proficiency in Power BI, with advanced skills in SQL and DAX.
  • Strong understanding of semantic modeling principles that drive consistency, performance, and reliability in enterprise reporting.
  • Proficiency in leveraging automation tools (e.g., Power Query, Power Automate) to streamline reporting and improve accuracy.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and communication skills.
  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and ability to manage confidential or sensitive information with discretion.

Minimum Requirements, Qualifications, Additional Skills, Aptitude

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Finance, Accounting or related field required.
  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in financial, commercial, or operational analytics, preferably within food distribution, retail, or consumer goods.

descriptionHtml:
The Senior Analyst serves as a strategic data partner to both Sales and Operations, enabling data-driven decision-making across key business priorities. This role will deliver actionable insights on performance, develop and maintain dashboards to track key initiatives and perform other ad hoc analyses. The Senior Analyst will support the organization by working closely with cross-functional leaders to translate complex data into clear recommendations, help guide strategy, improve execution, and drive business outcomes.


The candidate shall operate in a telecommuting role, with primary working hours to be flexibly scheduled within the window of 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.


Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

(95%) Analytics

  • Serve as a strategic data partner to Sales and Operations, providing insights and recommendations to support key priorities and drive business performance
  • Design, develop, and maintain Tableau dashboards that track KPIs and strategic initiatives, incorporating end-user feedback and best practices
  • Deliver ongoing performance reporting for Sales and Operations leadership, ensuring visibility into results and drivers of performance
  • Conduct ad hoc and recurring analyses to support leadership decision-making, including building presentations and communicating findings to stakeholders
  • Utilize SQL or other similar programming languages to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Support data integration and analytics for acquisitions and new site launches, including modeling exam and order volumes
  • Collaborate with IT and data management teams to support and enhance the broader Data Strategy

(5%) Completes other tasks and projects as assigned


COMPETENCIES (KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES) REQUIRED:

  • Knowledge of and adherence to company policies and protocols
  • Knowledge of and adherence to HIPAA and safety guidelines
  • Knowledge of business intelligence principles, data analytics methodologies, and key performance indicators used to evaluate business performance and support strategic priorities.
  • Knowledge of data visualization, dashboard design, data modeling, and data integration best practices.
  • Knowledge of Sales and Operations performance metrics, business drivers, and forecasting methodologies to support decision-making and operational planning.
  • Skill in designing, developing, and maintaining Tableau dashboards and performance reports that track KPIs and strategic initiatives.
  • Skill in utilizing SQL and similar programming languages to extract, transform, analyze, and interpret complex datasets.
  • Skill in conducting ad hoc and recurring analyses, modeling exam and order volumes, and developing actionable business recommendations.
  • Skill in preparing executive presentations and communicating analytical findings, trends, and performance drivers to stakeholders.
  • Skill in collaborating with Sales, Operations, IT, and data management teams to enhance reporting capabilities and support enterprise data strategy initiatives.
  • Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights that inform leadership decisions and improve business performance.
  • Ability to manage multiple analytical priorities, incorporate stakeholder feedback, and deliver accurate, timely, and reliable analytical solutions.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistic, Mathematics, Engineering, Finance, Economics, Health Administration, or other closely related fields
  • 4+ years in analytic roles
  • 3+ years of experience with SQL or other similar programming language to manipulate and extract large datasets.
  • 3+ years of experience designing and managing dashboards in Tableau or PowerBI
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel
  • Salesforce experience a plus
  • Candidates with experience in healthcare environments supporting provider practices, hospitals, or value-based care organizations are strongly preferred

descriptionHtml:
The Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data solutions that support business operations and strategic decision-making. Transforming complex data from multiple sources into meaningful insights, reports, dashboards, and performance metrics. The Business Intelligence Analyst works closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements, ensure data integrity, identify trends, and provide actionable recommendations through advanced analytics, data modeling, and visualization techniques.


Requirements


  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and database querying.
  • Experience utilizing Python, R, or similar scripting languages for data analysis and automation.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, data manipulation, and reporting automation.
  • Experience developing dashboards and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, Domo or similar BI tools.
  • Experience working with large, complex datasets from multiple sources.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to transform complex data into actionable business insights.
  • Knowledge of data modeling, data warehousing concepts, and database structures.
  • Ability to identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and opportunities within large datasets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Resourceful and innovative in diagnosing and resolving technical and business challenges.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects while maintaining attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong collaboration skills with the ability to build effective relationships across departments and organizational levels
